PetalburgCity_Text_WhereIsWally.current: Where has our WALLY gone? //  We have to leave for VERDANTURF TOWN /  very soon…

PetalburgCity_Text_WaterReflection.current: My face is reflected in the water. //  It's a shining grin full of hope… //  Or it could be a look of somber silence /  struggling with fear… //  What do you see reflected in your face?

PetalburgCity_Text_FullPartyExplanation.current: Let's say you have six POKéMON. /  If you catch another one… //  It is automatically sent to a STORAGE /  BOX over a PC connection.

PetalburgCity_Text_AreYouRookieTrainer.current: Hiya! Are you maybe… /  A rookie TRAINER? //  Do you know what POKéMON TRAINERS /  do when they reach a new town? //  They first check what kind of GYM /  is in the town.

PetalburgCity_Text_ThisIsPetalburgGym.current: See? This is PETALBURG CITY's GYM.

PetalburgCity_Text_ThisIsGymSign.current: This is the GYM's sign. Look for it /  whenever you're looking for a GYM.

PetalburgCity_Text_AreYouATrainer.current: Excuse me! //  Let me guess, from the way you're /  dressed, are you a POKéMON TRAINER?

PetalburgCity_Text_WellMaybeNot.current: … … … … … … //  Well, maybe not. /  Your clothes aren't all that dirty. //  You're either a rookie TRAINER, /  or maybe you're just an ordinary kid.

PetalburgCity_Text_ImLookingForTalentedT.current: I'm roaming the land in search of /  talented TRAINERS. //  I'm sorry to have taken your time.

PetalburgCity_Text_GymSign.current: PETALBURG CITY POKéMON GYM /  LEADER: NORMAN /  “A man in pursuit of power!”

PetalburgCity_Text_CitySign.current: PETALBURG CITY /  “Where people mingle with nature.”

SlateportCity_Text_BushedHikingFromMauvi.current: Whew… I'm just bushed… //  I hiked over from MAUVILLE CITY. /  But, boy, this city's huge. //  If I'd known this, I would've ridden /  my BIKE here.

SlateportCity_Text_AmIOnTV.current: Hey! Are you watching? /  Am I on TV?

SlateportCity_Text_EveryoneCallsHimCaptS.current: STERN, the fellow who built the /  MUSEUM, also happens to be the leader /  of an undersea exploration team. //  So, everyone calls him CAPT. STERN.

SlateportCity_Text_CaptainsACelebrity.current: A TV interview! Here! /  The CAPTAIN's a celebrity!

SlateportCity_Text_GoingToCompeteInBattl.current: Wroooar! I'm going to compete in /  the BATTLE TENT, too! //  But before that, I need to catch /  some POKéMON!

SlateportCity_Text_SternSaysDiscoveredSo.current: CAPT. STERN says they discovered /  something at the bottom of the sea. //  I wonder what it is? /  What could it be?

SlateportCity_Text_WhatsLongLineOverTher.current: What is that over there? /  That long line…

SlateportCity_Text_VisitedMuseumOften.current: When I was a child, I visited /  the MUSEUM often. //  I used to dream about the mysteries of /  the sea after seeing the exhibits.

SlateportCity_Text_QuitPushing.current: Hey, there! Quit pushing! /  This is the line, can't you see?

SlateportCity_Text_SeaweedFullOfLife.current: Ooh, look at this! //  The seaweed you can get around these /  parts is fresh and full of life. //  Why, it looks like it can even rear up /  and attack!

SlateportCity_Text_CaptainComeBackWithBi.current: What's going on here? //  Did the good CAPTAIN come back with /  a big fish from the ocean floor?

SlateportCity_Text_HowTownIsBornAndGrows.current: Where the water is clean, the fruits /  of bountiful harvest gather. //  And where people gather, a market /  soon starts. //  That is how a town is born and grows.

SlateportCity_Text_CaptSternBeingIntervi.current: I was hoping that it was a famous star /  so I could get an autograph. //  But who's that being interviewed? /  Isn't that CAPT. STERN?

SlateportCity_Text_SlateportWonderfulPla.current: Shopping where you can breathe the /  scent of the ocean… //  SLATEPORT is such a wonderful place!

SlateportCity_Text_BuyBricksSoDecorWontG.current: If you put DOLLS or CUSHIONS on /  the floor, they'll get dirty. //  I'm going to buy some BRICKS so my /  DOLLS and CUSHIONS won't get dirty /  when I leave them out.

SlateportCity_Text_InterviewerSoCool.current: That lady interviewer is so cool /  and pretty. //  When I grow up, I'm going to be /  an international journalist!

SlateportCity_Text_BigSmileForCamera.current: TY: Okay, CAPT. STERN, a big smile /  for the camera!

SlateportCity_Text_MostInvaluableExperie.current: GABBY: I see, I see. You've had a most /  invaluable experience…

SlateportCity_Text_SternMoveAheadWithExp.current: CAPT. STERN: Yes, indeed. We intend to /  move ahead with our exploration.

SlateportCity_Text_GabbyWonderfulThanksF.current: GABBY: That's wonderful, CAPT. STERN! /  Thank you for taking the time from /  your busy schedule to talk to us. //  We hope we can interview you again /  with news of more discoveries!

SlateportCity_Text_SternWhewFirstIntervi.current: CAPT. STERN: Whew… //  That was my first time to be filmed for /  TV. That was nerve-wracking.

SlateportCity_Text_OhPlayerWeMadeDiscove.current: Oh! {PLAYER}{KUN}! /  You're looking great! //  We made a huge discovery on our last /  seafloor exploration. //  We found an underwater cavern on /  ROUTE 128. //  We think it's the habitat of a POKéMON /  that's said to have been long extinct.

SlateportCity_Text_AquaWillAssumeControl.current: Fufufu… /  CAPT. STERN, I presume. //  We of TEAM AQUA will assume /  control of your submarine! //  Your objections are meaningless! /  We expect your total cooperation! //  Fufufu… /  Just watch and learn what TEAM /  AQUA has planned!

SlateportCity_Text_SternWhatWasAllThat.current: CAPT. STERN: What was that all about? //  It sounded like someone using /  a megaphone… //  Where did it come from?

SlateportCity_Text_FromHarborTryingToTak.current: It's from the HARBOR! //  The submarine! /  They're trying to take it!

SlateportCity_Text_SeaIsSoWet.current: The sea is just so vast… //  Could the sea have been made by /  the tears shed by POKéMON?

SlateportCity_Text_SinkOldBoats.current: Do you know what they do with old /  ships that become too creaky to sail? //  They sink them in the sea so they /  become habitats for POKéMON.

SlateportCity_Text_BuyTooMuch.current: Whenever I visit here, I get carried /  away and buy too much.

SlateportCity_Text_BattleTentBuiltRecent.current: Recently, a BATTLE TENT was built /  in SLATEPORT. //  GYMS are fun, but the BATTLE TENT's /  awesome in its own way. //  You should go find tough POKéMON /  for the BATTLE TENT!

SlateportCity_Text_GetNameRaterToHelpYou.current: If you want to change your POKéMON's /  nickname, you'll have to get the NAME /  RATER to help you.

SlateportCity_Text_CantChangeTradeMonNam.current: Any POKéMON you get in a trade, /  you can't change its nickname. //  The original TRAINER's love for that /  POKéMON is in the nickname.

SlateportCity_Text_AquaHasPolicy.current: TEAM AQUA has a policy of /  assembling and dispersing at /  the operation site.

SlateportCity_Text_BossIsBrilliant.current: Our BOSS is brilliant. //  What would he want to do with /  a MUSEUM now?

SlateportCity_Text_WonderIfLighthouseSta.current: The light of the lighthouse reaches /  dozens of miles away. //  I wonder if it doesn't startle POKéMON /  in the sea.

SlateportCity_Text_StatPointsAlreadyRead.current: Your {STR_VAR_1} already has its full /  competitive STAT POINT budget. //  There is no EV training here; only /  team building and battle practice!

SlateportCity_Text_CatchingGuruSellWhatY.current: I'm the CATCHING GURU! I stock /  specialized BALLS for every hunt. //  The right BALL can turn a rare sighting /  into your next teammate!

SlateportCity_Text_WhatsNewSchemeIWonder.current: What's the new scheme, I wonder? //  Our BOSS is scary when he's mad, so /  I'd better not screw things up…

SlateportCity_Text_ShouldTakeItAll.current: If there's something we need in /  the MUSEUM, we should take it all!

SlateportCity_Text_DontButtIn.current: Hey, you there! /  Don't butt in!

SlateportCity_Text_RemindsMeOfLongLineFo.current: A long line, huh? //  It reminds me of the times I lined up to /  buy smash-hit games…

SlateportCity_Text_WhyAreWeLiningUp.current: Why are we even lining up and paying? /  We should just march in!

SlateportCity_Text_IllReadSignForYou.current: You want to read this sign? /  I'll read it for you!

SlateportCity_Text_SaysSomethingLikeSeaI.current: Let's see… //  Um… I think it says something like /  “the life in the sea is endless.” //  Yup, I'm pretty sure that's what /  it says.

SlateportCity_Text_ShouldveBroughtMyGame.current: Grumble… //  I should've brought my Game Boy /  Advance so I wouldn't get bored in line… //  Grumble…

SlateportCity_Text_HotSpringsAfterOperat.current: When this operation's over, I'll take /  you to a hot spring spa! //  That's what our leader said. /  I can't wait!

SlateportCity_Text_ExplainBerries.current: If a wild POKéMON gets hurt, it heals /  itself by chewing on BERRIES. //  Did you know that? //  Somebody saw that and got the idea /  of making medicine from BERRIES. //  Did you know that? //  To turn BERRIES into medicine, /  they must be crushed into powder. //  Did you know that? //  You seem to have an interest /  in BERRIES! //  I've got something good for someone /  like you.

SlateportCity_Text_PowderJarSentToPC.current: Your KEY ITEMS pocket is full, so the /  POWDER JAR was sent to your PC.

SlateportCity_Text_PowderJarNoRoom.current: Your KEY ITEMS pocket and PC are full. /  Make room, then return for the jar.

SlateportCity_Text_ExplainBerryPowder.current: I recently had machines installed at /  POKéMON CENTERS for crushing BERRIES. //  The BERRY CRUSH machines are at /  the DIRECT CORNER upstairs. //  Did you know? //  Could you make BERRY POWDER for /  me using those machines? //  I can make you all sorts of medicine /  if you bring me lots of BERRY POWDER.

SlateportCity_Text_BroughtMeSomeBerryPow.current: Have you brought me some /  BERRY POWDER?

SlateportCity_Text_ExchangeWhatWithIt.current: What would you like to exchange /  it with?

SlateportCity_Text_ExchangeBerryPowderFo.current: Okay, you want to exchange your /  BERRY POWDER for one {STR_VAR_1}?

SlateportCity_Text_DontHaveEnoughBerryPo.current: Oh, dear. You don't have enough /  BERRY POWDER.

SlateportCity_Text_FineBerryPowderTradeS.current: This is fine BERRY POWDER. /  It will make excellent medicine. //  Would you like to trade more of your /  BERRY POWDER for something else?

SlateportCity_Text_WhenYouGetMoreBringIt.current: Okay! When you get some more /  BERRY POWDER, bring it to me, please!

SlateportCity_Text_ComeBackToTradeBerryP.current: Come back if you'd like to trade your /  BERRY POWDER for some medicine. //  I'm always running a bazaar here. //  Did you know?

SlateportCity_Text_BattleItemScholar.current: I once sold POWER items here. //  The left-side vendor in every CENTER /  now supplies battle items for free.

SlateportCity_Text_IncenseScholar.current: Incense still matters for breeding, /  but not as a scarce battle tool. //  Check CENTER vendors and local shops.

SlateportCity_Text_GretaChallenge.current: I'm GRETA of the BATTLE ARENA. //  A real match reveals mind, skill, /  and body all at once. Show me yours!

SlateportCity_Text_GretaDefeat.current: All three were sharp. Nicely done!

SlateportCity_Text_GretaDecline.current: Return when mind, skill, and body are /  ready to be judged together.

SlateportCity_Text_GretaAfter.current: That GENGARITE marks a contender. /  Bring it to the BATTLE FRONTIER.

SlateportCity_Text_WhoahLineSoLong.current: Whoa! This line barely moves! /  I could have paddled home by now.

SlateportCity_Text_LookingForBrawly.current: Oh! You came looking for /  DEWFORD's GYM LEADER? //  That's me! BRAWLY. /  Guess I've kept you waiting. //  I'll head back to DEWFORD right now. /  Bring two POKéMON. I battle doubles!

SlateportCity_Text_KnuckleGuardClosed.current: ROUTE 110 is closed while the CYCLING /  ROAD crew resurfaces the trail. //  The LEAGUE lets certified TRAINERS /  through. BRAWLY's KNUCKLE BADGE /  counts.

SlateportCity_Text_BrawlyAtMuseum.current: BRAWLY is in the queue outside the /  OCEANIC MUSEUM. Ask him to go home. //  Then sail back with MR. BRINEY and /  challenge DEWFORD GYM.

SlateportCity_Text_BrawlyBackInDewford.current: BRAWLY has returned to DEWFORD GYM. /  Challenge him for the KNUCKLE BADGE. //  MR. BRINEY's boat is on ROUTE 109, /  south of SLATEPORT.

SlateportCity_Text_TakingBattleTentChall.current: SCOTT: Oh, hey! /  If it isn't {PLAYER}{KUN}! //  {PLAYER}{KUN}, let me guess--you're going /  to take the BATTLE TENT challenge? //  Yeah! That's a good idea! /  That's a really great idea! //  After all, a tough TRAINER is /  the perfect fit for the BATTLE TENT! //  Give it your best effort!

SlateportCity_Text_KnuckleGuardTrigger.current: Whoa, not past the cones! ROUTE 110 /  is closed until you hold the /  KNUCKLE BADGE.

SlateportCity_Text_HarborFerryUnderConst.current: SLATEPORT HARBOR //  “The ferry S.S. TIDAL is under /  construction in the SHIPYARD. //  “Service is scheduled to begin /  shortly.”

SlateportCity_Text_HarborSign.current: SLATEPORT HARBOR //  “Enjoy a delightful cruise on /  the ferry S.S. TIDAL.”

SlateportCity_Text_MarketSign.current: SLATEPORT MARKET /  “Specialty goods and local services!”

SlateportCity_Text_OceanicMuseumSign.current: “The endless sea sustains /  all life.” //  OCEANIC MUSEUM

SlateportCity_Text_CitySign.current: SLATEPORT CITY //  “The port where people and POKéMON /  cross paths.”

SlateportCity_Text_PokemonFanClubSign.current: POKéMON FAN CLUB /  “Calling all fans of POKéMON!”

SlateportCity_Text_BattleTentSign.current: BATTLE TENT SLATEPORT SITE /  “Find it! The ultimate POKéMON!”

SlateportCity_Text_SternsShipyardWantedS.current: STERN'S SHIPYARD //  “Wanted: A sailor capable of sailing /  in all currents.”

SlateportCity_Text_SternsShipyardNearsCo.current: STERN'S SHIPYARD //  “The ferry S.S. TIDAL nears /  completion for serving the ports of /  SLATEPORT and LILYCOVE.”

SlateportCity_Text_SternsShipyardFerryCo.current: STERN'S SHIPYARD //  “Boarding of the SLATEPORT-LILYCOVE /  ferry S.S. TIDAL is handled at the /  HARBOR.”

SlateportCity_Text_YouDroveTeamAquaAway.current: SCOTT: Huh? /  I'm sure I met you somewhere before. //  Have I introduced myself to you? /  If not, my name's SCOTT. //  I just saw TEAM AQUA run away from /  here like they were stung. //  Let me guess--you drove them away?

SlateportCity_Text_MaybeThisTrainer.current: SCOTT: Hmm… /  Maybe, just maybe, this TRAINER…

SlateportCity_Text_LetsRegisterEachOther.current: SCOTT: All right! I think you're going /  to become a good friend. //  So, let's register each other in our /  POKéNAVS. //  … … … … … …

SlateportCity_Text_RegisteredScott.current: Registered this SCOTT person /  in the POKéNAV.

SlateportCity_Text_KeepEyeOnTrainersBeSe.current: SCOTT: What I'd like to do is tag along /  with you, but I do want to keep an eye /  on the talents of other people, too. //  So, I'll be off to roam other towns /  a bit more. //  Be seeing you, {PLAYER}{KUN}!

MauvilleCity_Text_NurseHurtMonBackToHeal.current: You know, it's cool to have POKéMON /  battles and stuff… //  But if your POKéMON gets hurt, /  you have to nurse it back to health.

MauvilleCity_Text_PokemonCanJumpYouOnBik.current: Even if you're riding a BIKE, /  wild POKéMON could jump you.

MauvilleCity_Text_AllSortsOfPeopleComeTh.current: The roads of this town stretch north /  and south, and east and west. //  Because of that, we get all sorts of /  people coming through.

MauvilleCity_Text_RydelVeryGenerous.current: Have you been to RYDEL'S CYCLES yet? //  RYDEL, the owner, is a very generous /  man.

MauvilleCity_Text_ExplainTV.current: Hi, do you check out TV at all? //  They've added a bunch of cool new /  shows recently. //  TV is so cool. I've seen my friends on /  TV just out of the blue. //  And, sometimes, they even put you on TV /  without telling you. //  I wish I would be on TV sometime. //  That's why I think you should check /  out TVs whenever you can.

MauvilleCity_Text_BeenCheckingOutTV.current: Hi, have you been checking out TVs?

MauvilleCity_Text_WallyWantToChallengeGy.current: WALLY: Aww, UNCLE, please? //  I don't grind. Nobody has to. I built a /  team, and a GYM is where you test one.

MauvilleCity_Text_UncleYourePushingIt.current: UNCLE: Now hold on, WALLY. //  Since you started living with POKéMON, /  you have grown quite a lot stronger. //  But don't you think you're pushing it /  to suddenly challenge a GYM?

MauvilleCity_Text_WallyWeCanBeatAnyone.current: WALLY: I'm not pushing it. //  RALTS and I found five partners who /  cover each other. We can beat anyone!

MauvilleCity_Text_WallyWillYouBattleMe.current: WALLY: Oh! Hi, {PLAYER}! //  I've built a real doubles team since we /  met. I want you and my UNCLE to see it. //  Please, will you battle me?

MauvilleCity_Text_WallyMyUncleWontKnowIm.current: WALLY: Oh… If you won't, my UNCLE will /  never believe my team is real.

MauvilleCity_Text_WallyHereICome.current: WALLY: {PLAYER}, thank you. //  WEAVILE leads, ZAPDOS sets the wind… /  Okay. Here I come!

MauvilleCity_Text_WallyDefeat.current: WALLY: … … … … … … … //  My wind never came. You took the lead /  before it mattered. //  I lost…

MauvilleCity_Text_WallyIllGoBackToVerdan.current: WALLY: UNCLE… I'll go back to /  VERDANTURF. //  I know what my team was missing now.

MauvilleCity_Text_ThankYouNotEnoughToBat.current: {PLAYER}, thank you. /  Being a TRAINER is tough, isn't it? //  It's not enough just to have POKéMON /  and make them battle. That isn't what /  being a real TRAINER is about.

MauvilleCity_Text_UncleNoNeedToBeDown.current: UNCLE: WALLY, there's no need to be so /  down on yourself. //  Why, what's keeping you from becoming /  stronger and stronger? //  Come on, let's go home. /  Everyone's waiting for you.

MauvilleCity_Text_UncleVisitUsSometime.current: UNCLE: {PLAYER}{KUN}, it just dawned on me /  that you must be the TRAINER who kept /  an eye out for WALLY when he caught /  his POKéMON. //  Why don't you visit us in VERDANTURF /  sometime? /  I'm sure WALLY would enjoy it.

MauvilleCity_Text_ScottYouDidntHoldBack.current: SCOTT: Hehe… /  I was watching that match! //  You're friends with that boy WALLY, /  aren't you? //  But you didn't hold anything back /  and beat him impressively. //  Yeah! That's what a real POKéMON /  battle is all about! //  I idolize TRAINERS like that! //  … … … … … … /  I'll be cheering for you!

MauvilleCity_Text_UncleHesTooPeppy.current: UNCLE: It's because of POKéMON that /  this boy's got more pep, I suppose… /  But he's become a bit too peppy…

MauvilleCity_Text_UncleCanYouBattleWally.current: UNCLE: {PLAYER}{KUN}, was it? /  On WALLY's behalf, can I ask you to /  battle with him just this once? //  I don't think he's going to listen to /  any reason the way he is now.

MauvilleCity_Text_WattsonNeedFavorTakeKe.current: WATTSON: Oh, {PLAYER}{KUN}! /  You look like you have a lot of zip! /  That's a good thing, wahahahaha! //  Fine! I've decided! /  I need a favor, {PLAYER}{KUN}! //  MAUVILLE CITY has an underground /  sector called NEW MAUVILLE. //  {PLAYER}{KUN}, I'd like you to go there and /  switch off the GENERATOR. //  The GENERATOR has been running a bit /  haywire. It's getting unsafe. //  Here, this is the KEY to get into /  NEW MAUVILLE.

MauvilleCity_Text_WattsonWontBeChallenge.current: WATTSON: Don't you worry about it. /  It won't be a challenge to you. //  The entrance to NEW MAUVILLE is just /  a short SURF away from ROUTE 110. //  That's it, then, you have my trust! /  Wahahahaha! //  WATTSON: If you find MELTAN, level it /  up in NEW MAUVILLE to get MELMETAL. /  The generator can be on or off!

MauvilleCity_Text_WattsonThanksTakeElect.current: WATTSON: Wahahahaha! I knew I'd made /  the right choice asking you! //  This ELECTIRIZER came from the old /  GENERATOR. You've earned it!

MauvilleCity_Text_WattsonYoungTakeCharge.current: WATTSON: Wahahahaha! //  It pleases me to no end to see /  the young step up and take charge! //  WATTSON: If you find MELTAN, level it /  up in NEW MAUVILLE to get MELMETAL. /  The generator can be on or off!

MauvilleCity_Text_GymSign.current: MAUVILLE CITY POKéMON GYM /  LEADER: WATTSON /  “The cheerfully electrifying man!”

MauvilleCity_Text_CitySign.current: MAUVILLE CITY /  “The bright and shiny city of fun!”

MauvilleCity_Text_BikeShopSign.current: “Ride in gravel and shake up your /  soul!” /  RYDEL'S CYCLES

MauvilleCity_Text_GameCornerSign.current: “The play spot for all!” /  MAUVILLE GAME CORNER

RustboroCity_Text_GymLeaderIsntEasyWithF.current: I challenged the GYM LEADER, but… //  It's not going to be easy winning with /  my FIRE-type POKéMON… //  FIRE-type POKéMON don't match up /  well against ROCK-type POKéMON…

RustboroCity_Text_WeShortenItToDevon.current: The DEVON CORPORATION… /  We all just shorten it to DEVON. //  That company makes all sorts of /  convenient products.

RustboroCity_Text_SneakyLookingManWentAr.current: Hm? A sneaky-looking man? //  Come to think of it, yes, a shady- /  looking guy went around the corner.

RustboroCity_Text_CatchRarePokemonIfIGoT.current: POKéMON TRAINER'S SCHOOL! //  If I go to this school, will I be able /  to catch rare POKéMON easily?

RustboroCity_Text_WowYouHavePokemon.current: Wow, you have POKéMON with you, too. //  When I get bigger, I'm going to go /  places with POKéMON, too.

RustboroCity_Text_MrBrineyWalksInTheTunn.current: The old sailor MR. BRINEY lives in /  a cottage by the sea. //  He goes for walks in the tunnel every /  so often.

RustboroCity_Text_MrBrineyLovesPeeko.current: The old sailor MR. BRINEY lives in /  a cottage by the sea. //  He said he was going shopping in /  SLATEPORT for his pet, PEEKO. //  That old sea dog, he must really love /  that PEEKO.

RustboroCity_Text_HaveYouChallengedGym.current: Have you taken the POKéMON GYM /  challenge? //  When you get that shiny GYM BADGE /  in hand, I guess TRAINERS begin to /  realize what is required of them.

RustboroCity_Text_HeyThatsRustborosGymBa.current: Hey, that's RUSTBORO's GYM BADGE! //  Out of all the POKéMON GYM BADGES, /  RUSTBORO's is the coolest, I'd say.

RustboroCity_Text_PokemonCanChangeLookFr.current: If a POKéMON gains experience in /  battles, it can sometimes change in /  the way it looks.

RustboroCity_Text_PokemonChangeShape.current: A POKéMON changes shape? /  If one did that, I would be shocked!

RustboroCity_Text_ShadyCharacterTookOffT.current: Follow ROUTE 116 east to /  RUSTURF TUNNEL. He went that way! //  Please bring the DEVON GOODS /  back to me here.

RustboroCity_Text_YouGotItThankYou.current: Oh! How did it go? /  The DEVON GOODS? //  You did! /  You got them back! //  You really are a great TRAINER! //  I know! As my thanks, I'll give you /  another GREAT BALL!

RustboroCity_Text_YoureLoadedWithItems.current: You're loaded with items. /  I can't give you this GREAT BALL.

RustboroCity_Text_PleaseComeWithMe.current: Excuse me, please! /  Please come with me!

RustboroCity_Text_YoureNewAroundHere.current: Oh? Who might you be? /  You're a new face around these parts. //  Have you just transferred into the /  POKéMON TRAINER'S SCHOOL?

RustboroCity_Text_TradePokemonGrowFast.current: A POKéMON you get in a trade from /  someone grows fast. //  But if you don't have certain GYM /  BADGES, it may not obey you…

RustboroCity_Text_MayHiLetsRegister.current: MAY: Oh, hi, {PLAYER}{KUN}! //  You had a MATCH CALL feature put /  on your POKéNAV! //  Let's register each other so we can /  contact one another anytime! //  … … … … … …

RustboroCity_Text_MayPassedBrineyWantToB.current: MAY: Oh, by the way, I passed /  MR. BRINEY in PETALBURG WOODS. //  I guess he's on his way home to his /  cottage by the sea. //  How's your POKéDEX coming along, /  {PLAYER}{KUN}? Mine's looking pretty decent! //  So… /  How about a little battle?

RustboroCity_Text_MayOhHaventRaisedPokem.current: MAY: Oh, what's the matter? //  Haven't you caught or raised your /  POKéMON very much? //  That's not very good for a TRAINER!

RustboroCity_Text_MayWantToBattle.current: MAY: So, what do you think? /  How about a little battle here?

RustboroCity_Text_MayImNotGoingToLose.current: MAY: You just became a TRAINER, /  {PLAYER}{KUN}. I'm not going to lose!

RustboroCity_Text_MayDefeat.current: Yikes! /  You're better than I expected!

RustboroCity_Text_MayMrBrineyHint.current: MAY: Oh, by the way, MR. BRINEY, who /  I just passed… //  {PLAYER}{KUN}, you just moved here so you /  might not know this, but MR. BRINEY /  was once a revered seafarer.

RustboroCity_Text_BrendanHiLetsRegister.current: BRENDAN: Oh, hey, {PLAYER}! //  You had a MATCH CALL feature put /  on your POKéNAV! Cool! //  Let's register each other so we can /  get in touch anytime! //  … … … … … …

RustboroCity_Text_BrendanPassedBrineyWan.current: BRENDAN: By the way, {PLAYER}, I walked /  by MR. BRINEY in PETALBURG WOODS. //  I bet he was on his way home to his /  cottage by the sea. //  {PLAYER}, how's your POKéDEX? /  Have you filled in any pages yet? //  Mine rules. //  Want to have a battle to test how /  far you've progressed?

RustboroCity_Text_BrendanNoConfidenceInP.current: BRENDAN: What's the matter? Don't have /  any confidence in your POKéMON?

RustboroCity_Text_BrendanWantToBattle.current: BRENDAN: What's up? /  Want to have a battle with me?

RustboroCity_Text_BrendanIWontGoEasy.current: BRENDAN: I know you just became /  a TRAINER, but I won't go easy!

RustboroCity_Text_BrendanMrBrineyHint.current: BRENDAN: By the way, you know /  MR. BRINEY? The guy I just passed? //  I bet you didn't know this, since you /  just moved here, {PLAYER}, but /  MR. BRINEY was once a great sailor.

RustboroCity_Text_YouCanHave2On2Battle.current: Did you know this? //  You can have a 2-on-2 battle even /  if you're not with another TRAINER. //  If you catch the eyes of two TRAINERS /  when you have two or more POKéMON, /  they'll both challenge you. //  Don't you think it'd be cool if you /  could beat two TRAINERS by yourself?

RustboroCity_Text_RoxanneRestoredBefore.current: Stone alone is not a strategy. //  Study the partners in my GYM, then /  show me how your own team connects.

RustboroCity_Text_RoxanneRestoredAfter.current: Your STONE BADGE proves you can solve /  more than a type chart. //  DEVON may have a task for you next.

RustboroCity_Text_OutOfTheWay.current: Get out! /  Out of the way!

RustboroCity_Text_WaitDontTakeMyGoods.current: Wait! Pleeeaaase! //  Don't take my GOODS!

RustboroCity_Text_HelpMeIWasRobbed.current: Oh, it's you! //  You're that fantastic TRAINER who /  helped me in PETALBURG WOODS! //  Help me! I was robbed by TEAM AQUA! /  I have to get the DEVON GOODS back! //  If I don't… /  I'm going to be in serious trouble. //  He ran east along ROUTE 116! /  Please check RUSTURF TUNNEL. //  Bring the GOODS back to me here. /  I'll wait by the road.

RustboroCity_Text_GymSign.current: RUSTBORO CITY POKéMON GYM /  LEADER: ROXANNE //  “The ROCK-loving honors student!”

RustboroCity_Text_TrainersSchoolSign.current: POKéMON TRAINER'S SCHOOL //  “We'll teach you anything about /  POKéMON!”

RustboroCity_Text_CitySign.current: RUSTBORO CITY //  “The city probing the integration of /  nature and science.”

RustboroCity_Text_DevonCorpSign.current: DEVON CORPORATION //  “For all your living needs, we make /  it all.”

RustboroCity_Text_TunnelNearingCompletio.current: “Timesaving tunnel nearing /  completion!” //  …Is what it says on the sign, but /  there's also a big “X” splashed /  across it in red paint…

RustboroCity_Text_DevelopedNewPokenavFea.current: I've been developing an added feature /  for the POKéNAV… //  And it turned out great! //  {PLAYER}, may I see that POKéNAV? /  The one our PRESIDENT gave you?

RustboroCity_Text_AddedMatchCallPleaseCa.current: There you go, {PLAYER}! //  I added a new feature named /  MATCH CALL to your POKéNAV. //  Using the MATCH CALL feature, /  you can chat with people who have /  been registered in your POKéNAV. //  {PLAYER}, our PRESIDENT STONE should /  be registered in your POKéNAV. //  Test it out. /  Please give our PRESIDENT a call.

RustboroCity_Text_IdBetterGetBackToWork.current: Okay, I'd better get back to work. /  Please take care, {PLAYER}!

FortreeCity_Text_SawGiganticPokemonInSky.current: No one believes me, but I saw this /  gigantic POKéMON in the sky. //  It seemed to squirm as it flew toward /  ROUTE 131. //  By the way… Sniff… /  Um… You, uh…smell singed. //  Were you at a volcano or something?

FortreeCity_Text_TreesGrowByDrinkingRain.current: The ground absorbs rainwater, and /  trees grow by drinking that water… //  Our FORTREE CITY exists because /  there's both water and soil.

FortreeCity_Text_SomethingBlockingGym.current: I want to go to the POKéMON GYM, /  but something's blocking the way. //  After all the bother I went through /  training on ROUTE 120… //  STEVEN is on the bridge east of town. /  He was studying something invisible. //  Maybe he can help us clear the GYM path!

FortreeCity_Text_ThisTimeIllBeatWinona.current: I've got my pride-and-joy POKéMON /  with me. This time, I'll beat WINONA.

FortreeCity_Text_BugPokemonComeThroughWi.current: Living on top of trees is okay. //  But sometimes BUG POKéMON come in /  through windows. /  It can be really startling.

FortreeCity_Text_EveryoneHealthyAndLivel.current: The CITY consists of homes built on /  trees. //  Perhaps because of that lifestyle, /  everyone is healthy and lively. //  Why, even myself--I feel as if I've /  grown thirty years younger.

FortreeCity_Text_PokemonThatEvolveWhenTr.current: There are POKéMON that evolve when /  you trade them! That's what I heard.

FortreeCity_Text_SomethingUnseeable.current: Something unseeable is in the way.

FortreeCity_Text_UnseeableUseDevonScope.current: Something unseeable is in the way. //  Want to use the DEVON SCOPE?

FortreeCity_Text_UsedDevonScopePokemonFl.current: {PLAYER} used the DEVON SCOPE. //  An invisible POKéMON became completely /  visible! //  The startled POKéMON fled!

FortreeCity_Text_CitySign.current: FORTREE CITY /  “The treetop city that frolics with /  nature.”

FortreeCity_Text_GymSign.current: FORTREE CITY POKéMON GYM /  LEADER: WINONA //  “The bird user taking flight into /  the world.”

LilycoveCity_Text_TeamAquaBeenTrainingWa.current: TEAM AQUA's been training their /  WAILMER in the cove. //  We SAILORS can't get our boats out /  to sea with them in the way!

LilycoveCity_Text_SomeonePuntedTeamAquaO.current: Ahoy, did you know? //  Someone punted TEAM AQUA out of /  the way for us! //  That got the WAILMER out of the cove, /  so we can get our boats out again.

LilycoveCity_Text_StrangeCaveInCove.current: Have you seen that strange cave in /  the cove at the edge of town?

LilycoveCity_Text_GoingToMoveDeleterForH.current: I'm going to teach my POKéMON some new /  moves for entering a CONTEST. //  So, I'm going to see the MOVE DELETER /  and make it forget HM moves.

LilycoveCity_Text_ContestHallInTown.current: There's a POKéMON CONTEST HALL /  right in this here town.  //  That means well-raised POKéMON will /  come from all over the country. //  My heart swells with excitement!

LilycoveCity_Text_ImFromKanto.current: I came from KANTO. //  The HOENN region is beautiful with /  all its water and verdant nature. //  Hunh? Wait a second… //  Could there be rare POKéMON that live /  only in this area?

LilycoveCity_Text_ImArtDealer.current: I'm an ART DEALER. //  I am a buyer and seller of fine art, /  especially paintings. //  I've heard that the MUSEUM here has /  magnificent works on exhibit…

LilycoveCity_Text_SomeoneStoleMyPokemon.current: I was taking a relaxing snooze at the /  seaside inn to the sound of waves… //  When someone stole my POKéMON! //  Who's the abductor? /  TEAM AQUA? Is it TEAM AQUA?

LilycoveCity_Text_MissingPokemonCameBack.current: My missing POKéMON… /  It came back without me noticing!

LilycoveCity_Text_SeaRemainsForeverYoung.current: Even as we grow old and wrinkled, /  the sea remains forever young with /  the vivid brilliance of life… //  Fwohoho fwohohohoho…

LilycoveCity_Text_SixtyYearsAgoHusbandPr.current: It was sixty years ago that my husband /  proposed to me here. /  The sea remains as beautiful as ever. //  Mufufufu mufufufufufu…

LilycoveCity_Text_TeamAquaRenovatedCaver.current: Hm, you know of the peculiar cavern /  in this cove? //  That had been a natural formation, /  but then that TEAM AQUA lot came /  along and made their renovations. //  They call themselves /  the “nature-loving TEAM AQUA”! //  But what they do and what they say /  don't match at all!

LilycoveCity_Text_TeamAquaLotGoneForGood.current: That cave in the cove… //  I didn't notice it right away, /  but it's completely empty now. //  That TEAM AQUA lot, they must /  have gone away for good.

LilycoveCity_Text_WailmerLeapOutOfWater.current: There! WAILMER! /  Leap out of the water now!

LilycoveCity_Text_GetLostMessingUpTraini.current: Hunh? What do you want? //  You're messing up our training, /  so can you, like, get lost?

LilycoveCity_Text_IfWorldBecomesOurs.current: If this whole wide world becomes ours, /  TEAM AQUA's, it will be a happier /  place for POKéMON, too.

LilycoveCity_Text_MovedLootIntoHideoutTo.current: Fufufu… //  We moved more loot into our secret /  HIDEOUT today… //  Wh-who are you?! /  I was just talking to myself!

LilycoveCity_Text_ChanceToDoBigThings.current: I'm just a GRUNT, so I don't know what /  the BOSS is thinking… //  But being on TEAM AQUA, I know I'll get /  the chance to do big things! //  Wh-who are you?! /  I was just talking to myself!

LilycoveCity_Text_DontGoNearCaveInCove.current: Hey, you! //  Don't go near the cave in the cove! //  Why? You don't need a reason why! /  I'm an adult, so you just listen to me!

LilycoveCity_Text_MayShoppingLetsBattle.current: MAY: {PLAYER}{KUN}! Shopping? I'm picking /  held items. The CENTER gives them free, /  but choosing is the fun part. //  I rebuilt my six around every SIGN I /  woke. Battle me and show me yours!

LilycoveCity_Text_MayNotRaisingPokemon.current: MAY: Not now? Come on. Nobody needs to /  grind here. Bring the plan you have.

LilycoveCity_Text_MayBattleMe.current: MAY: Come on, battle me so I can see /  how you build now!

LilycoveCity_Text_MayWontBeBeaten.current: MAY: My six have an answer for /  everything. Let's see yours answer them!

LilycoveCity_Text_MayDefeat.current: … … … … … … … … //  I remember ROUTE 103. You didn't win /  on power then either. You read faster. //  You're still reading faster.

LilycoveCity_Text_MayGoingBackToLittlero.current: MAY: I'm heading back to LITTLEROOT. //  Dad's SIGN records need a second pair of /  hands, and mine are free now.

LilycoveCity_Text_MayYouGoingToCollectBa.current: {PLAYER}{KUN}, keep going. Earn the /  BADGES, wake the SIGNS, take the LEAGUE. //  I'll still finish the POKéDEX before /  you do. See you!

LilycoveCity_Text_MayYouGoingToPokemonLe.current: {PLAYER}{KUN}, is it the LEAGUE next? /  Or the POKéDEX? //  I lost the battle. I'm still winning /  the POKéDEX. See you!

LilycoveCity_Text_MayYouGoingToBattleFro.current: {PLAYER}{KUN}, what are you going to do? //  Are you taking the BATTLE FRONTIER /  challenge? //  Or, are you going to complete your /  POKéDEX? //  I might've lost to you in battling, /  but I'll finish my POKéDEX before you! //  See you!

LilycoveCity_Text_BrendanShoppingLetsBat.current: BRENDAN: {PLAYER}. Running an errand for /  Dad. No, not DOLLS. //  It's been a while. Let's see whose six /  got smarter since ROUTE 119.

LilycoveCity_Text_BrendanNoConfidence.current: BRENDAN: What, no plan ready? /  That's new for you.

LilycoveCity_Text_BrendanBattleMe.current: BRENDAN: Battle me. I want to see how /  you build now.

LilycoveCity_Text_BrendanWontBeBeaten.current: BRENDAN: I read every SIGN on the way /  here. I'm not losing to {PLAYER}.

LilycoveCity_Text_BrendanDefeat.current: Humph… You read my lead in one turn. //  That stings. I had a head start on you /  as a TRAINER…

LilycoveCity_Text_BrendanGoingBackToLitt.current: BRENDAN: I'm going home to LITTLEROOT. //  Dad's SIGN records are a mess. Someone /  who's actually seen them should help.

LilycoveCity_Text_BrendanYouGoingToColle.current: {PLAYER}, what's next? The rest of the /  BADGES and the LEAGUE? //  Maybe I'll do that too… //  Anyway. Keep reading them faster.

LilycoveCity_Text_BrendanYouGoingToPokem.current: {PLAYER}, going for the LEAGUE? //  One more rebuild and I'd beat you. /  Probably. Anyway, hang in there!

LilycoveCity_Text_BrendanYouGoingToBattl.current: {PLAYER}, what now? The FRONTIER, or /  the POKéDEX? //  With your teams, the FRONTIER. The /  CIRCUIT there is doubles all the way. //  One more rebuild and I'm stronger than /  you. Probably. Hang in there!

LilycoveCity_Text_DoYouKnowAboutBerryBle.current: Do you know about the machine /  BERRY BLENDER?

LilycoveCity_Text_FasterSpinBetterPokebl.current: People have to work together to get it /  to spin faster. //  The faster you can make it spin, the /  better {POKEBLOCK}S you can get, I've heard.

LilycoveCity_Text_ExplainBerryBlender.current: It's used for making a kind of candy /  called a {POKEBLOCK}. //  If you give a good {POKEBLOCK} to a POKéMON, /  its condition will improve by a lot.

LilycoveCity_Text_HoneymoonVowToSeeRareP.current: On our honeymoon, we vowed to see as /  many rare POKéMON as we can. //  So we were delighted to see a rare /  POKéMON as soon as we arrived. //  I mean, we are totally happy!

LilycoveCity_Text_JustArrivedAndSawRareP.current: We just arrived here on our /  honeymoon vacation. //  We happened to see a DRAGON-type /  POKéMON flying way up in the sky. //  Do cool POKéMON like that live in /  the HOENN region?

LilycoveCity_Text_HeardTowerCalledSkyPil.current: I heard there's a tower somewhere out /  on the sea routes. //  It's called the SKY PILLAR, I hear.

LilycoveCity_Text_SawTallTowerOnRoute131.current: I saw this tall tower somewhere /  around ROUTE 131. //  Could that possibly be…?

LilycoveCity_Text_AltarianiteKeeperOffer.current: Your ALTARIA carries itself like a /  cloud dragon. Take this ALTARIANITE?

LilycoveCity_Text_AltarianiteKeeperExpla.current: ALTARIANITE lets ALTARIA Mega Evolve. //  WINONA also entrusts one to every /  TRAINER who earns her BADGE.

LilycoveCity_Text_AltarianiteKeeperNeeds.current: Return with ALTARIA. I want to see /  whether it moves like a cloud.

LilycoveCity_Text_AltarianiteKeeperDecli.current: Very well. The stone will wait until /  you and ALTARIA are ready.

LilycoveCity_Text_MuseumSign.current: LILYCOVE MUSEUM //  “POKéMON Masterpiece Collection /  on exhibit!”

LilycoveCity_Text_MuseumSignPlayersExhib.current: LILYCOVE MUSEUM //  “{PLAYER}'s POKéMON Collection /  on exhibit!”

LilycoveCity_Text_DepartmentStoreSign.current: LILYCOVE DEPARTMENT STORE //  “Overflowing with great merchandise /  and excitement! //  “A great place to find that something /  you need!”

LilycoveCity_Text_CitySign.current: LILYCOVE CITY //  “Where the land ends and the /  sea begins.”

LilycoveCity_Text_ContestHallSign.current: POKéMON CONTEST HALL /  “The gathering place for TRAINERS!”

LilycoveCity_Text_MotelSign.current: COVE LILY MOTEL //  “Remember us as COVE LILY of /  LILYCOVE.”

LilycoveCity_Text_HarborSignUnderConstru.current: LILYCOVE CITY HARBOR //  “The ferry S.S. TIDAL is under /  construction in SLATEPORT CITY. //  “Service is scheduled to begin /  shortly.”

LilycoveCity_Text_HarborSign.current: LILYCOVE CITY HARBOR //  “Enjoy a delightful cruise on /  the ferry S.S. TIDAL.”

LilycoveCity_Text_TrainerFanClubSign.current: POKéMON TRAINER FAN CLUB //  The names of TRAINERS are scribbled /  all over the sign…

LilycoveCity_Text_MoveDeletersHouseSign.current: MOVE DELETER'S HOUSE //  “Unwanted POKéMON moves deleted.”

MossdeepCity_Text_MossdeepTargetedByMagm.current: I heard from a SAILOR buddy that /  TEAM AQUA set up shop in LILYCOVE. //  I also heard that someone came along /  and wiped the floor with them! //  But MOSSDEEP here's been targeted /  by that TEAM MAGMA. //  If you want to know what they're up to, /  go visit the SPACE CENTER.

MossdeepCity_Text_FeelReliefOnLand.current: I'm a SAILOR, so the sea's obviously /  more important to me. //  But you know? When I get back on land /  after a long voyage, I do feel relief!

MossdeepCity_Text_LifeNeedsSeaToLive.current: All life needs the sea to live, even /  though it makes its home on the land. //  Old divers tell of a RELICANTH circling /  the SEAFLOOR CAVERN approach. //  When it does, a princely light stirs /  beneath the trench.

MossdeepCity_Text_SpaceCenterReceivedLet.current: The island's SPACE CENTER has been /  launching huge rockets. //  There's been some kind of an uproar /  over a letter they received recently.

MossdeepCity_Text_SpaceCenterLaunchingRo.current: The island's SPACE CENTER has been /  launching huge rockets.

MossdeepCity_Text_WailmerWatching.current: Around MOSSDEEP, you can see wild /  WAILMER. //  It's called, uh… /  What was it now… //  WAI, WAI, WAI… //  WAILMER watching!

MossdeepCity_Text_NiceIfWorldCoveredByFl.current: Wouldn't it be nice? //  If the whole world was covered in /  plants and flowers like this island?

MossdeepCity_Text_SurfExhilarating.current: A voyage on a ship is fine. //  But crossing the sea with POKéMON /  using SURF… //  Now that's an exhilarating trip! /  Wouldn't you agree, youngster?

MossdeepCity_Text_SpecialSpaceCenterRock.current: This rock has a special meaning to /  the people at the SPACE CENTER. //  They put it here as their wish for /  their rockets to fly safely. //  When you make a wish, what do you use? /  Do you wish upon a star? //  I use a wish tag to make it happen. /  That's what I do.

MossdeepCity_Text_WantKingsRockStevenGav.current: I got this from STEVEN, but I don't /  know what it's good for. //  I think it's called KING'S ROCK. /  Do you want it?

MossdeepCity_Text_YouCanKeepIt.current: Why would you want it? /  You're weird. //  You can keep it, but keep it a secret /  from STEVEN.

MossdeepCity_Text_StevensHouseOverThere.current: STEVEN's house is right over there!

MossdeepCity_Text_WhatToDoWithWeirdRock.current: Yeah, you think so, too! What are you /  supposed to do with some weird rock?

MossdeepCity_Text_ScottSomethingWrongWit.current: SCOTT: {PLAYER}{KUN}, feeling good? /  I'm doing great! //  I'd heard MOSSDEEP's GYM LEADER is /  pretty strong, so I decided to come /  take a look-see for myself. //  But there's something wrong about /  this town. //  People are going on about a warning /  letter and the SPACE CENTER… //  I don't think it concerns me in any /  way, though.

MossdeepCity_Text_SootopolisNewGymLeader.current: Ahh… It feels great letting the waves /  wash over my feet… //  Speaking of the waves, you know that /  island city SOOTOPOLIS? //  I think the GYM there had a new /  LEADER come in. //  People tell me the new LEADER once /  mentored WALLACE.

MossdeepCity_Text_GymSign.current: MOSSDEEP CITY POKéMON GYM /  LEADERS: LIZA & TATE //  “The mystic combination!”

MossdeepCity_Text_SpaceCenterSign.current: MOSSDEEP SPACE CENTER /  “The closest place to space.”

SootopolisCity_Text_CaveOfOriginPleaseLe.current: Who might you be? //  This is the CAVE OF ORIGIN. //  The spirits of POKéMON, becalmed at /  MT. PYRE, are said to be revived here. //  Please leave.

SootopolisCity_Text_LeadSuperiorTrainerT.current: A person with a strong will and /  superior talent… //  A TRAINER who has knowledge and /  experience of many kinds of POKéMON… //  If such a person were to appear, I was /  instructed by WALLACE to lead that /  TRAINER to this CAVE.

SootopolisCity_Text_AwakenedPokemonClash.current: Oh, my… //  The clash between the two awakened /  POKéMON was quelled by the awakening /  of a third POKéMON…

SootopolisCity_Text_CaveOfOriginSleepsTo.current: This is the CAVE OF ORIGIN… //  The crisis has passed, but new signs /  stir within. You may enter.

SootopolisCity_Text_WeatherWentWild.current: The weather was clear this morning, /  but… //  All of a sudden, dark clouds brewed up, /  rain started falling in sheets, and /  there was thunder and lightning, too. //  The weather just went completely /  wild! //  Is all of this because of those /  POKéMON?

SootopolisCity_Text_YouBroughtFlyingMon.current: Oh? //  It was you who brought that flying /  POKéMON here? //  Well, aren't you amazing!

SootopolisCity_Text_BigPokemonFighting.current: A big POKéMON is fighting with /  another big POKéMON! //  Please, someone make them stop!

SootopolisCity_Text_PrettyMonCameFromSky.current: A pretty POKéMON came down from /  the sky…

SootopolisCity_Text_WonderWhatWorldIsLik.current: I… I've never been out of this city. //  I wonder what the world is like on /  the other side of this round sky?

SootopolisCity_Text_PhysicallyFitLivingH.current: Diving in the sea. Climbing up and /  down stairs all the time… //  If you live in this town, you end up /  getting physically fit.

SootopolisCity_Text_GiantPokemonSuddenly.current: These giant POKéMON suddenly appeared /  in the middle of the city! //  And, I've never seen them before! //  Why are they smashing into each /  other like that? //  Why can't they be friends, those /  POKéMON?

SootopolisCity_Text_WhatIsThatGreenPokem.current: What? What? What? /  What is that green POKéMON?!

SootopolisCity_Text_WhereDidLegendariesG.current: GROUDON and KYOGRE… /  Where did they go? //  Will they cause droughts or downpours /  somewhere else?

SootopolisCity_Text_NoOrdinaryTourist.current: Hm! /  You've come all the way to SOOTOPOLIS? /  You're no ordinary tourist. //  But I suppose that doesn't make you /  an extraordinary tourist, either.

SootopolisCity_Text_CityRegainedCalm.current: The city has regained its calm…

SootopolisCity_Text_InvolvedWithCrisisCo.current: STEVEN: GROUDON and KYOGRE are pulling /  every awakened SIGN toward this crater. //  No team can defeat this weather. The /  balance itself must be restored. //  You have solved that kind of problem all /  across HOENN. Come meet WALLACE.

SootopolisCity_Text_DoesThisMakeYourFear.current: STEVEN: Power without relationship looks /  terrifying. You already know the answer: /  a partner is not a tool to command.

SootopolisCity_Text_HereWereAreHelpWalla.current: WALLACE knows HOENN's oldest balance /  ritual. Share what the SIGNS taught you.

SootopolisCity_Text_KnowWhatsNeededToHel.current: STEVEN: I think you have what's /  needed to help him…

SootopolisCity_Text_NeverBeenToSkyPillar.current: STEVEN: SKY PILLAR is on the north side /  of ROUTE 131, east of PACIFIDLOG. //  The oldest SIGN in HOENN should be there, /  and no one has read it in centuries.

SootopolisCity_Text_SoThatsRayquaza.current: STEVEN: RAYQUAZA did not make them flee. /  It reminded land and sea of the whole.

SootopolisCity_Text_MaxieArchieLeft.current: STEVEN: MAXIE and ARCHIE have gone to /  MT. PYRE to return the ORBS. //  The network is quiet again. Every SIGN /  it woke is still out there, waiting for /  the partner it asked for.

SootopolisCity_Text_SootopolisSkyBeautif.current: SOOTOPOLIS sprang up as a town in /  the crater of a volcano. //  If you look up at the sky, the lip of /  the crater is also visible. /  So, all you see is the sky in a circle. //  But that's what makes the sky above /  SOOTOPOLIS the most beautiful.

SootopolisCity_Text_GiganticPokemonFight.current: When two POKéMON that gigantic /  are fighting that savagely, there's /  not much that we can do.

SootopolisCity_Text_FearedWorstWhenPokem.current: When that third POKéMON flew down, /  I feared the worst.

SootopolisCity_Text_NightSkyFavoriteScen.current: A circle of a night sky framed by /  the crater of a volcano… //  And in that ring, stars flicker and /  blink as if they were alive… /  It's my favorite scenery.

SootopolisCity_Text_SeeingLegendWithOwnE.current: There's an ancient legend that claims /  the land and sea were shaped by /  a colossal battle between POKéMON. //  Well, I'm seeing that happen with /  my very own eyes! //  Whoa! I never expected to be /  witness to something this huge!

SootopolisCity_Text_SawLegendWithOwnEyes.current: There's an ancient legend that claims /  the land and sea were shaped by /  a colossal battle between POKéMON. //  Well, I saw that happen with /  my very own eyes! //  Whoa! I never expected to be /  witness to something this huge!

SootopolisCity_Text_SootopolisWillBeWrec.current: Oh, no! /  SOOTOPOLIS CITY will get wrecked!

SootopolisCity_Text_GoRedAndBlueMon.current: Go for it, red POKéMON! /  Don't back off, blue POKéMON!

SootopolisCity_Text_DoYouKnowMonNames.current: … … … … … … //  Hi, do you know the names of those /  POKéMON fighting over there?

SootopolisCity_Text_GreenOneSettlesThing.current: I was wondering which one would win, /  the red one or the blue one, but, oh no, /  it's the green one that settles things! //  Talk about a huge turn of events!

SootopolisCity_Text_TwoPokemonArentAngry.current: I just get this sense somehow that /  the two POKéMON aren't angry. //  I think… They probably can't control /  their own power…

SootopolisCity_Text_FlyingMonStoppedRamp.current: That flying POKéMON came down from /  the sky and stopped the rampaging /  POKéMON…

SootopolisCity_Text_GroudonPleaseStop.current: MAXIE: GROUDON, stop! I wanted land that /  could sustain a future, not consume it. //  My certainty left no room for yours.

SootopolisCity_Text_AfterAllOurScheming.current: MAXIE: RAYQUAZA did not overpower both /  rivals. It restored their relationship. //  All our models optimized one side of a /  system that could only live in balance.

SootopolisCity_Text_KyogreCalmDown.current: ARCHIE: KYOGRE! I called this freedom, /  but even the sea needs a shore. //  The RED ORB cannot make you hear me.

SootopolisCity_Text_TryingMeaninglessToP.current: ARCHIE: Land, sea, and sky returned to /  motion without belonging to any of us. //  AQUA tried to free the world by choosing /  its answer for it. That was control too.

SootopolisCity_Text_HaventYouScaledSkyPi.current: WALLACE: Oh? /  {PLAYER}{KUN}? //  Haven't you scaled the SKY PILLAR /  yet? //  I'm sure that you can make it to /  the top of the SKY PILLAR…

SootopolisCity_Text_AquaMagmaDidntMeanHa.current: WALLACE: MAXIE and ARCHIE caused this, /  but both finally understand the cost. //  Hear them. Accountability matters more /  when the motive once sounded noble.

SootopolisCity_Text_ThankYouForHelpAccep.current: WALLACE: You did not win by possessing /  the strongest POKéMON in the crater. //  You found the one relationship that made /  every other action possible. //  HOENN is safe. Please accept this.

SootopolisCity_Text_ExplainWaterfallGoTo.current: That HIDDEN MACHINE contains /  WATERFALL. //  With the RAIN BADGE, a party member /  that can learn WATERFALL can climb /  waterfalls without being taught it. //  And where does one get the RAIN BADGE? /  You know, don't you? //  That's right! You have to beat /  the SOOTOPOLIS GYM LEADER. //  When you're all set to go, step through /  that door.

SootopolisCity_Text_DazzledByMentor.current: WALLACE: JUAN's Gym is the final test /  before the LEAGUE. Expect no mercy.

SootopolisCity_Text_GymSign.current: SOOTOPOLIS CITY POKéMON GYM /  LEADER: JUAN //  “The GYM LEADER with the beauty /  of pure water!”

SootopolisCity_Text_CitySign.current: SOOTOPOLIS CITY //  “The mystical city where history /  slumbers.”

EverGrandeCity_Text_CitySign.current: EVER GRANDE CITY //  “The paradise of flowers, the sea, /  and POKéMON.”

LittlerootTown_Text_IfYouGoInGrassPokemo.current: Um, um, um! //  If you go outside and go in the grass, /  wild POKéMON will jump out!

LittlerootTown_Text_CanYouGoSeeWhatsHapp.current: Um, hi! //  There are scary POKéMON outside! /  I can hear their cries! //  I want to go see what's going on, /  but I don't have any POKéMON… //  Can you go see what's happening /  for me?

LittlerootTown_Text_YouSavedBirch.current: You saved PROF. BIRCH! /  I'm so glad!

LittlerootTown_Text_GoodLuckCatchingPoke.current: Are you going to catch POKéMON? /  Good luck!

LittlerootTown_Text_CanUsePCToStoreItems.current: If you use a PC, you can store items /  and POKéMON. //  The power of science is staggering!

LittlerootTown_Text_BirchSpendsDaysInLab.current: PROF. BIRCH spends days in his LAB /  studying, then he'll suddenly go out in /  the wild to do more research… //  When does PROF. BIRCH spend time /  at home?

LittlerootTown_Text_WearTheseRunningShoe.current: MOM: {PLAYER}! {PLAYER}! Did you /  introduce yourself to PROF. BIRCH? //  Oh! What an adorable POKéMON! /  You got it from PROF. BIRCH. How nice! //  You're your father's child, all right. /  You look good together with POKéMON! //  Here, honey! If you're going out on an /  adventure, wear these RUNNING SHOES. //  They'll put a zip in your step!

LittlerootTown_Text_SwitchShoesWithRunni.current: {PLAYER} switched shoes with the /  RUNNING SHOES.

LittlerootTown_Text_ExplainRunningShoes.current: MOM: {PLAYER}, those shoes came with /  instructions. //  “Press the B Button while wearing these /  RUNNING SHOES to run extra-fast! //  “Slip on these RUNNING SHOES and race /  in the great outdoors!”

LittlerootTown_Text_ComeHomeIfAnythingHa.current: … … … … … … … … /  … … … … … … … … //  To think that you have your very own /  POKéMON now… /  Your father will be overjoyed. //  He's at the GYM in PETALBURG CITY. /  Go west from OLDALE along ROUTE 102. //  …But please be careful. /  If anything happens, you can come home. //  Go on, go get them, honey!

LittlerootTown_Text_DangerousIfYouDontHa.current: It's dangerous if you don't have /  your own POKéMON.

LittlerootTown_Text_TownSign.current: LITTLEROOT TOWN /  “A town that can't be shaded any hue.”

LittlerootTown_Text_OurNewHomeLetsGoInsi.current: MOM: {PLAYER}, we're here, honey! //  It must be tiring riding with our things /  in the moving truck. //  Well, this is LITTLEROOT TOWN. //  How do you like it? /  This is our new home! //  It has a quaint feel, but it seems to be /  an easy place to live, don't you think? //  And, you get your own room, {PLAYER}! /  Let's go inside.

LittlerootTown_Text_BirchSomethingToShow.current: PROF. BIRCH: Well, well, {PLAYER}{KUN}! /  That was good work out there! //  I knew there was something special /  about you when I first saw you, /  but I never expected this. //  Oh, yes. Do you still have the POKéDEX /  I gave you? //  I have something to show you. /  Let's go to my LAB.

OldaleTown_Text_SavingMyProgress.current: I want to take a rest, so I'm saving my /  progress.

OldaleTown_Text_IWorkAtPokemonMart.current: Hi! /  I work at a POKéMON MART. //  Can I get you to come with me?

OldaleTown_Text_ThisIsAPokemonMart.current: This is a POKéMON MART. /  Just look for our blue roof. //  We sell a variety of goods including /  POKé BALLS for catching POKéMON. //  Here, I'd like you to have this as /  a promotional item.

OldaleTown_Text_PotionExplanation.current: A POTION can be used anytime, so it's /  even more useful than a POKéMON CENTER /  in certain situations.

OldaleTown_Text_DiscoveredFootprints.current: I just discovered the footprints of /  a rare POKéMON! //  Wait until I finish sketching /  them, okay?

OldaleTown_Text_FinishedSketchingFootpri.current: I finished sketching the footprints of /  a rare POKéMON. //  But it turns out they were only my /  own footprints…

OldaleTown_Text_MayLetsGoBack.current: MAY: {PLAYER}{KUN}! /  Over here! /  Let's hurry home!

OldaleTown_Text_BrendanLetsGoBack.current: BRENDAN: I'm heading back to my dad's /  LAB now. /  {PLAYER}, you should hustle back, too.

OldaleTown_Text_WaitDontComeInHere.current: Aaaaah! Wait! /  Please don't come in here. //  I just discovered the footprints of /  a rare POKéMON! //  Wait until I finish sketching /  them, okay?

OldaleTown_Text_TownSign.current: OLDALE TOWN /  “Where things start off scarce.”

DewfordTown_Text_TinyIslandCommunity.current: The meadow west of town reopened after /  the cave began shining. //  An abandoned manor there holds DEVON's /  oldest records of MEGA EVOLUTION.

DewfordTown_Text_SetSailBackToPetalburg.current: MR. BRINEY: Have you delivered your /  LETTER? //  Or were you meaning to sail back to /  PETALBURG?

DewfordTown_Text_PetalburgWereSettingSai.current: MR. BRINEY: PETALBURG it is, then! //  Anchors aweigh! /  PEEKO, we're setting sail, my darling!

DewfordTown_Text_GoDeliverIllBeWaiting.current: MR. BRINEY: Look for GRANITE CAVE along /  ROUTE 106. That's where STEVEN went. //  Take your time with the LETTER. PEEKO /  and I will keep an eye on the boat!

DewfordTown_Text_WhereAreWeBound.current: MR. BRINEY: Ahoy! The LETTER's delivered, /  and the sea's still calling us! //  Now, my friend, where are we bound?

DewfordTown_Text_PetalburgWereSettingSai.current: MR. BRINEY: PETALBURG, is it? //  Anchors aweigh! /  PEEKO, we're setting sail, my darling!

DewfordTown_Text_SlateportWereSettingSai.current: MR. BRINEY: SLATEPORT, is it? /  A fine harbor, and a busy one! //  Anchors aweigh! PEEKO, we're off!

DewfordTown_Text_JustTellMeWhenYouNeedTo.current: MR. BRINEY: You just tell me whenever /  you need to set sail again!

DewfordTown_Text_GettingItchToFish.current: This is a renowned fishing spot. /  Are you getting the itch to fish?

DewfordTown_Text_GiveYouOneOfMyRods.current: I hear you, and I like what /  you're saying! //  I'll give you one of my fishing RODS.

DewfordTown_Text_ThrowInFishingAdvice.current: And, as an added bonus, I'll even throw /  in a little fishing advice! //  First, you want to face the water, /  then use the ROD. //  Focus your mind… /  If you get a bite, pull on the ROD. //  Sometimes you can snag something /  immediately, but with bigger catches, /  you need to time the pulls on your ROD /  to haul them in.

DewfordTown_Text_ThatsTooBadThen.current: Oh, is that so? /  That's too bad, then.

DewfordTown_Text_GreatHaulInSomeBigOnes.current: Is that right! That's great! /  Haul in some big ones!

DewfordTown_Text_FishingAdvice.current: Oh, hey, don't get down on yourself! /  I'll give you a little fishing advice. //  First, you want to face the water, /  then use the ROD. //  Focus your mind… /  If you get a bite, pull the ROD. //  Sometimes you can snag something /  immediately, but with bigger catches, /  you need to time the pulls on your ROD /  to haul them in.

DewfordTown_Text_XIsTheBiggestHappeningT.current: I like what's hip, happening, and trendy. /  I'm always checking it out. //  Listen, have you heard about this new /  “{STR_VAR_1}”? //  That's right! /  Of course you know! //  I mean, sheesh, /  “{STR_VAR_1}”… /  It's the hottest thing in cool! //  Wherever you're from, /  “{STR_VAR_1}” /  is the biggest happening thing, right?

DewfordTown_Text_TellMeWhatsNewAndIn.current: Hunh? /  It's not the hip and happening thing? //  Well, hey, you have to tell me, /  what's new and what's “in”?

DewfordTown_Text_OfCourseIKnowAboutThat.current: Hunh? /  “{STR_VAR_2}”? //  … … //  …Uh… Yeah! That's right! /  Yeah, I knew that! Knew it all along! //  Of course I know about that! /  “{STR_VAR_2},” right? //  Yeah, that's it, it's there! /  Isn't “{STR_VAR_2}” /  the coolest, or what? //  It's the hippest thing in hip. /  You think I'd not know about it? //  “{STR_VAR_1}”… /  It's, like, so five minutes ago. //  Now, “{STR_VAR_2}” is /  what's vital and in tune with the times!

DewfordTown_Text_XHuhIThinkYIsCool.current: Hmm… /  “{STR_VAR_2},” huh? //  But personally, I think /  “{STR_VAR_1}” /  is what's real in cool.

DewfordTown_Text_HearOfAnyTrendsComeShar.current: Well, if you hear of any happening new /  trends, come share them with me, okay?

DewfordTown_Text_YeahDefinitionOfInRight.current: Yeah, absolutely right! //  “{STR_VAR_1}” is the /  definition of “in” right now.

DewfordTown_Text_BrawlyInSlateport.current: Hey, Champ-to-be! //  BRAWLY, the GYM LEADER here, went /  to SLATEPORT's OCEANIC MUSEUM. //  Look for him in the queue outside. /  He needs a nudge to come home! //  MR. BRINEY can sail you there once /  you deliver STEVEN's LETTER. //  Find STEVEN in GRANITE CAVE, /  northwest of DEWFORD.

DewfordTown_Text_TownSign.current: DEWFORD TOWN /  “A tiny island in the blue sea.”

DewfordTown_Text_GymSign.current: DEWFORD TOWN POKéMON GYM /  LEADER: BRAWLY /  “A big wave in fighting!”

LavaridgeTown_Text_OhYouLikeHotSprings.current: Oh, you like hot springs, do you? //  That's surprising for one as young /  as you.

LavaridgeTown_Text_HotSpringsNeverRunDry.current: We draw as much hot water as we need, /  and yet the hot springs never run dry. //  Isn't it magical? //  These hot springs appear near active /  volcanoes. Veins of water under the /  ground are heated by magma to well up /  as hot springs.

LavaridgeTown_Text_PokemonNippedBackside.current: Being buried in this hot sand is… /  Sigh… //  So warm and heavenly… //  Eh? Gyaah! Ouch! //  A POKéMON nipped my backside!

LavaridgeTown_Text_BatheInHotSpringsEver.current: I bathe in the hot springs every day. //  I want to become a beautiful and strong /  GYM LEADER like FLANNERY.

LavaridgeTown_Text_IfPokemonInHotSprings.current: If people put POKéMON in hot springs, /  it might be seriously strange. //  Why, it might be an electric bath, or /  a bubble bath, or even a lava bath…

LavaridgeTown_Text_HotSpringsClaims.current: They're claiming that these hot springs /  are good for calming nervous tension, /  relieving aching muscles, solving /  romantic problems, and attracting /  money…

LavaridgeTown_Text_HaveEggWillYouTakeIt.current: I have here an EGG. //  I'd hoped to hatch it by covering it in /  hot sand by the hot springs. /  But that doesn't seem to be enough… //  I've heard it would be best if it were /  kept together with POKéMON and /  carried about. //  You are a TRAINER, yes? /  And your POKéMON radiate vitality. //  So, what say you? /  Will you take this EGG to hatch?

LavaridgeTown_Text_HopeYoullWalkPlentyWi.current: Good! I hope you'll walk plenty with /  this here EGG!

LavaridgeTown_Text_NoRoomForThisEgg.current: Oh? You've too many POKéMON. /  There's no room for this EGG…

LavaridgeTown_Text_AsYouWishThen.current: As you wish, then… //  If you have a change of heart about /  hatching this EGG, I will be here.

LavaridgeTown_Text_EverySoOftenEggFoundA.current: Every so often, an EGG will be found at /  the POKéMON DAY CARE. //  Or at least that's how the rumor goes.

LavaridgeTown_Text_GymSign.current: LAVARIDGE TOWN POKéMON GYM /  LEADER: FLANNERY /  “One with a fiery passion that burns!”

LavaridgeTown_Text_TownSign.current: LAVARIDGE TOWN //  “POKéMON CENTER HOT SPRINGS /  An excellent place for relaxing!”

LavaridgeTown_Text_MayNiceBadgesTakeThis.current: MAY: {PLAYER}{KUN}! Long time no see! //  Oh? While I visited the hot springs, /  you got the LAVARIDGE GYM BADGE. //  You must have collected /  good POKéMON… /  No, I believe you raised some. //  I guess it would be okay for you to /  have this.

LavaridgeTown_Text_GoGogglesSentToPC.current: Your KEY ITEMS pocket is full, so the /  GO-GOGGLES were sent to your PC.

LavaridgeTown_Text_GoGogglesNoRoom.current: Your KEY ITEMS pocket and PC are full. /  Make room before taking the GO-GOGGLES.

LavaridgeTown_Text_MayExplainGoGogglesCh.current: MAY: With those GO-GOGGLES, you'll /  have no trouble getting through the /  desert near ROUTE 111. //  But, wow, {PLAYER}{KUN}… /  Challenging GYMS… //  You're trying hard because you don't /  want to lose to me, I bet! //  {PLAYER}{KUN}, I think I should challenge /  your dad in PETALBURG GYM. //  See you again!

LavaridgeTown_Text_BrendanNiceBadgesTake.current: BRENDAN: {PLAYER}, hey, it's been a while. /  How's it going? //  Hmm… /  That's a decent collection of BADGES. //  All right, then. /  You may as well have this.

LavaridgeTown_Text_BrendanExplainGoGoggl.current: BRENDAN: Keep those with you if you're /  planning on going into that desert near /  ROUTE 111. //  There should be some POKéMON that /  are exclusively desert-dwellers. /  You might look around for those. //  As for me… /  I'm considering challenging NORMAN, /  the GYM LEADER of PETALBURG. //  Unlike you, {PLAYER}, your dad looks like /  he really is tough. //  See you around!

FallarborTown_Text_MyPreciousAzurill.current: See! Take a look! /  This is my precious AZURILL! //  It's slick and smooth and plushy, too!

FallarborTown_Text_ShadyCharactersCozmos.current: Something's happening, /  and I don't like it! //  I've seen shady characters wandering /  in and out of PROF. COZMO's home…

FallarborTown_Text_RegionKnownForMeteors.current: This region's been known for meteors /  since the olden days. //  They say METEOR FALLS was gouged out /  by a falling meteorite long ago.

FallarborTown_Text_HaveYouChallengedFlan.current: Have you already challenged FLANNERY, /  the LEADER of LAVARIDGE GYM? //  The girl's grandfather was famous. /  He was one of the ELITE FOUR in the /  POKéMON LEAGUE at one point. //  It wouldn't surprise me to see FLANNERY /  become a great TRAINER in her own /  right.

FallarborTown_Text_MayWeirdos.current: MAY: PROF. COZMO was abducted by /  TEAM MAGMA! //  I'm heading for METEOR FALLS now. /  Please catch up and help us!

FallarborTown_Text_BrendanNuts.current: BRENDAN: PROF. COZMO was abducted by /  TEAM MAGMA! //  I'm heading for METEOR FALLS now. /  Catch up as soon as you can!

FallarborTown_Text_BattleTentSign.current: BATTLE TENT FALLARBOR SITE /  “May the Greatest Teams Gather!”

FallarborTown_Text_TownSign.current: FALLARBOR TOWN /  “A farm community with small gardens.”

FallarborTown_Text_MoveTutorSign.current: HEART SCALE WORKSHOP /  “Scales polished into PP UPS.”

VerdanturfTown_Text_AirCleanHere.current: The way the winds blow, volcanic ash /  is never blown in this direction. //  The air is clean and delicious here. /  Living here should do wonders for even /  frail and sickly people.

VerdanturfTown_Text_ManTryingToDigTunnel.current: My papa told me. //  He says this tunnel is full of /  timid POKéMON. //  They get all scared of loud noise and /  make a big uproar. //  So they had to stop the big tunnel /  project. //  But there's one man. He's trying to dig /  the tunnel by himself!

VerdanturfTown_Text_ManDugTunnelForLove.current: There was a man who dug a tunnel for /  a lady he loved. //  I don't really get it, but hey!

VerdanturfTown_Text_GuyTryingToBustThrou.current: Did you see the cave next to the /  POKéMON MART? //  There's a guy in there who's trying to /  bust up boulders so he can bust out /  through to the other side. //  It'd be great if we could go through… /  It'll make it easy to visit RUSTBORO.

VerdanturfTown_Text_EasyToGetToRustboroN.current: That cave next to the POKéMON MART /  is now a tunnel to the other side. //  It's great--it's easy to go shop for /  new DEVON products in RUSTBORO now.

VerdanturfTown_Text_MakeBattleTentDebut.current: My POKéMON and I, we've been riding /  a hot winning streak. //  So I decided to make my BATTLE TENT /  debut in this town.

VerdanturfTown_Text_TownSign.current: VERDANTURF TOWN //  The windswept highlands where grass and /  people recover after every storm. //  A restored meadow lies to the south.

VerdanturfTown_Text_BattleTentSign.current: BATTLE TENT VERDANTURF SITE /  “Feast Your Eyes on Battles!”

VerdanturfTown_Text_RusturfTunnelSign.current: RUSTURF TUNNEL /  “Linking RUSTBORO and VERDANTURF //  “The tunnel project has been /  canceled.”

PacifidlogTown_Text_FastRunningCurrent.current: The sea between PACIFIDLOG and /  SLATEPORT has a fast-running tide. //  If you decide to SURF, you could end /  up swept away somewhere else.

PacifidlogTown_Text_SkyPillarTooScary.current: The SKY PILLAR? //  …Oh, you must mean that tall, tall /  tower a little further out. //  If you asked me, I wouldn't climb it. /  It's too scary to get up that high. //  Life at sea level in PACIFIDLOG, /  that suits me fine.

PacifidlogTown_Text_NeatHousesOnWater.current: See, isn't it neat? /  These houses are on water! //  I was born here!

PacifidlogTown_Text_TownSign.current: PACIFIDLOG TOWN //  “Where the morning sun smiles upon /  the waters.”

Route101_Text_TakeTiredPokemonToPokeCent.current: If POKéMON get tired, take them to /  a POKéMON CENTER. //  There's a POKéMON CENTER in OLDALE /  TOWN right close by.

Route101_Text_YouSavedMe.current: PROF. BIRCH: Whew… //  I was in the tall grass studying wild /  POKéMON when I was jumped. //  You saved me. /  Thanks a lot! //  Oh? //  Hi, you're {PLAYER}{KUN}! //  This is not the place to chat, so come /  by my POKéMON LAB later, okay?

Route101_Text_WildPokemonInTallGrass.current: Wild POKéMON will jump out at you in /  tall grass. //  If you want to catch POKéMON, you have /  to go into the tall grass and search.

Route101_Text_PleaseHelp.current: Hello! You over there! /  Please! Help! //  In my BAG! /  There's a POKé BALL!

Route101_Text_DontLeaveMe.current: Wh-Where are you going?! /  Don't leave me like this!

Route102_Text_ImNotVeryTall.current: I'm…not very tall, so I sink right /  into tall grass. //  The grass goes up my nose and… /  Fwafwafwafwafwa… //  Fwatchoo!

Route102_Text_CatchWholeBunchOfPokemon.current: I'm going to catch a whole bunch of /  POKéMON!

Route103_Text_ShortcutToOldale.current: If you cross the sea from here, /  it'll be a shortcut to OLDALE TOWN. //  Fufufu, that's useful, isn't it?

Route103_Text_MayRoute103Pokemon.current: MAY: Let's see… The POKéMON found /  on ROUTE 103 include…

Route103_Text_MayLetsBattle.current: MAY: There you are, {PLAYER}{KUN}! //  Dad said you helped him out. I wanted to /  meet the POKéMON that was with you! //  Mine has the type advantage, though. /  Did you use OLDALE's LEVELER? //  Let's see how we do together!

Route103_Text_MayDefeated.current: We lost! You two make a good team!

Route103_Text_MayTimeToHeadBack.current: MAY: I thought I had the advantage! /  I guess there's more to learn. //  Come on, let's head back to the LAB. /  Dad will want to hear about this!

Route103_Text_BrendanRoute103Pokemon.current: BRENDAN: Okay, so it's this one and /  that one that live on ROUTE 103…

Route103_Text_BrendanLetsBattle.current: BRENDAN: Hey, {PLAYER}. Dad told me /  you got him out of trouble. //  Let's see your POKéMON in a battle. /  Mine has the type advantage! //  You tried the LEVELER in OLDALE, right? /  Then let's get started.

Route103_Text_BrendanDefeated.current: Huh. We still have work to do.

Route103_Text_BrendanTimeToHeadBack.current: BRENDAN: All right, you earned that win. /  Type advantage isn't enough, is it? //  Let's head back to the LAB. Dad wanted /  to see you when we were done.

Route103_Text_ANDREW_LocalConversation.current: The fish are ignoring my bait. /  I may have offended the chef.

Route103_Text_ShouldHaveBroughtPotion.current: My POKéMON is staggeringly tired… /  I should have brought a POTION…

Route103_Text_MARCOS_LocalConversation.current: I wrote a song about this river. /  It has a very strong current.

Route103_Text_ISABELLE_LocalConversation.current: I found a shell for my collection. /  It objected and walked away.

Route103_Text_PETE_LocalConversation.current: Swimming is all about timing. /  So is remembering to breathe.

Route104_Text_WhatsItLikeAtBottomOfSea.current: The sea, huh? //  I wonder what it's like at the bottom /  of the sea?

Route104_Text_BrineyLivesInSeasideCottag.current: That seaside cottage is where /  MR. BRINEY lives. //  He was once a mighty sailor who never /  feared the sea, however stormy.

Route104_Text_ThrowBallAtWeakenedPokemon.current: If you're going to throw a POKé BALL, /  weaken the wild POKéMON first. //  It will be easier to catch if it's been /  poisoned, burned, or lulled to sleep.

Route104_Text_OnlyThrowBallAtWildPokemon.current: You're a thief if you try to steal /  someone else's POKéMON. //  You should throw POKé BALLS only at /  wild POKéMON.

Route104_Text_ImNotATrainer.current: Oh, no, I'm not a TRAINER. //  But that's right, if TRAINERS lock eyes, /  it's a challenge to battle. //  If you don't want to battle, stay out /  of their sight.

Route104_Text_DontNeedThisTakeIt.current: I found this Leaf Stone among the /  flowers. You should have it!

Route104_Text_FlowerShopSellingSaplings.current: This FLOWER SHOP started selling /  saplings recently. //  It made me so happy, I went overboard /  shopping. Where should I put them?

Route104_Text_LikeFillingMouthWithSeedsT.current: I found this LEAF STONE beneath the /  flowers! Some GRASS POKéMON evolve /  when exposed to it. You should have it!

Route104_Text_LeafStoneExplanation.current: That LEAF STONE can evolve certain /  GRASS POKéMON. Use it when ready.

Route104_Text_MayWeShouldRegister.current: MAY: Oh, hi, {PLAYER}{KUN}! //  DEVON upgraded your POKéNAV with /  the MATCH CALL system, huh? //  We should register each other so we /  can get in contact anytime.

Route104_Text_MayHowsYourPokedex.current: MAY: Oh, by the way, {PLAYER}{KUN}, /  how's your POKéDEX coming along?

Route104_Text_MayMinesDecentLetsBattle.current: Mine's looking pretty decent. /  So… /  How about a little battle?

Route104_Text_MayHaventRaisedPokemon.current: MAY: Oh, what's the matter? //  Haven't you caught or raised your /  POKéMON very much? //  That's not very good for a TRAINER!

Route104_Text_MayLetsBattle.current: MAY: So, what do you think? /  How about a little battle here?

Route104_Text_MayIntro.current: MAY: {PLAYER}{KUN}! Two badges' worth of /  catching between us now. Show me!

Route104_Text_MayDefeat.current: Yikes! You read that faster than me!

Route104_Text_MayPostBattle.current: MAY: You handle a team like you've /  done it for years. //  But go talk to MR. BRINEY sometime. /  He and PEEKO aren't a “set”. They're /  friends. That matters here too.

Route104_Text_BrendanWeShouldRegister.current: BRENDAN: Oh, hey, {PLAYER}! //  Cool, you had DEVON install the MATCH /  CALL system on your POKéNAV! //  Let's register each other in our /  POKéNAVS so we can keep in touch.

Route104_Text_BrendanHowsYourPokedex.current: BRENDAN: {PLAYER}, how's your POKéDEX? /  Have you filled in any pages yet?

Route104_Text_BrendanDoingGreatLetsBattl.current: Me, I'm doing great! //  Want to check out how good I am with /  a battle?

Route104_Text_BrendanNoConfidence.current: BRENDAN: What's the matter? Don't have /  any confidence in your POKéMON?

Route104_Text_BrendanLetsBattle.current: BRENDAN: What's up? /  Want to have a battle with me?

Route104_Text_BrendanIntro.current: BRENDAN: {PLAYER}. Fresh TRAINER or not, /  I'm not going easy.

Route104_Text_BrendanDefeat.current: Hmm… Fine. You saw it coming.

Route104_Text_BrendanPostBattle.current: BRENDAN: You build well already. //  Still. Watch MR. BRINEY with PEEKO some /  time. Not every partner is a piece on /  a board. Don't forget that part.

Route104_Text_TrainerTipsDoubleBattles.current: TRAINER TIPS //  In the HOENN region there are pairs /  of TRAINERS who challenge others /  for 2-on-2 POKéMON battles called /  DOUBLE BATTLES. //  In a DOUBLE BATTLE, the TRAINER must /  send out two POKéMON, the one at the /  left of the list and the top one. /  Watch how POKéMON are lined up.

Route105_Text_DOMINIK_LocalConversation.current: I challenged the current. /  It swept the entire match.

Route106_Text_DOUGLAS_LocalConversation.current: A LAPRAS ferry sounds relaxing. /  I should have booked one.

Route106_Text_TrainerTips.current: TRAINER TIPS //  Advice on catching POKéMON with a ROD: /  Press the A Button if you get a bite.

Route107_Text_BETH_LocalConversation.current: I swim for the scenery. /  The scenery keeps splashing me.

Route108_Text_JEROME_LocalConversation.current: I counted every wave out here. /  Then somebody used SURF.

Route108_Text_MATTHEW_LocalConversation.current: MANTINE makes this look easy. /  I would also like some wings.

Route109_Text_BrineySailToDewfordQuestio.current: MR. BRINEY: I thought you're supposed /  to deliver the DEVON GOODS. //  Would you like to sail back to /  DEWFORD, then?

Route109_Text_BrineyDewfordItIs.current: MR. BRINEY: DEWFORD it is, then! //  Anchors aweigh! /  PEEKO, we're setting sail, my darling!

Route109_Text_BrineyDeliverDevonGoods.current: MR. BRINEY: Then you go on and deliver /  the DEVON GOODS. I'll be waiting.

Route109_Text_BrineyWhereAreWeBound.current: MR. BRINEY: Ahoy! /  For you, I'll go out to sea anytime! //  Now, my friend, where are we bound?

Route109_Text_BrineyTellMeWhenYouNeedToS.current: MR. BRINEY: You just tell me whenever /  you need to set sail again!

Route109_Text_HUEY_LocalConversation.current: My sea legs are excellent. /  My land legs filed a complaint.

Route109_Text_ChillAtMyPapasSpot.current: Yo, TRAINERS! /  Whether you're hot to trot, /  or cool cat not, /  chill at my papa's spot!

Route109_Text_GWEN_LocalConversation.current: My float has never lost a race. /  It has never entered one either.

Route109_Text_SandCastleTakingLongTime.current: Our sand castle's taking a long time /  to make.

Route109_Text_WereGoingToMakeBigCastle.current: We're going to get all the sand from /  the beach and make a big castle! //  And then we're going to be a king and /  queen. //  We'll let you be a servant.

Route109_Text_LittleKidsDartAround.current: Little kids can dart around so quickly… //  You don't dare take your eyes off them /  for an instant. It's very taxing. //  Mine are with my POKéMON, so they /  should be okay, but…

Route109_Text_ZigzagoonPicksUpLitter.current: The water around these parts is clean. //  But, I get my ZIGZAGOON to pick up /  litter from the shoreline at times. //  Dirty water becomes rain and joins our /  rivers, which we drink from… //  If we pollute the sea, it all comes /  back to haunt us eventually.

Route109_Text_ELIJAH_LocalConversation.current: A bird overhead means good luck. /  Usually. Keep your hat on.

Route109_Text_SeashoreHouseSign.current: SEASHORE HOUSE //  “May hot battles rage on hot sands! /  The place for hot TRAINERS!”

Route109_Text_TrainerTipsSign.current: TRAINER TIPS //  POKéMON at the same level may not /  always have identical stats. //  POKéMON raised by TRAINERS are said /  to grow stronger than wild POKéMON.

Route110_Text_WhichShouldIChoose.current: Which should I choose? //  Make a beeline for MAUVILLE on /  CYCLING ROAD, or take the low road /  and look for POKéMON?

Route110_Text_BikeTechniques.current: Learning techniques will make BIKE /  riding even more fun. //  There are some places that you can /  reach only by using a BIKE technique.

Route110_Text_WalkOnTheLowRoad.current: I don't have a BIKE, so I'll take /  a leisurely walk on the low road.

Route110_Text_YouGotBikeFromRydel.current: Oh, hey, you got that BIKE from RYDEL! //  Oh, it's glaringly obvious. /  It says right on your bike… //  RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, /  RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, //  RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, /  RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, //  RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, /  RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, //  RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, /  RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, //  RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL… /  That name's everywhere. //  You should ride it around all over /  the place--it's good advertising!

Route110_Text_TwoRoads.current: The two roads, one above, one below… //  A road each for people and POKéMON. /  Perhaps that is right and fair.

Route110_Text_HairStreamsBehindMe.current: How do you like the way my raven- /  colored hair streams behind me? //  I grew my hair out just for that.

Route110_Text_RideBikeAtFullSpeed.current: Wouldn't it be great to ride a BIKE /  at full speed on CYCLING ROAD?
