Route110_Text_DALE_LocalConversation.current: OCTILLERY has eight arms. /  Still only holds one fishing rod.

Route110_Text_RatedForNumberOfCollisions.current: This is CYCLING ROAD. //  If you were to ride from MAUVILLE to /  SLATEPORT on a MACH BIKE, you would /  be rated for the number of collisions /  and your total time.

Route110_Text_AlwaysAimHigher.current: Regardless of the results, I count on /  seeing more challenges from you. /  Always aim higher!

Route110_Text_AcroBikesDoNotQualify.current: On this CYCLING ROAD, those riding /  MACH BIKES are rated for their number /  of collisions and their total times. //  ACRO BIKES do not qualify for rating. /  They are easy to turn, so it's not fair.

Route110_Text_WeCantTalkAboutAquaActivit.current: TEAM AQUA's activities… /  We can't talk about them yet.

Route110_Text_KickUpARuckus.current: I want to get going to SLATEPORT and /  kick up a ruckus!

Route110_Text_MyFirstJobInAqua.current: This is my first job after joining /  TEAM AQUA. It's a little scary.

Route110_Text_AquaActionsBringSmiles.current: TEAM AQUA's actions should bring /  smiles to people's faces!

Route110_Text_MayExplainItemfinder.current: MAY: That's a DOWSING MACHINE. Hidden /  items make it sing. //  Have DEVON's researcher translate /  each SIGN before seeking its partner. //  I'm heading north to MAUVILLE! /  WATTSON's GYM is there. See you ahead!

Route110_Text_RivalBeforeBattle.current: Hey, {PLAYER}! Meet me just down /  the path. I want to see your team!

Route110_Text_RivalRewardRetry.current: I still have that DOWSING MACHINE /  for you. Here you go!

Route110_Text_DowsingMachineSentToPC.current: Your KEY ITEMS pocket is full, so the /  DOWSING MACHINE was sent to your PC.

Route110_Text_DowsingMachineNoRoom.current: Your KEY ITEMS pocket and PC are full. /  Make room, then speak to me again.

Route110_Text_BrendanExplainItemfinder.current: BRENDAN: DOWSING MACHINE. It hums near /  items you can't see. //  DEVON's researcher has useful leads /  if you want help finding a SIGN. //  Keep north to MAUVILLE CITY. /  WATTSON's GYM will test your team.

Route110_Text_ChallengeReactionBest.current: Bravo! Splendid showing! //  Your love of cycling comes from deep /  within your heart. /  You've shaken me to my very soul!

Route110_Text_ChallengeReactionGood.current: Your technique is remarkable. //  I suggest you speed up a bit while /  still avoiding collisions.

Route110_Text_ChallengeReactionOk.current: I would consider you a work in /  progress. //  Still, I hope you don't forget the /  sheer pleasure of cycling.

Route110_Text_ChallengeReactionBad.current: My word… Your cycling skills border /  on terrifying. //  Most certainly, you need much more /  practice riding.

Route110_Text_ChallengeReactionWorst.current: …I am aghast… //  You're perhaps not cut out for this /  unfortunate cycling business. //  You ought to give serious thought to /  returning that BIKE to RYDEL.

Route110_Text_MayLetsBattle.current: MAY: {PLAYER}{KUN}! I've been catching /  partners on every route since OLDALE. //  Two of them cover each other in a way /  I want to test. Doubles, right now!

Route110_Text_MayDefeated.current: You broke my pair before it clicked!

Route110_Text_MayTakeThis.current: MAY: You didn't outlevel me. Nobody can, /  here. You built the better answer. //  Take this. It finds what routes hide.

Route110_Text_BrendanLetsBattle.current: BRENDAN: Hey, {PLAYER}. Figured you'd /  come this way. //  I built a pair that covers each other. /  Let's see if your six can read it.

Route110_Text_BrendanDefeated.current: Hmm… You read the pair fast.

Route110_Text_BrendanTakeThis.current: BRENDAN: Levels don't decide anything in /  HOENN. Plans do. Yours was better. //  Here. Take this.

Route110_Text_ImagineSeeingYouHere.current: PROF. BIRCH: Oh, {PLAYER}{KUN}! /  Imagine seeing you here! //  And where might my {RIVAL} be?

Route110_Text_HeardYouInstallMatchCall.current: Oh, I see! /  You two are running separately. /  Well, that's fine. //  Oh, yes, I heard that your POKéNAV /  had the MATCH CALL system installed. //  Well, then, I should register you in /  my POKéNAV as well. //  That way, even when we're apart, /  I can rate your POKéDEX anytime. //  … … … … … …

Route110_Text_RegisteredBirchInPokenav.current: Registered PROF. BIRCH /  in the POKéNAV.

Route110_Text_KeepAnEyeOutForRival.current: PROF. BIRCH: {PLAYER}{KUN}… //  Please keep an eye out for my {RIVAL}. /  … … … … … … //  Well, I had better get going. /  See you again, {PLAYER}{KUN}!

Route110_Text_AquaWasHere.current: “TEAM AQUA was here!” //  Someone painted that onto this sign, /  but then someone else painted over it. //  “TEAM MAGMA rules!” is what it /  says now.

Route110_Text_MauvilleCitySign.current: ROUTE 110 /  {UP_ARROW} MAUVILLE CITY //  A scorched note says MANECTRIC may /  call a storm Champion after MAUVILLE.

Route110_Text_TrainerTipsPrlzSleep.current: TRAINER TIPS //  The foe can be made helpless by /  paralyzing it or causing it to sleep. //  It is an important technique for /  POKéMON battles.

Route110_Text_TrainerTipsRegisterItems.current: TRAINER TIPS //  The items in the BAG can be reorganized /  by pressing SELECT.

Route110_Text_TrickHouseSign.current: “Three steps {RIGHT_ARROW} and two steps {UP_ARROW} /  to reach the wondrous TRICK HOUSE.”

Route110_Text_BestRecord.current: THE BEST RECORD TO DATE… //  No. of collisions: {STR_VAR_1} //  Elapsed time: {STR_VAR_2}

Route110_Text_ThereIsNoRecord.current: THE BEST RECORD TO DATE… //  No one seems to have taken the /  challenge. There is no record…

Route111_Text_BattleOurFamily.current: Hello! I take it you're a traveler. //  How's this? What do you say to taking /  on our family of four in a series of /  POKéMON battles?

Route111_Text_IsThatSo.current: Is that so? /  Drop in, if you change your mind!

Route111_Text_VictorIntro.current: That's the spirit! I like you!

Route111_Text_VictorDefeat.current: Aiyah! /  You're a lot tougher than I expected!

Route111_Text_VictorPostBattle.current: Hey, all! /  I've found a pretty strong TRAINER!

Route111_Text_VictoriaIntro.current: Oh, my goodness! Aren't you young? //  You must be quite the TRAINER to beat /  my husband, though. //  It's my turn to battle now!

Route111_Text_VictoriaDefeat.current: Oh, gosh! /  I can't get over how strong you are!

Route111_Text_VictoriaPostBattle.current: There's a strong TRAINER here! /  This one's really strong!

Route111_Text_ViviIntro.current: You're stronger than Mommy? Wow! //  But I'm strong, too! /  Really! Honestly!

Route111_Text_VickyIntro.current: How dare you make my granddaughter /  cry! //  For that, I'm going to smack you! /  Prepare to lose!

Route111_Text_VickyDefeat.current: Kwah! You are strong… /  My granddaughter was right…

Route111_Text_VickyPostBattle.current: If you're not in any hurry, /  visit with us awhile.

Route111_Text_ToughToKeepWinningUpTheRan.current: If you don't raise your POKéMON some /  more, it could be tough to keep winning /  up through the ranks. //  I've heard the POKéMON LEAGUE's /  ELITE FOUR are far stronger than /  any GYM LEADER.

Route111_Text_BECKY_LocalConversation.current: I came to admire the desert. /  The desert came into my shoes.

Route111_Text_IRENE_LocalConversation.current: A picnic needs three things: /  Food, shade, and less SANDSTORM.

Route111_Text_WinstrateFamilyDestroyedMe.current: I challenged the WINSTRATE family, /  but four matches in a row is tough /  going… They destroyed me.

Route111_Text_ShouldBeMirageTowerAroundH.current: There should be a tower made of sand /  around here somewhere. //  But for some reason, it can be seen /  sometimes, and sometimes not. //  That's why I call it the MIRAGE TOWER.

Route111_Text_MirageTowerClearlyVisible.current: The MIRAGE TOWER is visible! Beneath its /  first floor lies an older stairway. //  Archaeologists say it reaches a fossil /  archive called SANDSTREWN RUINS.

Route111_Text_ThatWasShockingSandRainedD.current: The tower collapsed, but its basement /  passage may still meet DESERT UNDERPASS. //  That route leads into SANDSTREWN RUINS.

Route111_Text_MirageTowerHasntBeenSeenSi.current: MIRAGE TOWER is gone, but the ruins below /  remain. FOSSIL MANIAC's tunnel on /  ROUTE 114 now reaches DESERT UNDERPASS.

Route111_Text_CursedStoneClue.current: That carved stone just east of me /  matches a Galarian YAMASK's slab. //  Read it with a conscious Galarian /  YAMASK missing at least 49 HP from /  its maximum. It becomes RUNERIGUS. //  You can return to the stone even after /  MIRAGE TOWER disappears.

Route111_Text_VialNurseWatching.current: Blob and I help travelers here. /  CHANSEY can be rather playful.

Route111_Text_VialReplacementBall.current: You lost the HEAL BALL? Take another. /  Blob will recognize it.

Route111_Text_VialBringBlobBack.current: Blob ran north along ROUTE 111. /  Please bring my CHANSEY home!

Route111_Text_VialThanks.current: You caught Blob! Thank you! //  Poké Centers will now refill your /  Poké Vial with two full charges.

Route111_Text_DynamoGuardClosed.current: The trail north is closed for now. /  The power lines up to LAVARIDGE went /  down in the last storm. //  WATTSON's crew is rewiring the route. /  Once his GYM certifies you with the /  DYNAMO BADGE, you're cleared to pass.

Route111_Text_CursedStone.current: A curse is carved into this stone. //  Each conscious Galarian YAMASK in your /  party that is missing at least 49 HP /  can become RUNERIGUS here. //  Let the stone call to your party?

Route111_Text_CursedStoneUnchanged.current: The stone falls silent. Bring a /  conscious Galarian YAMASK missing /  at least 49 HP, without an EVERSTONE.

Route111_Text_VialBlobGetBackHere.current: Blob! Stop goofing around and get back /  here! How did you get over there?

Route111_Text_VialNurseNeedsHelp.current: Oh, no! My CHANSEY ran north! //  Please bring Blob back. I'll improve /  your Poké Vial's capacity as thanks.

Route111_Text_VialHealBall.current: Blob trusts this HEAL BALL. /  Follow the trail north and use it.

Route111_Text_DynamoGuardTrigger.current: Hey! Not past the rope. The trail /  north is closed until WATTSON's crew /  finishes the power lines.

Route111_Text_WinstrateHouseSign.current: “Our family's hearts beat as one!” /  THE WINSTRATE'S HOUSE

Route111_Text_OldLadysRestStopSign.current: OLD LADY'S REST STOP /  “Come in and rest your tired bones.”

Route111_Text_TrainerTipsSpAtkSpDef.current: TRAINER TIPS //  One of the indicators of a POKéMON's /  powerfulness is SP. ATK. It stands for /  “SPECIAL ATTACK.” //  Likewise, SP. DEF stands for “SPECIAL /  DEFENSE.”

Route111_Text_TrainerHillSign.current: {RIGHT_ARROW} TRAINER HILL ENTRANCE //  “Scale the heights, you hot-blooded /  TRAINERS!”

Route111_Text_ClawFossilDisappeared.current: The CLAW FOSSIL disappeared into /  the sand…

Route111_Text_RootFossilDisappeared.current: The ROOT FOSSIL disappeared into /  the sand…

Route112_Text_LeaderGoingToAwakenThing.current: Hey, man, is our leader really going /  to awaken that thing?

Route112_Text_YeahWeNeedMeteorite.current: Sounds like it, yeah. But I heard /  we need a METEORITE to do it.

Route112_Text_OhThatsWhyCrewWentToFallar.current: Oh, I get it now. That's why the rest /  of the crew went out to FALLARBOR.

Route112_Text_CantLetAnyonePassUntilThey.current: You got it. And until they come back, /  we're not to let anyone pass, right.

Route112_Text_CAROL_LocalConversation.current: The mountain is lovely today. /  My sandwich is now toast. //  KOFFING takes to FIERY PATH better. /  Level it up there at Lv. 35 or higher /  for Galarian WEEZING. //  Outside that cave, it evolves into /  the usual WEEZING.

Route112_Text_NotEasyToGetBackToLavaridg.current: Eh, I'd like to get to MAUVILLE, but if /  I went down these ledges, it'd be no /  easy matter to get back to LAVARIDGE.

Route112_Text_VialChanseyClimbed.current: Blob bounded toward JAGGED PASS. /  The trail continues up the mountain.

Route112_Text_MtChimneySign.current: MT. CHIMNEY //  “For LAVARIDGE TOWN or the summit, /  please take the CABLE CAR.” //  A newer carving points into FIERY PATH: /  a flame, a mane, and TORKOAL's shell.

Route112_Text_MtChimneyCableCarSign.current: MT. CHIMNEY CABLE CAR /  “A short walk {UP_ARROW} way!”

Route113_Text_FunWalkingThroughAsh.current: PAWNIARD leave little tracks in the ash. /  They become BISHARP at Lv. 52. //  Let BISHARP hold a LEADER'S CREST, /  then level it up for KINGAMBIT. /  The crest is used up when it evolves. //  The free Evolution Items archive has /  crests. Show a battle supplier your /  MEGA RING to open the archive.

Route113_Text_AshCanBeFashionedIntoGlass.current: Wahahaha! Today's technology is a /  wondrous thing! //  Take this volcanic ash here. /  It can be fashioned into glass.

Route113_Text_TrainerTipsRegisterKeyItem.current: TRAINER TIPS //  You may register one of the KEY ITEMS /  in your BAG as SELECT. //  Simply press SELECT to use /  the registered item conveniently.

Route113_Text_GlassWorkshopSign.current: GLASS WORKSHOP /  “Turning Volcanic Ash into Glass Items”

Route114_Text_NANCY_LocalConversation.current: I packed for every weather. /  My bag weighs more than I do.

Route114_Text_AllMyMonDoesIsRoarTakeThis.current: All my POKéMON does is ROAR… /  No one dares to come near me… //  I found this DRAGON SCALE nearby. /  Please, take it off my hands.

Route114_Text_ExplainRoar.current: A Dragon Scale evolves Seadra. /  Use it from the Bag when ready.

Route114_Text_GoodRodOffer.current: These pools hide stronger partners than /  an OLD ROD can reach. Take my GOOD ROD?

Route114_Text_GoodRodAdvice.current: A GOOD ROD opens another layer of each /  route's encounter pool. Try every shore.

Route114_Text_GoodRodDeclined.current: Come back if you decide to explore /  what waits below the surface.

Route114_Text_MeteorFallsSign.current: METEOR FALLS /  RUSTBORO CITY THROUGH HERE

Route114_Text_FossilManiacsHouseSign.current: FOSSIL MANIAC'S HOUSE /  “Fossils from every era studied!”

Route115_Text_NeverKnowWhenCavePokemonWi.current: The shifted tide exposed SEASPRAY CAVE /  along the lower shore. //  Its first chamber is wet stone. The floor /  below is somehow frozen.

Route115_Text_NOB_1_LocalConversation.current: I punched a rock for training. /  The rock remains undefeated.

Route115_Text_KYRA_LocalConversation.current: I race my own best time now. /  She is a very annoying rival.

Route115_Text_HELENE_LocalConversation.current: My coach told me to loosen up. /  I dropped my entire backpack.

Route115_Text_MeteorFallsSign.current: METEOR FALLS /  FALLARBOR TOWN THROUGH HERE

Route116_Text_ScoundrelMadeOffWithPeeko.current: Ohhh, what am I to do? //  We were on our walk, PEEKO and I, when /  we were jumped by an odd thug… //  The scoundrel made off with my /  darling PEEKO! //  Wrrrooooooaaaar! PEEKO!

Route116_Text_KAREN_1_LocalConversation.current: I studied type matchups all night. /  The quiz was on geography.

Route116_Text_ThankYouTokenOfAppreciatio.current: Oh! It's you! //  You're that person who not only helped /  me in PETALBURG WOODS, but also got /  back my stolen package and then even /  graciously delivered it to SLATEPORT! //  CAPT. STERN informed us that the /  package arrived, too! //  I thank you very, very much! //  Why, if I were a rain cloud, I would /  shower you with gratitude and hail /  you as a hero! //  For you, the most wonderful TRAINER, /  I bear good news! //  Recently, our company developed /  a new kind of POKé BALL. //  As a token of our appreciation, this /  is our gift to our wonderful TRAINER!

Route116_Text_NewBallAvailableAtMart.current: Our new POKé BALL will be available /  at the POKéMON MART in RUSTBORO. //  Please do try it out! /  Thank you and bye-bye!

Route116_Text_BagIsJamPacked.current: Your BAG is jam-packed. /  I can't give you this REPEAT BALL.

Route116_Text_TokenOfAppreciation.current: As a token of our appreciation for /  your delivering our package, I have /  a gift of a new kind of POKé BALL /  for our most wonderful TRAINER!

Route116_Text_WantToDigTunnel.current: Nnn… Roar! //  I want to dig that tunnel!

Route116_Text_DiggingTunnelWhenGoonOrder.current: Nnn… Roar! /  What's going on? //  I was digging the tunnel without any /  tools when some goon ordered me out! //  That tunnel's filled with POKéMON /  that react badly to loud noises. /  They could cause an uproar. //  That's why we stopped using heavy /  equipment for tunneling… //  I'm worried that the goon will do /  something stupid and startle the /  POKéMON into an uproar.

Route116_Text_GoonHightailedItOutOfTunne.current: Nnn… Roar! //  That goofy goon hightailed it out of /  the tunnel! I can go back to digging!

Route116_Text_CanYouHelpMeFindDuskStone.current: I dropped a dark stone with a purple /  gleam… //  Can you help me find it?

Route116_Text_MayISeeThatDuskStone.current: That DUSK STONE! /  May I see it for a second?

Route116_Text_DuskStoneIsYours.current: Hmm… Mine bore a crescent scratch. /  This one is different. //  It seems to have chosen you. Keep it-- /  some POKéMON evolve in its darkness.

Route116_Text_DuskStoneAlreadyUsed.current: The purple gleam that was here is gone. //  Perhaps a TRAINER found it and gave it /  purpose. I'll search on.

Route116_Text_DuskStoneNotYetFound.current: A lovely DUSK STONE, but not the one /  gleaming somewhere along this path.

Route116_Text_RusturfTunnelSign.current: RUSTURF TUNNEL /  “Linking RUSTBORO and VERDANTURF //  “The tunnel project has been /  canceled.”

Route116_Text_TrainerTipsBToStopEvolutio.current: TRAINER TIPS //  If you want to stop a POKéMON from /  evolving, press the B Button while it /  is trying to evolve. /  The startled POKéMON will stop. //  This is called an evolution cancel.

Route116_Text_TrainerTipsBagHasPockets.current: TRAINER TIPS //  Your BAG has several POCKETS. //  Items you obtain are automatically /  placed in the appropriate POCKETS. //  No TRAINER can afford to be without /  a BAG of their own.

Route117_Text_AudiniteGift.current: AUDINO often wander through these /  flowers. They're wonderful partners. //  Take this AUDINITE. With a MEGA RING, /  it helps an AUDINO Mega Evolve.

Route117_Text_ArentTheseFlowersPretty.current: What do you think? /  Aren't these flowers pretty? //  I planted them all!

Route117_Text_DYLAN_1_LocalConversation.current: Training tip: take a breath. /  That is also my swimming plan.

Route117_Text_DayCarePokemonHadNewMove.current: I left two compatible POKéMON at the /  DAY CARE, and they produced an EGG! //  Center tutors handle moves. The DAY CARE /  is where new partners inherit traits.

Route117_Text_DayCareSign.current: POKéMON DAY CARE /  “Let us raise your POKéMON.”

Route118_Text_CanCrossRiversWithSurf.current: Even if there isn't a boat, you can /  cross rivers and the sea if you have /  a POKéMON that knows SURF. //  POKéMON can be counted on to do so /  much!

Route118_Text_YouAgreeGoodRodIsGood.current: Hmm! /  A GOOD ROD is really good! //  Wouldn't you agree?

Route118_Text_IdenticalMindsTakeThis.current: Hmm! /  We're of identical minds! //  Hmm! /  Take this GOOD ROD!

Route118_Text_TryYourLuckFishing.current: Wherever there's water, try your luck /  at fishing.

Route118_Text_TryCatchingMonWithGoodRod.current: Try catching all sorts of POKéMON /  with your GOOD ROD.

Route118_Text_MagikarpGuyChallenge.current: A rod catches fish. A Trainer finds the /  battle hidden inside them. //  Want to face my complete fishing team?

Route118_Text_MagikarpGuyDefeat.current: You never mistook the little fish for /  the whole current.

Route118_Text_MagikarpGuyAfter.current: MAGIKARP was the invitation. /  It was never the joke. //  Every weak-looking lead can hide a plan.

Route118_Text_MagikarpGuyDecline.current: No hurry. The river and my team will wait.

Route118_Text_WADE_LocalConversation.current: That splash was a huge fish! /  Or my lunch. I hope it was a fish.

Route118_Text_BARNY_LocalConversation.current: WAILORD took the bait once. /  I am still paying for the rod.

Route118_Text_StevenQuestions.current: STEVEN: {PLAYER}{KUN}! Good to see you. //  Have you found new partners, or stayed /  with your favorites? //  Either way, think about how they help /  one another. That's a team's strength. //  Head north on ROUTE 119. /  Visit the WEATHER INSTITUTE on the way. //  Ask its researchers about the weather. /  Then challenge WINONA in FORTREE. //  I'll keep exploring. /  Let's compare discoveries next time.

Route119_Text_HUGH_LocalConversation.current: Listen to the birds for a while. /  They have plenty to argue about.

Route119_Text_StayAwayFromWeatherInstitu.current: We're standing lookout here. //  Hey, you! Stay away from the WEATHER /  INSTITUTE. It's not safe.

Route119_Text_DontGoNearWeatherInstitute.current: Lookout duty is surprisingly boring. //  Hey, you! Please don't go near the /  WEATHER INSTITUTE.

Route119_Text_ThoughtFlyByCatchingBirdMo.current: I thought you FLY by catching a whole /  flock of BIRD POKéMON, and then /  hanging on to them somehow. //  But it turns out there's an HM move /  called FLY! //  I wish I'd known about that a long /  time ago…

Route119_Text_TallGrassSnaresBikeTires.current: Tch… /  It's a no-go… //  The tall grass snares BIKE tires. /  There's no way you can cycle here.

Route119_Text_CanYourMonMakeSecretBase.current: Can your POKéMON use its SECRET POWER /  on a big pile of grass and make a /  SECRET BASE?

Route119_Text_DAYTON_LocalConversation.current: I brought a campfire starter. /  The rain brought an opinion.

Route119_Text_MayIntro.current: MAY: {PLAYER}{KUN}! The storms up here /  rewrote my whole team. //  I want to know if you still adapt faster /  than I do. Ready? Go!

Route119_Text_MayPresentForYou.current: MAY: I worried the BADGE road would /  harden you into one team. It didn't. //  Here. I have a present for you.

Route119_Text_MayExplainFly.current: MAY: Your FLIGHT BEACON turns on once /  you hold the FEATHER BADGE. //  WINONA awards it at FORTREE GYM. /  Just follow this road north! //  Use it from the BAG. Any town you've /  seen, instantly. //  Go home sometime. Mom asks about you. //  Maybe we'll meet at the LEAGUE!

Route119_Text_FlyHMSentToPC.current: Your TM pocket is full, so FLY was sent /  to your PC. Retrieve it when ready.

Route119_Text_FlyHMNoRoom.current: Your TM pocket and PC are both full. /  Make room, then speak to me again.

Route119_Text_BrendanIntro.current: BRENDAN: {PLAYER}! The rain up here /  made me rebuild everything. //  Let's see whose rebuild is better. /  It's a battle, so battle!

Route119_Text_BrendanDefeat.current: Hmm… You adapted quicker than me.

Route119_Text_BrendanIllGiveYouThis.current: BRENDAN: You could build a team for any /  route in HOENN now. //  Here. Try this out.

Route119_Text_BrendanExplainFly.current: BRENDAN: Your FLIGHT BEACON turns on /  once you hold the FEATHER BADGE. //  WINONA has it at FORTREE GYM. /  Follow the road north and earn it! //  Use it from the BAG. Any town you've /  seen, instantly. //  I'm off. The SIGNS won't catalog /  themselves.

Route119_Text_ScottWayToGoBeSeeingYou.current: SCOTT: Hahahah! /  Way to go, {PLAYER}{KUN}! //  I just passed by a TRAINER riding /  a BIKE. //  You just beat that TRAINER, didn't you? /  It was pretty obvious that you did. //  Already planning the next battle, /  by the look of it. I like that spirit! //  I sure seem to run into you often. /  Are you off to FORTREE GYM next? //  I expect that you'll do well at the GYM. /  Well, I'll be seeing you!

Route119_Text_WeatherInstitute.current: WEATHER INSTITUTE //  FIELD NOTE: CASTFORM may wake the /  storm Champion near FORTREE.

Route119_Text_TrainerTipsDecoration.current: TRAINER TIPS //  Up to sixteen decorations and /  furniture items can be placed in /  a SECRET BASE. //  Pick your favorite items and create /  your very own SECRET BASE exactly the /  way you want.

Route120_Text_ROBERT_1_LocalConversation.current: My bird knows the way home. /  I am trying not to look jealous.

Kecleon_Text_SomethingUnseeable.current: Something unseeable is in the way.

Route120_Text_StevenGreeting.current: STEVEN: Hm? {PLAYER}{KUN}, hi. /  It's been a while. //  There's something here that you can't /  see, right? //  Now, if I were to use this device on /  the invisible obstacle… //  No, no. Rather than describing it, /  I should just show you. /  That would be more fun. //  {PLAYER}{KUN}, are your POKéMON ready for /  battle?

Route120_Text_StevenIllWaitHere.current: STEVEN: No? //  I'll wait here, so you can get ready.

Route120_Text_StevenReadyForBattle.current: STEVEN: {PLAYER}{KUN}, are your POKéMON /  ready for battle?

Route120_Text_StevenShowMeYourPower.current: STEVEN: {PLAYER}{KUN}, show me your true /  power as a TRAINER!

Route120_Text_StevenUsedDevonScope.current: STEVEN used the DEVON SCOPE. //  An invisible POKéMON became completely /  visible! //  The startled POKéMON attacked!

Route120_Text_StevenGiveDevonScope.current: STEVEN: I see… /  Your battle style is intriguing. //  Your POKéMON have obviously grown /  since I first met you in DEWFORD. //  I'd like you to have this /  DEVON SCOPE. //  Who knows, there may be other /  concealed POKéMON.

Route120_Text_DevonScopeSentToPC.current: Your KEY ITEMS pocket is full, so the /  DEVON SCOPE was sent to your PC.

Route120_Text_DevonScopeNoRoom.current: Your KEY ITEMS pocket and PC are full. /  Make room, then speak to me again.

Route120_Text_StevenGoodbye.current: STEVEN: {PLAYER}{KUN}. //  I enjoy seeing POKéMON and TRAINERS /  who strive together. //  WINONA is waiting in FORTREE. /  Earn her FEATHER BADGE, then the road /  east is yours. //  Use the SCOPE on the obstacle outside /  her GYM. It should clear your way.

Route120_Text_StevenFeatherGate.current: STEVEN: The road east can wait. //  WINONA is ready to test you in /  FORTREE GYM. Return with her /  FEATHER BADGE. //  The SCOPE will reveal the POKéMON /  blocking her GYM. Try it there.

Route120_Text_KEIGO_LocalConversation.current: You cannot see a true ninja. /  Please pretend you cannot see me.

Route120_Text_RILEY_LocalConversation.current: I practiced hiding in the grass. /  The grass had other occupants.

Route120_Text_CALLIE_LocalConversation.current: Every good partner needs a break. /  Mine insisted I take one first.

Route120_Text_RouteSignFortree.current: ROUTE 120 /  {LEFT_ARROW} FORTREE CITY //  Two weathered marks show GARDEVOIR /  beside water and XATU beside grass.

Route121_Text_AheadLoomsMtPyre.current: Ahead looms MT. PYRE… //  It is a natural monument to the spirits  /  of departed POKéMON…

Route121_Text_VANESSA_LocalConversation.current: My POKéMON posed for a portrait. /  The artist requested hazard pay.

Route121_Text_NurseOffer.current: MT. PYRE is a long climb. Shall I heal /  your party before you continue?

Route121_Text_NurseHealed.current: All better. Keep your partners close /  on the mountain.

Route121_Text_NurseDeclined.current: All right. SKITTY and I will be here /  if you need us.

Route121_Text_OkayMoveOutToMtPyre.current: Okay! /  We're to move out to MT. PYRE!

Route121_Text_MtPyrePierSign.current: MT. PYRE PIER //  …The sign is old and worn out. /  The words are barely legible…

Route123_Text_LoveGrassMonsHaveAny.current: I love GRASS-type POKéMON! //  Do you have any GRASS-type POKéMON?

Route123_Text_YouLikeGrassMonsTooHaveThi.current: Oh? //  You like GRASS-type POKéMON, too, /  don't you? //  I'm so happy, you can have this! /  It's a token of our friendship.

Route123_Text_CheckTreesWithMyGrassMon.current: I check trees with my GRASS-type /  POKéMON. I'm like a tree doctor.

Route123_Text_KINDRA_LocalConversation.current: That shadow is following you. /  Most shadows do. Carry on.

Route123_Text_JONAS_LocalConversation.current: My smoke bomb worked perfectly. /  Finding my lunch afterward did not.

Route123_Text_RouteSignMtPyre.current: {UP_ARROW} MT. PYRE /  “Forbidden to the faint of heart.” //  A horned ward below the words resembles /  TAUROS.

Route124_Text_SPENCER_LocalConversation.current: I keep a map in my swim trunks. /  It is mostly ocean now.

Route124_Text_ROLAND_LocalConversation.current: CLAWITZER is a powerful swimmer. /  The brakes could use some work.

Route124_Text_CHAD_LocalConversation.current: STOUTLAND found my lost goggles. /  I was wearing them. Good dog.

Route125_Text_NOLEN_LocalConversation.current: I know a shortcut to the shore. /  First, decide which shore.

Route125_Text_SHARON_LocalConversation.current: SLOWBRO never seems rushed. /  I am trying to learn from that.

Route126_Text_ISOBEL_LocalConversation.current: My warm-up was a little long. /  I think I crossed a time zone.

Route126_Text_LEONARDO_LocalConversation.current: I was racing a FLOATZEL. /  Now I am enjoying a quiet swim.

Route127_Text_JONAH_LocalConversation.current: Fishing teaches patience. /  This spot has a full curriculum.

Route127_Text_AIDAN_LocalConversation.current: Birds never need a boarding pass. /  I think they are showing off.

Route128_Text_WAYNE_LocalConversation.current: DHELMISE is not fishing tackle. /  Important lesson. Expensive rod.

Route128_Text_ArchieWhatHappened.current: ARCHIE: What happened… /  What is this wretched scene… //  Did I…make a horrible mistake?

Route128_Text_MaxieDoYouUnderstandNow.current: MAXIE: Do you understand now, /  ARCHIE? //  Do you finally see how disastrous /  your dream turned out to be? //  We have to hurry! We have to do /  something before the situation goes /  completely out of control!

Route128_Text_MaxieResponsibilityFallsTo.current: MAXIE: {PLAYER}, don't say anything. //  I know that I have no right to be /  critical of ARCHIE… //  But the way things are now, I doubt /  that we humans will be capable of /  doing anything about it. //  But neither can we stand by and /  just watch helplessly. //  The responsibility for putting an end /  to this falls to ARCHIE and me…

Route128_Text_MaxieThisDefiesBelief.current: MAXIE: This defies belief… //  Those super-ancient POKéMON… //  Their power is unbelievable. /  They've upset the balance of nature…

Route128_Text_StevenWholeWorldWillDrown.current: This is terrible… //  After the scorching heat wave ended, /  this deluge began. //  If this doesn't stop, all of HOENN… /  No, the whole world will drown. //  This huge rain cloud is spreading /  from above SOOTOPOLIS… //  What in the world is taking place there? //  There's no point arguing here… /  SOOTOPOLIS might provide answers…

Route128_Text_StevenImGoingToSootopolis.current: STEVEN: SURF north to ROUTE 127, /  then west to ROUTE 126's white crater. //  Use DIVE along its southern wall. /  Enter the cavern and surface inside. //  Meet me in SOOTOPOLIS. We must find /  the source of this storm.

Route133_Text_FRANKLIN_LocalConversation.current: WALREIN offered me a ride. /  The seat was colder than expected.

Route133_Text_VialNurseHelp.current: We were swept onto this island by /  Route 133's current. //  May I borrow your help getting /  Chansey and me safely ashore?

Route133_Text_VialNurseUpgrade.current: Thank you! Before we go, I tuned your /  Poké Vial one final time. //  Centers will now refill three charges.

Route133_Text_VialNurseDecline.current: We'll keep waiting for a safe opening.

Route134_Text_HITOSHI_LocalConversation.current: Even MACHAMP takes a rest day. /  It rests four arms. I rest two.

PlayersHouse_1F_Text_IsntItNiceInHere.current: MOM: See, {PLAYER}? /  Isn't it nice in here, too?

PlayersHouse_1F_Text_GoSetTheClock.current: MOM: {PLAYER}. //  Go set the clock in your room, honey.

PlayersHouse_2F_Text_Notebook.current: {PLAYER} flipped open the notebook. //  ADVENTURE RULE NO. 1 /  Open the MENU with START. //  ADVENTURE RULE NO. 2 /  Record your progress with SAVE. //  The remaining pages are blank…

PlayersHouse_2F_Text_ItsAGameCube.current: It's a Nintendo GameCube. //  A Game Boy Advance is connected to /  serve as the Controller.

RivalsHouse_1F_Text_LikeChildLikeFather.current: Like child, like father. //  My husband is as wild about POKéMON /  as our child. //  If he's not at his LAB, he's likely /  scrabbling about in grassy places.

RivalsHouse_1F_Text_TooBusyToNoticeVisit.current: That {RIVAL}! //  I guess our child is too busy with /  POKéMON to notice that you came /  to visit, {PLAYER}{KUN}.

RivalsHouse_1F_Text_WentOutToRoute103.current: Oh, {RIVAL} went out to ROUTE 103 /  just a little while ago. //  Like father, like child. /  {RIVAL} can't stay quietly at home.

RivalsHouse_1F_Text_ShouldGoHomeEverySoO.current: I think it's wonderful for people to /  travel with POKéMON. //  But you should go home every so often /  to let your mother know you're okay. //  She might not say it, but I'm sure she /  worries about you, {PLAYER}{KUN}.

RivalsHouse_1F_Text_DoYouHavePokemon.current: Hi, neighbor! //  Do you already have your /  own POKéMON?

RivalsHouse_1F_Text_MayWhoAreYou.current: You're {PLAYER}, right? /  I'm MAY. Welcome to LITTLEROOT! //  Dad said a GYM LEADER's kid was /  moving next door. I hoped we'd battle. //  He studies how Trainers from different /  regions build around their partners. //  For today's fieldwork, he packed all /  nine regional starter trios. //  He went to ROUTE 101, north of town. /  Go introduce yourself before he leaves!

RivalsHouse_1F_Text_OhYoureTheNewNeighbo.current: Oh, hello. And you are? //  … … … … … … … … … /  … … … … … … … … … //  Oh, you're {PLAYER}{KUN}, our new next-door /  neighbor! Hi! //  We have a {STR_VAR_1} about the same /  age as you. //  Our {STR_VAR_1} was excited to make /  a new friend. //  Our {STR_VAR_1} is upstairs, I think.

RivalsHouse_2F_Text_MayGettingReady.current: POKéMON fully restored! /  Items ready, and…

RivalsHouse_2F_Text_BrendanGettingReady.current: POKéMON fully restored… /  Items all packed, and…

RivalsHouse_2F_Text_MayJustCheckingMyPok.current: MAY: {PLAYER}{KUN}! //  I was just checking my POKéDEX. //  There's still a lot of POKéMON that /  I've seen but haven't caught. //  And there are many others that /  I think will evolve. //  I wonder where I should go catch /  some POKéMON next?

RivalsHouse_2F_Text_MayWhereShouldIGoNex.current: MAY: I wonder where I should go catch /  some POKéMON next? //  Wouldn't it be funny if we ran into each /  other, {PLAYER}{KUN}?

RivalsHouse_2F_Text_BrendanJustCheckingM.current: BRENDAN: Hey, it's {PLAYER}. //  I was just checking out my POKéDEX. //  There are still many POKéMON that /  I need to catch, I know, but this /  is looking pretty good. //  Checking this POKéDEX out gives me /  the urge to hit the road again.

RivalsHouse_2F_Text_BrendanWhereShouldIG.current: BRENDAN: I'm having a hard time deciding /  where I should catch POKéMON next. //  Hey, {PLAYER}, if I see you while I'm out /  catching POKéMON, I can pitch you a /  battle if you'd like.

RivalsHouse_2F_Text_MayWhoAreYou.current: You're {PLAYER}, right? /  I'm MAY. Welcome to LITTLEROOT! //  Dad said a GYM LEADER's kid was /  moving next door. I hoped we'd battle. //  He studies how Trainers from different /  regions build around their partners. //  For today's fieldwork, he packed all /  nine regional starter trios. //  He went to ROUTE 101, north of town. /  Go introduce yourself before he leaves!

RivalsHouse_2F_Text_ItsRivalsPokeBall.current: It's {RIVAL}'s POKé BALL! //  Better leave it right where it is.

LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_B.current: Hunh? PROF. BIRCH? //  The PROF's away on fieldwork. /  Ergo, he isn't here. //  Oh, let me explain what fieldwork is. //  It is to study things in the natural /  environment, like fields and mountains, /  instead of a laboratory. //  The PROF isn't one for doing desk work. /  He's the type of person who would /  rather go outside and experience /  things than read about them here.
The PROF isn't one for doing desk work. /  He's the type of person who would /  rather go outside and experience /  things than read about them here.
PROF. BIRCH is studying the habitats /  and distribution of POKéMON. //  The PROF enjoys {RIVAL}'s help, too. /  There's a lot of love there.
PROF. BIRCH: {RIVAL}? /  Gone home, I think. //  Or maybe that kid's scrabbling around /  in tall grass again somewhere… //  If you or your POKéMON get tired, /  you should get some rest at home.

LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_C.current: Rare POKéMON live throughout HOENN. /  I wonder which ones you'll meet first? //  Explore! And remember, the Trainers you /  meet are learning alongside you.

LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_G.current: PROF. BIRCH: But listen. /  You've become the CHAMPION, /  but your POKéMON journey isn't over. //  There is no end to the road /  that is POKéMON. //  Somewhere, there is a grassy patch /  that's waiting for you!

LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_R.current: PROF. BIRCH: Your LEGENDARY FORM tools /  are still here. Let's finish the set.
Those tools affect KYUREM, ZYGARDE, /  NECROZMA, and CALYREX. //  The POKéMON must still choose you. The /  tools only reveal forms they can take.
Your KEY ITEMS pocket is full. Make room /  and return; every remaining tool is safe.

LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_M.current: MAY: I wonder where I should go look /  for POKéMON next?

LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_B.current: BRENDAN: Where should I look for /  POKéMON next…

LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_M.current: MAY: I think I'll take a short break /  from fieldwork. //  I think I'll help the PROF here for /  a while.

LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_B.current: BRENDAN: For the time being, /  I'm taking a break from fieldwork. //  I'll be helping out the PROF here /  for a while.

LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_M.current: MAY: {PLAYER}{KUN}, after this… /  What are you going to do? //  Are you going to keep battling /  and sharpening your skills? //  Or are you going to try filling /  the NATIONAL POKéDEX? //  I'm staying here to help the PROF.

LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_B.current: BRENDAN: Rather than collecting /  POKéMON, I prefer slowly and  /  steadily raising the one I chose.

LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_M.current: MAY: Oh, hi, {PLAYER}{KUN}! /  Have you gone to that place, /  the BATTLE FRONTIER?

LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_B.current: BRENDAN: Hey, {PLAYER}! /  Have you gone out to that place, /  the BATTLE FRONTIER?

LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_S.current: It's a serious-looking machine. /  The PROF must use this for research.

LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_B.current: It's a book that's too hard to read.

LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_C.current: It's crammed with books on POKéMON.

LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_P.current: It's a PC used for research. /  Better not mess around with it.

LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_L.current: PROF. BIRCH: {PLAYER}, thank you! /  I really was in a spot back there. //  My colleagues sent these POKéMON from /  nine regions. Quite a welcome to HOENN! //  That one trusted you when it mattered. /  I'd like you to keep traveling together. //  {PLAYER} received the {STR_VAR_1}!

LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_W.current: PROF. BIRCH: While you're at it, why not /  give a nickname to that {STR_VAR_1}?

LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_M.current: {RIVAL} is out studying on ROUTE 103. /  You should go introduce your partner! //  {RIVAL}'s POKéMON has the type edge. /  Visit OLDALE's POKéMON CENTER first. //  The LEVELER trains your POKéMON to the /  current level limit, free of charge. //  Would you like to go find {RIVAL}?

LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_G.current: Good! You can learn a lot from a battle, /  even one you lose. Take care out there!

LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_D.current: PROF. BIRCH: Oh, don't be that way. /  You should go meet my kid.

LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_H.current: PROF. BIRCH: {RIVAL} told me all about /  your battle! Sounds like quite a match. //  I have something for your journey. This /  POKéDEX records each species you meet, /  even the ones you haven't caught. //  I can't see all of HOENN from here. /  Will you tell me what you discover?

LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_E.current: Read the signs along each route. They'll /  help you find the POKéMON living there. //  Catch the ones that interest you. Try /  traveling with different companions. //  The LEVELER helps new teammates catch /  up. But tough battles still take care /  and preparation. Look after each other!

LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_M.current: MAY: Oh, wow, {PLAYER}{KUN}! /  You got a POKéDEX, too! //  That's great! Just like me! /  I've got something for you, too!

LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_C.current: MAY: Take these POKé BALLS! I always /  meet new friends in unexpected places. //  Catch lots of POKéMON. You can change /  your team to suit the battles ahead!

LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_B.current: BRENDAN: Huh… /  So you got a POKéDEX, too. //  Well then, here. /  I'll give you these.

LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_C.current: BRENDAN: Here, take these POKé BALLS. /  There's more out there than you think. //  Catch different POKéMON. Then you can /  choose the right six for each battle.

LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_O.current: PROF. BIRCH: Now… //  {PLAYER}{KUN} and {RIVAL}, I've had the two /  of you help me study POKéMON. //  Your POKéDEX recorded every region from /  the day your journey began. //  Now I can synchronize our final field /  notes and mark FRONTIER research. //  Here, let me see your POKéDEX units.

LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_M.current: MAY: Eheheh! //  It's so cool that our field notes /  are finally synchronized! //  It's because you went out and caught /  so many POKéMON, {PLAYER}{KUN}!

LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_B.current: BRENDAN: I went out all over HOENN /  and checked out POKéMON. //  You can thank me for the final /  research notes. //  Yep, you're lucky, {PLAYER}!

LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_P.current: {PLAYER}'s POKéDEX synchronized /  the CHAMPION research notes!

LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_C.current: PROF. BIRCH: Oh, {PLAYER}{KUN}! /  Let's have a look at your POKéDEX. //  … … … … … … /  … … … … … … //  Every known HOENN species. Wonderful! /  You proved how each habitat connects. //  DEVON helped me restore five tools /  from our LEGENDARY FORM research. //  They let certain rare POKéMON change /  or combine outside battle. Take them!

OldaleTown_House1_Text_LeftPokemonGoesOu.current: When a POKéMON battle starts, the one /  at the left of the list goes out first. //  So, when you get more POKéMON in your /  party, try switching around the order /  of your POKéMON. //  It could give you an advantage.

OldaleTown_House2_Text_PokemonLevelUp.current: POKéMON grow from battles, but you /  never need to grind. //  A POKéMON CENTER LEVELER trains your /  whole party to the current limit.

OldaleTown_House2_Text_YoullGoFurtherWit.current: Raw levels alone won't take you far. //  Build different partners for different /  battles, then change plans when needed.

OldaleTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Trainer.current: That PC in the corner there is /  for any POKéMON TRAINER to use. //  Naturally, that means you're welcome /  to use it, too.

OldaleTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Pokemon.current: POKéMON CENTERS are great! //  You can use their services as much /  as you like, and it's all for free. /  You never have to worry!

OldaleTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Wireles.current: The POKéMON WIRELESS CLUB on /  the second floor was built recently. //  But they say they're still making /  adjustments.

OldaleTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_TradedI.current: The POKéMON WIRELESS CLUB on /  the second floor was built recently. //  I traded POKéMON right away.

OldaleTown_Mart_Text_PokeBallsAreSoldOut.current: The clerk says they're all sold out. /  I can't buy any POKé BALLS.

OldaleTown_Mart_Text_ImGoingToBuyPokeBal.current: I'm going to buy a bunch of POKé BALLS /  and catch a bunch of POKéMON!

OldaleTown_Mart_Text_RestoreHPWithPotion.current: If a POKéMON gets hurt and loses its HP /  and faints, it won't be able to battle. //  To prevent your POKéMON from fainting, /  restore its HP with a POTION.

DewfordTown_House1_Text_LifeGoesSlowlyOn.current: I left the major port of SLATEPORT /  CITY when I married my husband here. //  Life goes by slowly on this little /  island. But being surrounded by the /  beautiful sea--that's happiness, too.

DewfordTown_House1_Text_LotToBeSaidForLi.current: There's a lot to be said for living on /  a small island like this in harmony with /  POKéMON and the family.

DewfordTown_House1_EventScript_MegaGift_.current: I found this in a tide pool, held /  tight between two little claws. //  A Binacle has a stubborn grip. /  Its grown form can use this stone.

DewfordTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_StoneC.current: There's a stone cavern at the edge /  of town. //  I've heard you can find rare stones /  there.

DewfordTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Fainte.current: Even if a POKéMON faints and can't /  battle, it can still use a move learned /  from a HIDDEN MACHINE (HM).

DewfordTown_Gym_Text_BrawlyIntro.current: Back from SLATEPORT? Right on! //  I'm BRAWLY, DEWFORD's GYM LEADER! //  My team draws attacks aside, /  then uses the space to set up. //  Don't give us time to build momentum. /  Once we're rolling, we're hard to stop!

DewfordTown_Gym_Text_BrawlyDefeat.current: Whoa! You knocked me off balance! //  Take the KNUCKLE BADGE. You earned it!

DewfordTown_Gym_Text_ReceivedKnuckleBadg.current: {PLAYER} received the KNUCKLE BADGE /  from BRAWLY.

DewfordTown_Gym_Text_KnuckleBadgeInfoTak.current: The KNUCKLE BADGE lets your LEVELER /  train a party up to Lv. 30. //  It also enables the hidden move FLASH /  outside of battle. //  Take this rare MEGA STONE, too.

DewfordTown_Gym_Text_ExplainLucarionite.current: Lucarionite lets Lucario Mega Evolve. /  You'll soon receive the Ring it needs.

DewfordTown_Gym_Text_RegisteredBrawly.current: Registered GYM LEADER BRAWLY /  in the POKéNAV.

DewfordTown_Gym_Text_BrawlyPostBattle.current: Return to STEVEN in GRANITE CAVE, /  northwest of town, for your MEGA RING. //  Your new BADGE lets you use FLASH /  to light the way inside.

DewfordTown_Gym_Text_BrawlyPreRematch.current: BRAWLY: A wave may draw back, but it /  always returns to the shore. //  A giant wave of a talent like you… /  I knew you would return! //  Show me how much higher /  you've gone!

DewfordTown_Gym_Text_BrawlyPostRematch.current: BRAWLY: Battling is vast and it's deep. /  You can't see the bottom. /  It's just like the sea of HOENN!

DewfordTown_Gym_Text_BrawlyRematchNeedTw.current: BRAWLY: A wave may draw back, but it /  always returns to the shore. //  A giant wave of a talent like you… /  I knew you would return! //  Oh? You only have one POKéMON /  that can battle. //  I'm sorry, but I'd like you to come back /  with at least two POKéMON.

DewfordTown_Gym_Text_TakaoIntro.current: GRAPPLOCT locks you down. WOBBUFFET /  makes sure you cannot leave at all. //  Win here, or do not win!

DewfordTown_Gym_Text_TakaoPostBattle.current: Preserve FAIRY or ICE pressure for the /  rare Dragon waiting behind my fighters.

DewfordTown_Gym_Text_JocelynIntro.current: TAILWIND goes up before you move, /  and everything behind it runs you down. //  Four turns. Survive them!

DewfordTown_Gym_Text_JocelynDefeat.current: You never fed the pressure I needed!

DewfordTown_Gym_Text_JocelynPostBattle.current: Attack around MAGIC BOUNCE instead of /  handing NATU your best status move.

DewfordTown_Gym_Text_LauraIntro.current: FAKE OUT steals the first turn, and /  GUTS makes my own burn a weapon. //  Can you afford to blink?

DewfordTown_Gym_Text_LauraDefeat.current: You denied both of my free turns!

DewfordTown_Gym_Text_LauraPostBattle.current: Blank FAKE OUT, pressure the Flame Orb, /  and never switch on instinct alone.

DewfordTown_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice.current: Hey, how's it going, CHAMPION- /  bound {PLAYER}? //  DEWFORD's GYM LEADER BRAWLY commands /  FIGHTING-type POKéMON. //  Going against him with NORMAL-type /  POKéMON is asking for trouble. //  FIGHTING POKéMON will lay a serious /  smack down on NORMAL POKéMON, /  so be careful! //  What's worse, the GYM is as dark as /  the ocean floor. //  But it will get brighter after defeating /  the TRAINERS in your way. //  Hey, okay, go for it!

DewfordTown_Gym_Text_GymGuidePostVictory.current: Whoah! It's turned too bright in here! //  Your future is bright, too!

DewfordTown_Gym_Text_CristianIntro.current: FALINKS strikes its own partner, and /  JUSTIFIED turns the blow into power. //  Hurt us and we sharpen!

DewfordTown_Gym_Text_CristianDefeat.current: You changed form without losing focus!

DewfordTown_Gym_Text_CristianPostBattle.current: Stop RIOLU's stance, respect the LEEK, /  then contain THROH's committed power.

DewfordTown_Gym_Text_LilithIntro.current: INTIMIDATE softens you, then SCRAGGY /  dances into the space it made. //  Weaken me and I only grow!

DewfordTown_Gym_Text_LilithPostBattle.current: A paired battle is two complete teams, /  not one trick repeated twice.

DewfordTown_Gym_Text_BrendenIntro.current: SAWK breaks through what should stop /  it. MACHOP simply never misses. //  There is no safe angle here!

DewfordTown_Gym_Text_BrendenDefeat.current: You changed answers with the damage!

DewfordTown_Gym_Text_BrendenPostBattle.current: Do not let one physical wall become your /  answer to an entire FIGHTING school.

DewfordTown_Gym_Text_GymStatueCertified.current: DEWFORD TOWN POKéMON GYM //  BRAWLY'S CERTIFIED TRAINERS: /  {PLAYER}

DewfordTown_Hall_Text_CantImagineLifeWit.current: What's in vogue? Why, it has to be /  “{STR_VAR_1}”! //  I can't imagine what life would be like /  without “{STR_VAR_1}”!

DewfordTown_Hall_Text_GettingBoredOfTren.current: What's in vogue? Why, it has to be /  “{STR_VAR_1}”! //  But I'm getting kind of bored with it. //  I should look for the next big thing.

DewfordTown_Hall_Text_TeachingMonAboutTr.current: I'm teaching my POKéMON about /  “{STR_VAR_1},” /  but it's not going well. //  It's a bit too much, I think.

DewfordTown_Hall_Text_DeepLinkBetweenXAn.current: I'm studying up on the hip and trendy /  “{STR_VAR_1}” now. //  Is it true that there's a deep link /  between “{STR_VAR_1}” /  and “{STR_VAR_2}”?

DewfordTown_Hall_Text_MyHunchWasRight.current: Oh! /  So, my hunch was right! //  I'm one step closer to being hip and /  happening, yowza!

DewfordTown_Hall_Text_NotEasyToKeepUp.current: What?! /  Is that so?! //  It's not easy for an older fellow like /  me to keep up with trends!

DewfordTown_Hall_Text_TVShowAboutTrend.current: This whole business about /  “{STR_VAR_1}”… /  Isn't there a TV show on it?

DewfordTown_Hall_Text_IsTrendMorePopular.current: Across the sea… //  Is “{STR_VAR_1}” /  even more popular?

DewfordTown_Hall_Text_CollectTrendMercha.current: I collect official /  “{STR_VAR_1}” /  licensed merchandise. //  I have official /  “{STR_VAR_1}” DOLLS… //  Official “{STR_VAR_1}” /  brand clothing… //  And officially licensed /  “{STR_VAR_1}” /  picture books. //  Heheh, I own! /  I'm not sharing anything with you!

DewfordTown_Hall_Text_SawTrendCoolestThi.current: I saw “{STR_VAR_1}”! /  Cool, huh? //  It's, like, the coolest thing going! //  It was awesome! /  It was the real thing, oh yeah!

DewfordTown_Hall_Text_AllegedTrendNotAut.current: Oh, no, no, no. //  That alleged /  “{STR_VAR_1}” /  you claim to have seen--it's not. //  The authentic article is much… /  How should I say it? /  Sharper, yet more mellow! //  Ah, no matter. It's astonishing!

DewfordTown_Hall_Text_ComposedTrendTheme.current: Hey, listen, I composed a theme song /  for “{STR_VAR_1}.” //  “{STR_VAR_1}” /  is really popular right now. //  Okay, listen! /  … … //  Oh! /  {STR_VAR_1}! //  Wonderful /  {STR_VAR_1}!

DewfordTown_Hall_Text_WorkOnYourSinging.current: … … //  I dare say, chap, it would pay for you /  to work on your singing before you /  trifle yourself with /  “{STR_VAR_1}.”

DewfordTown_Hall_Text_OrganizeTrendParty.current: Anyway, as I was saying earlier, we /  should get together and organize a /  “{STR_VAR_1}” party /  on the island.

DewfordTown_Hall_Text_BrilliantIndeed.current: Oh, a smashing good idea! //  It will settle once and for all /  who is the best at /  “{STR_VAR_1}.” /  Brilliant, indeed! //  Starting today, our lives will revolve /  around “{STR_VAR_1}”!

DewfordTown_Hall_Text_TrendHasBecomePart.current: I was thinking, though… //  Wouldn't you agree that /  “{STR_VAR_1}” has /  grown from being something trendy to /  being a part of our daily lives?

DewfordTown_Hall_Text_TrendWeighsHeavily.current: Beg pardon? /  That much, what? //  However, it's true that /  “{STR_VAR_1}” /  weighs heavily on your mind, whether /  you're awake or asleep. //  Absolutely, you're the /  “{STR_VAR_1}” /  PROFESSOR, old sport!

DewfordTown_Hall_Text_IfWeTeamUpWellBeIn.current: If you and me team up as a combo, /  we'll be invincible when it comes to all /  things “{STR_VAR_1}”!

DewfordTown_Hall_Text_WellBeTrendDuo.current: Spot on, my friend! //  We shall be the /  “{STR_VAR_1}” DUO! //  Isn't that a ripe image? /  Hahahah!

DewfordTown_Hall_Text_GiveYouDeepSeaScal.current: The Deep Sea Scale is trending! //  It evolves Clamperl into Gorebyss.

DewfordTown_Hall_Text_ScaleAndTrend.current: That DEEP SEA SCALE evolves CLAMPERL /  into GOREBYSS. //  The trendy move “{STR_VAR_1}” is /  making waves, too.

DewfordTown_Hall_Text_TradeTropius.current: My {STR_VAR_2} longs for a new route. //  Trade your {STR_VAR_1} for my /  {STR_VAR_2}?

DewfordTown_Hall_Text_TradeComplete.current: A fair trade! Give {STR_VAR_2} room /  to spread those broad leaves.

DewfordTown_Hall_Text_TradeDeclined.current: No pressure. Good trades should feel /  right to both TRAINERS.

DewfordTown_Hall_Text_NeedRequestedMon.current: That isn't a {STR_VAR_1}. I promised /  my partner an even exchange.

DewfordTown_Hall_Text_TropiusDoingWell.current: How is TROPIUS? DEWFORD's sea breeze /  never quite suited those leaves.

DewfordTown_Hall_Text_BooksAboutTrend.current: IDENTIFYING GOOD /  “{STR_VAR_1}” & /  BAD “{STR_VAR_1}”… //  THE LINK BETWEEN /  “{STR_VAR_1}” AND /  POKéMON… //  USEFUL /  “{STR_VAR_1}”… //  It's neatly jammed with books about /  “{STR_VAR_1}.”

DewfordTown_House2_Text_WantYouToHaveRea.current: Gorge your eyes on this rare /  REAPER CLOTH! Spooky, yet stylish! //  You appreciate my dazzling taste. /  Here, I want you to have it!

DewfordTown_House2_Text_NoRoom.current: Oh, you don't have room? //  This REAPER CLOTH is rare! Make room /  and come back for it.

DewfordTown_House2_Text_ExplainReaperClo.current: A Reaper Cloth evolves Dusclops. /  Use it from the Bag when ready.

DewfordTown_House2_EventScript_MegaGift_.current: The fish you overlook today might /  carry you through a storm tomorrow. //  Raise a Magikarp with care. /  This stone is for its grown form.

DewfordTown_House2_Text_BrawlySoCool.current: Wow, you bothered to cross the sea /  to visit DEWFORD? //  Did you maybe come here because you /  heard about BRAWLY? //  He's so cool… /  Everyone idolizes him.

DewfordTown_House2_EventScript_MegaGift_.current: I followed a Krabby along the shore /  and found this where it was digging. //  When its claw is big and strong, /  this stone could make it stronger!

LavaridgeTown_HerbShop_Text_WelcomeToHer.current: Welcome to the HERB SHOP, home of /  effective and inexpensive medicine!

LavaridgeTown_HerbShop_Text_YouveComeToL.current: You've come to look at herbal medicine /  in LAVARIDGE? //  That's rather commendable. //  I like you! Take this!

LavaridgeTown_HerbShop_Text_ExplainFireS.current: A Fire Stone evolves certain Pokémon. /  Use it from the Bag when ready.

LavaridgeTown_HerbShop_Text_HerbalMedici.current: Herbal medicine works impressively well. /  But your POKéMON will dislike you for it. /  It must be horribly bitter!

LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_FlanneryIntro.current: I'm FLANNERY, LAVARIDGE's GYM LEADER! //  I used to think Fire meant attacking /  harder. MT. CHIMNEY taught me timing. //  My slowest POKéMON can move first in two /  different ways. Cool the engine early!

LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_FlanneryDefeat.current: You weakened the eruptions, broke the /  Balloon, and changed pace with my heat. //  No type-chart shortcut. Take the /  HEAT BADGE!

LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_ReceivedHeatBa.current: {PLAYER} received the HEAT BADGE /  from FLANNERY.

LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_ExplainHeatBad.current: The HEAT BADGE lets your LEVELER train /  a party up to Lv. 45. //  It also enables STRENGTH outside /  of battle. //  This is a token of my appreciation. /  Don't be shy about taking it!

LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_ExplainCamerup.current: Cameruptite lets Camerupt Mega Evolve. /  Let it hold the stone in battle.

LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_RegisteredFlan.current: Registered GYM LEADER FLANNERY /  in the POKéNAV.

LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_FlanneryPostBa.current: Four BADGES! NORMAN is ready for /  your challenge in PETALBURG CITY. //  Head back through MAUVILLE, then /  west through RUSTURF TUNNEL. //  From RUSTBORO, follow the woods /  south to PETALBURG and its GYM. //  EMBER PATH is also open now. /  Explore it when you can move boulders.

LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_FlanneryPreRem.current: FLANNERY: Losing a battle isn't going /  to deflate me. //  I love POKéMON. /  I love to battle. /  And… I love this GYM! //  Let's exchange superhot moves /  in another battle!

LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_FlanneryRematc.current: Whew! /  On the verge of eruption!

LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_FlanneryPostRe.current: FLANNERY: I lost the match, /  but I'm completely satisfied. //  It's not often I get to enjoy a battle /  this heated. //  Let's have another one like this /  again sometime!

LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_FlanneryRematc.current: FLANNERY: Losing a battle isn't going /  to deflate me. //  I love POKéMON. /  I love to battle. /  And… I love this GYM! //  Let's exchange superhot moves /  in another battle! //  Oh, wait. Do you only have one POKéMON /  that can battle? //  I hate to say this, but when you come /  see me, bring at least two POKéMON.

LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_ColeIntro.current: Owowowowow! /  Yikes, it's hot! //  Touch us, and you will feel it!

LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_ColeDefeat.current: I'm blinded by sweat in my eyes…

LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_GeraldIntro.current: Can your POKéMON withstand /  392-degree heat? //  SUNNY DAY first. Then we run!

LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_GeraldPostBatt.current: The temperature of magma is /  392 degrees. //  Your POKéMON beat me, so they should /  easily survive in magma.

LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_AxleIntro.current: I'm trying to relieve my stress. /  Don't come along and stress me out! //  Hit me hard. I only grow!

LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_AxleDefeat.current: I hope FLANNERY flames you good!

LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_AxlePostBattle.current: Haaah… Whew… //  If you spend too much time buried in /  hot sand, it tuckers you out…

LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_DanielleIntro.current: Um… /  Okay, I'll battle with you. //  Dance, and ORICORIO dances too!

LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_DaniellePostBa.current: I'm going to be a pretty and strong /  TRAINER just like FLANNERY.

LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_GymGuideAdvice.current: Hey, how's it going, CHAMPION- /  bound {PLAYER}? //  LAVARIDGE's GYM LEADER FLANNERY /  uses FIRE-type POKéMON. //  Her passion for POKéMON burns stronger /  and hotter than a volcano. //  Her sun weakens WATER and speeds SOLAR /  BEAM, while TRICK ROOM reverses tempo. //  Protect your WATER answer and disrupt /  the field before attacking.

LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_GymGuidePostVi.current: Yow! That was a scorching-hot battle!

LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_GymStatueCerti.current: LAVARIDGE TOWN POKéMON GYM //  FLANNERY'S CERTIFIED TRAINERS: /  {PLAYER}

LavaridgeTown_House_Text_WifeWarmingEggI.current: My wife's warming an EGG in the hot /  springs. This is what she told me. //  She left two POKéMON with the DAY CARE. /  And they discovered that EGG!

LavaridgeTown_House_EventScript_MegaGift.current: Machamp carried the stones that /  built some of these old baths. //  This one is small enough to carry /  yourself. Let a Machamp hold it.
I learned footwork by watching /  Blaziken train on the hot rocks. //  A flame needs room to grow. /  Take this stone on your journey.

LavaridgeTown_Mart_Text_PrepareBeforeTra.current: TRAINER battles don't allow items /  from the BAG. //  Prepare your moves and held items /  before the battle begins!

LavaridgeTown_Mart_Text_LocalSpecialtyOn.current: On MT. CHIMNEY's peak, there's a local /  specialty sold beside the crater. //  Give it to a POKéMON--it will be elated.

LavaridgeTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_HotS.current: It's sort of magical how just sitting /  in a hot-spring pool can invigorate. //  I wish I could let my POKéMON /  soak, too.

LavaridgeTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Trai.current: I think POKéMON get closer to their /  TRAINERS if they spend time together. //  The longer the better. /  That's what I think.
Hohoho! Hey, kid, you can reach /  the hot springs from here. //  If POKéMON are getting rest, so too /  should their TRAINERS.

LavaridgeTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Moom.current: Moomoo Milk is perfect before or after /  the hot spring. How many would you like?

LavaridgeTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Lucy.current: Scott said a serious Trainer would /  come through these springs. //  I am Lucy. I stack the odds until /  they obey. Show me your answer.
So… You made your own luck.
That ABSOLITE belongs with someone /  who can force the right outcome. //  The BATTLE FRONTIER awaits.

FallarborTown_Mart_Text_DecidingSkittyEv.current: I'm having a hard time deciding if I /  should make my SKITTY evolve or not. //  I only have to use this MOON STONE, /  but it's so hard to decide… //  If I make it evolve, it will become /  much stronger. //  But it will look so different, too.

FallarborTown_Mart_Text_SellNuggetIFound.current: This NUGGET I found here… /  I suppose I'll have to sell it, seeing /  as how it has no other use.

FallarborTown_Mart_Text_MoveSpecialist.current: I once handed out DRAIN PUNCH as a TM. //  Now every POKéMON CENTER specialist /  teaches any legal move for free.

FallarborTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_CameT.current: I heard something about some tent, /  so I came to camp out. //  I didn't know that tents these days /  are so luxurious! //  Since I'm here, I may as well try /  my hand at battling!

FallarborTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_MakeT.current: Fufufufufu. //  I'm going to make everyone think /  I'm just a kid and let them play down. //  Then, I'll shock them and grab /  the title!

FallarborTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_Falla.current: You know how BATTLE TENTS offer /  different events in different towns? //  My favorite is definitely the BATTLE /  TENT in FALLARBOR TOWN. //  I think it's fantastic how TRAINERS /  try to win with all their faith in /  their POKéMON.

FallarborTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_Scott.current: SCOTT: Hi, {PLAYER}{KUN}! /  So you came out to this BATTLE TENT! //  The people in these parts tend to be /  easygoing and laid-back. //  But, you see, what I'm looking for are /  people with… //  How should I say this? //  Someone bursting with the desire /  and the drive to win. //  If there were a TRAINER like that, /  I'd immediately… //  Whoops! Never mind! /  Keep working at it!
SCOTT: Instead of wasting your /  time with the likes of me, why not /  make a challenge?

FallarborTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Foss.current: I wonder what POKéMON looked like /  long, long ago? //  Maybe the FOSSIL MANIAC at the edge /  of town will know.

FallarborTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Plan.current: In the fields of FALLARBOR, we plant /  seedlings of hardy trees that thrive /  even in volcanic ash.

FallarborTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Lane.current: Oh, hello. /  You are? //  Okay, your name's {PLAYER}{KUN}. /  I can see that you're a TRAINER. //  So that means you use the POKéMON /  Storage System I developed. //  How I arrived at that conclusion is /  a simple deductive process. //  You spoke to me because you wanted /  to access something on this PC. //  Oh, I'm sorry. I'm LANETTE. //  Honestly, I'm glad to meet you--it's /  great you're using the Storage System. //  If you could, please visit me at home. /  My house is on ROUTE 114.

FallarborTown_CozmosHouse_Text_Meteorite.current: PROF. COZMO: Oh… /  I never should have let myself be /  conned into telling TEAM MAGMA where /  you can find METEORITES… //  That METEORITE from METEOR FALLS… /  It's never going to be mine now…

FallarborTown_CozmosHouse_Text_IsThatMet.current: Oh! Is that the METEORITE TEAM MAGMA /  took from METEOR FALLS? //  Please, may I have it? I can offer this /  rare DAWN STONE in exchange.

FallarborTown_CozmosHouse_Text_PleaseTak.current: This Dawn Stone is my thanks. /  Please put it to good use.

FallarborTown_CozmosHouse_Text_ReallyGoi.current: PROF. COZMO: Oh, I can't believe it. /  This is really, really great! //  This is really going to help my research!

FallarborTown_CozmosHouse_Text_CrushedWi.current: PROF. COZMO: Oh, but… /  I'm crushed with disappointment…

FallarborTown_CozmosHouse_Text_MayIHaveM.current: PROF. COZMO: Please, may I have that /  METEORITE? //  I can offer this rare DAWN STONE /  in exchange.

FallarborTown_CozmosHouse_Text_CozmoWent.current: PROF. COZMO went off to METEOR FALLS /  on ROUTE 114 with some people from /  TEAM MAGMA.

FallarborTown_CozmosHouse_Text_FeelSorry.current: Poor PROF. COZMO… /  He's so depressed… I feel sorry for him.

FallarborTown_CozmosHouse_Text_CozmoIsSo.current: Look at PROF. COZMO… /  He's so happy! I think it's cute.

FallarborTown_CozmosHouse_EventScript_Me.current: Cozmo studies what falls from space. /  I notice who comes looking for it. //  Clefairy gather around these stones. /  Take this one for its evolved form.

FallarborTown_CozmosHouse_Text_HisuianGo.current: METEOR FALLS has iron-rich stone. Level /  GOOMY to Lv. 40 or higher in its main /  entrance chamber for Hisuian SLIGGOO. //  Elsewhere, GOOMY keeps its usual form. /  Either SLIGGOO evolves at Lv. 50 or /  higher when leveled in rain or fog.

FallarborTown_MoveRelearnersHouse_Text_I.current: Hey there, TRAINER! //  If you want your POKéMON to be the very /  best in all of HOENN, you've come to /  the right place! //  I'm EVIE, and this is my sister, IVY.
IVY: We run the training programs that /  seriously beef up your team!
EVIE: And these days it's all free. //  IVY tunes STAT POINTS, and I trade /  HEART SCALES for PP UPS. //  Come back as often as you like!
I'm a HEART SCALE collector. //  The tutors at every POKéMON CENTER /  already teach moves for free. //  I polish HEART SCALES into PP UPS, /  one for one.

FallarborTown_MoveRelearnersHouse_Text_T.current: Trade one HEART SCALE for one PP UP?

FallarborTown_MoveRelearnersHouse_Text_E.current: A fine trade! I can polish another /  HEART SCALE whenever you're ready.

FallarborTown_MoveRelearnersHouse_Text_B.current: Bring me a HEART SCALE and I'll trade /  you a PP UP.

FallarborTown_MoveRelearnersHouse_Text_N.current: Your BAG has no room for a PP UP. /  Make space before we trade.

FallarborTown_MoveRelearnersHouse_Text_M.current: No rush. Your HEART SCALE stays safe /  with you until you're ready.

VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_Attr.current: My feelings toward my POKéMON… /  The attraction runs deep… //  Oh, hi! A bond like yours deserves /  this SHINY STONE.
My feelings toward my POKéMON… /  I'm sure the attraction is mutual! //  They battle exactly the way I want /  them to!

VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_Taug.current: What kind of moves have you taught /  your POKéMON? //  I think you would give yourself /  an advantage if they knew how to /  heal or protect themselves.

VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_Mons.current: If it doesn't like a certain move, /  a POKéMON will be reluctant to use it. //  It doesn't matter how strong it is, /  either. //  For example, a POKéMON with a GENTLE /  nature probably won't enjoy hurting /  its opponents. //  If it can't seem to live up to its /  potential, it's probably failing at /  using a disliked move against its will.

VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_Scot.current: SCOTT: Hey there, {PLAYER}{KUN}! /  I thought I might see you here. //  A BATTLE TENT's a place where /  you can meet tough TRAINERS. //  It doesn't matter what the rules are, /  or how battles are waged, either. //  {PLAYER}{KUN}, I expect you to do /  the best you can!
SCOTT: I visit here regularly in hopes /  of seeing tough TRAINERS in action /  in whatever the situation.

VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_Gent.current: My big sister is gentle usually. /  But when she gets angry, /  she's really, really scary! //  I bet a gentle POKéMON will be scary /  if it gets angry!

VerdanturfTown_Mart_Text_LuxuryBallBuild.current: A LUXURY BALL helps a caught POKéMON /  grow friendly more quickly. //  The right Ball can make team building /  feel like part of the adventure.

VerdanturfTown_Mart_Text_NoStrategyGuide.current: They don't seem to sell any winning /  strategy guides for the BATTLE TENT… //  It seems one must rely on one's /  own wits after all…

VerdanturfTown_Mart_Text_NestBallOnLower.current: The NEST BALL works better on /  lower-level wild POKéMON. //  It is one of several specialty BALLS /  sold around HOENN.

VerdanturfTown_Mart_Text_MoveSpecialist.current: I used to reward patient POKéMON /  with the move PAYBACK. //  The CENTER specialist teaches it now /  whenever the species can learn it.

VerdanturfTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Fai.current: You can't consider yourself a real /  TRAINER if you don't have faith /  in your POKéMON. //  Only those people who can believe /  in their battling POKéMON can win /  through to the very end.

VerdanturfTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Vis.current: The reason why anyone would visit /  VERDANTURF… //  It's the BATTLE TENT. It goes without /  saying. //  Or is there somebody here that you /  came to see?

VerdanturfTown_WandasHouse_Text_Stronger.current: WALLY: I lost to you, {PLAYER}, but I'm /  not feeling down anymore. //  Because I have a new purpose in life. /  Together with my RALTS, I'm going /  to challenge POKéMON GYMS and become /  a great TRAINER. //  Please watch me, {PLAYER}. /  I'm going to be stronger than you. //  When I do, I'm going to challenge you /  to another battle.
WALLY: Please watch me, {PLAYER}. /  I'm going to get stronger than you. //  When I do, I'm going to challenge you /  to another battle.

VerdanturfTown_WandasHouse_Text_CanSeeGi.current: Thanks to you, I can see my girlfriend /  every day. /  Happy? You bet I am!

VerdanturfTown_WandasHouse_Text_WallysNe.current: UNCLE: Oh! {PLAYER}{KUN}! /  WALLY's next door. //  But, boy, there's something I have to /  tell you. //  This natural environment is doing /  wonders for WALLY's health. //  Maybe it's not just the environment. /  It could be POKéMON that are giving /  the boy hope.

VerdanturfTown_WandasHouse_Text_WallySli.current: WALLY's gone away… /  He slipped off on his own…

VerdanturfTown_WandasHouse_Text_WallyGon.current: UNCLE: Is that right? /  WALLY's gone away that far all by /  himself… //  Well, I have to give him credit--he is /  my little brother's son.

VerdanturfTown_WandasHouse_Text_Daughter.current: My daughter's boyfriend is a very /  driven and passionate sort of person. //  He's been digging a tunnel nonstop /  just so he can see my daughter. //  My daughter's a little concerned, /  so she goes out to the tunnel a lot.
It's amazing. My daughter's boyfriend /  was digging the tunnel by hand! //  It's so incredible!

VerdanturfTown_WandasHouse_Text_IfAnythi.current: If anything were to happen to WALLY, /  I would never be able to look his /  parents in PETALBURG in the eye…

VerdanturfTown_WandasHouse_Text_WallyWas.current: WALLY was in EVER GRANDE? //  His parents in PETALBURG would be /  astonished to hear that!

VerdanturfTown_WandasHouse_EventScript_M.current: Wally and his Ralts have given /  each other the courage to grow. //  If you raise a Gardevoir, this /  stone can deepen that partnership.

VerdanturfTown_WandasHouse_Text_MeetWand.current: WANDA: You are? /  Oh, right, I get it! //  You're the {PLAYER} who WALLY was /  telling me about. //  I'm WALLY's cousin. /  Glad to meet you! //  I think WALLY's become a lot more lively /  and healthy since he came here.

VerdanturfTown_WandasHouse_Text_DontWorr.current: WANDA: Don't worry about WALLY. /  He'll be just fine. //  I know my little cousin, and he has /  POKéMON with him, too.

VerdanturfTown_FriendshipRatersHouse_Tex.current: Let me see your POKéMON. /  I'll check to see how much it likes you. //  Oh. /  Your POKéMON…
It adores you. /  It can't possibly love you any more. /  I even feel happy seeing it.
It seems to be very happy. /  It obviously likes you a whole lot.
It likes you quite a lot. /  It seems to want to be babied a little.
It's getting used to you. /  It seems to believe in you.
It's not very used to you yet. /  It neither loves nor hates you.
It's very wary. /  It has scary viciousness in its eyes. /  It doesn't like you much at all.
This is a little hard for me to say… //  Your POKéMON simply detests you. /  Doesn't that make you uncomfortable?

VerdanturfTown_FriendshipRatersHouse_Eve.current: A little Pichu can grow into /  a wonderful traveling companion. //  This stone is for a Raichu. /  Friendship is where it all begins.

VerdanturfTown_FriendshipRatersHouse_Tex.current: This {STR_VAR_2} needs a caring /  TRAINER. Trade a {STR_VAR_1} for it?
Thank you. Friendship is the best /  training CHANSEY can receive.
That's all right. A trade should never /  be rushed.
That isn't a {STR_VAR_1}. Please bring /  the partner we discussed.
CHANSEY and DITTO at the DAY CARE /  can have a HAPPINY EGG.

VerdanturfTown_House_Text_TrainersGather.current: Far away, deep in EVER GRANDE CITY, /  is the POKéMON LEAGUE. //  The TRAINERS who gather there are /  all frighteningly well skilled.

VerdanturfTown_House_Text_DefeatEliteFou.current: In the POKéMON LEAGUE, I think the /  rules say that you have to battle the /  ELITE FOUR all in a row. //  If you lose to any of them, you have /  to begin your challenge again from the /  first one.

VerdanturfTown_House_EventScript_MegaGif.current: Strength can be quiet. A Gallade /  uses its blades to protect others. //  I think this stone belongs with /  someone who understands that.

PacifidlogTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Anc.current: The ancestors of the people in /  PACIFIDLOG were said to have been /  born on boats and then lived and died  /  aboard them. //  I understand that they lived that way /  because they were searching for /  something.

PacifidlogTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Wha.current: What color is your TRAINER CARD? /  Mine's copper!

PacifidlogTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_OnC.current: PACIFIDLOG TOWN floats on top of /  a colony of CORSOLA. //  If I told you that, would you believe /  me?

PacifidlogTown_House1_Text_RegiStory.current: In the HOENN region, there are three /  POKéMON that represent the power of /  rock, ice, and steel. //  Each of them is said to hide away deep /  inside caves. //  That's the story I heard when I was /  just a little kid.

PacifidlogTown_House1_Text_SixDotsOpenTh.current: “Six dots open three doors.” //  Grandpa used to say that, but I don't /  know what he meant.

PacifidlogTown_House2_Text_ChairmansYoun.current: Er-hem! //  I am the POKéMON FAN CLUB's most /  important person, the CHAIRMAN's /  younger brother. //  I'm here enjoying my vacation with /  POKéMON, yes, indeed.

PacifidlogTown_House2_Text_AdoringPokemo.current: It clearly likes you very much. //  A POKéMON that bright deserves this /  SUN STONE, don't you think?

PacifidlogTown_House2_Text_PutInSomeMore.current: Hmm… /  It's not bad, but it's also not good. //  You, as the TRAINER, need to put in /  some more effort.

PacifidlogTown_House2_Text_ViciousPokemo.current: It has a fierce look to it. //  A POKéMON that intense deserves this /  MOON STONE.

PacifidlogTown_House2_Text_ExplainReturn.current: SUN and MOON STONES evolve different /  POKéMON. Use this one when ready.

PacifidlogTown_House2_Text_GetGoodStoneI.current: In {STR_VAR_1} days, I'll receive more /  evolution stones. //  Come see me then, and I'll choose one /  that suits your lead POKéMON.

PacifidlogTown_House2_Text_VeryFriendlyW.current: It appears to be very friendly with the /  TRAINER.

PacifidlogTown_House2_Text_DoesntLikeTra.current: It doesn't appear to like the TRAINER /  very much.

PacifidlogTown_House3_Text_IsThatAPokede.current: Is that a POKéDEX? //  Did you get to meet a lot of different /  POKéMON? //  I wish I was like you.

PacifidlogTown_House3_Text_WillingToTrad.current: Check out this {STR_VAR_2}! //  It's the {STR_VAR_2} that I caught /  yesterday to celebrate my birthday! //  Oh, I can see that you want it! /  After all, it's priceless! //  I'll tell you what. I might be willing /  to trade it for a {STR_VAR_1}.

PacifidlogTown_House3_Text_ItsSubtlyDiff.current: Oh, so this is a {STR_VAR_1}? //  It's sort of like a {STR_VAR_2}, /  and yet it's subtly different. //  My {STR_VAR_2} is already trained /  for doubles. Ride it well!

PacifidlogTown_House3_Text_WontAcceptAny.current: No, no, no! I won't accept any /  less than a real {STR_VAR_1}!

PacifidlogTown_House3_Text_NotDesperateO.current: Oh, so you're not going to go through /  with this? //  That's cool. I'm not desperate to make /  a trade or anything.

PacifidlogTown_House3_Text_ReallyWantedT.current: I know I could go looking for one /  on my own, but… //  But I really wanted to get a BAGON /  that another TRAINER caught…

PacifidlogTown_House4_Text_PeopleSawHigh.current: People were saying they saw a POKéMON /  flying high above HOENN. //  Is it flying around all the time? /  Doesn't it need to rest somewhere?

PacifidlogTown_House4_Text_SkyPokemon.current: A sky POKéMON! /  A sky POKéMON!

PacifidlogTown_House4_Text_YesTown.current: Yes? /  YES TOWN? //  I've never heard of a place like that.

PacifidlogTown_House4_Text_YouHaveToCome.current: No? That doesn't make any sense. /  You have to come from somewhere. //  Oh! Wait! You're not going to say you /  were born at the bottom of the sea?

PacifidlogTown_House5_Text_CantSeeMirage.current: I can't see MIRAGE ISLAND today…

PacifidlogTown_House5_Text_CanSeeMirageI.current: Oh! Oh my! /  I can see MIRAGE ISLAND today!

PacifidlogTown_House5_Text_MirageIslandA.current: MIRAGE ISLAND… //  It must become visible and invisible /  depending on the weather conditions /  that make mirages appear. //  Or is it really appearing and /  disappearing?

PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_ThanksFor.current: You're… /  Ah, you must be {PLAYER}{KUN}, right? //  Thank you for playing with WALLY a /  little while ago. //  He's been frail and sickly ever /  since he was a baby. //  We've sent him to stay with my relatives /  in VERDANTURF TOWN for a while. //  The air is a lot cleaner there /  than it is here. //  What's that? Where's WALLY? /  He's already left, our WALLY. //  I wonder where he could have /  gotten by now?

PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_WonderHow.current: I wonder how our WALLY is doing?

PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_SurfGoAll.current: A partner that can SURF will carry /  you across water. Head to MAUVILLE. //  Go east onto ROUTE 118 and cross its /  river, then take ROUTE 119 north. //  Beyond the WEATHER INSTITUTE lies /  FORTREE CITY and WINONA's GYM.
