PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_WallyIsCo.current: WALLY's coming home soon. /  I'm looking forward to that.

PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_YouMetWal.current: Oh? You met WALLY in /  EVER GRANDE CITY? //  Oh, {PLAYER}{KUN}, don't be silly. //  He may have gotten healthy, but he /  can't go somewhere far away like /  that all by himself.

PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_WallyWasR.current: WALLY was really happy when he told /  us that he caught a POKéMON. //  It's been ages since I've seen him /  smile like that.

PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_WallyLeft.current: I want you to keep this a secret /  from my husband… //  But our WALLY left VERDANTURF TOWN /  without telling anyone. //  You know, WALLY is frail, but /  he's surprisingly strong-willed. //  I'm sure that he'll come back safe /  and sound one day!

PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_PleaseExc.current: {PLAYER}{KUN}! Please excuse us for /  dragging you here this way. //  But our WALLY's become very healthy /  since he went to VERDANTURF TOWN. //  We owe it all to you! //  When WALLY left town, you helped /  him catch a POKéMON, right? //  I think that made WALLY really /  happy. //  Actually, not just WALLY. /  It made me, his father, happy too. //  Happy that he's gained such a great /  friend as you. //  This isn't a bribe or anything, but /  I'd really like you to have this.

PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_DadYoureHereWithY.current: DAD: Hm? //  Well, if it isn't {PLAYER}! /  So you're all finished moving in? //  I'm surprised that you managed to /  get here by yourself. //  Oh, I see. /  You're with your POKéMON. //  Hm… Then I guess you're going to /  become a TRAINER like me, {PLAYER}. //  That's great news! /  I'll be looking forward to it!

PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_WallyIdLikeAPokem.current: Um… I… /  I'd like to get a POKéMON, please…

PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_DadOhYoureWallyRi.current: DAD: Hm? You're… Uh… Oh, right. /  You're WALLY, right?

PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_WallyIveNeverCaug.current: WALLY: I'm going to go stay with my /  relatives in VERDANTURF TOWN. //  I thought I would be lonely by myself, /  so I wanted to take a POKéMON along. //  But I've never caught a POKéMON before. /  I don't know how…

PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_DadPlayerGoWithWa.current: DAD: {PLAYER}, you heard that, /  right? //  Go with WALLY and make sure that he /  safely catches a POKéMON.

PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_IllLoanYouMyZigza.current: WALLY, here, I'll loan you my POKéMON. //  WALLY received a ZIGZAGOON!

PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_WallyThankYouAndD.current: WALLY: Oh, wow! /  A POKéMON! //  DAD: Hm. I'll give you a POKé BALL, too. /  Go for it! //  WALLY received a POKé BALL!

PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_WouldYouReallyCom.current: {PLAYER}… Would you really come /  with me?

PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_NormanGoToRustbor.current: DAD: Hm? Aren't you going to the /  POKéMON GYM in RUSTBORO CITY? //  Follow ROUTE 104 west of town, then /  head north through PETALBURG WOODS. //  There's no challenge for me to /  battle a greenhorn TRAINER. //  {PLAYER}, I want you to challenge me /  when you become a lot stronger. //  I'll battle you, {PLAYER}, when you /  can show me four GYM BADGES, okay?

PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_NormanGoToDewford.current: DAD: I see… So, you've beaten /  the GYM LEADER in RUSTBORO CITY. //  But there are many more TRAINERS /  who are stronger than you, {PLAYER}. //  Across the sea in DEWFORD TOWN is a /  GYM LEADER named BRAWLY. //  You should go challenge him.

PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_YouHaveGottenStro.current: DAD: Hm… {PLAYER}, you have gotten /  stronger. //  I can tell by the number of BADGES /  that you've earned.

PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_NextGymMauville.current: WATTSON runs MAUVILLE GYM. From /  SLATEPORT, follow ROUTE 110 north. //  Keep going. Bring back four BADGES, /  and we'll see how far you've come.

PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_NextGymLavaridge.current: FLANNERY runs LAVARIDGE GYM, below /  MT. CHIMNEY. Travel north of MAUVILLE. //  The cable car is on ROUTE 112. From /  the summit, JAGGED PASS leads down. //  Earn that fourth BADGE, then come home. /  I'll be waiting here at the GYM.

PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_NormanIntro.current: DAD: Four BADGES brought you back, but /  this battle is not about raw growth. //  Every member of my team reveals a rule: /  a lock, an Ability, an item, or a clock. //  Read each one before you commit. I will /  battle as GYM LEADER, not as your father.

PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_NormanDefeat.current: You read every rule I placed in front of /  you, and forced me to read yours. //  I'm proud of you. Take the BALANCE BADGE.

PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_ReceivedBalanceBa.current: {PLAYER} received the BALANCE BADGE /  from DAD!

PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_ExplainBalanceBad.current: DAD: The BALANCE BADGE lets your /  LEVELER train a party up to Lv. 55. //  It also lets POKéMON use SURF to /  travel over water. //  This is my gift to you. {PLAYER}, I'm /  sure you can use it correctly.

PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_ExplainLopunnite.current: Dad: Lopunnite lets Lopunny Mega Evolve. /  Let it hold the stone in battle.

PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_DadHappyAndSad.current: DAD: As a LEADER, I learned from you. /  As your father, I'm simply proud.

PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_PleaseComeWithMe.current: Ah, there you are, {PLAYER}{KUN}! //  Please come with me. /  I have something I want you to have.

PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_LetMeBorrowPlayer.current: NORMAN, you don't mind, do you? //  Let me borrow your {PLAYER}{KUN} for /  a minute or two.

PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_DadGoingToKeepTra.current: DAD: {PLAYER}, you should go visit /  your mother every so often. //  I'm going to stay here and redouble /  my training. //  It would bother me as a TRAINER to /  not avenge my loss to you, {PLAYER}!

PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_DadNoAmountOfTrai.current: DAD: {PLAYER}, how are things going? //  The world of POKéMON is deep. //  I honestly think that no amount of /  training would ever be enough.

PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_MaryIntro.current: Giggle… /  This is the ACCURACY ROOM. //  It's pretty nasty when every attack /  lands without fail. //  Hurt me halfway, and BERSERK answers!

PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_MaryDefeat.current: You were a cut above me…

PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_MaryPostBattle.current: There are some even stronger /  TRAINERS waiting for you. //  The left is the DEFENSE ROOM, and /  the right is the RECOVERY ROOM. //  Your POKéMON's ATTACK power will be /  on trial either way.

PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_MaryPostBadge.current: Do you know what we're trying to /  achieve as TRAINERS? //  We're striving to become soul mates /  with our POKéMON.

PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_RandallIntro.current: The ability to attack before the /  opponent… //  Just that alone puts me at a great /  advantage, don't you agree? //  Five hits a turn. No SASH lives!

PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_RandallPostBattle.current: Go on to the next room where a new /  challenge awaits you. //  At the left is the CONFUSION ROOM. //  The right door leads to the DEFENSE /  ROOM.

PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_RandallPostBadge.current: Whomever you beat, and whomever you /  may lose to, you never shirk from /  training yourself and your POKéMON. //  That's what I think being a /  GYM LEADER is all about.

PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_ParkerIntro.current: This is the CONFUSION ROOM. //  Let me see how well bonded you are /  with your POKéMON! //  TRICK ROOM. My slowest strike first!

PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_ParkerDefeat.current: I couldn't confuse your team enough… /  You share a strong bond together.

PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_ParkerPostBattle.current: The next room is the STRENGTH ROOM. /  Can you withstand brute force?

PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_ParkerPostBadge.current: After you beat our LEADER, the /  training has become a lot tougher.

PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_AlexiaIntro.current: The higher the DEFENSE, the more /  reckless I can be in attack. //  My own poison is the whole point!

PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_AlexiaPostBattle.current: I think you've taught me a valuable /  lesson here. //  Now, go on! The left door goes to /  the STRENGTH ROOM. //  The right door opens to /  the ONE-HIT KO ROOM. //  Both of them have TRAINERS who are /  skilled at offense.

PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_AlexiaPostBadge.current: Hi! Have you tried using SURF?

PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_GeorgeIntro.current: Just when you think you're going to /  win, your opponent restores HP… //  Can you just imagine how awful that /  must feel? //  I'll show you exactly how awful it /  feels!

PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_GeorgeDefeat.current: I couldn't restore HP enough… /  What ATTACK power…

PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_GeorgePostBattle.current: I should have expected no less from /  our LEADER's kid. //  No, wait! A TRAINER's abilities are /  earned only through effort. //  I lost because my own efforts /  weren't enough. //  Go on! The ONE-HIT KO ROOM is next.

PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_GeorgePostBadge.current: I'm going to keep training at GYMS. /  One day, I'll become a LEADER.

PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_JodyIntro.current: Our GYM LEADER told us to go all out /  and beat you. //  Even if you happen to be the /  LEADER's kid! //  No tricks in here. Only power!

PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_JodyPostBattle.current: The way you use your POKéMON… /  It's like your father's style. //  Go on through! The GYM LEADER, your /  father, is waiting!

PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_JodyPostBadge.current: Sure, it's fine to make your POKéMON /  stronger. //  But what decides the winner? //  Why, it's the feelings TRAINERS have /  for their POKéMON.

PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_BerkeIntro.current: This is the BURST ROOM. SCRAPPY sound /  crosses Ghosts. One visible EXPLOSION /  can erase a careless board. Position!

PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_BerkeDefeat.current: You made every burst hit the wrong turn!

PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_BerkePostBattle.current: Track TRICK ROOM, guard the telegraphed /  EXPLOSION, and keep an answer for the /  refrigerated final impact.

PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_BerkePostBadge.current: Since your dad became the LEADER, /  the TRAINERS of PETALBURG CITY have /  become a lot tougher.

PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice.current: Hey, how's it going, CHAMPION- /  bound {PLAYER}? //  The doors in this GYM open when you /  beat the awaiting TRAINERS. //  Whoops! The doors in this room are /  already open, so don't attack me! //  The TRAINERS of PETALBURG GYM /  use all kinds of items. //  The door at the left leads to /  the SPEED ROOM. //  The door at the right leads to /  the ACCURACY ROOM. //  The room's name will be on /  the door, so choose carefully. //  Once you've chosen the door… /  Well, hey, go for it!

PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_GymGuidePostVicto.current: {PLAYER}! Whoa! You've overcome even /  your own father! //  Like, whoa! /  What a stunning turn of events!

PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_DoorAppearsLocked.current: This door appears to be locked /  right now…

PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_EnterSpeedRoom.current: “SPEED ROOM,” the sign says. //  Do you want to go through?

PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_EnterAccuracyRoom.current: “ACCURACY ROOM,” the sign says. //  Do you want to go through?

PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_EnterConfusionRoo.current: “CONFUSION ROOM,” the sign says. //  Do you want to go through?

PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_EnterDefenseRoom.current: “DEFENSE ROOM,” the sign says. //  Do you want to go through?

PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_EnterRecoveryRoom.current: “RECOVERY ROOM,” the sign says. //  Do you want to go through?

PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_EnterStrengthRoom.current: “STRENGTH ROOM,” the sign says. //  Do you want to go through?

PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_EnterOHKORoom.current: “BURST ROOM,” the sign says. //  Do you want to go through?

PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_EnterGymLeadersRo.current: “GYM LEADER'S ROOM //  “See for yourself what POKéMON await /  you!” the sign says. //  Do you want to go through?

PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_GymStatueCertifie.current: PETALBURG CITY POKéMON GYM //  NORMAN'S CERTIFIED TRAINERS: /  {PLAYER}

PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_DadSoDidItWorkOut.current: DAD: So, did it work out?

PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_WallyThankYouBye.current: WALLY: Thank you, yes, it did. /  Here's your POKéMON back. //  {PLAYER}, thank you for coming along /  with me. //  You two are why I was able to catch /  my POKéMON. //  I promise I'll take really good /  care of it. //  Oh! My mom's waiting for me, /  so I have to go! //  Bye, {PLAYER}!

PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_DadGoCollectBadge.current: DAD: Now… //  {PLAYER}, if you want to become a /  strong TRAINER, here's my advice. //  Head west to ROUTE 104, then north /  through PETALBURG WOODS to RUSTBORO. //  There, you should challenge /  the GYM LEADER, ROXANNE. //  After her, go on to other POKéMON /  GYMS and defeat their LEADERS. //  Collect BADGES from them, /  understood? //  Of course, I'm a GYM LEADER, too. /  We'll battle one day, {PLAYER}. //  But that's only after you become /  stronger.

PetalburgCity_House1_Text_GoOnAdventure.current: Sigh… //  I wish I could go on an adventure /  with some POKéMON… //  Crawl through some damp grass… /  Climb rocky, rugged mountains… //  Cross the raging seas… /  Wander about in dark caves… //  And, sometimes, even get a little /  homesick… //  It must be fabulous to travel!

PetalburgCity_House1_Text_TravelingIsWon.current: Traveling is wonderful! //  When I was young, I roamed the seas /  and the mountains!

PetalburgCity_House2_Text_NormanBecameGy.current: NORMAN became our town's new /  GYM LEADER. //  I think he called his family over from /  somewhere far away.

PetalburgCity_House2_Text_BattledNormanO.current: I battled NORMAN once, but, whew, /  he was way too strong. //  How would I put it? //  I just got the feeling that he /  lives for POKéMON.

PetalburgCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_PCSt.current: That PC-based POKéMON Storage /  System… //  Whoever made it must be some kind /  of a scientific wizard!

PetalburgCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Oran.current: When my POKéMON ate an /  ORAN BERRY, it regained HP!

PetalburgCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Many.current: There are many types of POKéMON. //  All types have their strengths and /  weaknesses against other types. //  Depending on the types of POKéMON, /  a battle could be easy or hard.

PetalburgCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Tree.current: For example, your TREECKO /  is a GRASS type. //  It's strong against the WATER and /  GROUND types. //  But, it's weak against FIRE-type /  POKéMON.

PetalburgCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Torc.current: For example, your TORCHIC /  is a FIRE type. //  It's strong against the GRASS and /  BUG types. //  But, it's weak against WATER-type /  POKéMON.

PetalburgCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Mudk.current: For example, your MUDKIP /  is a WATER type. //  It's strong against the FIRE type. //  But, it's weak against GRASS-type /  and ELECTRIC-type POKéMON.

PetalburgCity_Mart_Text_TakeSomeAntidote.current: Do you carry ANTIDOTES? //  Poison no longer drains HP while /  walking, but it still matters in battle. //  An ANTIDOTE clears it before your /  next fight.

PetalburgCity_Mart_Text_RepelIsUseful.current: Do you use REPEL? /  It keeps POKéMON away, so it's /  useful when you're in a hurry.

PetalburgCity_Mart_Text_WeakWillGrowStro.current: Even if a POKéMON is weak now, /  it will grow stronger. //  The most important thing is love! /  Love for your POKéMON!

SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_Can.current: The hull fits. The engine fits. /  So why won't these measurements agree? //  If I move this here… /  No, then that won't fit!

SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_Mee.current: Hm? Oh, sorry. I'm DOCK. /  CAPT. STERN asked me to design a ferry. //  Are those the DEVON GOODS? /  He's been waiting for them. //  He's at the OCEANIC MUSEUM. /  Take the parcel straight to him.

SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_Cou.current: DOCK: Try the OCEANIC MUSEUM. /  CAPT. STERN needs that parcel. //  I'll be here, arguing with /  these measurements…
DOCK: Shipbuilding is an art. //  A lot of things can't be figured out /  just by calculating. //  I really could use advice from a veteran /  who knows the seas…

SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_Bri.current: DOCK: Hi! MR. BRINEY's joined us to /  lend us his help. //  Thanks to the veteran sailor, the /  ferry is steadily coming together.

SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_Fer.current: DOCK: The ferry is finally ready! //  The new S.S. TIDAL is truly a marvel /  of technology! //  But, I get the feeling that we can /  make something even better. //  You know, there's never an end to /  technology's march.

SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_Sea.current: The seasons, the weather, where /  the moon sits in the sky… //  These and other conditions make /  the sea change its expression. //  That's right! /  The sea is like a living thing!

SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_Get.current: I get seasick real easily. /  So I get to help out here instead.

SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_Dec.current: MR. BRINEY: Ah, {PLAYER}{KUN}! /  It's been too long! //  Aye, since I met you, this old sea dog's /  been feeling frisky! //  So I've decided to help DOCK make /  a ferry. //  Aye, after all, a ferry would be able /  to carry a lot of people. //  But, you know, that DOCK is really /  something special. //  With his knack for technology and /  my experience, I'm sure that we can /  build one great ship, aye!

SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_2F_Text_Shi.current: Designing a large ship is more like /  making a big building than putting /  together a transportation vehicle.

SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_2F_Text_Flo.current: Don't you think it's strange that /  a ship made of heavy iron floats? //  It floats because of a principle /  called buoyancy.

SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_Could.current: So, like, I couldn't find myself any /  POKéMON that were, like, for me. //  So, I figured, like, hey, I should file /  a complaint to the guy there? //  And he wouldn't hear me out, like, hey! /  So, like, total bummer, man! //  Hey, like, you! Zip it, you know? /  Just, you know, take this!

SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_Expla.current: A Prism Scale evolves Feebas. /  Use it from the Bag when ready.

SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_IllTr.current: I don't really like BUG POKéMON, /  but maybe I'll try using some for /  a change of pace. //  Who knows, I might even get to like /  them!

SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_Battl.current: You can battle all you want here even /  if you don't have any tough POKéMON.

SlateportCity_BattleTentLobby_Text_NiceI.current: Wouldn't it be nice if they had more of /  a selection?

SlateportCity_NameRatersHouse_Text_Pleas.current: Hi, hi! I'm the NAME RATER! /  I'm the fortune-teller of names! //  I shall be pleased to rate your /  POKéMON's nickname.

SlateportCity_NameRatersHouse_Text_Criti.current: Which POKéMON's nickname should /  I critique?

SlateportCity_NameRatersHouse_Text_FineN.current: Hmmm… {STR_VAR_1}, is it? That is /  quite a fine name you bestowed. //  But! What say you, if I were to /  suggest a slightly better name?

SlateportCity_NameRatersHouse_Text_WhatS.current: Ah, good. Then, what shall the new /  nickname be?

SlateportCity_NameRatersHouse_Text_MonSh.current: Done! From now on, this POKéMON /  shall be known as {STR_VAR_1}! //  It is a better name than before! /  How fortunate for you!

SlateportCity_NameRatersHouse_Text_DoVis.current: I see. /  Do come visit again.

SlateportCity_NameRatersHouse_Text_NameN.current: Done! From now on, this POKéMON /  shall be known as {STR_VAR_1}! //  It looks no different from before, /  and yet, this is vastly superior! //  How fortunate for you!

SlateportCity_NameRatersHouse_Text_Magni.current: Hmmm… {STR_VAR_1} it is! //  This is a magnificent nickname! /  It is impeccably beyond reproach! //  You'll do well to cherish your /  {STR_VAR_1} now and beyond.

SlateportCity_NameRatersHouse_Text_ThatI.current: Now, now. /  That is merely an EGG!

SlateportCity_NameRatersHouse_EventScrip.current: An Inkay once watched me write /  its name while hanging upside down. //  It left this curious stone behind. /  A Malamar should know what to do.

SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_Pokemo.current: If you keep letting a POKéMON faint /  in battle, it'll come to resent it. //  Soon, it will become less trusting /  of the TRAINER. //  In other words, it certainly won't /  like you very much.

SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_MonEnj.current: Do POKéMON remember how they were /  caught? //  Mine became friendly so quickly after /  I caught it in a LUXURY BALL.

SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_ShowMe.current: I love seeing POKéMON that love /  their TRAINERS. //  POKéMON are very sensitive to /  the feelings of their TRAINERS. //  If you treat your POKéMON with love /  and care, they'll love you back. //  When your POKéMON grow to love you, /  please come show me.

SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_Pokemo.current: Your POKéMON really adores you. //  For you, a most compassionate /  TRAINER, a gift from the FAN CLUB!

SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_TreatP.current: POKéMON are very sensitive to /  the feelings of their TRAINERS. //  If you treat your POKéMON with love /  and care, they'll love you back.

SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_MeetCh.current: Er-hem! I am the CHAIRMAN of the /  POKéMON FAN CLUB! //  Being the CHAIRMAN, I am naturally /  the most important! //  No one can best me when it comes /  to raising POKéMON. No one! //  Well, let me tell you about /  POKéMON CONTESTS. //  They're events where one can show off /  POKéMON for the world to see! //  However, they're held in far-off towns, /  so I cannot participate often enough. //  That is why we gather here to show /  off our POKéMON, and have others /  show us theirs.

SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_LikeTo.current: The POKéMON of a TRAINER who has /  entered a POKéMON CONTEST… /  That, I would like to see.

SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_AllowM.current: Er-hem! I see you've participated in /  a POKéMON CONTEST! //  Please! Allow me to examine how you /  have raised your POKéMON. //  It delights me no end to see POKéMON /  raised by other TRAINERS. //  The happy expressions of POKéMON /  raised with proper care… //  The kindly eyes of the TRAINER that /  nurtured and raised the POKéMON… //  The very thought fills my heart to /  overwhelming with joy. //  Oh! I do beg your pardon! /  Forgive me for prattling on so! //  Please! Allow me to examine how much /  your POKéMON has grown!

SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_HowIsY.current: How is your POKéMON growing? /  Allow me to examine it.

SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_GiveMo.current: Hmmm… It's not bad, but it's not /  good, either… //  You, the TRAINER, must put more /  effort into raising this POKéMON! //  For instance, may I suggest that /  you give it more {POKEBLOCK}S?

SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_NoSpac.current: Oh, my… //  Your POKéMON is growing quite well, /  so you deserve a reward. //  Unfortunately, you have no space for /  this in your BAG.

SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_MonMos.current: Your {STR_VAR_1}, it is growing in /  a most impressive manner! /  It is one fine specimen! //  But! If you were to give it this, /  it would grow even better! Indeed!

SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_Explai.current: Let a POKéMON hold that RED SCARF. //  Everyone will recognize the coolness /  of that POKéMON!
Let a POKéMON hold that BLUE SCARF. //  Its beauty will be accentuated much /  more than now!
Let a POKéMON hold that PINK SCARF. //  It will draw out the cuteness of /  the POKéMON some more!
Let a POKéMON hold that GREEN SCARF. //  That will enhance the /  smartness of POKéMON!
Let a POKéMON hold that YELLOW SCARF. //  It will bolster your POKéMON's /  toughness so much more!

SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_Nothin.current: I'm sorry, but I've nothing else to /  give you! None at all! //  After all, you're blessed with the gift /  of raising POKéMON without resorting /  to any items!

SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_Furfro.current: I style every FURFROU trim used by /  competitive TRAINERS. Want a new cut?
Choose the FURFROU you want styled.
All done! {STR_VAR_1} has a clean /  new competitive look.
I can only style FURFROU, including /  one that already has a trim.
Come back whenever FURFROU wants a /  different look.

SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_Woul.current: If I ripped off the stuff here, /  would it make me rich?

SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_CanL.current: What I learn here, I can put to use on /  nefarious deeds…

SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_OurB.current: We were told to assemble here, /  so we did, but… //  Our BOSS, the linchpin, isn't here.

SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_Aqua.current: We, TEAM AQUA, exist for the good /  of all!

SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_Rust.current: If our goons didn't bungle things /  in RUSTBORO, we wouldn't be here!

SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_Didn.current: I didn't have ¥50, so it took a long /  time getting by the receptionist.

SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_Lear.current: I want to learn about the sea and /  use that knowledge for battling.

SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_Ster.current: I get all giddy and gooey when /  I see the sea! //  For me, CAPT. STERN is the number /  one role model!

SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_Must.current: The sea is vast without end, and /  infinitely deep… //  There must be many POKéMON that /  we don't know about.

SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_Want.current: I want a sea POKéMON. //  I think it would feel cool and nice /  to hug.

SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_Reme.current: Aiyeeeh! /  What are you doing here? //  Me? I'm the TEAM AQUA member /  you thumped before, remember? /  Back in RUSTURF TUNNEL? //  Here, take this! /  You have to forgive me!

SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_Hope.current: That DEEP SEA TOOTH suits you more /  than it does me. It evolves CLAMPERL. //  Hope I never see you again! /  Wahahaha!

SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_YouH.current: Awww, come on! /  You have to take this and let me go!

SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_Woul.current: Welcome to the OCEANIC MUSEUM. //  The entrance fee is ¥50. /  Would you like to enter?

SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_NotE.current: Oh? I'm sorry, but you don't seem to /  have enough money.

SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_Catc.current: Oh? You're with that group that /  went in earlier? //  You're the only one who's late. /  You'd better go catch up to them!

SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_Whir.current: A blue fluid is spiraling inside /  a glass vessel. //  “This is an experiment to create a /  WHIRLPOOL artificially using wind.”

SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_Wate.current: A red ball is bobbing up and down /  inside a glass vessel. //  “This is an experiment simulating a /  WATERFALL using the ball's buoyancy.”

SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_Ocea.current: It's a sample of soil from the ocean /  floor. //  “Over many years, the remains of /  life-forms settle at the bottom of /  the sea, making sedimentary layers. //  “By analyzing these layers, the /  ancient past is revealed.”

SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_Beac.current: It's a sample of beach sand. //  “Stones from mountains are washed /  down by rivers where they are /  chipped and ground down. //  “They are reduced to grains and end /  up as sand on beaches.”

SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_Ocea.current: “OCEANIC MINIFACT 1 /  Why is seawater blue? //  “Light is composed of many colors. //  “When light passes through water, /  most kinds of light lose color. //  “However, blue light retains its /  color, making the sea appear blue.”

“OCEANIC MINIFACT 2 /  Why is the sea salty? //  “Seawater contains dissolved salt in /  the form of sodium and chlorine ions. //  “These ions leech out of rocks /  and are carried out to sea by rain. //  “The concentration of dissolved salt /  makes the sea salty.”
“OCEANIC MINIFACT 3 /  Which is bigger? The sea or land? //  “The sea covers about 70% of /  the planet, and the rest is land. //  “The sea is therefore more than twice /  the size of land.”

SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_Foss.current: It's a fossil with wavy ridges on it. //  “Soil on the ocean floor gets scoured /  by the tide. //  “The flowing seawater marks the soil /  with small ridges and valleys. //  “If this soil becomes fossilized, it is /  called a ripple mark.”

SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_Dept.current: A strange machine is rotating under /  a glass dome. //  Maybe it's for measuring the depth /  of something…

SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_Than.current: I'm STERN. You brought DEVON's parts! //  They'll let us measure pressure /  deep beneath the seafloor. //  The tides have shifted since strange /  marks began shining across HOENN.

SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_Well.current: Hold it. Those parts map pressure below /  the seafloor. AQUA is taking them.

SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_Ster.current: CAPT. STERN: Wh-what? /  Who are you people?

SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_Were.current: We're TEAM AQUA! Those parts belong to /  the people who understand the sea!

SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_Boss.current: The boss is going to hear about this…

SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_LetM.current: Move aside. /  I'll get those parts myself!

SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_Medd.current: We still don't have the parts. /  What are we going to tell ARCHIE?

SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_Came.current: That's enough. You two, stand back. /  I'll deal with this.

SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_Arch.current: I'm ARCHIE, leader of TEAM AQUA. //  The sea doesn't care for borders. /  Life moves where the water carries it. //  Those parts can trace the deep current /  waking HOENN's ancient marks. //  MAXIE would bury that power /  under more land. I intend to let it flow. //  Hand them over, or stand and fight!
Keep them, then. /  AQUA won't turn back for one Trainer. //  We'll find that current with or without /  your precious instruments.

SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_Ster.current: {PLAYER}, thank you. /  You kept us and the parts safe. //  These parts may reveal why the ocean /  and the CHAMPION'S SIGNS move together.

I'll get these instruments to the ship. /  We can't let AQUA reach the depths first. //  After DEWFORD GYM, follow ROUTE 110 /  north to MAUVILLE CITY. //  WATTSON keeps the city running. /  His GYM should give you a challenge!

SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_Braw.current: But earn BRAWLY's BADGE first. /  Then you can head north.

SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_Remi.current: I saw a model of a ship here. //  It reminded me of the ABANDONED SHIP /  near DEWFORD TOWN…

SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_Dont.current: Don't you dare run around inside /  the MUSEUM!

SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_Want.current: Wow, the submarine's awesome! /  I want to go for a ride!

SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_Wate.current: “WATER QUALITY SAMPLE 1,” the /  label says. //  The sea is all connected, but the /  water seems to differ by region.
“WATER QUALITY SAMPLE 2,” the /  label says. //  Does the saltiness of seawater differ /  by region, too?

SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_Sumb.current: “SUBMERSIBLE POD //  “A replica of a compact, unmanned /  pod for seafloor exploration.”

SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_Subm.current: “SUBMARINE EXPLORER 1 //  “A replica of the high-performance /  ocean floor exploration submarine.”

SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_SSTi.current: “THE FERRY S.S. TIDAL //  “A scale replica of the ship under /  construction at STERN'S SHIPYARD.”

SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_SSAn.current: “S.S. ANNE //  “A replica of the luxury liner that /  circles the globe.”

SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_Surf.current: It's a display on the flow of seawater. //  “Toward the surface, seawater flows /  as currents driven by the winds.”

SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_Deep.current: It's a display on the flow of seawater. //  “Near the bottom of the sea, water /  flows due to differences in such /  factors as temperature and salinity.”

SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_Hoen.current: “MODEL OF HOENN REGION” //  It's a miniature diorama of the /  HOENN region. //  Where is LITTLEROOT TOWN on this?

SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_Pres.current: A rubber ball is expanding and /  shrinking. //  “In the sea, the weight of water itself /  exerts pressure. //  “In shallow water, the pressure is not /  very heavy. //  “However, in extremely deep water, /  the pressure can reach even tens of /  thousands of tons on a small area.”

SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_FerryServiceUn.current: I beg your pardon? /  You're looking for a ship? //  I'm sorry, the ferry service isn't /  available at present…

SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_MayISeeYourTic.current: Hello, are you here for the ferry? /  May I confirm your ferry pass?

SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_YouMustHaveTic.current: Your ferry pass is not registered. //  I'm terribly sorry. //  You need a registered pass to board /  the ferry.

SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_ConfirmedPassW.current: The attendant confirmed your ferry /  pass. //  Perfect! That's all you need! //  And where would you like to go?

SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_SailAnotherTim.current: Please sail with us another time!

SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_PleaseBoardFer.current: Please board the ferry and wait for /  departure.

SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_WhereWouldYouL.current: Then, where would you like to go?

SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_LoveToGoDeepUn.current: A journey to the bottom of the sea… /  I wonder what it'd be like? //  I'd love to go deep underwater like /  that someday.

SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_AbnormalWeathe.current: For a ship to sail safely, we need to /  know about the weather! //  Speaking of weather, I heard something /  from a guy at the WEATHER INSTITUTE. //  He was saying abnormal weather has /  been reported all over the place! //  You should visit the WEATHER INSTITUTE /  and ask around!

SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_SubTooSmallFor.current: I wanted to go with CAPT. STERN on /  the ocean floor exploration. //  But the sub's too small for me. //  If I squeezed in, there wouldn't be /  any room for the CAPTAIN…

SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_SameThugsTried.current: CAPT. STERN: Those thugs… //  They're the same lot who tried to rob /  the DEVON GOODS at the MUSEUM.

SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_CaptSternWhySt.current: CAPT. STERN: They have my submarine. /  The cavern charts are aboard, too. //  ARCHIE named LILYCOVE. Reach the city /  by heading east from ROUTE 121. //  Find LILYCOVE's eastern beach. SURF /  north to TEAM AQUA's cave hideout. //  Stop their launch before they reach /  the sleeping POKéMON on the seafloor.

SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_TeamAquaLeftNe.current: CAPT. STERN: Oh, {PLAYER}{KUN}… //  Okay… So TEAM AQUA left before you /  could stop them… //  Oh, no, don't blame yourself. /  You're not responsible for this. //  Trying to catch a submarine… /  It's impossible for most people. //  You would need a POKéMON that knows /  how to DIVE… //  Perhaps if you went out to /  MOSSDEEP CITY… //  A lot of divers live out there, so /  someone might teach you…

SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_NeedDiveToCatc.current: CAPT. STERN: Trying to catch a /  submarine… It's impossible. //  You would need a POKéMON that knows /  how to DIVE… //  Perhaps if you went out to /  MOSSDEEP CITY… //  A lot of divers live out there, so /  someone might teach you…

SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_WontBeLongBefo.current: CAPT. STERN: Oh, yes. /  MR. BRINEY came to our SHIPYARD. //  It won't be long now before we finish /  making the ferry!

SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_FinishedMaking.current: CAPT. STERN: {PLAYER}{KUN}! //  We finally finished making the ferry /  S.S. TIDAL! //  We couldn't have done it without /  your friend MR. BRINEY. //  Please go for a short cruise on it!

SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_WouldYouTradeS.current: CAPT. STERN: Oh? /  {PLAYER}{KUN}, that item you have… //  That's a SCANNER! That would sure /  help us on our explorations. //  {PLAYER}{KUN}, would you trade your /  SCANNER for something? //  Like, say, a DEEPSEATOOTH or /  a DEEPSEASCALE that I have?

SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_IfYouWantToTra.current: CAPT. STERN: Are you certain? /  It's useless to you, {PLAYER}{KUN}… //  Well, okay, then. If you want to trade /  your SCANNER, let me know.

SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_TradeForDeepSe.current: CAPT. STERN: So you'll trade it for /  my DEEPSEATOOTH?
CAPT. STERN: So you'll trade it for /  my DEEPSEASCALE?

SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_WhichOneDoYouW.current: CAPT. STERN: Which one do you want?

SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_HandedScannerT.current: {PLAYER} handed the SCANNER to /  CAPT. STERN.

SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_ThisWillHelpRe.current: CAPT. STERN: Thanks, {PLAYER}{KUN}! /  This will help our research a lot!

SlateportCity_Harbor_Text_ArchieYouAgain.current: ARCHIE: Oh? /  Not you again… //  You are tenacious to track us here, /  that much I will give you. //  But now… /  No one can stop us! No one! //  Or, will you follow us back to our /  HIDEOUT in LILYCOVE CITY? //  Fwahahahaha…

SlateportCity_House_Text_NatureToDoWithS.current: My POKéMON has a HASTY nature. //  It has higher SPEED compared to /  my other POKéMON. //  Maybe their nature has something to /  do with the stat gains of POKéMON.

SlateportCity_House_Text_MustBeGoingToBa.current: You're a TRAINER, aren't you? //  Since you came to SLATEPORT CITY, /  you must be going to the BATTLE TENT.

SlateportCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Rais.current: Want a tip for battling? //  I'd say it's raising different kinds /  of POKéMON in a balanced manner. //  It's no good to make just one /  POKéMON strong. //  If it has a type disadvantage, /  it might not stand a chance.

SlateportCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Trad.current: I trade POKéMON with my friends. //  If a traded POKéMON is holding an /  item, it makes me twice as happy!

SlateportCity_Mart_Text_MarketAndMartSto.current: The MARKET has unusual merchandise. //  The MART is still a reliable place to /  restock everyday field supplies.

SlateportCity_Mart_Text_GreatBallIsBette.current: A GREAT BALL is better than a POKé BALL /  at catching POKéMON. //  With this, I should be able to get that /  elusive POKéMON…

MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_WattsonIntro.current: Wahahahah! I'm WATTSON! //  Electric teams can race forward or close /  the circuit and reverse move order. //  My opening is fixed. My reserves are not. /  Read the board each time it changes!

MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_WattsonDefeat.current: Wahahah! You solved the circuit instead /  of memorizing it! Take the DYNAMO BADGE!

MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_ReceivedDynamoBadg.current: {PLAYER} received the DYNAMO BADGE /  from WATTSON.

MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_ExplainDynamoBadge.current: The DYNAMO BADGE lets your LEVELER /  train a party up to Lv. 40. //  It also enables ROCK SMASH outside /  of battle. //  Hmm… /  You should take this, too!

MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_ExplainManectite.current: Manectite lets Manectric Mega Evolve. /  Let it hold the stone in battle.

MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_RegisteredWattson.current: Registered GYM LEADER WATTSON /  in the POKéNAV.

MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_WattsonPostBattle.current: Head north on ROUTE 111. My crew /  will let you through with that BADGE. //  Turn west onto ROUTE 112 and go /  through FIERY PATH to ROUTE 113. //  Follow it west to FALLARBOR TOWN. /  Ask there about the trouble at //  METEOR FALLS, down ROUTE 114.

MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_WattsonMtChimney.current: Head north on ROUTE 111, then west /  onto ROUTE 112. //  Take the cable car up MT. CHIMNEY. /  Stop TEAM MAGMA at the crater.

MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_WattsonLavaridge.current: Take ROUTE 112's cable car up /  MT. CHIMNEY, then descend JAGGED PASS. //  That leads to LAVARIDGE TOWN. /  Challenge FLANNERY at the GYM.

MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_WattsonGoForthAndE.current: Wahahahah! /  Go forth and endeavor, youngster!

MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_WattsonPreRematch.current: WATTSON: Ah-ha! Here at last! /  I know what you want. /  You want to battle my POKéMON! //  Wahahahaha! //  I'll make sparks fly from you! /  Don't say I didn't warn you!

MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_WattsonPostRematch.current: WATTSON: We'll have to recharge our /  batteries again. //  When we're fully charged up, we'll /  gladly accept your challenge. //  So, come back again sometime, /  won't you?

MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_WattsonRematchNeed.current: WATTSON: Ah-ha! Here at last! /  I know what you want. /  You want to battle my POKéMON! //  Wahahahaha! //  Oops! Wait! /  You've only one POKéMON with you! //  Come see me with two or more /  POKéMON, all right?

MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_ShawnIntro.current: You saved your EARTHQUAKE for me. /  Nothing here stands on the ground. //  Try again, from the air!

MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_ShawnPostBattle.current: Stop one lead before HELPING HAND and /  ELECTROWEB turn every attack dangerous.

MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_VivianIntro.current: PLUSLE and MINUN amplify each other /  just by standing side by side. //  Split us, or lose to both!

MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_VivianDefeat.current: You found a path around every immunity!

MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_VivianPostBattle.current: Do not press ELECTRIC attacks into the /  Ability that wants to absorb them.

MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_BenIntro.current: Send current -- LANTURN drinks it. /  Send water -- HELIOLISK drinks that. //  What is left in your bag?

MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_BenPostBattle.current: Taunt ORANGURU or wait out TRICK ROOM. /  Never race a slow battery on its clock.

MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_KirkIntro.current: PINCURCHIN floors the whole stage, /  and TOGEDEMARU takes your bolts. //  Find the current's blind spot!

MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_KirkPostBattle.current: Sound pressure is still special damage. /  SNARL and LIGHT SCREEN can quiet it.

MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice.current: Hey, how's it going, CHAMPION- /  bound {PLAYER}? //  WATTSON, the LEADER of MAUVILLE /  GYM, uses ELECTRIC-type POKéMON. //  If you challenge him with WATER-type /  POKéMON, he'll zap them! Bzzt! //  And, he's put in switch-controlled /  doors all over his GYM! Eccentric! //  Hey, go for it!

MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_GymGuidePostVictor.current: Whoa, you're electrifying! /  You've powered the door open!

MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_AngeloIntro.current: JOLTIK's THUNDER does not miss, and /  TOXTRICITY only gets louder. //  Accuracy is a luxury. I have it!

MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_AngeloPostBattle.current: Clear the STICKY WEB before my /  VIKAVOLT outspeeds your whole team.

MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_GymStatueCertified.current: MAUVILLE CITY POKéMON GYM //  WATTSON'S CERTIFIED TRAINERS: /  {PLAYER}

MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_RydelGreeting.current: Well, well, what have we here? /  A most energetic customer! //  Me? You may call me RYDEL. /  I'm the owner of this cycle shop.

MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_DidYouComeFro.current: RYDEL: Your RUNNING SHOES… /  They're awfully filthy. //  Did you come from far away?

MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_GuessYouDontN.current: RYDEL: Is that right? //  Then, I guess you have no need for /  any of my BIKES.

MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_ExplainBikesC.current: RYDEL: Hm, hm… … … … … //  You're saying that you came all this /  way from LITTLEROOT? //  My goodness! /  That's ridiculously far! //  If you had one of my BIKES, you could /  go anywhere easily while feeling the /  gentle caress of the wind! //  I'll tell you what! /  I'll give you a BIKE! //  Oh, wait a second! //  I forgot to tell you that there are /  two kinds of BIKES! //  They are the MACH BIKE and /  the ACRO BIKE! //  The MACH BIKE is for cyclists who want /  to feel the wind with their bodies! //  And an ACRO BIKE is for those who /  prefer technical rides! //  I'm a real sweetheart, so you can /  have whichever one you like! //  Which one will you choose?

MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_ComeBackToSwi.current: RYDEL: If you get the urge to switch /  BIKES, just come see me!

MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_WantToSwitchB.current: RYDEL: Oh? Were you thinking about /  switching BIKES?

MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_IllSwitchBike.current: RYDEL: Okay, no problem! /  I'll switch BIKES for you!

MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_ExchangedMach.current: {PLAYER} got the MACH BIKE exchanged /  for an ACRO BIKE.

MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_ExchangedAcro.current: {PLAYER} got the ACRO BIKE exchanged /  for a MACH BIKE.

MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_HappyYouLikeI.current: RYDEL: Good, good! /  I'm happy that you like it!

MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_OhYourBikeIsI.current: Oh? What happened to that BIKE /  I gave you? //  Oh, I get it, you stored it using your PC. //  Well, take it out of PC storage, /  and I'll be happy to exchange it! //  May the wind always be at your back /  on your adventure!

MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_HandbooksAreI.current: I'm learning about BIKES while /  I work here. //  If you need advice on how to ride your /  BIKE, there're a couple handbooks in /  the back.

MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_MachHandbookW.current: It's a handbook on the MACH BIKE. //  Which page do you want to read?

MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_HowToRideMach.current: A BIKE moves in the direction that /  the + Control Pad is pressed. //  It will speed up once it gets rolling. //  To stop, release the + Control Pad. /  The BIKE will slow to a stop. //  Want to read a different page?

MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_HowToTurnMach.current: A MACH BIKE is speedy, but it can't /  stop very quickly. //  It gets a little tricky to get around /  a corner. //  Release the + Control Pad a little /  before the corner and slow down. //  Want to read a different page?

MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_SandySlopes.current: There are small sandy slopes /  throughout the HOENN region. //  The loose, crumbly sand makes it /  impossible to climb normally. //  But if you have a MACH BIKE, you can /  zip up a sandy slope. //  Want to read a different page?

MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_AcroHandbookW.current: It's a handbook on the ACRO BIKE. //  Which page do you want to read?

MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_Wheelies.current: Press the B Button while riding, /  and the front wheel lifts up. //  You can zip around with the front /  wheel up using the + Control Pad. //  This technique is called a wheelie. //  Want to read a different page?

MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_BunnyHops.current: Keeping the B Button pressed, /  your BIKE can hop on the spot. //  This technique is called a bunny hop. //  You can ride while hopping, too. //  Want to read a different page?

MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_Jumps.current: Press the B Button and the + Control /  Pad at the same time to jump. //  Press the + Control Pad to the side /  to jump sideways. //  Press it backwards to make the BIKE /  change directions while jumping. //  Want to read a different page?

MauvilleCity_House1_Text_ImRockSmashDude.current: Woohoo! //  I hear people call me the ROCK SMASH /  GUY, but I find that sort of degrading. //  I think I deserve a bit more respect, /  like maybe the ROCK SMASH DUDE. //  Woohoo! //  Anyways, your POKéMON look pretty /  strong. //  I like that! /  Here, take this HIDDEN MACHINE!

MauvilleCity_House1_Text_ExplainRockSmas.current: That HM registers ROCK SMASH as a /  field technique for your team. //  If you come across large boulders /  that block your path… //  Well, use that HM move and smash /  them right out of your way! //  Yes, sir! Smash rocks aside, I say! /  Woohoo!

MauvilleCity_House1_Text_MonCanFlyOutOfS.current: Oh, yes, if you smash a rock, a POKéMON /  could come flying out of hiding. //  Woohoo!

MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_CoinsAreNee.current: COINS are needed to play here /  in the GAME CORNER.

MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_RouletteOnl.current: This ROULETTE thing… /  It's rather demanding. //  Win or lose, it's only by luck.

MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_NeedCoinCas.current: Okay, you wanted some COINS for /  the games? //  But you don't have a COIN CASE for /  stowing the COINS.

MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_WereYouLook.current: Were you looking for COINS? //  It's ¥1000 for 50 COINS. /  Would you like some?

MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_ThankYouHer.current: Thank you very much! /  Here are your COINS!

MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_DontHaveEno.current: Um… You don't appear to have /  enough money…

MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_CoinCaseIsF.current: Oh? /  Your COIN CASE is full.

MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_DontNeedCoi.current: Oh… You don't need COINS, then? /  Good luck on your adventure!

MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_ExchangeCoi.current: Welcome. //  You can exchange your COINS for /  prizes here.

MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_SendToYourH.current: Thank you! /  We'll send it to your PC at home.

MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_OhIsThatSo.current: Oh, is that so?  /  You need to save some COINS before /  coming back here.

MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_PokemonPriz.current: {STR_VAR_1} arrived battle-ready! //  Its moves, nature, Ability, and item /  match a competitive set.

MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_AlreadyRece.current: That unique prize has already been /  claimed.

MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_WhichStarte.current: Starters cost 500 Coins each. /  Which region should I open?

MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_PokemonPriz.current: That battle set is unavailable. /  No Coins or prize claim were used.

MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_AlreadyCaug.current: You have already befriended this /  legendary Pokémon. //  Your Coins have not been spent.

MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_GotTwoOfSam.current: I made a mistake and got two of /  the same DOLLS. //  Would you like one of them?

MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_YouWantItBu.current: Huh? /  You want it, but not right now?

MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_DontBeNegat.current: Oh, don't be so negative! /  You can have this!

MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_CantWinJack.current: There's a prize I want, but I can't win /  the jackpot.

MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_NeedCoinCas.current: Hey, kid, if you want to play here, /  you need a COIN CASE. //  I think the young lady next door /  had one. Go see her!

MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_LuckOnlyLas.current: My luck can only last so long. /  This is too much for me. /  Here, take some COINS!

MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_MauvilleSom.current: MAUVILLE has something for /  everyone. //  For me, it's the GAME CORNER.

MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_RouletteTab.current: The ROULETTE tables have different /  rates. //  Check your COINS if you're going to /  pick a table.

MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_EasyToLoseT.current: It's easy to lose track of time in here.  /  I should get back to work.

MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_UpTo3CoinsC.current: Up to three COINS can be used to play /  the SLOTS.

MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_DifficultTo.current: It's very difficult to make it stop /  right on “7.” //  If it stops on “7” during the REEL TIME /  bonus game, you'll receive extra COINS.

MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_HeresSomeSl.current: Here's some information for you /  about the SLOTS. //  The more lightning bolts you stock, /  the more REEL TIME chances you get. //  In a game with the maximum five /  REEL TIME chances… //  It is possible to receive four regular /  bonuses, then a big bonus. //  That would total 660 COINS, but it's /  very difficult to get.

MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_CantPlayWit.current: You can't play if you don't have /  a COIN CASE.

MauvilleCity_House2_Text_BuyHarborMailAt.current: If I had a BIKE, it'd be easy to cycle to /  SLATEPORT for some shopping. //  I'd be able to buy HARBOR MAIL at the /  POKéMON MART in SLATEPORT…

MauvilleCity_House2_Text_TradeHarborMail.current: Oh! You have HARBOR MAIL? /  Will you trade it for a COIN CASE?

MauvilleCity_House2_Text_IllTradeYouCoin.current: Oh, I'm so happy! /  Okay, I'll trade you a COIN CASE!

MauvilleCity_House2_Text_UseCoinCaseAtGa.current: That COIN CASE can be used /  at the GAME CORNER.

MauvilleCity_House2_Text_ThatsDisappoint.current: Oh, that's disappointing. //  A COIN CASE is needed for the /  GAME CORNER.

MauvilleCity_House2_Text_MoveSpecialist.current: I studied the PLEDGE moves and the /  three ultimate starter techniques. //  The POKéMON CENTER specialist can /  teach all six now, free of charge.

MauvilleCity_House2_EventScript_MegaGift.current: An Ampharos can light a road for /  everyone following behind it. //  Take this stone. A strong partner /  can help others find their way.

MauvilleCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_ManOv.current: That man over there, he says weird /  things! //  He's funny in a weird way. /  I doubt I'll forget about him!

MauvilleCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_MyDat.current: When I accessed the RECORD CORNER, /  the data for what's hot in DEWFORD /  got updated. //  Now that bit of data is the same /  as my friend's!

MauvilleCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Recor.current: A RECORD CORNER opened upstairs in /  the POKéMON CENTER. //  I don't know what it's about, but it /  sounds fun. I'll go check it out!

MauvilleCity_PokemonCenter_2F_Text_Young.current: Did you know that you can link battle /  at the COLOSSEUM here? //  They put up your record on the wall /  for everyone to see. //  It's embarrassing if you lose more /  often than you win…

MauvilleCity_Mart_Text_ItemsToTemporaril.current: Trainer battles do not allow BAG items. /  This shop stocks specialized POKé BALLS /  instead, so you can build more teams.

MauvilleCity_Mart_Text_DecisionsDetermin.current: Choose a move, switch a partner, or /  protect a position… //  The TRAINER's decisions determine how /  battles turn out.

RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F_Text_ThoseShoe.current: Hey, those RUNNING SHOES! /  They're one of our products! //  It makes me happy when I see someone /  using something we made.

RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F_Text_RobberWas.current: That stolen parcel… //  Well, sure it's important, but it's not /  anything that anyone can use. //  In my estimation, that robber must not /  have been very bright.

RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F_Text_SoundsLik.current: It sounds like they've recovered /  the ripped-off DEVON GOODS.

RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F_Text_OnlyAutho.current: I'm sorry, only authorized people /  are allowed to enter here.

RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F_Text_HowCouldW.current: It's beyond stupid. /  How could we get robbed?

RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F_Text_YoureAlwa.current: Hi, there! /  You're always welcome here!

RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F_Text_WelcomeTo.current: Hello and welcome to the DEVON /  CORPORATION. //  We're proud producers of items and /  medicine that enhance your life.

RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F_Text_StaffGotR.current: One of our research staff stupidly /  got robbed of an important parcel.

RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F_Text_ProductDi.current: Prototypes and test products fill /  the glass display case. //  There's a panel with a description… //  “In addition to industrial products, /  DEVON now markets sundries and /  pharmaceuticals for better lifestyles. //  “Recently, DEVON has begun marketing /  tools for POKéMON TRAINERS, including /  POKé BALLS and POKéNAV systems.”

RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F_Text_RocksMeta.current: Samples of rocks and metal are /  displayed in the glass case. //  There's a panel with some writing /  on it… //  “DEVON CORPORATION got its start as /  a producer of stones from quarries. //  “The company also produced iron from /  filings in the sand. //  “From that humble start as a producer /  of raw materials, DEVON developed. //  “DEVON is now a manufacturer of a wide /  range of industrial products.”

RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_DeviceFor.current: We're developing a device for talking /  with POKéMON. //  But we haven't had much success…

RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_Developin.current: I'm developing new kinds of /  POKé BALLS… //  But I haven't made much headway…

RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_WeFinally.current: We finally made new kinds of /  POKé BALLS! //  The REPEAT BALL makes it easier to /  catch POKéMON you've caught before. //  The TIMER BALL gets better at catching /  POKéMON the longer a battle runs. //  Both are proudly developed by /  the DEVON CORPORATION. //  Please give them a try!

RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_EventScript_Me.current: Eight badges! You have seen things /  our laboratory can only dream of. //  This stone responds to Magearna. /  Perhaps you can learn why.

RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_IMadePoke.current: I made the POKéNAV! //  As an engineer, I feel blessed to have /  made something so great!

RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_WowThatsA.current: Oh, wow! /  That's a POKéNAV! //  It came about as a result of our /  PRESIDENT's desire to learn about /  the feelings of POKéMON. //  Would you like me to describe its /  features in detail? //  No, no. I think you'll find out just by /  trying the POKéNAV out.

RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_Legendary.current: HOENN is full of LEGENDARY SIGNS. /  You can follow them at your own pace. //  Inspect marked stones and strange /  shrines as you explore. They can /  answer without a visit to DEVON. //  If a legendary escapes or faints, /  leave its area and return to try again. //  I keep leads for every discovery, /  including ones you have completed.

RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_MagearnaP.current: Your discovery completes DEVON's /  sealed mechanical prototype! //  MAGEARNA awakens and joins your party.
Your discovery completes DEVON's /  sealed mechanical prototype! //  MAGEARNA awakens and is sent to your PC.

RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_MagearnaN.current: The sealed prototype answers DIANCIE, /  but your party and PC have no room.

RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_ArceusRew.current: Every Legendary Sign is complete! //  Their light calls ARCEUS, who has /  joined your party.
Every Legendary Sign is complete! //  Their light calls ARCEUS, who was /  sent to your PC.
Every Sign is complete, but ARCEUS /  has nowhere to go. Make PC space.
You completed every Legendary Sign. /  Even ARCEUS answered your call.

RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_DevelopDe.current: My FOSSIL REGENERATOR can restore /  ancient POKéMON from every era. //  Bring me any complete fossil you find.

RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_WantToBri.current: Wait! You have a POKéMON fossil! //  Shall I restore its ancient POKéMON /  with the FOSSIL REGENERATOR?

RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_OhIsThatS.current: Oh, is that so? //  DEVON's technological expertise /  is outstanding, I tell you.

RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_ChooseFos.current: The machine restores one fossil at /  a time. Which one shall I revive?

RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_HandedFos.current: Excellent! /  Let's do this right away. //  {PLAYER} handed the {STR_VAR_1} to /  the DEVON RESEARCHER.

RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_FossilNoL.current: Oh! That fossil is no longer in your /  Bag. Bring it back and we'll try again.

RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_FossilDat.current: The regenerator's record is unreadable. /  I've reset it so we can try again.

RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_FossilReg.current: The FOSSIL REGENERATOR, which I made, /  is incredible. //  But it has one drawback--it takes /  a long time to work. //  So, uh… How about you go for a stroll /  and look around for a while?

RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_Fossilize.current: Thanks for waiting! //  Your fossilized POKéMON has been /  brought back to life! //  It was {STR_VAR_2}! /  An ancient POKéMON!

RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_DevelopNe.current: I'm trying to develop a new feature /  for the POKéNAV… //  But it's not going well.

RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_WhatToWor.current: Well, now what shall I work on /  developing next? //  Our company allows us to make our /  inspirations into reality. //  One couldn't ask for a better /  environment as an engineer.

RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_EeveeRese.current: DEVON can safely return an evolved /  EEVEE to its original form. Try it?
Choose the EEVEE evolution to return /  to EEVEE.
Return {STR_VAR_1} to EEVEE? Its /  current moves will be preserved.
The genetic pattern stabilized. /  {STR_VAR_1} is EEVEE again.
That POKéMON is not an evolved member /  of EEVEE's family.
The machine will be ready whenever /  you need it.

RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_CountingO.current: You'll find STEVEN in GRANITE CAVE, /  near DEWFORD. He often loses track /  of time when he's studying rocks. //  Our researcher on the second floor /  keeps a guide to the LEGENDARY SIGNS. /  Ask him whenever you want a lead.

RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_StevenAwa.current: STEVEN received my LETTER. Good. //  He will entrust the MEGA RING only after /  you earn DEWFORD's KNUCKLE BADGE.

RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_ThankYouF.current: You reached STEVEN and earned the right /  to use MEGA EVOLUTION. Excellent. //  This stone was found above RUSTBORO. /  Let PIDGEOT show you what it can become.

RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_ExplainPi.current: Shops never sell MEGA STONES. Once you /  hold a RING, every POKéMON CENTER /  VENDOR lends the whole archive free. //  The ones in HOENN's gyms, ruins and /  caves are the originals. Find them.

RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_NotFamili.current: The old records call these marks a /  network of CHAMPION'S SIGNS. //  They do not reward strength alone. Each /  one asks for the right partner or deed.

RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_VisitCapt.current: If you visit the SHIPYARD in SLATEPORT, /  you should go see CAPT. STERN.

RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_RepeatAnd.current: DEVON's new products, the REPEAT BALL /  and TIMER BALL, have become hugely /  popular among TRAINERS.

RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_RareRocks.current: It's a collection of rare rocks and /  stones assembled by the PRESIDENT.

RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_MrStoneIH.current: I'm MR. STONE, president of DEVON. //  You recovered our GOODS and protected /  my staff. Thank you, {PLAYER}. //  I fear these thefts are connected to /  something we don't yet understand. //  Strange marks have appeared in caves, /  forests, and ruins across HOENN. //  They react to strong POKéMON teams. /  Both MAGMA and AQUA seek them. //  My son STEVEN studies stones. Please /  take this LETTER to him in DEWFORD. //  Then take the GOODS to CAPT. STERN in /  SLATEPORT. He's still counting on us.

RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_LetterSen.current: Your KEY ITEMS pocket is full, so the /  LETTER was sent to your PC.

RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_LetterNoR.current: Your KEY ITEMS pocket and PC are full. /  Make room, then return to my desk.

RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_MrStoneWa.current: Please take this POKéNAV. You'll need /  a good map for the journey ahead.

RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_MrStoneEx.current: The POKéNAV has a map of HOENN and /  keeps you in touch with key Trainers. //  Our researcher on the second floor is /  cataloging the CHAMPION'S SIGNS. //  He can help you follow their clues /  whenever you want a lead to explore. //  Please rest here before you leave. /  DEWFORD is your next stop. //  I hope STEVEN can make sense of this /  before anyone else gets hurt.

RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_MrStoneGo.current: Go carefully, {PLAYER}. You've already /  done more for us than I could ask.

RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_ThisIs3rd.current: This is the DEVON CORPORATION's /  third floor. //  Our PRESIDENT's OFFICE is on /  this floor. //  Anyway, I can't tell you how much I'm /  grateful for what you've done. //  Um… By the way, that parcel /  you got back for us… //  Could I get you to deliver that to /  the SHIPYARD in SLATEPORT? //  It would be awful if those robbers /  tried to take it again. //  Uh… Hehehe, so, uh, could I count /  on you to do that for me? //  Oh, that's right. /  Could you wait here a second?

RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_WordWithP.current: Our PRESIDENT would like to have /  a word with you. //  Please come with me.

RustboroCity_Gym_Text_RoxanneIntro.current: I am ROXANNE, RUSTBORO's GYM LEADER. //  I teach here, but each challenger gives /  me something new to study. //  Rock can endure, redirect an attack, or /  reverse the order of a battle. My /  students have shown you the pieces. //  Now, let us put them together.

RustboroCity_Gym_Text_RoxanneDefeat.current: There is always more to learn. Even a /  carefully prepared team can be beaten. //  You have earned the STONE BADGE. /  May it be the first of many!

RustboroCity_Gym_Text_ReceivedStoneBadge.current: {PLAYER} received the STONE BADGE /  from ROXANNE.

RustboroCity_Gym_Text_StoneBadgeInfoTake.current: The STONE BADGE lets your LEVELER train /  a party up to Lv. 20. //  It also enables POKéMON to use CUT /  outside of battle. //  It also marks your first true step /  toward the POKéMON LEAGUE. //  Please take this with you, too.

RustboroCity_Gym_Text_ExplainRoxanneRewa.current: Aerodactylite lets Aerodactyl Mega /  Evolve once you possess a Mega Ring. //  DEVON can restore that OLD AMBER. /  Consider Aerodactyl your first Mega /  project.

RustboroCity_Gym_Text_RoxannePostBattle.current: Your next GYM is BRAWLY's in DEWFORD. //  MR. BRINEY sails from his cottage on /  ROUTE 104, south of PETALBURG WOODS.

RustboroCity_Gym_Text_RoxannePreRematch.current: ROXANNE: I'm so glad to see you again. /  I'm ROXANNE, the GYM LEADER here. //  I'm sure we've both experienced many /  battles since we last met. //  I would like to see how much better /  we've become. Let us battle!

RustboroCity_Gym_Text_RoxannePostRematch.current: ROXANNE: I still have much to learn /  when it comes to battling POKéMON. //  That awareness makes me love battling /  all that much more!

RustboroCity_Gym_Text_RoxanneRematchNeed.current: ROXANNE: I'm so glad to see you again. /  I'm ROXANNE, the GYM LEADER here. //  I'm sure we've both experienced many /  battles since we last met. //  I would like to see how much better /  we've become… //  Oh, no… /  You only have one POKéMON with you? //  Please return with at least one more /  POKéMON.

RustboroCity_Gym_Text_JoshIntro.current: STURDY means BONSLY and SHIELDON /  always live to swing back. //  Chip them first, or don't swing!

RustboroCity_Gym_Text_JoshDefeat.current: You broke the wall and the chip!

RustboroCity_Gym_Text_JoshPostBattle.current: STURDY guarantees NOSEPASS one more /  turn. Plan for the turn after it.

RustboroCity_Gym_Text_TommyIntro.current: LILEEP drinks the water you aim at /  my rocks. SHUCKLE slows your feet. //  Go on -- find the dry path!

RustboroCity_Gym_Text_TommyPostBattle.current: Two small ROCKS still add up. Never /  underestimate a first-badge team.

RustboroCity_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice.current: Yo, how's it going? //  Listen, my friend! /  Would you like to become the CHAMPION? //  I'm no TRAINER, not me, but I can /  sure give you winning advice. //  That's settled, then! We'll aim for the /  POKéMON CHAMPIONSHIP together! //  It's your job as a TRAINER to collect /  GYM BADGES, am I right? //  But GYM LEADERS aren't pushovers! //  And that's where I come in! /  I'm here to provide expert advice! //  ROXANNE, the GYM LEADER, is a user /  of ROCK-type POKéMON. //  The ROCK type is very durable, but /  it can't stand WATER-type and /  GRASS-type moves. //  Come see me afterwards, if you beat /  the GYM LEADER. //  Well, go for it!

RustboroCity_Gym_Text_GymGuidePostVictor.current: Whoa! What a breathtaking victory! /  My cheering must've worked! //  Great! /  Check your TRAINER CARD. //  The STONE BADGE you got should be /  properly recorded on it. //  In other words… //  You've climbed the first step on /  the stairs to the CHAMPIONSHIP! //  That's got to feel awesome!

RustboroCity_Gym_Text_MarcIntro.current: AMAURA calls the snow, and the veil /  it raises blunts everything. //  Break the snow, or break through!

RustboroCity_Gym_Text_MarcDefeat.current: You kept control of your choices!

RustboroCity_Gym_Text_MarcPostBattle.current: ROXANNE combines every lesson: field /  control, reverse speed, and endurance.

RustboroCity_Gym_Text_GuideIntroduction.current: Yo! Welcome to your first GYM exam. //  ROXANNE battles with a full doubles team. /  Her students teach the pieces: field /  control, redirection, and reverse speed. //  Read each pair before attacking, and /  bring answers instead of one favorite. //  Take these FRESH WATERS for the road. /  Come see me after you earn the BADGE!

RustboroCity_Gym_Text_GymStatueCertified.current: RUSTBORO CITY POKéMON GYM //  ROXANNE'S CERTIFIED TRAINERS: /  {PLAYER}

RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_TradingR.current: I'm trading POKéMON with my friend /  right now.

RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_AlwaysWa.current: I always wanted a SEEDOT, and /  I'm finally getting one!

RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_Pokemont.current: POKéMON can hold items, but they /  don't know what to do with man-made /  items like POTION and ANTIDOTE.

RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_Confused.current: You know how some POKéMON moves can /  confuse a POKéMON? //  A confused POKéMON will sometimes /  attack itself without meaning to. //  But once it leaves battle, it will /  return to normal.

RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_PokemonH.current: A POKéMON holding a BERRY will heal /  itself… //  There are many kinds of items that /  POKéMON can hold… //  Boy, it sure is hard taking notes /  down…

RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_Students.current: A good TRAINER studies every tool. //  This SUN STONE evolves certain POKéMON. /  Show me that you know when to use it.

RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ExplainS.current: A Sun Stone evolves certain Pokémon. /  Use it from the Bag when ready.

RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ScottMet.current: Hello? Didn't we meet before? /  I think back in PETALBURG CITY. //  Let me introduce myself. /  My name's SCOTT. //  I've been traveling everywhere in /  search of outstanding TRAINERS. //  More specifically, I'm looking for /  POKéMON battle experts. //  So, what brings you to this SCHOOL? /  Are you a TRAINER, too? //  The first thing you should do is to /  have a POKéMON learn the move CUT. //  If I remember correctly, someone in /  this town has CUT.

RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_StudentT.current: SCOTT: Hmm… //  The talent levels of the students here /  are unknown. The potential's there.

RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ScottSto.current: SCOTT: Oh, what's that? //  It's a STONE BADGE, isn't it? /  That's pretty impressive, I'd say. //  But, you know, I would've loved to see /  you in battle. //  It's hard to tell what you're like as /  a TRAINER from a LEAGUE BADGE.

RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ScottMet.current: Hello? Didn't we meet before? /  I think back in PETALBURG CITY. //  Let me introduce myself. /  My name's SCOTT. //  I've been traveling everywhere in /  search of outstanding TRAINERS. //  More specifically, I'm looking for /  POKéMON battle experts. //  Oh, what's that? /  It's a STONE BADGE, isn't it? //  That's pretty impressive, I'd say, for /  a starting TRAINER like yourself. //  But, you know, I would've loved to see /  you in battle. //  It's hard to tell what you're like as /  a TRAINER from a LEAGUE BADGE.

RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_Blackboa.current: The blackboard lists status changes /  that may affect POKéMON in battle.

RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ReadWhic.current: Which topic do you want to read?

RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ExplainP.current: If a POKéMON is poisoned, it steadily /  loses HP during battle. //  Poison remains after battle, but it no /  longer causes damage while traveling. //  Heal it using an ANTIDOTE.
If a POKéMON becomes paralyzed, /  its SPEED drops. //  It may also not be able to move while /  it is in battle. //  Paralysis remains after battle. /  Cure it using a PARLYZ HEAL.

RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ExplainS.current: If a POKéMON falls asleep, it will be /  unable to attack. //  A POKéMON may wake up on its own, /  but if a battle ends while it is /  sleeping, it will stay asleep. //  Wake it up using an AWAKENING.

RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ExplainB.current: A burn reduces ATTACK power, and it /  steadily reduces the victim's HP. //  A burn lingers after battle. /  Cure a burn using a BURN HEAL.

RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ExplainF.current: If a POKéMON is frozen, it becomes /  completely helpless. //  It will remain frozen after battle. /  Thaw it out using an ICE HEAL.

RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_Students.current: It's this student's notebook… //  POKéMON are to be caught using /  POKé BALLS. //  Up to six POKéMON can accompany /  a TRAINER. //  A TRAINER is someone who catches /  POKéMON, raises them, and battles /  with them. //  A TRAINER's mission is to defeat /  the strong TRAINERS who await /  challengers in POKéMON GYMS.

RustboroCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Pokem.current: My POKéMON has a NAIVE nature, and my /  friend's has a JOLLY nature. //  It's fascinating how POKéMON have /  personalities!

RustboroCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_MaleA.current: Just like people, there are male and /  female POKéMON. //  But no one seems to have any idea how /  they're different.

RustboroCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_HMCut.current: The man next door gave me an HM! //  I used it to teach my POKéMON how to /  CUT down skinny trees.

RustboroCity_Mart_Text_ShouldBuySuperPot.current: My POKéMON evolved. /  It has a lot of HP now. //  I should buy SUPER POTIONS for it /  instead of ordinary POTIONS.

RustboroCity_Mart_Text_BuyingHealsInCase.current: I'm buying some PARLYZ HEALS and /  ANTIDOTES. //  Just in case I run into SHROOMISH /  in PETALBURG WOODS.

RustboroCity_Mart_Text_GettingEscapeRope.current: I'm getting an ESCAPE ROPE just in /  case I get lost in a cave. //  I just need to use it to get back to /  the entrance.

RustboroCity_Mart_Text_MoveSpecialist.current: FALSE SWIPE used to be my special TM. //  The POKéMON CENTER specialist now /  teaches it whenever it is legal.

RustboroCity_Flat1_1F_Text_EveryPokemonH.current: Every POKéMON has a special ability /  that it can use.

RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_ComingUpWithM.current: Oh, it's so hard every day… //  What's hard? /  You need to ask? //  It's trying to figure out what to /  make for meals every day. //  It really isn't easy coming up with /  meals every day.

RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_HelloDoYouKno.current: Oh, hello! /  Welcome to the PEPPER household. //  I have a question for you. /  Have you ever baby-sat? //  You see, I'm a new father, so raising /  a child is all new to me. //  And I have a problem. My daughter /  WALDA doesn't laugh enough. //  I think she'd laugh for me if I told /  her something funny. //  Do you know of a funny word or /  phrase you can tell me?

RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_BeenSayingXDo.current: I've been saying “{STR_VAR_1}” /  to amuse her lately. //  Do you know of a better word or /  a phrase that might work?

RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_WonderfulLets.current: Oh, that's wonderful. /  So, let's hear it, your suggestion.

RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_OhIsThatRight.current: Oh, is that right? //  Well, if you come up with a good /  suggestion, I'm all ears.

RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_LetsGiveItATr.current: Ah, I see. /  Well, let's give it a try, shall we?

RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_OhShesLaughin.current: {STR_VAR_1}. /  {STR_VAR_1}. //  Oh, yes! She's laughing! /  Oh, I am as delighted as she!

RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_LetsGiveItATr.current: Ah, I see. /  Well, let's give it a try, shall we?

RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_ShesNotSmilin.current: {STR_VAR_1}. /  {STR_VAR_1}. //  Hmmm… She's not smiling at all. /  Maybe WALDA is one serious child…

RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_ThinkOfMyOwnP.current: Oh, so you don't know any good words. /  I'd better think for myself, then. //  Hmm… /  How about “{STR_VAR_1}”? /  Let's see if that will work.

RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_ShesNotSmilin.current: {STR_VAR_1}. /  {STR_VAR_1}. //  Hmmm… She's not smiling at all. /  Maybe WALDA is one serious child…

RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_OhYouDontKnow.current: Oh, so you don't know any good words. /  I guess I'll try to amuse her with /  the saying I used before. //  Anyways, if you have a good suggestion, /  don't hesitate in telling me, okay?

RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_ThankYouIllGi.current: Thank you! //  Thanks to you, my darling WALDA /  laughed for me! //  Actually, I may not look all that /  special, but I'm one of DEVON /  CORPORATION's top researchers. //  So, how about I do something in return /  for you? //  I know, I'll add some new wallpaper /  patterns for the BOXES in the PC /  POKéMON Storage System. //  In the wallpaper pattern menu, /  select “FRIENDS.” //  That will give you access to the new /  wallpaper patterns.

RustboroCity_House1_Text_IllTradeIfYouWa.current: Huh? My POKéMON is cute? /  Sure, I knew that. //  But if you really want, I'm willing /  to trade it to you. //  I'll trade you my {STR_VAR_2} for /  a {STR_VAR_1} if you want.

RustboroCity_House1_Text_PleaseBeGoodToM.current: Eheheh… /  Please be good to my POKéMON. //  It already has a proper battle set, /  so it can fight from day one.

RustboroCity_House1_Text_DoesntLookLikeM.current: Huh? That doesn't look anything like /  a {STR_VAR_1} to me.

RustboroCity_House1_Text_YouDontWantToTh.current: Oh, if you don't want to, that's okay. /  But my POKéMON is cute, you know…

RustboroCity_House1_Text_AnyPokemonCanBe.current: Any POKéMON can be cute if you raise /  it with care and kindness.

RustboroCity_House1_Text_AllSortsOfPlace.current: In all sorts of places, there are all /  sorts of POKéMON and people. //  I find that fascinating, so I go to all /  sorts of places.

RustboroCity_CuttersHouse_Text_YouCanPut.current: That determined expression… /  That limber way you move… /  And your well-trained POKéMON… //  You're obviously a skilled TRAINER! //  No, wait, don't say a word. /  I can tell just by looking at you. //  I'm sure that you can put this /  HIDDEN MACHINE to good use. //  No need to be modest or shy. /  Go on, take it!

RustboroCity_CuttersHouse_Text_ExplainCu.current: That HM registers CUT as a field /  technique for your team. //  Once you earn the STONE BADGE, any /  POKéMON that knows CUT can chop thin /  trees outside battle.

RustboroCity_CuttersHouse_Text_DadHelped.current: When they were expanding the city of /  RUSTBORO, my dad helped out. //  He made his POKéMON use CUT to clear /  the land of trees.

RustboroCity_House2_Text_TrainerSchoolEx.current: The TRAINER'S SCHOOL is excellent. //  If you study there, you could even /  become a GYM LEADER.

RustboroCity_House2_Text_RoxanneKnowsALo.current: ROXANNE, the GYM LEADER, really knows /  a lot about POKéMON. //  She's really strong, too!

RustboroCity_Flat2_1F_Text_DevonWorkersL.current: DEVON CORPORATION's workers live in /  this building.

RustboroCity_Flat2_2F_Text_DevonWasTinyI.current: Way back in the old days, DEVON was just /  a teeny, tiny company.

RustboroCity_Flat2_2F_Text_MyDaddyMadeTh.current: My daddy's working at the CORPORATION. //  My daddy made this! /  But I can't use it, so you can have it.

RustboroCity_Flat2_2F_Text_GoingToWorkAt.current: My daddy's working at the CORPORATION. //  When I grow up, I'm going to work for /  DEVON, too.

RustboroCity_Flat2_2F_Text_MyDadsAceAtDe.current: My dad is a real ace at DEVON. //  Here. Take something an ACE TRAINER /  like me knows how to use.

RustboroCity_Flat2_2F_Text_PokemonHoldFl.current: A METAL COAT lets some POKéMON evolve /  when traded. DEVON refines them.

RustboroCity_Flat2_2F_Text_PutOnWeight.current: For some reason, I've put on a lot of /  weight recently…

RustboroCity_Flat2_3F_Text_PresidentColl.current: DEVON's PRESIDENT likes to collect /  rare stones.

RustboroCity_Flat2_3F_Text_PresidentsSon.current: I think the PRESIDENT's son also /  collects rare stones.

RustboroCity_House3_Text_IGivePerfectlyS.current: For my own POKéMON, I give them /  perfectly suited nicknames! //  It's my expression of, uh… /  originality, yes, that's it!
