RustboroCity_House3_Text_NamingPikachuPe.current: But giving the name PEKACHU to /  a PIKACHU? It seems pointless. //  I suppose it is good to use a name /  that's easy to understand, but…

FortreeCity_House1_Text_YouWillTradeWont.current: Wrooooaaar! I need it! /  I have to get me a {STR_VAR_1}! /  I'll do anything for it! //  …Uh… Did you hear that? /  My shout from the bottom of my heart? //  Having heard that, you will trade /  your {STR_VAR_1} for my {STR_VAR_2}, /  won't you?

FortreeCity_House1_Text_MonYouTakeCare.current: Oh, yeah, right on! //  {STR_VAR_1}, welcome! /  {STR_VAR_2}, you take care!

FortreeCity_House1_Text_ThisIsntAMon.current: Uh, no, I don't think so. /  That isn't a {STR_VAR_1}.

FortreeCity_House1_Text_YouWontTradeMe.current: No? You won't trade me? /  Even after I bared my heart to you?

FortreeCity_House1_Text_GoingToMakeVolbe.current: I'm going to make VOLBEAT super /  strong from this moment on! //  BOMBIRDIER already knows its role. /  Just give it a partner to cover!

FortreeCity_House1_Text_TradingMemoriesW.current: Trading POKéMON with others… //  It's as if you're trading your own /  memories with other people.

FortreeCity_House1_EventScript_MegaGift_.current: People admire a Milotic, but few /  remember the patient work of raising it. //  Take this stone if you find one. /  Beauty deserves a little adventure.

FortreeCity_Gym_Text_WinonaIntro.current: I am WINONA, FORTREE's GYM LEADER. //  The sky controls position: wind decides /  speed, wings evade Ground, snow hides /  the final horizon. //  Preserve the answer you will need after /  the weather changes.

FortreeCity_Gym_Text_WinonaDefeat.current: You denied the wind without losing sight /  of the snow. Accept the FEATHER BADGE.

FortreeCity_Gym_Text_ReceivedFeatherBadg.current: {PLAYER} received the FEATHER BADGE /  from WINONA.

FortreeCity_Gym_Text_ExplainFeatherBadge.current: The FEATHER BADGE lets your LEVELER /  train a party up to Lv. 60. //  It also enables FLY outside of battle. /  Your FLIGHT BEACON works from now on. /  Use it from the BAG to revisit towns. //  And this… /  This is a gift from me.

FortreeCity_Gym_Text_ExplainAltarianite.current: Altarianite lets Altaria Mega Evolve. /  Let it hold the stone in battle.

FortreeCity_Gym_Text_PyreHandoff.current: AQUA has been seen near MT. PYRE. /  Follow ROUTES 120 and 121 east, then /  SURF south on ROUTE 122 to find it. //  Discover what they are disturbing there. /  The skies over HOENN are unsettled.

FortreeCity_Gym_Text_RegisteredWinona.current: Registered GYM LEADER WINONA /  in the POKéNAV.

FortreeCity_Gym_Text_WinonaPostBattle.current: A flying team is not one species label. /  It is freedom of position. Remember that. //  To follow AQUA to MT. PYRE, head east /  through ROUTES 120 and 121, then SURF /  south on ROUTE 122. //  Find what drew them to that quiet place.

FortreeCity_Gym_Text_WinonaPreRematch.current: WINONA: We humans can never escape /  gravity's pull on the ground. //  But by striving for excellence, /  we have the power to soar! //  You have scaled the pinnacle as /  the reigning CHAMPION. //  Please, allow me to see your power /  at full flight!

FortreeCity_Gym_Text_WinonaRematchDefeat.current: I failed to reach your height again…

FortreeCity_Gym_Text_WinonaPostRematch.current: WINONA: Even though I have lost, /  the wings of my heart remain unbroken. //  I can rise and soar again and /  yet again. //  I am convinced of it!

FortreeCity_Gym_Text_WinonaRematchNeedTw.current: WINONA: We humans can never escape /  gravity's pull on the ground. //  But by striving for excellence, /  we have the power to soar! //  You have scaled the pinnacle as /  the reigning CHAMPION. //  Please, allow me to see your power /  at full flight! //  Oh, no… Do you have but one /  POKéMON with you? //  Please return with two POKéMON /  at the very least.

FortreeCity_Gym_Text_WinonaAfterPyre.current: A flying team is not one species label. /  It is freedom of position. Remember that.

FortreeCity_Gym_Text_JaredIntro.current: SWOOBAT's SIMPLE doubles every CALM /  MIND. NOCTOWL puts you to sleep first. //  Wake up before STORED POWER lands!

FortreeCity_Gym_Text_JaredDefeat.current: You broke the boost before it grew!

FortreeCity_Gym_Text_JaredPostBattle.current: TAUNT or a fast hit stops SIMPLE setup. /  Never give a SIMPLE user a free turn.

FortreeCity_Gym_Text_FlintIntro.current: MULTISCALE DRAGONITE, SPEED BOOST /  YANMEGA, and a TAILWIND behind them. //  WINONA needn't see you if I win here!

FortreeCity_Gym_Text_FlintPostBattle.current: Speed stacked on speed still dies to /  priority. EXTREME SPEED is coming.

FortreeCity_Gym_Text_AshleyIntro.current: PIDGEOT's HURRICANE never misses under /  NO GUARD. SWANNA brings the rain. //  Position, then power!

FortreeCity_Gym_Text_AshleyDefeat.current: You changed the weather on me!

FortreeCity_Gym_Text_AshleyPostBattle.current: Your own weather move overwrites mine. /  The sky belongs to whoever set it last.

FortreeCity_Gym_Text_EdwardoIntro.current: JUMPLUFF puts you to sleep, and /  HONCHKROW grows with every fall. //  Give it nothing to feed on!

FortreeCity_Gym_Text_EdwardoPostBattle.current: TAILWIND lasts four turns. Stall the /  wind, then punish what it carried.

FortreeCity_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice.current: Yo, how's it going, CHAMPION- /  bound {PLAYER}? //  FORTREE GYM LEADER WINONA is /  a master of FLYING-type POKéMON. //  She's waiting at the back of this GYM, /  behind the rotating doors. //  She's waiting for new challengers /  who are trying to take wing! //  Okay, go for it!

FortreeCity_Gym_Text_GymGuidePostVictory.current: You did it! /  You've achieved liftoff!

FortreeCity_Gym_Text_HumbertoIntro.current: GLISCOR heals through its own poison, /  and CORVIKNIGHT returns what you send. //  Lower our stats. I dare you!

FortreeCity_Gym_Text_HumbertoDefeat.current: You hit MINIOR before the shell came off!

FortreeCity_Gym_Text_HumbertoPostBattle.current: SHELL SMASH needs one free turn. /  FAKE OUT or a spread attack denies it.

FortreeCity_Gym_Text_DariusIntro.current: TORNADUS raises the TAILWIND before /  you have taken a single turn. //  Four turns. Outlast them!

FortreeCity_Gym_Text_DariusDefeat.current: You aimed at the rod itself!

FortreeCity_Gym_Text_DariusPostBattle.current: Remove the redirect first. The birds /  behind it are only fast, not sturdy.

FortreeCity_Gym_Text_GymStatueCertified.current: FORTREE CITY POKéMON GYM //  WINONA'S CERTIFIED TRAINERS: /  {PLAYER}

FortreeCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_GoToSa.current: Listen, kid, are you working /  on a POKéDEX? //  Hmm… Go to the SAFARI ZONE. /  That's my suggestion.

FortreeCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Record.current: Have you done anything at /  the RECORD CORNER? //  It's pretty neat. It mixes and matches /  the records of TRAINERS. //  I don't know quite how it works, /  but it's cool. It's exciting, even!

FortreeCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_DoYouK.current: Oh, wow, you have a POKéNAV! /  And it's just like mine! //  Do you know about POKéNAV's /  MATCH CALL system? //  Access it, and you can chat with /  registered TRAINERS anytime. //  It also lets TRAINERS share news /  and training notes with you. //  It's really nifty! Those DEVON guys /  sure know what they're doing!

FortreeCity_Mart_Text_SuperRepelBetter.current: SUPER REPEL lasts a long time, /  and it gets the job done. //  It's much better than an ordinary /  REPEL.

FortreeCity_Mart_Text_StockUpOnItems.current: I always stock up on more items than /  I'm sure I'll need. //  You never know what might happen. /  Better to be safe than sorry!

FortreeCity_Mart_Text_RareCandyMakesMonG.current: The LEVELER raises your whole party to /  the current level limit at once. //  It makes training completely optional.

FortreeCity_Mart_Text_SpenserChallenge.current: I am SPENSER of the BATTLE PALACE. //  A Pokémon's instincts reveal its /  Trainer's trust. Let me see yours!

FortreeCity_Mart_Text_SpenserAfter.current: Use that PROTECTOR to raise a new /  partner. We will meet at the FRONTIER.

FortreeCity_House2_Text_HiddenPowersArou.current: People… POKéMON… //  Their hidden powers are aroused by /  living in natural environments…

FortreeCity_House2_Text_CoinInWhichHand.current: Let this old woman see if your hidden /  power has awoken… //  I hold a coin in my hand. //  Now, tell me, have I palmed it in /  the right hand? Or in the left?

FortreeCity_House2_Text_CorrectTryAgainW.current: Oh! Yes, correct! //  We shall try again. //  In which hand have I palmed the coin? /  The right or left?
Oh! Yes, correct! //  We shall try again. //  In which hand have I palmed the coin? /  The right or left?

FortreeCity_House2_Text_YourHiddenPowerH.current: Your insight has awoken! //  Take this Dubious Disc for Porygon2.

FortreeCity_House2_Text_ExplainDubiousDi.current: A DUBIOUS DISC evolves PORYGON2. /  Use it from the Bag when ready.

FortreeCity_House2_Text_YouGuessedWrong.current: No, too bad. /  You guessed wrong.

FortreeCity_House3_Text_MetStevenHadAmaz.current: While speaking about POKéDEXES, /  I remembered something. //  I met this TRAINER, STEVEN, when /  I was searching for rare stones. //  Hoo, boy, he had some amazing POKéMON /  with him. //  They weren't just rare, they were /  trained to terrifying extremes! //  He might even be stronger than the /  GYM LEADER in this town…

FortreeCity_House3_Text_OhYouHavePokedex.current: What's that thing you have there? //  … … … … … … //  Oh, it's called a POKéDEX? /  It's really awesome!

FortreeCity_House4_Text_BringsWorldClose.current: By being together with POKéMON, /  people make more and more friends. //  And that brings the world closer /  together. I think it's wonderful!

FortreeCity_House4_Text_AskedWingullToRu.current: Heheh, I asked my WINGULL to run /  an errand for me.

FortreeCity_House4_Text_WelcomeWingullTa.current: Welcome back, Wingull! And thank you. //  Please take this Sachet as my thanks.

FortreeCity_House4_Text_FriendsFarAwayTh.current: Thanks to my WINGULL, I have friends /  who live far away.

FortreeCity_House5_Text_TreeHousesAreGre.current: The tree houses of FORTREE are great! //  I think it's the number one town for /  living together with POKéMON.

FortreeCity_House5_EventScript_MegaGift_.current: Listen to the chimes in the trees. /  No two breezes sound quite alike. //  I kept this for a Chimecho. /  Perhaps yours will give it a voice.

FortreeCity_House5_Text_AdaptedToNature.current: POKéMON and people have adapted to /  nature for survival. //  There's no need to make nature /  conform to the way we want to live.

FortreeCity_DecorationShop_Text_Merchand.current: Merchandise you buy here is sent to /  your own PC. //  That's fantastic! I wish they could /  also deliver me home like that.

FortreeCity_DecorationShop_Text_BuyingDe.current: I'm buying a pretty desk and I'm /  putting my cute DOLLS on it. //  If I don't, when I decorate my /  SECRET BASE, my DOLLS will get /  dirty or poked with splinters.

LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_1F_Text_Guest.current: Hm, so they doubled the guests by /  using POKéMON as attractions? //  Hm, well, maybe I should make a cute /  POKéMON our inn's mascot. //  I wonder if that will attract more /  guests to stay with us?

LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_1F_Text_NoGue.current: Oh, sorry, sorry! /  I was too involved in watching TV! //  Since that TEAM AQUA came to town, /  the tourists have been staying away.

LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_1F_Text_MonFo.current: Amazing! You're telling me a POKéMON /  found someone's lost item? //  That's something. If we had some smart /  POKéMON like that… //  We could recover anything that our /  guests mislaid…

LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_1F_Text_Heard.current: Oh, sorry, sorry! /  I was too involved in watching TV! //  I heard that someone busted /  the TEAM AQUA HIDEOUT. //  Thanks to that, we just booked /  a reservation from a big group. //  It was a company called… Uh… /  GAME something…

LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_1F_Text_House.current: Amazing! A house-sitting POKéMON /  caught a burglar? //  That's something. If we had a tough /  POKéMON as a security guard… //  We would be able to provide our guests /  with greater safety.

LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_1F_Text_Bette.current: Oh, sorry, sorry! /  I was too involved in watching TV. //  Oh, yes. A big group of guests arrived /  a little while ago. //  They booked in as GAME FREAK, /  so I guess they must make games. //  Uh-oh, I'd better get working on /  their dinner!

LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_1F_Text_CantS.current: Hey, down in front! /  I can't see the TV!

LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_2F_Text_ShowM.current: I'm the GAME DESIGNER. //  Oh, is that right? /  You're working on a POKéDEX? //  It's tough trying to complete it, /  but don't give up. //  If you do complete it, please come /  show me.

LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_2F_Text_Fille.current: Wow! That's awesome! /  Yep, it's totally awesome! //  This POKéDEX is completely filled! /  You really must love POKéMON! //  I'm so impressed! //  Let me give you something in /  recognition of your feat!

LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_2F_Text_ImThe.current: I'm the GRAPHIC ARTIST! Aren't the /  POKéMON of HOENN interesting?

LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_2F_Text_Girls.current: The girl TUBERS, they're cute, hey? /  To battle against a cute TUBER… //  Whoop, it's so awesome! //  And the TWINS! Aren't they cute? /  A 2-on-2 battle with TWINS… //  Whoop, it's unbearably fun!

LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_2F_Text_ImThe.current: Me? You're talking to me? /  I'm the PROGRAMMER. //  I wonder what the SLOTS are /  like here.

LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_2F_Text_Never.current: You never know when and where /  people will challenge you. //  That's why I never leave home without /  my GAME BOY ADVANCE.

LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_2F_Text_SeaBr.current: The sea breeze tickles my heart. /  It feels wonderful here!

LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_2F_Text_Snooz.current: SCOTT: … … … … … /  … … … … … Zzz… //  … … … … … Huh?! /  Oh, sorry, sorry! I was snoozing! //  I came to check out this POKéMON /  CONTEST thing. //  I have to admit, it does look quite /  entertaining, but… //  Consider me a purist--I prefer /  battles and tough TRAINERS. //  But that's just me. //  {PLAYER}{KUN}, I hope you'll enjoy everything /  like the GYMS, CONTESTS, BATTLE TENT, /  the whole works!

LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_2F_Text_Conte.current: SCOTT: I think it does take strategy /  to win a CONTEST. //  Devising CONTEST strategies is one way /  of becoming a better TRAINER, I'd say.

LilycoveCity_CoveLilyMotel_2F_Text_Buffe.current: I helped design battles where every role /  hands momentum to the next. //  Want to test one of my favorite teams?
You broke the redirect before the setup.
The best battle is difficult, readable, /  and different from the one before it.
Return when you want a designer's test.

LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_Welc.current: Welcome to LILYCOVE MUSEUM. //  Please take the time to enjoy our /  collection of fantastic artwork /  featuring POKéMON.

LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_ImCu.current: I'm the CURATOR of this MUSEUM of /  fine arts. //  It's heartening to see someone so /  young as you in our MUSEUM. //  Have you viewed our collection of /  paintings already?

LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_NotD.current: Ah, then let me not disturb you. /  Please, do take your time.

LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_Have.current: Oh? I do believe that you seem to /  be a POKéMON TRAINER. //  Have you an interest in paintings, /  too?

LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_Hono.current: I see… //  I'm honored that you would visit /  us in spite of that.

LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_Exce.current: Ah, excellent! /  You do like paintings! //  Then, may I ask you to come with me?

LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_Must.current: Battling with POKéMON is fun, /  I'll grant you that. //  But one mustn't forget our love for /  the fine arts.

LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_This.current: This ART MUSEUM… Well, you could /  see many fantastic paintings. //  And the CURATOR is a wonderful person. //  Among artists like myself, this MUSEUM /  is an inspiration.
This lady is pretty! /  She's like Mommy!
This POKéMON is adorable! /  Just like our little boy!

LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_Hear.current: I'd heard that this ART MUSEUM got /  in some new paintings. //  So, naturally I hurried over. //  Are the new paintings up on /  the second floor?

LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_AimT.current: I aim to see many great paintings /  here and learn from them. //  I have this dream of one day having /  my artwork exhibited here.

LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_Muse.current: The ART MUSEUM has become a favorite /  tourist destination. //  It's great for LILYCOVE… /  No, great for the HOENN region! //  This is what I've heard--a lone TRAINER /  procured all the paintings upstairs.

LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_Cura.current: Lately, the CURATOR has been /  unusually cheerful. //  I bet something good happened for him. /  Definitely.

LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_OddL.current: It's an odd landscape with bizarre /  and fantastic scenery.

LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_Pain.current: It's a delicious-looking painting /  of BERRIES. //  This painting could make you hungry!

LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_Very.current: It's a very old painting. /  The paint is peeling here and there.

LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_Pain.current: It's a painting of a beautiful, smiling /  woman with a POKéMON on her lap.

LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_Text_BirdPok.current: It's a replica of a famous sculpture. //  It depicts an ancient BIRD POKéMON.

LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_Pain.current: It's a painting of GRASS POKéMON /  swaying in a breeze. //  They appear to be enjoying the wind's /  gentle caress.

LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_Ston.current: It's a huge stone tablet inscribed /  with POKéMON and dense text in the /  small characters of an ancient, /  unreadable language.

LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_Pain.current: It's a painting of a legendary POKéMON /  from long ago. //  The artist painted this from /  imagination.

LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_1F_Text_BigP.current: It's a big POKé BALL carved from /  a black stone. //  It was apparently used in festivals /  in the olden days.

LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_Wish.current: I wish to fill this exhibit hall with /  modern and vibrant paintings of /  POKéMON.

LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_Than.current: Thanks to you, we've added a new /  painting to our collection! //  I've heard it depicts your POKéMON. /  Truly magnificent! //  Thank you so very, very much!

LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_Pain.current: Isn't this marvelous? /  This collection of paintings! //  Each one of them flawless! /  None better than another! //  These paintings have attracted /  more guests to our ART MUSEUM. //  Sincerely, I thank you, {PLAYER}. /  This is my dream come true!

LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_Toke.current: This is merely a token of my gratitude.

LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_Keep.current: I will keep this for you until we /  meet again.

LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_Hono.current: Ah, so good to see you, {PLAYER}! //  It's an honor to have you visit us /  on your busy journeys. //  Please, relax and do enjoy your /  visit with us.

LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_NewP.current: I've been away awhile, so the new /  paintings up here surprised me. //  I wish someone would paint my POKéMON /  this pretty.
Well… So this is where they show /  the topical POKéMON paintings. //  I see, these new paintings are indeed /  rather amusing.

LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_Thes.current: Wow, is that right? /  These paintings are of your POKéMON. //  Isn't that just the ultimate joy for /  a TRAINER?

LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_ItsP.current: It's a picture frame with pink-colored /  adornments.

LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_ItsY.current: It's a picture frame with /  yellow-colored adornments.

LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_ItsR.current: It's a picture frame with /  red-colored adornments.

LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_ItsB.current: It's a picture frame with /  blue-colored adornments.

LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_ItsG.current: It's a picture frame with /  green-colored adornments.

LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_This.current: This is our special exhibit hall.

LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_Expl.current: As you can plainly see, there is not /  a single painting on exhibit. //  Here, I don't wish to exhibit works of /  so-called classical art. //  Such classical works you can see on /  our ground floor. //  I wish to exhibit work that is far /  different from the classics. //  Art, after all, is not restricted to old, /  famous works! //  This exhibit hall, I wish to fill it with… //  Modern and vibrant artworks of /  POKéMON seemingly ready to spring /  forth into glorious life!

LilycoveCity_LilycoveMuseum_2F_Text_Plea.current: I beg your pardon. I didn't intend /  to monopolize the conversation. //  Now, as you are young, and yet /  obviously well traveled… //  You must encounter lively POKéMON /  and works of art depicting them. //  If you were to come across such /  a painting, may we ask you to obtain /  the artist's permission to exhibit /  it here?

LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_MasterRan.current: Hoo, boy… Master Rank CONTESTS, /  here I come. //  The world will know that my dearest /  POKéMON is the cutest being in all /  existence. The time has come! /  Uheheheh.

LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_WholeVari.current: You can see a whole variety of /  POKéMON here. //  That's why I make this place a regular /  part of my daily stroll.

LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ContestFe.current: Wow, coming out to a CONTEST is /  a feast for these eyes! //  Would you look at all the POKéMON /  that just scream to be painted?

LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_LavishedC.current: Day in and day out, I lavished my care /  on this POKéMON. //  Its condition is peaking. /  Today, victory is mine!

LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ToughCont.current: The TOUGHNESS CONTEST is like /  extreme, man! //  Those muscular appeals… /  Cascading sweat… I swoon!

LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_MadePokeb.current: I made {POKEBLOCK}S with Mom, Dad, and /  Big Sister. They turned out great! //  I bet you can make smoother, better /  {POKEBLOCK}S if you have more people.

LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_LadyGaveM.current: Yippee! //  The lady at the reception counter /  gave me a case for {POKEBLOCK}S!

LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_MakePokeb.current: Make {POKEBLOCK}S and put them in there. //  When you make a {POKEBLOCK}, everyone /  has to put in a different BERRY.

LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_YourPokem.current: Congratulations! //  I did a painting of your POKéMON to /  commemorate its victory… //  Well, your POKéMON's appeals were /  so fantastic, it spurred me into /  painting better than I usually do. /  Look, see?

LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ShouldITa.current: What do you think? I'm confident in /  what I've done, but do you like it? //  A work of this caliber, it wouldn't look /  out of place in an art museum. //  Huh? An art museum really is looking /  for paintings? //  Do you think I should take this there?

LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_IllTakePa.current: What, really? Then, sure, I will take /  this painting there right now. //  I'll give it a proper title, too. //  I hope they'll like it and consider /  exhibiting this. //  Please check if they did accept this. /  Thank you!

LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_TakeMemen.current: Oh, that's right! //  As a memento of me painting your /  POKéMON, please take this.

LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_TakeHomeB.current: Oh… Then, I guess I'll just take /  this home with me… //  But, you know, I would like to take /  this to the art museum… Okay?

LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_FineThats.current: Oh, fine, that's the way it is. /  I will hang this in my own house. //  I'll just have to try harder next time. /  Well, be seeing you.

LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_TodayWonSm.current: This POKéMON won the BEAUTY CONTEST /  here before. //  Well, guess what? Today, I made it /  win a SMARTNESS CONTEST! //  My abilities scare even me…

LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_EnteredBun.current: I've entered a bunch of CONTESTS, /  so I'm seeing how things work. //  If you're in a COOLNESS CONTEST, /  cool moves go over as appeals. //  But smart moves and cute moves /  don't go over well, for instance.

LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_ManWhoWonE.current: That young man who won earlier had /  a whole bunch of different {POKEBLOCK}S. //  Can you win if you had that many /  of those things?

LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_GiveItBest.current: MC: Okay, SMART POKéMON and their /  TRAINERS, are you ready?! //  Give it your best showing! /  Let's appeal!

LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_AreYouEnjo.current: JUDGE: Are you enjoying this CONTEST? //  Come back with three friends, and /  all of you may enter a CONTEST!

LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_EnteredWro.current: Ayayayay… /  I entered the wrong CONTEST. //  I entered this tough POKéMON in /  the SMARTNESS CONTEST… //  Come on, wow them with a smart-looking /  ROCK SMASH.

LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_RaisedMonT.current: I've spent many a year, and all my /  wisdom besides, raising this POKéMON /  to be smart. //  It won't be easily bested by some /  young pup's POKéMON. //  My dear wife, are you seeing this?

LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_IfMonPulls.current: There it is! //  If my POKéMON pulls a smart move next, /  the audience's excitement will peak!

LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_DontApprec.current: Oh, dear, no! //  My darling ZUBAT's LEECH LIFE is so /  cute I kept using it over and over! //  But these mean people don't appreciate /  it at all!

LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_StillLoveS.current: When all's said and done, I still love /  SMARTNESS CONTESTS. //  That intellectual green color… /  It's so… So… Cool.

LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_AllSeemToU.current: Even when TRAINERS enter the same /  kind of POKéMON, they all seem to use /  different moves for appeals. //  It's just like the way people have /  different styles for battling.

LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_AreYouEnte.current: MC: Are you entering the BEAUTY /  CONTEST, too? Good luck!

LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_EveryPokem.current: JUDGE: Ah, every POKéMON here is /  a model of pristine beauty! //  Why, I almost forgot to score them!

LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_EyesWillBe.current: A POKéMON this beautiful… /  There isn't another one like it. //  Everyone's eyes will be glued to /  my beauty.

LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_OverdidGro.current: Waaaah! //  I brushed and groomed my POKéMON /  carefully for this CONTEST… //  But I overdid it… /  My POKéMON's coat turned all scraggly… //  What should I do?

LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_JudgeWontS.current: This AURORA BEAM is so dazzling, /  the JUDGE won't be able to see it. //  Uh, wait a second… /  That'll be meaningless, then!

LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_PokemonLoo.current: This pretty POKéMON looks just like /  me when I was younger. //  Right when I said that, my husband /  spewed the coffee he was drinking. //  Did I say something funny?

LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_WinBeautyC.current: You know, if I win at a BEAUTY /  CONTEST, sure it makes me /  happy. More than usual, anyway.

LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_CantWinOnB.current: You can't always win on just beauty /  alone. //  You have to groom your POKéMON so /  it's nice and glossy like mine.

LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_GanderAtAl.current: Wahahahah! //  Will you take a gander at all those /  pretty POKéMON! /  I just love this sort of glitz!

LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_PokemonSma.current: I think the POKéMON look smarter /  than their TRAINERS. By a lot.

LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_InTheMiddl.current: MC: Uh-oh! Hello! /  We're in the middle of a CONTEST! //  Please enter at our registration /  counter and come out, okay?

LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_SuchCharmi.current: JUDGE: Oh, such charming and cute /  appeals! //  Oh, my goodness! What a perfectly /  adorable WATER SPORT appeal!

LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_MyAzurillW.current: Oh, no… My sweet AZURILL was /  distracted by another POKéMON.

LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_NeverWonBa.current: My POKéMON has never won in a battle, /  but put it in a CONTEST and look out!

LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_PetalDance.current: My POKéMON's PETAL DANCE is a marvel /  of elegance. //  I won't let anyone disturb its /  performance.

LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_MyMonAppea.current: Everyone's POKéMON are very cute. //  However, if my POKéMON were to make /  a cute appeal… //  I'm sure that it would be so much  /  cuter than the others.

LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_MyChildIsI.current: My child is in this CONTEST.

LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_ComeOnDear.current: Come on, dear. Go for it! /  Your POKéMON is the best!

LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_ThatGirlTh.current: I think that girl over there is /  the cutest of the lot. //  What's that? They're judging /  POKéMON by their looks?

LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_WantCuteMo.current: Ohh, seeing all these cute POKéMON, /  they make we want to get my own! //  I'm going to go catch some!

LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_IsntThisPl.current: Whoa, isn't this place humongous! //  The tension in the air… It's not /  like a CONTEST hall in the sticks.

LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_BeautyCont.current: BEAUTY CONTEST STAGE /  BE ALLURED BY BEAUTIFUL POKéMON!

LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_CuteContes.current: CUTENESS CONTEST STAGE /  BE CHARMED BY CUTE POKéMON!

LilycoveCity_ContestHall_Text_SmartConte.current: SMARTNESS CONTEST STAGE /  BE IMPRESSED BY SMART POKéMON!

LilycoveCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_HowMa.current: I wonder how many kinds of POKéMON /  there are in the world. //  It'd be great to cross seas and /  trade POKéMON with people far away.

LilycoveCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Heard.current: I've been hearing about some rotten /  scoundrels who steal POKéMON and rip /  off METEORITES.

LilycoveCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Haven.current: Those rotten scoundrels who steal /  POKéMON and rip off METEORITES… //  I haven't seen them around recently.

LilycoveCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_.current: Oh! /  {PLAYER}! //  Go for it! /  I'm pulling for you!
Sigh… /  BRAWLY… //  Oh, no! Wait! /  That's not right! No, no, no! //  I'm your fan through and through! //  So make me proud! /  Go for it!
I can't help it, I can only get to /  like BRAWLY…
Nobody understands the charm of /  BRAWLY… //  I don't care! //  Even if I'm the only one, I'm going /  to keep cheering for BRAWLY!
Whatever anyone says, my favorite /  TRAINER is DEWFORD's GYM LEADER /  BRAWLY!
Yo, {PLAYER}! /  You're the one we want to win!
The others, they don't know that /  you're the best of the best! //  Isn't that right, {PLAYER}? /  Show them you've got guts!
I hate to say this, but the TRAINER /  everybody's talking about is /  {STR_VAR_1}, no question about it! //  That TRAINER's power… /  It's out of the ordinary.
Darn it… I've been telling people /  that {STR_VAR_1} is the best now… //  But no one wants to listen…
I've been hearing things about /  a tough new TRAINER. //  This TRAINER's supposed to be beating /  GYM LEADERS, even. //  Do you know anything about this /  new TRAINER?
You've surpassed your own father in /  every regard! //  I'm telling you, so there's no question /  about it at all!
Even when things turned bleak, /  your father never gave up. //  This I know to be true. //  You never give up even if you lose! /  So keep on battling!
NORMAN battled with more power, /  charisma, and showmanship than you. //  Even though people may say that /  you're strong… //  You've still got a long way to go /  compared to your father.

You're beginning to get the same /  air of awe NORMAN exudes. //  But there's something conclusively /  different between you and NORMAN. //  I can't tell you what that is. /  You'll have to find it yourself.
Everyone here, we're all huge fans /  of POKéMON battles. //  We discuss who we consider to be /  the strongest of all TRAINERS. //  If you were to become famous, /  we might even become your fans!
Oh, woweee! It's {PLAYER}! /  For real, too! //  Please, shake my hand, shake my hand!
I'll always cheer for you, {PLAYER}! /  Always, always! //  I don't want to see you lose ever, /  {PLAYER}. //  Because I know you're really, /  really strong, {PLAYER}!
{STR_VAR_1} is really cool… //  Everyone thinks so, right, right?
{STR_VAR_1} really is cool, don't /  you think so? //  Even if it's just me, I'm going to keep /  cheering my favorite TRAINER.
My favorite TRAINER is… //  Cool… //  Strong… //  And really nice… //  I wish there was a TRAINER like that…
Whoa! It's {PLAYER}! /  Wicked! //  When I grow up, I want to be strong /  like you, {PLAYER}!
Even if I'm the only one… //  You'll always be the only one /  I cheer for, {PLAYER}! //  Because I believe in you, {PLAYER}!
{STR_VAR_1} is so wickedly cool… /  I want to shake hands with my hero.
Even if I'm the only one… //  I'm never going to stop being /  {STR_VAR_1}'s fan! //  Because I've heard, {STR_VAR_1} /  never loses!
{PLAYER}! /  You are amazing after all! //  Ever since I set eyes on you, /  I knew that you were great. //  It looks like my eyes didn't deceive me.
Who cares about the others. /  I'm in your corner! //  You don't need to worry. Just get /  out there and battle like always.
You're a pretty decent TRAINER, /  I think. //  But I also think that {STR_VAR_1} /  is number one right now. //  That's just my opinion. /  Don't worry about it too much.
Wow, you really are strong. /  Maybe even stronger than {STR_VAR_1}. //  But {STR_VAR_1} needs me. //  If I don't cheer for {STR_VAR_1}, /  who will?
You've changed my mind! /  You are strong, aren't you? //  I'd like you to tell me how you managed /  to get so strong!
The tougher the situation, the more /  attractively you battle. //  I can't wait for your next battle!
Among the recently hot TRAINERS, /  {STR_VAR_1} is the standout. //  That toughness, it's simply not normal. //  You're doing okay, but you're not in /  the same class as {STR_VAR_1}.
You are really popular… //  You're strong, and you're caring to /  POKéMON. No one can knock you. //  But, you know, I believe in {STR_VAR_1}. //  {STR_VAR_1} is definitely stronger! /  I'm positive!
You… //  Impressive!
Your true worth, it is fine if only /  I recognized it. //  The others I doubt will understand /  the hidden power that beats within.
Yes, I see strength in your eyes. //  But! //  You still haven't realized your /  potential.

It is true that you are tremendously /  powerful. //  But! /  I can tell… //  That strength cannot be considered /  true strength yet! //  True strength is…! /  … … //  Actually, I have no idea, either.
Oh, wow! /  It's {PLAYER}!

I've heard the news! /  You're really strong, aren't you? //  We always argue about who is the /  strongest of all TRAINERS here. //  So when I heard about you, I decided /  to be your fan! //  I hope you'll keep on battling other /  tough TRAINERS. //  That way, we'll be able to see more /  of your hot, hot battles. //  That will make the others here see /  exactly how great you are. //  Remember, I'm cheering for you, /  {PLAYER}!

LilycoveCity_Harbor_Text_FerryUnavailabl.current: I beg your pardon? /  You're looking for a ship? //  I'm sorry, the ferry service isn't /  available at present…

LilycoveCity_Harbor_Text_MayISeeYourTick.current: Hello, are you here for the ferry? /  May I confirm your ferry pass?

LilycoveCity_Harbor_Text_NoTicket.current: Your ferry pass is not registered. //  I'm terribly sorry. //  You need a registered pass to board /  the ferry.

LilycoveCity_Harbor_Text_ConfirmedPassWh.current: The attendant confirmed your ferry /  pass. //  Perfect! That's all you need! //  And where would you like to go?

LilycoveCity_Harbor_Text_SailAnotherTime.current: Please sail with us another time!

LilycoveCity_Harbor_Text_PleaseBoard.current: Please board the ferry and wait for /  departure.

LilycoveCity_Harbor_Text_WhereWouldYouLi.current: Then, where would you like to go?

LilycoveCity_Harbor_Text_SailorFerryUnav.current: Until they finish making the ferry, /  we sailors have nothing to do… //  I wish they'd get a move on, the folks /  at the SHIPYARD in SLATEPORT.

LilycoveCity_Harbor_Text_SailorFerryAvai.current: CHAMPION! STERN and DEVON approved /  four old exploration passes for you. //  They chart SOUTHERN ISLAND, NAVEL ROCK, /  BIRTH ISLAND, and FARAWAY ISLAND.

LilycoveCity_Harbor_Text_ChampionPassesR.current: All four routes are active. Show the /  attendant a pass to choose its island. //  Each destination preserves a unique /  legendary encounter. Explore them all.

LilycoveCity_Harbor_Text_ChampionPassesB.current: Your BAG cannot hold the next pass. Make /  room and speak to me again.

LilycoveCity_MoveDeletersHouse_Text_ICan.current: Uh… /  Oh, yes, I'm the MOVE DELETER. //  I can make POKéMON forget their moves. //  Would you like me to do that?

LilycoveCity_MoveDeletersHouse_Text_Whic.current: Which POKéMON should forget a move?

LilycoveCity_MoveDeletersHouse_Text_MonO.current: {STR_VAR_1} knows only one move /  so it can't be forgotten…

LilycoveCity_MoveDeletersHouse_Text_Mons.current: Hm! {STR_VAR_1}'s {STR_VAR_2}? /  That move should be forgotten?

LilycoveCity_MoveDeletersHouse_Text_MonH.current: It worked to perfection! //  {STR_VAR_1} has forgotten /  {STR_VAR_2} completely.

LilycoveCity_MoveDeletersHouse_Text_Come.current: Come again if there are moves that /  need to be forgotten.

LilycoveCity_MoveDeletersHouse_Text_EggC.current: What? /  No EGG should know any moves.

LilycoveCity_MoveDeletersHouse_Text_Cant.current: Hm! //  Your {STR_VAR_1} doesn't seem willing /  to forget SURF.

LilycoveCity_House1_Text_PokemonPartners.current: POKéMON are partners to people. /  They aren't our tools. //  Unfortunately, there are some people /  who fail to understand that…

LilycoveCity_House2_Text_NotAwakeYetHave.current: Huh? What? What's that? //  I'm not near awake yet… /  You can have this…

LilycoveCity_House2_Text_SleepIsEssentia.current: Yawn… //  Sleep is essential for good health… /  Sleep and regain health…

LilycoveCity_House3_Text_GoingToWinMulti.current: We're having MULTI BATTLES, but I know /  I'm going to win.

LilycoveCity_House3_Text_LikeMixingAtRec.current: We like mixing stuff at /  the RECORD CORNER. //  But what gets mixed up?

LilycoveCity_House3_Text_MakePokeblocksW.current: We're going to make super {POKEBLOCK}S /  with a BERRY BLENDER!

LilycoveCity_House3_Text_GoingToEnterCon.current: I want to brag about how tough my /  POKéMON is, so we're going to enter /  a CONTEST together.

LilycoveCity_House3_Text_LearnFromMaster.current: Oh, my, my! Are you traveling alone? /  But you're so young! Good for you! //  I'm sure my kids could learn a thing /  or two from you! //  Me? I'm a master of {POKEBLOCK}S. //  If I get serious just a little, why, /  I can concoct great {POKEBLOCK}S. //  Would you like to learn from me, /  a master of {POKEBLOCK}S?

LilycoveCity_House3_Text_OhAreYouSure.current: Oh? Are you sure? //  You shouldn't always try to do /  everything by yourself, dear!

LilycoveCity_House3_Text_ExplainPokebloc.current: Oh, good! You're a smart soul! /  This is a bit long, so listen up! //  Are you ready? //  If you look at {POKEBLOCK}S, you should see /  that they are rated on how they feel. //  The lower the feel rating, /  the better it is. Don't forget this! //  A good {POKEBLOCK} has a low feel /  rating and a high level. //  A POKéMON can eat more good /  {POKEBLOCK}S than ordinary ones, too. //  And this is important. //  If you want to make smooth {POKEBLOCK}S, /  use different kinds of BERRIES. //  Don't be stingy--the kinds of BERRIES /  affect the smoothness of {POKEBLOCK}S. //  And another thing. //  The more people blending BERRIES, /  the smoother the {POKEBLOCK}S. //  That's why you should talk to other /  people and make {POKEBLOCK}S together. //  That's about all you need to know to /  make good {POKEBLOCK}S. //  If everyone had POKéMON they love, /  smooth {POKEBLOCK}S, and a loving family, /  the world would be a happier place. //  Don't give up, dear!

LilycoveCity_House3_Text_HappyToHaveQuad.current: When my wife gave birth to quadruplets, /  you bet I was shocked. //  But, now, seeing them play together, /  it makes me happy.

LilycoveCity_House4_Text_MysteriesAtBott.current: This planet's biggest mysteries are /  at the bottom of the sea. //  Somebody said that, but I don't know…

LilycoveCity_House4_EventScript_MegaGift.current: The sea leaves more than shells /  on our shore after a storm. //  This stone shines like a Starmie. /  Let one carry it beneath the stars.

LilycoveCity_House4_Text_UnderwaterTrenc.current: There's a deep underwater trench /  between MOSSDEEP and SOOTOPOLIS. //  That's what someone told me, anyway.

LilycoveCity_House4_EventScript_MegaGift.current: A Lapras once carried my family /  home through a terrible storm. //  I kept this stone in gratitude. /  Please find a Lapras to give it to.

LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_1F_Text_IBu.current: Whenever I come to the DEPARTMENT /  STORE, I always end up buying all sorts /  of things because it's so fun.

LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_1F_Text_Mom.current: Today, my mom is going to buy me some /  nice furniture.

LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_1F_Text_Buy.current: I'm buying something for my AZUMARILL /  as a reward for winning a CONTEST.

LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_1F_Text_Flo.current: 1F: SERVICE COUNTER /      LOTTERY CORNER //  2F: TRAINER'S ZONE //  3F: BATTLE COLLECTION //  4F: MOVE STUDY //  5F: POKé DOLL FLOOR //  ROOFTOP: ROOFTOP PLAZA

LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_2F_Text_Lea.current: Learn to use items properly. /  That's basic, really.

LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_2F_Text_Goo.current: My husband is waiting at home. /  What would make a good gift for him?

LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_2F_Text_Sto.current: I'm leaving on a long journey soon. /  I need to stock up on items.

LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_3F_Text_Rig.current: For building a new team quickly, /  the right kind of BALL is best. //  QUICK BALLS reward a fast throw, /  while DUSK BALLS shine in caves.

LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_3F_Text_Tim.current: Some rare POKéMON take patience. //  A TIMER BALL grows stronger as the /  battle lasts, so I always carry a few.

LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_3F_Text_Qui.current: I caught a new partner with a /  QUICK BALL on the very first turn!

LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_4F_Text_Att.current: Hmm… //  Immediate pressure… /  Or a defensive answer… //  A good set needs four moves that solve /  one plan without becoming predictable.

LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_4F_Text_Man.current: There are so many different kinds of /  moves. //  The POKéMON CENTER tutor can teach /  every move a species may legally learn.

LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_4F_Text_Pok.current: A POKéMON learns only four moves. //  Changing one can change the role of the /  whole team.

LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_4F_Text_Cle.current: Every POKéMON CENTER has a tutor who /  teaches legal moves without charging. //  Experiment freely. No TM purchase is /  needed.
The CENTER tutor also applies complete /  competitive sets: moves, Nature, /  Ability, Stat Points, and held item. //  Mega sets still require the matching /  stone from your adventure.

LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_5F_Text_Get.current: I'm not big enough to raise POKéMON, /  so I'm getting a cute DOLL instead.

LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_5F_Text_Pla.current: This place is full of cute DOLLS. //  I should buy some for me, instead of /  just for my children.

LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_5F_Text_Sel.current: They sell many cute MATS here. //  I wonder which one I should get? /  Maybe I'll buy them all…

LilycoveCity_DepartmentStore_5F_Text_Clo.current: I think they closed the rooftop /  because the weather is wild today.

LilycoveCity_DepartmentStoreRooftop_Text.current: Don't they have set dates for their /  clear-out sales? //  I watch TV, but they never show any /  commercials.
Yes! I've been waiting a long time for /  this clear-out sale. //  They have unusual decorations today. /  I'm going to load up, that I am!
It's a VENDING MACHINE. /  Which drink would you like?
Clang! //  A can of {STR_VAR_1} dropped down.
Clang! //  Score! An extra can of {STR_VAR_1} /  dropped down!

MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_NeedFeatherBadge.current: TATE: Your path still bends west. /  LIZA: WINONA awaits in FORTREE. //  Return with the FEATHER BADGE, and /  we'll accept your challenge.

MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_TateAndLizaIntro.current: TATE: We share one board. /  LIZA: But we can give it two move orders. //  TATE: Psychic Terrain denies priority. /  LIZA: TRICK ROOM punishes speed. //  TATE: Break our timing... /  LIZA: ...before the ice rider closes it.

MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_TateAndLizaDefeat.current: TATE: You broke the room... /  LIZA: ...without losing the board. //  TATE: You earned... /  LIZA: ...the MIND BADGE.

MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_ReceivedMindBadge.current: {PLAYER} received the MIND BADGE /  from TATE and LIZA.

MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_ExplainMindBadgeTa.current: TATE: The MIND BADGE lets your LEVELER /  train a party up to Lv. 70. //  LIZA: It also enables DIVE outside /  of battle. //  TATE: You should also take this, too.

MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_ExplainMetagrossit.current: Tate: Metagrossite lets Metagross Mega /  Evolve. Let it hold the stone.

MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_RegisteredTateAndL.current: Registered GYM LEADERS TATE & LIZA /  in the POKéNAV.

MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_TateAndLizaPostBat.current: TATE: The SPACE CENTER detected a wish... /  LIZA: ...inside METEOR FALLS. Ask STEVEN.

MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_TateAndLizaNeedTwo.current: TATE: Hehehe… Were you surprised? //  LIZA: That there are two GYM LEADERS? //  TATE: Oops, you have only one… /  LIZA: POKéMON that can battle. //  TATE: We can't battle that way! //  LIZA: If you want to challenge us, /  bring some more POKéMON.

MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_TateAndLizaPreRema.current: TATE: POKéMON… /  LIZA: POKéMON… //  TATE: By changing the party's mix… /  LIZA: The battle style changes. //  TATE: But me… /  LIZA: But me… //  TATE: I'll always be with LIZA! /  LIZA: I'll always be with TATE! //  TATE: Our combination… /  LIZA: We'll show you again and again!

MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_TateAndLizaRematch.current: TATE: You and your POKéMON… /  LIZA: It's as if you were siblings!

MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_TateAndLizaPostRem.current: TATE: You can knock us down, /  but we'll never stay down! //  LIZA: Because the two of us, /  we always support each other!

MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_TateAndLizaRematch.current: TATE: You're back again… /  LIZA: You're back again… //  TATE: To give us a rematch. /  LIZA: To give us a rematch. //  TATE: But… /  LIZA: For our match… //  TATE: You brought just one POKéMON! /  LIZA: You brought just one POKéMON! //  TATE: We need you to bring at least… /  LIZA: Two POKéMON when you come back.

MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_SpaceCenterHandoff.current: TATE: TEAM MAGMA is after the /  SPACE CENTER's rocket fuel. //  LIZA: Please help STEVEN stop them! /  The SPACE CENTER is east of our GYM.

MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_PrestonIntro.current: MAGIC GUARD means ALAKAZAM pays no /  price for anything it does. //  Hit it directly, or not at all!

MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_PrestonPostBattle.current: Never use a setup move beside ENCORE. /  Attack, or switch the locked partner.

MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_BlakeIntro.current: GIRAFARIG's THUNDER WAVE and MR. MIME's /  ICY WIND both attack your speed. //  Two ways to be slow. Pick neither!

MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_BlakeDefeat.current: You kept your speed through both!

MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_BlakePostBattle.current: A paralyzed partner can still switch. /  Bring the fresh one back in later.

MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_MauraIntro.current: SLOWBRO leaves and comes back whole. /  AMOONGUSS puts you to sleep meanwhile. //  Out-wait me if you can!

MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_MauraDefeat.current: You aimed where I would be!

MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_MauraPostBattle.current: Spread moves ignore ALLY SWITCH. /  Single-target moves gamble against it.

MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_SamanthaIntro.current: GOTHITELLE closes the exit. AZELF /  plots, and then ends the board. //  You cannot run from this one!

MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_SamanthaPostBattle.current: MAGIC BOUNCE returns your hazards and /  sleep. Attack through XATU instead.

MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_VirgilIntro.current: MEDICHAM buys one turn with FAKE OUT. /  BRONZONG spends it on TRICK ROOM. //  Then the slowest hits first!

MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_VirgilDefeat.current: You stopped the ROOM before it opened!

MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_VirgilPostBattle.current: Protect the FAKE OUT turn and the ROOM /  never happens. Reverse it if it does.

MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_HannahIntro.current: SHARPNESS cuts half again as deep, /  and GALLADE swings twice as well. //  Every blade here is physical!

MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_HannahPostBattle.current: NASTY PLOT doubles the damage each /  turn. Never give AZELF a free one.

MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice.current: Yo, how's it going, CHAMPION-bound /  {PLAYER}? //  The GYM LEADERS here use /  PSYCHIC-type POKéMON. //  If you go up against them with /  FIGHTING- or POISON-type POKéMON, /  they'll inflict horrible damage! //  Plus, they'll come at you with /  outstanding combination attacks. //  If you want to win, you'll need to show /  them how tight you are with your /  POKéMON. Go for it!

MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_GymGuidePostVictor.current: Wow, you're astounding! /  You're one great TRAINER!

MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_NateIntro.current: METAGROSS resists half of what you /  own, and MIMIKYU gets a free turn. //  Break the disguise early!

MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_NateDefeat.current: You hit the star before it shone!

MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_NatePostBattle.current: An attacker beside support is strong /  and fragile. Remove the support first.

MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_SylviaIntro.current: TATSUGIRI climbs inside DONDOZO, /  and what comes out is far worse. //  Stop the little one first!

MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_SylviaPostBattle.current: Lower TORKOAL's HP and ERUPTION fades. /  KO or TAUNT ORANGURU before it teaches.

MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_CliffordIntro.current: PINCURCHIN's terrain doubles RAICHU's /  speed. ESPATHRA gets faster every turn. //  Keep up if you can!

MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_CliffordPostBattle.current: Overwrite ELECTRIC TERRAIN and SURGE /  SURFER becomes an ordinary RAICHU.

MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_MaceyIntro.current: FERROTHORN and TOXAPEX do not fall. /  DELPHOX takes the item that would help. //  Bring fire, or bring patience!

MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_MaceyPostBattle.current: Wake-up plans lose to attack plans. /  Remove the sleeper before it moves.

MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_KathleenIntro.current: I am the last door before the twins. //  LATIAS endures, DRAGAPULT outruns, /  and TYRANITAR wears you down. //  Prove you belong in there!

MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_KathleenDefeat.current: You found the move that fed nothing!

MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_KathleenPostBattle.current: STORED POWER grows with every boost. /  Never let SWOOBAT set up twice.

MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_NicholasIntro.current: LATIOS moves before you do, and /  AEGISLASH punishes your reply. //  Choose your swing carefully!

MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_NicholasDefeat.current: You broke the ROOM through the redirect!

MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_NicholasPostBattle.current: FOLLOW ME cannot pull spread attacks. /  Hit both slots and the ROOM never opens.

MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_GymStatueCertified.current: MOSSDEEP CITY POKéMON GYM //  LIZA AND TATE'S CERTIFIED TRAINERS: /  {PLAYER}

MossdeepCity_House1_Text_CynthiaChalleng.current: I'm CYNTHIA. I study myths, but battles /  reveal how a Trainer reasons under fire. //  You are HOENN's Champion. Will you face /  a Champion from another region?

MossdeepCity_House1_Text_CynthiaDefeat.current: You removed the shelter, denied sleep, /  and still saved an answer for GARCHOMP.

MossdeepCity_House1_Text_CynthiaAfter.current: Take this SHINY CHARM. Let your next /  journey reveal something extraordinary.

MossdeepCity_House1_Text_CynthiaNotReady.current: These kind hosts gave me a quiet place /  to study HOENN's meteor records. //  Your journey continues. Return after /  the HOENN LEAGUE knows your name.

MossdeepCity_House1_Text_CynthiaDecline.current: A good challenge improves by waiting.

MossdeepCity_House1_Text_CynthiaBagFull.current: Make room for the SHINY CHARM. /  I will keep it safe.

MossdeepCity_House2_Text_SisterMailsBoyf.current: My little sister exchanges MAIL with /  her boyfriend in FORTREE. //  I don't envy her one bit at all.

MossdeepCity_House2_Text_PokemonCarriesM.current: Even though I can't see my friend in /  FORTREE, my POKéMON carries MAIL /  back and forth for us. //  I'm not lonesome, even though we're /  apart.

MossdeepCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_GymLe.current: The GYM LEADERS in this town are /  a formidable duo. //  Their combination attacks are, like, /  excellent and wow!

MossdeepCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Abili.current: Depending on the special abilities of /  POKéMON, some moves might change /  or not work at all.

MossdeepCity_PokemonCenter_2F_Text_Woman.current: If I win a whole lot of link battles /  and show everyone how good I am, /  I might get a fan following!

MossdeepCity_Mart_Text_ReviveIsFantastic.current: REVIVE is fantastic! //  Give it to a fainted POKéMON, /  and the POKéMON will arise. //  But be careful, REVIVE doesn't restore /  the used-up PP of moves.

MossdeepCity_Mart_Text_MaxRepelLastsLong.current: MAX REPEL keeps all weak POKéMON away. //  Out of all the REPEL sprays, it lasts /  the longest.

MossdeepCity_Mart_Text_NetAndDiveBallsRa.current: NET and DIVE BALLS specialize in /  different kinds of hunts. //  A NET BALL excels against BUG- and /  WATER-type POKéMON. //  A DIVE BALL excels while surfing, /  fishing, or exploring underwater.

MossdeepCity_House3_Text_YouWantSuperRod.current: Hey there, TRAINER! /  A SUPER ROD really is super! //  Say all you want, but this baby can /  catch POKéMON off the seafloor! //  What do you think? /  You want it, don't you?

MossdeepCity_House3_Text_SuperRodIsSuper.current: You bet, you bet! /  After all, a SUPER ROD is really super!

MossdeepCity_House3_Text_TryDroppingRodI.current: If there's any water, try dropping in /  your ROD and see what bites!

MossdeepCity_House3_Text_DontYouLikeToFi.current: Hunh? /  Don't you like to fish?

MossdeepCity_House3_Text_GoAfterSeafloor.current: Go after the seafloor POKéMON with /  your SUPER ROD.

MossdeepCity_StevensHouse_Text_Underwate.current: STEVEN: Search south on ROUTE 128. /  Use DIVE in the dark water. //  Find the SEAFLOOR CAVERN where AQUA /  took the submarine, and stop ARCHIE.

MossdeepCity_StevensHouse_Text_TakeBallC.current: {PLAYER} checked the POKé BALL. //  It contained the POKéMON /  BELDUM. //  Take the POKé BALL?

MossdeepCity_StevensHouse_Text_LeftPokeB.current: {PLAYER} left the POKé BALL where /  it was.

MossdeepCity_StevensHouse_Text_LetterFro.current: It's a letter. //  … … … … … … //  To {PLAYER}{KUN}… //  I've decided to do a little soul- /  searching and train on the road. //  I don't plan to return home for some /  time. //  I have a favor to ask of you. //  I want you to take the POKé BALL on /  the desk. //  Inside it is a BELDUM, my favorite /  POKéMON. //  I'm counting on you. //  May our paths cross someday. //  STEVEN STONE

MossdeepCity_StevensHouse_Text_Collectio.current: It's a collection of rare rocks and /  stones assembled by STEVEN.

MossdeepCity_StevensHouse_Text_YouveEarn.current: STEVEN: {PLAYER}{KUN}… //  As you can see, there's not much here, /  but this is my home. //  Thank you for all that you've done. //  This is my token of appreciation. /  It's the HIDDEN MACHINE DIVE. //  No need to be shy--you've earned /  this HM.

MossdeepCity_StevensHouse_Text_ExplainDi.current: STEVEN: While you're using SURF, you /  should notice dark patches of water. //  Use DIVE if you come to deep water /  like it. You'll drop to the seafloor. //  When you want to come back up, use /  DIVE again. //  In some places, it won't be possible /  for you to surface, though. //  AQUA took the submarine to a cavern. /  Search south on ROUTE 128. //  Use DIVE in the dark water to find the /  SEAFLOOR CAVERN and stop ARCHIE.

MossdeepCity_House4_Text_BrotherLikesToF.current: My little brother says he likes to go /  find people's SECRET BASES.

MossdeepCity_House4_Text_BrotherLikesToV.current: My little brother says he likes to /  visit people's SECRET BASES and have /  POKéMON battles.

MossdeepCity_House4_Text_YouMadeSecretBa.current: Was it you who made a SECRET BASE /  near {STR_VAR_1}?

MossdeepCity_House4_Text_MakeSecretBase.current: You should make a SECRET BASE /  somewhere. I'll go find it!

MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_Success.current: The rocket launched safely! /  That's launch no. {STR_VAR_1}!

MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_Haywire.current: I know that things are a little /  haywire right now, but… //  The rocket's launch is imminent!
I know that things are a little /  haywire right now, but… //  The rocket launched safely! /  That's launch no. {STR_VAR_1}!

MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_RocketL.current: A rocket launch demands perfection. /  Not even a 1% margin of error is allowed. //  Even if it's 99% okay, the whole thing /  is useless if 1% happens to be no good. //  Despite that, we never stop trying. /  Why? It's a dream that never ends.

MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_MagmaHa.current: Those MAGMA thugs have their sights /  set on our SPACE CENTER. //  But we can't allow anything that minor /  to interfere with our rocket launch!

MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_FoundTh.current: I was taking a stroll down the beach /  when I found this. //  It's not anything I need, so you can /  have it.

MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_HoennFa.current: The HOENN region has been famous for  /  its meteor showers for a long time.

MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_MagmaCa.current: TEAM MAGMA can't be allowed to steal /  the rocket fuel. //  Oh, by the way, you can have this stone /  I found on the beach.

MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_CantStr.current: With TEAM MAGMA around, I guess /  strolls on the beach aren't safe.

MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_Rockets.current: A giant chunk of metal bursts through /  the skies and flies into space… //  It boggles my mind!

MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_MagmaWa.current: A giant chunk of metal bursts through /  the skies and flies into space… //  But TEAM MAGMA wants to spoil /  that dream of mine! //  I'm not having any of that!

MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_DidPoke.current: Some people claim that POKéMON came /  from space. Could it be true?

MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_AquaSho.current: TEAM AQUA should take care of /  TEAM MAGMA! //  But if they did that, TEAM AQUA will /  become bold and brazen, won't they?

MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_Grunt3I.current: We're here for the rocket fuel, exactly /  like we announced. MAXIE likes it tidy.

MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_Grunt3P.current: Don't think you're on a roll just /  because you beat me. I'm the warm-up.

MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_Grunt1I.current: We gave fair warning! Nothing sneaky /  about TEAM MAGMA! Now, MIGHTYENA!

MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_Grunt1D.current: Grrr… Next time we try sneaky.

MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_Grunt1P.current: Okay, I get it. Next time we come /  unannounced. Write that down.

MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_Grunt4I.current: The rocket fuel in storage. Every last /  drop of it. That's the whole plan.

MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_Grunt4D.current: Please, can you spare some fuel? /  Even a chintzy cup?

MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_Grunt4P.current: What do we DO with rocket fuel? How /  would I know? Ask the boss upstairs.

MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_Grunt2I.current: MAXIE said nobody gets past me. So /  nobody gets past me. FLYGON!

MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_Grunt2P.current: Tell him I never left my post. Tell /  him I stayed to the end.

MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_MagmaIn.current: This is… /  An intent-to-steal notice? //  “To the staff of the SPACE CENTER: /  How are you? We are doing fine. //  “We will soon visit you to take your /  rocket fuel. //  “Please don't try to stop us. /  We will take the fuel no matter what. //  “Let there be more land! /                                            TEAM MAGMA”

MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_StevenM.current: STEVEN: {PLAYER}{KUN}, have you read that /  proclamation already? //  TEAM MAGMA is coming after the rocket /  fuel on this island. //  I don't know what they'd need it for, /  but they can't be allowed to take it. //  I'll keep an eye on things for /  a while longer. //  In the meantime, why don't you go /  check out the town?

MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_WishOrd.current: I wish ordinary people could go into /  space one day…

MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_DoesMag.current: TEAM MAGMA… /  Do they want to go to space, too?

MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_Wouldve.current: If only I was a little younger, I would /  have liked being an astronaut… //  No… It's not too late! /  I can and will try!

MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_MagmaCa.current: If TEAM MAGMA takes the rocket fuel, /  I won't be able to go to space! //  They can't be allowed to get away /  with such an outrage!

MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_Mossdee.current: MOSSDEEP has mainly sunny weather, /  and its winds are stable. //  It's an ideal location for launching /  rockets.

MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_WhyWoul.current: Why would TEAM MAGMA want to steal /  our rocket fuel in the first place?

MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_StevenW.current: STEVEN: Rocket fuel cannot control /  GROUDON. What are you truly targeting?

MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_MaxieUs.current: MAXIE: The rocket can strike MT. CHIMNEY /  with a measured charge from above. //  If GROUDON will not obey, I will sever /  the fault network before AQUA uses it. //  The calculation is brutal, not savage.

MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_StevenA.current: STEVEN: {PLAYER}! We fight together. /  Their formation is built for two targets. //  Are you ready to break it as partners?

MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_StevenH.current: STEVEN: Then, hurry! /  Get ready quickly!

MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_JustWan.current: All I want… /  I just want to expand the land mass…

MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_MaxieWe.current: MAXIE: Again, your partnership adapted /  while my certainty narrowed. //  We failed to control GROUDON, and now we /  would destroy what refused control. //  If MAGMA's premise is wrong, then AQUA's /  opposite certainty must be wrong as well.
MAXIE: Keep the fuel. I must find GROUDON /  before ARCHIE repeats the same mistake.

MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_StevenT.current: STEVEN: That was true doubles play: each /  of us made the other's options better. //  Come to my home west of the GYM. /  I have the HM DIVE for you. //  We can use it to follow AQUA's /  stolen submarine.

MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_Grunt6P.current: Three battles should expose every /  answer. You kept finding new ones.

MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_Grunt5P.current: MAXIE's model did not account for a team /  that improves while being worn down.

MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_Grunt7P.current: Attrition favored us. Adaptation favored /  you.

MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_Courtne.current: COURTNEY: MAXIE supplies force. I supply /  the alternate clock. STEVEN is accounted /  for. You remain the unstable variable.

MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_MaxieDo.current: MAXIE: The calculation has reached its /  final input. Do not interfere.

MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_Tabitha.current: TABITHA: The rocket needs a stable base. //  My sand formation will pin both of your /  POKéMON before you reach MAXIE.
You broke the foundation, but the real /  launch sequence is still ahead.
A formation requires two usable /  POKéMON. Return when both can battle.

MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_YoureOu.current: Three consecutive formations guard this /  corridor. You still choose to advance?

MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_GoodAns.current: A sound decision. Recover your team /  before challenging the full sequence.

MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_Grunt5I.current: First formation: establish pressure /  before you can read the sequence.

MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_Grunt5D.current: First line broken. The sequence holds.

MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_Grunt6I.current: Second formation: punish the answer you /  revealed in the first.

MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_Grunt7I.current: Final formation: exploit the damage the /  first two left behind. No reset.

MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_Grunt7D.current: Your team endured the whole sequence…

RS_MysteryEventsHouse_Text_DoorIsLocked.current: The door appears to be locked.

SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_JuanIntro.current: I am JUAN, WALLACE's mentor, keeper of /  SOOTOPOLIS's final examination. //  You calmed one impossible rain. Now solve /  rain used deliberately: speed, trapping, /  reversed order, and protected Water. //  This is artistry only if every choice has /  purpose. Show me yours.

SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_JuanDefeat.current: Excellent! You found space inside every /  current and denied my final rain turn. //  Take the RAIN BADGE. WALLACE will demand /  everything this Gym only introduced.

SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_ReceivedRainB.current: {PLAYER} received the RAIN BADGE /  from JUAN.

SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_ExplainRainBa.current: The RAIN BADGE lets your LEVELER train /  a party up to Lv. 80. //  It also enables WATERFALL to scale /  walls of cascading water. //  With all eight BADGES, HOENN's last /  doors open: VICTORY ROAD, and the /  LEAGUE beyond it. //  And, so that you never forget the /  battle we shared, take this…

SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_ExplainGyarad.current: Gyaradosite lets Gyarados Mega Evolve. /  Let it hold the stone in battle. //  SURF east from ROUTE 128 to EVER GRANDE. /  Use WATERFALL at the city's entrance.

SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_RegisteredJua.current: Registered GYM LEADER JUAN /  in the POKéNAV.

SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_JuanPostBattl.current: Eight BADGES open EVER GRANDE. Its /  challenge is five master teams in a row. //  SURF east from ROUTE 128 to EVER GRANDE. /  Use WATERFALL at the city's entrance. //  You may heal with your BAG between rooms, /  but never use items inside their battles.

SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_NeedMindBadge.current: There remains but one BADGE to /  obtain in HOENN. //  If you wish to challenge the POKéMON /  LEAGUE, first earn the MIND BADGE /  from the GYM in MOSSDEEP.

SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_JuanPreRematc.current: JUAN: Ah, this GYM had returned to its /  usual state of serenity… //  But our young typhoon has returned /  to put us to the test again! //  Well, my friend, most certainly! //  I shall be delighted to dance with you /  as often as you wish!

SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_JuanRematchDe.current: Ahahaha, you are the winner! /  You have defeated me again!

SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_JuanPostRemat.current: JUAN: If I told you to become my /  apprentice, you will refuse, I am sure. //  I would like to make a gift of my coat /  to you. //  But again, you will refuse. /  I imagine that to be so. //  And that, my friend, is a certain sign /  of nobility!

SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_JuanRematchNe.current: JUAN: Ah, this GYM had returned to its /  usual state of serenity… //  But our young typhoon has returned /  to put us to the test again! //  Well, my friend, most certainly! /  I shall be delighted to dance with you… //  Ah, no, no, no. /  You have with you but one POKéMON. //  I wish that you would return with /  two, perhaps more, POKéMON, please.

SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_GymGuideAdvic.current: Yo! How's it going, CHAMPION- /  bound {PLAYER}? //  SOOTOPOLIS's GYM LEADER JUAN is /  a master of WATER-type POKéMON. //  And, to get to JUAN, an icy floor /  will hamper your progress… //  Listen, I'm sorry, but that's all the /  advice that I have for you. //  The rest of the way, you have to /  go for it yourself!

SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_GymGuidePostV.current: Yow! You've beaten even JUAN, who /  was supposedly the best in all HOENN! //  Okay! Check out your TRAINER CARD. //  If you've gotten all the BADGES, you're /  set for the POKéMON LEAGUE challenge!

SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_GymStatueCert.current: SOOTOPOLIS CITY POKéMON GYM //  JUAN'S CERTIFIED TRAINERS: /  {PLAYER}

SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_AndreaIntro.current: I'll show you the sublime techniques /  I learned from our LEADER JUAN!

SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_AndreaPostBa.current: Watch what happens if you crack all /  the floor tiles.

SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_ConnieIntro.current: I should teach you how harsh battles /  can be.

SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_ConniePostBa.current: I'll tell you something good. //  If you want to reach JUAN, you /  need to walk on each floor tile once.

SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_BriannaIntro.current: Giggle… /  Your grim look is so charming.

SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_BriannaDefea.current: Oh, dear. /  I went much too easy on you.

SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_BriannaPostB.current: You couldn't lay a finger on JUAN, /  I'm sure. Giggle…

SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_BridgetIntro.current: The POKéMON GYM of the highest level /  in the HOENN region… //  That's the SOOTOPOLIS GYM.

SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_BridgetDefea.current: What a high level you are!

SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_BridgetPostB.current: Rather than being satisfied by being /  in a strong GYM, I imagine training in /  other places will make you stronger. /  But above all, it looks more fun.

SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_TiffanyIntro.current: A graceful glide across the ice while /  crossing no lines… //  A TRAINER putting on that performance /  would be elegantly beautiful!

SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_TiffanyPostB.current: This is really obvious, but how strong /  you are as a TRAINER has nothing to do /  with how young or old you are.

SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_BethanyIntro.current: When I'm with my POKéMON, the time /  flies by before you can say, “Oops!”

SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_BethanyPostB.current: I wish I could forget about lost causes /  before I can manage an “Oops!”

SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_CrissyIntro.current: You came all the way here, but you won't /  get to see JUAN. //  Not if you lose to me, you won't!

SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_CrissyDefeat.current: You're strong! /  I was fooled by your cute looks!

SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_CrissyPostBa.current: You might be good enough to avoid /  being wiped out in one hit by JUAN.

SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_OliviaIntro.current: I train my POKéMON together with /  JUAN. //  Don't think I'm a pushover.

SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_OliviaPostBa.current: I think you have potential. /  Why don't you stay and train with us?

SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_DaphneIntro.current: The sight of JUAN conducting /  a battle… //  The very beauty of it compelled me to /  become a TRAINER.

SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_DaphneDefeat.current: You battled with more beauty than /  I could muster…

SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_DaphnePostBa.current: The grace you bring to battle is /  fabulous. //  Oh… I'm so fortunate to have found /  POKéMON.

SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_AnnikaIntro.current: I can battle with really rare POKéMON /  if you'd like.

SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_AnnikaDefeat.current: Oh, there now! Did you have a good look /  at my POKéMON?

SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_AnnikaPostBa.current: I came to this GYM because JUAN /  praised me for my darling POKéMON. //  Oh, if only I'd met JUAN years ago /  when I was younger…

SootopolisCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Wal.current: WALLACE is rumored to be the toughest /  TRAINER in the whole HOENN region. //  This town's GYM is led by the TRAINER /  who taught WALLACE. //  But the ELITE FOUR… They're said to be /  even stronger than WALLACE's mentor. //  How strong could they be?

SootopolisCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Eve.current: Everyone in town has taken refuge /  and won't come out of their homes. //  Even I would rather not venture /  outside.

SootopolisCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Alw.current: Whenever, wherever, and whatever /  happens, I will always be friends with /  POKéMON. //  Because it's fun to be with POKéMON!

SootopolisCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Are.current: Aren't POKéMON our friends? //  Why are they going wild this way?

SootopolisCity_Mart_Text_PPUpIsGreat.current: PP UP is great! //  It raises the POWER POINTS, the PP, /  of a POKéMON move.

SootopolisCity_Mart_Text_TooScaryOutside.current: What… /  What is happening? //  I really want to know, but it's too /  scary to go outside.

SootopolisCity_Mart_Text_FullRestoreItem.current: Do you know FULL RESTORE? //  Full restoration of HP! /  Eradication of all status problems! //  It's truly an item of your dreams!

SootopolisCity_House1_Text_FoundThisRazo.current: For thirty years I've remained in /  SOOTOPOLIS honing my skills. //  This RAZOR CLAW is just as sharp. /  I bequeath it to you!

SootopolisCity_House1_Text_ExplainRazorC.current: A Razor Claw evolves Sneasel. /  Use it at night when ready.

SootopolisCity_House2_Text_DidYouKnowAbo.current: MT. PYRE… //  At its peak are two orbs placed side /  by side. Did you know?

SootopolisCity_House2_Text_YesTwoOrbsSid.current: Yes, two orbs side by side… //  The sight of them together… /  It is somehow soothing…

SootopolisCity_House2_Text_OughtToVisitA.current: Is that so? /  Perhaps you ought to visit and see…

SootopolisCity_House2_Text_MoveSpecialis.current: I once taught DRACO METEOR only to /  DRAGONS that trusted their TRAINER. //  The CENTER specialist now handles /  every legal competitive move.

SootopolisCity_House3_Text_JuanHasManyFa.current: You're a POKéMON TRAINER, aren't you? //  SOOTOPOLIS's JUAN has many fans. /  Even more than his student WALLACE! //  Do you have any?

SootopolisCity_House3_Text_YouMustBePret.current: Oh, then you must be pretty strong.

SootopolisCity_House3_Text_LonesomeTryWo.current: Oh, dear… /  That's a little lonesome. //  Try working a little harder to get /  a fan following.

SootopolisCity_House3_Text_TrainerFanClu.current: Dedicated fans come over from even /  outside of HOENN. //  It was really wild when I went to the /  TRAINER FAN CLUB in LILYCOVE.

SootopolisCity_House4_Text_AncientTreasu.current: Listen up, and I'll tell you something /  good. //  There's supposed to be an ancient /  ruin in the sea around here. //  There could be treasures just waiting /  to be discovered down there.

SootopolisCity_House4_Text_StrollUnderwa.current: Ancient treasures… //  It would be nice if they existed, but /  even if they didn't, it would be so /  beautiful to take an underwater /  stroll with my POKéMON.

SootopolisCity_House5_Text_SootopolisMtP.current: There appears to be some connection /  between SOOTOPOLIS and MT. PYRE. //  My friends and I did some research on /  it at the lab where I used to work.

SootopolisCity_House5_Text_BrotherUsedTo.current: My big brother used to study the sea.

SootopolisCity_House6_Text_FirstGuestInW.current: Hello! You're our first guest in /  a good while. //  You've brightened up my day, so I'll /  give you a big WAILMER DOLL.

SootopolisCity_House6_Text_IllHoldItForY.current: Oh, you want it, but not right now? /  Okay, then I'll hold it for you.

SootopolisCity_House6_Text_DontWantThisD.current: Are you sure? /  You don't want this DOLL?

SootopolisCity_House7_Text_CityFromErupt.current: An underwater volcano erupted and /  forced itself up from the depths. //  Its crater emerged from the sea and /  became filled with rainwater. //  That's how SOOTOPOLIS CITY came into /  being.

SootopolisCity_House7_Text_CaveMadeToKee.current: The cave that links SOOTOPOLIS and /  the outside world… //  It seems as if the cave was made to /  keep something from getting out. //  Or am I just imagining things?

SootopolisCity_LotadAndSeedotHouse_Text_.current: Do you know the POKéMON LOTAD? /  It's rarely seen in SOOTOPOLIS. //  I love, I mean love, big LOTAD! //  My big brother says that SEEDOT is /  bigger. //  But that's wrong! Everyone knows that /  LOTAD is a lot bigger. //  Hunh? Do you have a LOTAD? /  P-p-please show me!
{STR_VAR_2}! /  Wow, that is big! //  It might be even bigger than the huge /  SEEDOT my big brother saw. //  Thanks for showing me! /  This is my thanks!
Hunh? /  Your BAG is crammed full.
{STR_VAR_2}? //  Hmm… I've seen a bigger LOTAD /  than this one here.
Well, isn't this something! /  But it's no LOTAD!
Don't you have a big LOTAD? /  How disappointing… //  If you get a big LOTAD, please /  come show me!

Do you know the POKéMON SEEDOT? /  It's hardly ever seen in SOOTOPOLIS. //  Anyway, I love big SEEDOT. /  The bigger the better. //  But my younger brother, he says that /  LOTAD is bigger. //  That's silly. /  SEEDOT has to be bigger than that! //  Huh? Do you have a SEEDOT with you? /  P-p-please, show me!
{STR_VAR_2}! /  Oh, my gosh, this is a big one! //  It might even beat the big LOTAD /  my younger brother saw! //  Thanks for showing me. /  This is my thanks!
Hunh? /  Your BAG is crammed full.
{STR_VAR_2}, is it? //  Hmm… I've seen a bigger SEEDOT /  than this one.
Oh, now this is quite something… /  But it's not a SEEDOT!
You don't have a big SEEDOT? /  That's too bad… //  If you get a big SEEDOT, please /  come show me.
The biggest SEEDOT in history! /  {STR_VAR_2}'s {STR_VAR_3} giant! //  A SEEDOT bigger than a LOTAD /  always wanted!
The biggest LOTAD in history! /  {STR_VAR_2}'s {STR_VAR_3} colossus! //  A LOTAD bigger than a SEEDOT /  always wanted!

SootopolisCity_MysteryEventsHouse_1F_Tex.current: When I was young, I traveled the world /  as a POKéMON TRAINER. //  Now that I've become an old buzzard, /  my only amusement is watching young /  TRAINERS battle.
A TRAINER named {STR_VAR_1} /  is visiting my home. //  Would you like to challenge /  {STR_VAR_1}?
You won't battle? I'm disappointed /  that I can't see you battle…
Oh, good, good! //  But my house isn't all that sturdy. //  Could I ask you to keep it down to /  a 3-on-3 match?
Before you two battle, you should /  save your progress.
I hope to see a good match!
So, it became a standoff. //  It was a brilliant match in which /  neither side conceded a step!
That was superlative! //  Why, it was like seeing myself in /  my youth again!
Ah, too bad for you! //  But it was a good match. /  I hope you can win next time.

EverGrandeCity_SidneysRoom_Text_IntroSpe.current: Heh. SIDNEY. First door, best door. //  My crew fights dirty. Fake Out, sleep, /  a fast board that goes slow when you /  blink. You'll think you've read it. //  Then ABSOL shows up and the reading /  was wrong. Let's go, kid!

EverGrandeCity_SidneysRoom_Text_Defeat.current: Ha! You saw every trick coming. Fine. /  That was a good time.

EverGrandeCity_SidneysRoom_Text_PostBatt.current: Patch up from your BAG if you want. //  PHOEBE's next. Her idea of “safe” is /  not gonna match yours.

EverGrandeCity_PhoebesRoom_Text_IntroSpe.current: Welcome. I am PHOEBE. //  I trained on MT.
