PYRE, where the ones /  who are gone still take part. //  My friends borrow your boosts, shelter /  from your spread attacks, and one empty /  shell will swallow your best move. //  Keep something for the rider in the /  shadow. It is always closer than it looks.

EverGrandeCity_PhoebesRoom_Text_Defeat.current: You honored what you could not touch. /  My grandmother would like you.

EverGrandeCity_PhoebesRoom_Text_PostBatt.current: Rest a moment if you need to. //  GLACIA covers the whole field before /  she strikes. Do not fight in her snow.

EverGrandeCity_GlaciasRoom_Text_IntroSpe.current: GLACIA. I came far for opponents worth /  the cold. //  Snow is patience. The VEIL buys time, /  the wind rearranges order, and one /  slow horse ends whoever hurries. //  Break the climate. The ice will follow.

EverGrandeCity_GlaciasRoom_Text_Defeat.current: …You thawed the shelter before the /  storm arrived. Acceptable.

EverGrandeCity_GlaciasRoom_Text_PostBatt.current: DRAKE is old, and old Dragons know both /  speeds. Assume nothing about his tempo.

EverGrandeCity_DrakesRoom_Text_IntroSpee.current: DRAKE. Last of the four, and the one /  who's sailed the longest. //  Dragons remember every age of battle. /  DIALGA runs the clock backwards, /  RESHIRAM runs it forward, and two of /  mine set up while you decide which. //  Kill the first clock. Then meet /  SALAMENCE with something left. Come on!

EverGrandeCity_DrakesRoom_Text_Defeat.current: Hah! Both clocks, and you still stood. /  Superb, Trainer. Superb.

EverGrandeCity_DrakesRoom_Text_PostBattl.current: Heal up. Beyond that door WALLACE will /  throw every lesson at you at once. //  Go on. The CHAMPION's waiting.

EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_IntroS.current: WALLACE: Welcome, {PLAYER}. //  You crossed HOENN with every tool made /  available: moves, items, rare partners, /  and the power of Mega Evolution. //  Nothing was hidden behind grinding. Every /  loss asked you to build a better answer. //  You restored SOOTOPOLIS's balance and /  beat the ELITE FOUR without healing /  inside a single battle. //  Now face the region's complete exam. My /  team shifts rhythm until yours breaks. //  Show me the Champion you became!

EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_Defeat.current: Every time I changed the question, you /  found another answer. Magnificent.

EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_PostBa.current: WALLACE: Your final team was not the only /  team that brought you here. //  Every partner you caught, every puzzle /  you lost, and every rebuilt plan became /  part of this victory. //  You stand at HOENN's peak, but the /  FRONTIER waits beyond the summit. //  I proclaim you the new HOENN CHAMPION!

EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_MayAdv.current: MAY: {PLAYER}{KUN}! One thing before /  WALLACE. //  He changes rhythm the moment you settle. /  The turn you just won says nothing /  about the next one.

EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_MayIts.current: MAY: Huh? Wait. Your face… //  {PLAYER}{KUN}… It's already over, /  isn't it?

EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_Brenda.current: BRENDAN: {PLAYER}! Advice before /  WALLACE, if you want it. //  He resets the pace every time you find /  it. Don't trust a winning turn.
BRENDAN: {PLAYER}… //  Don't tell me. You already beat him.

EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_BirchA.current: BIRCH: You did it, {PLAYER}! //  You began with one of nine traditions, /  then made HOENN's whole ecosystem yours. //  Let me see the POKéDEX that recorded all /  those possible teams.

EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_BirchC.current: BIRCH: Congratulations. The final room /  records one team; HOENN remembers all.

EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_Wallac.current: WALLACE: {PLAYER}{KUN}… //  No, let me rephrase that properly. //  The new CHAMPION! //  Come with me.
WALLACE: I'm sorry, but… //  From here on, only those TRAINERS who /  have become CHAMPIONS may enter. //  You'll have to wait outside with /  PROF. BIRCH.

EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_MayCon.current: MAY: Groan… //  … … … … … … … … //  Kidding! That's the rule, and you /  earned every part of it. //  {PLAYER}{KUN}! Honestly, congratulations!

EverGrandeCity_ChampionsRoom_Text_Brenda.current: BRENDAN: Whaaaat?! … … … … … //  Fine. That's the rule, and I watched /  you earn it. //  {PLAYER}, way to go! Congratulations!

EverGrandeCity_PokemonLeague_1F_Text_Mus.current: Beyond this point, only those TRAINERS /  who have collected all the GYM BADGES /  are permitted to enter. //  TRAINER, let us confirm that you have /  all the GYM BADGES.

EverGrandeCity_PokemonLeague_1F_Text_Hav.current: You need all eight GYM BADGES. //  If you're bound for the POKéMON /  LEAGUE, you must return with them.

EverGrandeCity_PokemonLeague_1F_Text_GoF.current: TRAINER! Believe in yourself and your /  POKéMON, and go forth!

EverGrandeCity_HallOfFame_Text_HereWeHon.current: WALLACE: This room… //  This is where we keep records of /  POKéMON that prevailed through /  harsh battles. //  It is here that the LEAGUE CHAMPIONS /  are honored.

EverGrandeCity_HallOfFame_Text_LetsRecor.current: WALLACE: Come on, let's record your /  name as a TRAINER who triumphed over /  the POKéMON LEAGUE, and the names of /  the partners who battled with you.

EverGrandeCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Lea.current: The POKéMON LEAGUE is only a short /  distance after the VICTORY ROAD. //  If you've come this far, what choice /  do you have but to keep going?

EverGrandeCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Bel.current: The long and harrowing VICTORY ROAD… //  It's like reliving the path one has /  traveled in life… //  Believe in your POKéMON and give it /  your very best!

EverGrandeCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Sco.current: SCOTT: {PLAYER}{KUN}, you've clawed your /  way up to face the POKéMON LEAGUE! //  I'm happy for you! /  You made my cheering worthwhile! //  {PLAYER}{KUN}, if you were to become /  the POKéMON LEAGUE CHAMPION… //  I'll get in touch with you then. //  Okay, {PLAYER}{KUN}. /  Go for greatness!

Route104_MrBrineysHouse_Text_WaitUpPeeko.current: MR. BRINEY: Hold on, lass! /  Wait up, PEEKO!

Route104_MrBrineysHouse_Text_ItsYouLetsS.current: Hm? You're {PLAYER}{KUN}! /  You saved my darling PEEKO! /  We owe so much to you! //  What's that? /  You want to sail with me? //  Hmhm… //  You have a LETTER bound for DEWFORD /  and a package for SLATEPORT, then? //  Quite the busy life you must lead! //  But, certainly, what you're asking is /  no problem at all. //  You've come to the right man! /  We'll set sail for DEWFORD.

Route104_MrBrineysHouse_Text_SetSailForD.current: MR. BRINEY: DEWFORD it is, then! //  Anchors aweigh! /  PEEKO, we're setting sail, my darling!

Route104_MrBrineysHouse_Text_DeclineDeli.current: MR. BRINEY: Is that so? /  Your deliveries can wait? //  You just go on and tell me whenever /  you want to set sail!

Route104_MrBrineysHouse_Text_NeedToMakeD.current: MR. BRINEY: Ahoy! /  I know exactly what you want to say! //  You're to deliver a LETTER to DEWFORD /  and a package to SLATEPORT. //  What you need me to do is no problem /  at all--I'm the man for the job! //  First, we'll set sail for DEWFORD.

Route104_MrBrineysHouse_Text_NeedToDeliv.current: MR. BRINEY: Ahoy! /  I know exactly what you want to say! //  You're to deliver a package to /  CAPT. STERN in SLATEPORT. //  What you need me to do is no problem /  at all--I'm the man for the job! //  First, we'll set sail for DEWFORD.

Route104_MrBrineysHouse_Text_WhereAreWeB.current: MR. BRINEY: Ahoy! /  For you, I'll go out to sea anytime! //  Now, my friend, where are we bound?

Route104_MrBrineysHouse_Text_TellMeWhene.current: MR. BRINEY: Is that so? /  Well, PEEKO owes her life to you. //  You just go on and tell me whenever /  you want to set sail!

Route104_PrettyPetalFlowerShop_EventScri.current: I found this while tending flowers. /  It seems to answer a Venusaur. //  Keep gathering berries as you travel. /  The Berry Master trades stones, too.

Route111_WinstrateFamilysHouse_Text_Stro.current: Mommy is stronger than Daddy. //  I'm stronger than Mommy. //  And Grandma's stronger than me! //  But my big brother is even stronger /  than Grandma.

Route111_WinstrateFamilysHouse_Text_MySo.current: You're the first TRAINER I've seen who /  deploys POKéMON so masterfully. //  But, I should tell you--my son is /  stronger than you. //  He even took the POKéMON LEAGUE /  challenge, I'll have you know.

Route111_WinstrateFamilysHouse_Text_Like.current: You defeated all four of us without /  a chance to rest. That's remarkable! //  Take these berries from our garden. /  You have earned a little harvest.

Route111_WinstrateFamilysHouse_Text_Pass.current: Plant those berries or save them for /  the BERRY MASTER on ROUTE 123.

Route111_WinstrateFamilysHouse_Text_Gran.current: There's no question that you're strong. //  But if you were to battle my grandson, /  you'd end up crying in frustration. //  He's much stronger than any TRAINER /  our family knows. //  He must be challenging the POKéMON /  LEAGUE CHAMPION by now. //  Knowing my grandson, he could be the /  CHAMPION already!
My grandson must be challenging the /  POKéMON LEAGUE CHAMPION by now. //  Knowing my grandson, he could be the /  CHAMPION already!

Route111_OldLadysRestStop_Text_RestUpHer.current: Oh, dear, dear. /  Aren't your POKéMON exhausted? //  If you'd like, rest up here. /  That's a fine idea! You should do that.

Route111_OldLadysRestStop_Text_TakeYourT.current: That's right. /  Take your time and rest up!

Route111_OldLadysRestStop_Text_StillTire.current: Oh, dear, dear. /  Are your POKéMON still tired? //  You should take another rest here. /  That's a fine idea. You should do that.

Route111_OldLadysRestStop_Text_DontNeedT.current: Is that so? /  You don't need to be shy about it.

Route112_CableCarStation_Text_CableCarRe.current: The CABLE CAR is ready to go up. /  Would you like to be on it?

Route112_CableCarStation_Text_RideAnothe.current: Please ride with us another time.

MtChimney_CableCarStation_Text_CableCarR.current: The CABLE CAR is ready to go down. /  Would you like to be on it?

MtChimney_CableCarStation_Text_RideAnoth.current: Please ride with us another time.

Route114_FossilManiacsHouse_Text_HaveThi.current: My brother dug up this Metal Coat. //  It evolves Onix or Scyther when used.

Route114_FossilManiacsHouse_Text_DigRetu.current: If you make a POKéMON DIG inside a /  cave, you're returned to the entrance… //  Old peat has another use: use a PEAT /  BLOCK on URSARING at night to evolve /  it into URSALUNA, anywhere in HOENN. //  The free Evolution Items archive /  supplies PEAT BLOCKS once you have /  the MEGA RING.

Route114_FossilManiacsHouse_Text_RocksFi.current: Rocks in peculiar shapes fill /  the display case…

Route114_FossilManiacsHouse_Text_Crammed.current: THE COMPOSITION OF STRATA… /  HOW RAIN SHAPES THE LAND… /  STONES, SOIL, AND ROCK… //  It's crammed with books.

Route114_FossilManiacsTunnel_Text_LookIn.current: I'm the FOSSIL MANIAC… /  I'm a nice guy who loves FOSSILS… //  Do you want a FOSSIL? //  But the FOSSILS around these parts all /  belong to me… None for you… //  If you can't bear to go without /  a FOSSIL, look in a desert where there /  are boulders and sand that may hide /  FOSSILS…

Route114_FossilManiacsTunnel_Text_DevonC.current: You found a FOSSIL, didn't you? /  That's so nice… It's so dreamy… //  DEVON's researcher can revive complete /  fossils from every ancient era. //  The machine handles one at a time, /  but you may return with every kind.

Route114_FossilManiacsTunnel_Text_Fossil.current: You brought an ancient POKéMON back! /  Perhaps fossils are meant to awaken… //  DEVON can revive any others you find.

Route114_FossilManiacsTunnel_Text_NotSaf.current: Oh… /  It's not safe that way… //  I was digging away, you see… /  When the whole wall collapsed… //  I think there's a giant cavern /  underneath now… //  But I've left it alone because I don't /  think there are any FOSSILS there… //  One new wall mark does resemble /  LANDORUS. That is not a fossil.

Route114_LanettesHouse_Text_EverythingCl.current: LANETTE: Oh! {PLAYER}{KUN}! //  I'm sorry everything is so cluttered… /  When I get engrossed in research, /  things end up this way… //  This is embarrassing… Please keep /  this a secret in exchange for this.

Route114_LanettesHouse_Text_OrganizeYour.current: May I offer advice about my POKéMON /  Storage System? //  You should organize your BOXES so you /  can tell which POKéMON are in them.

Route114_LanettesHouse_Text_ResearchNote.current: It's LANETTE's research notes. /  There's information about BOXES. //  Design BOXES to hold 30 POKéMON each. //  Each TRAINER should be able to store /  420 POKéMON on the PC system. //  Keep reading?
A marking system should be added to /  make POKéMON easier to organize. //  The name and wallpaper design of each /  BOX will be made changeable to please /  the stored POKéMON. //  Keep reading?

When storing a POKéMON, it should be /  sent to the BOX inspected last. //  If that BOX is full, the received /  POKéMON is stored in the next BOX. //  In other words, when a BOX is examined, /  it is automatically selected as the BOX /  to which POKéMON are sent.

Route114_LanettesHouse_Text_EmailFromBil.current: There's an e-mail from someone on /  the PC. //  “… … … … … … … //  “Your Storage System offers more /  convenience than mine. //  “It has a lot of user-friendly features /  that make it fun and useful, too. //  “It makes me proud that I played /  a part in its development. //  “Here's hoping that you'll continue /  research in Storage Systems. //  “From BILL /  … … … … … … … …”

Route116_TunnelersRestHouse_Text_WeHadTo.current: That RUSTURF TUNNEL there… //  At first, we had a huge work crew boring /  through rock with the latest machinery. /  But, we had to stop. //  It turns out that we would have had /  a negative effect on wild POKéMON in /  the area. //  So, we've got nothing to do but loll /  around here doing nothing.

Route116_TunnelersRestHouse_Text_GetToVe.current: To get to VERDANTURF without using /  this TUNNEL, you'd have to cross the /  sea to DEWFORD, sail on to SLATEPORT, /  then travel through MAUVILLE.

Route116_TunnelersRestHouse_Text_TunnelH.current: Did you hear? The TUNNEL to VERDANTURF /  has gone through! //  Sometimes, if you hope strongly enough, /  dreams do come true.

Route116_TunnelersRestHouse_Text_ManDigg.current: There's a man digging his way to /  VERDANTURF all by his lonesome. /  He's desperate to get through. //  He says that if he digs little by little /  without using machines, he won't /  disturb POKéMON, and he'll avoid /  harming the natural environment. //  I wonder if he made it through yet.

Route117_PokemonDayCare_Text_TogepiEggOf.current: MEGA KANGASKHAN fights with its child. /  Their Ability is PARENTAL BOND. //  Leave two compatible adult POKéMON /  here, then hatch the EGG they produce. //  I'll give you a KANGASKHANITE! /  DITTO in the grass can help you breed. //  Want this TOGEPI EGG as a gift? /  This gift won't count for the stone.

Route117_PokemonDayCare_Text_TogepiEggRe.current: Take TOGEPI along on your adventure. //  For the stone, hatch an EGG produced /  by two POKéMON you leave here.

Route117_PokemonDayCare_Text_TogepiEggAf.current: Leave two compatible POKéMON here, /  then hatch the EGG they produce. //  One is enough for a KANGASKHANITE! /  Gift EGGS, including TOGEPI, don't count.

Route117_PokemonDayCare_Text_HatchReward.current: You raised an EGG from two parents! /  Now you've helped their family grow. //  KANGASKHAN's child grows brave enough /  to fight beside its mother. //  Their PARENTAL BOND lets the child /  follow up its mother's attacks. //  This KANGASKHANITE is yours. Keep it /  for a KANGASKHAN from the SAFARI ZONE.

Route117_PokemonDayCare_Text_RewardAfter.current: KANGASKHAN and its child battle /  together when it Mega Evolves. //  You'll find KANGASKHAN in the /  SAFARI ZONE. Take good care of them!

Route117_PokemonDayCare_Text_HatchReward.current: Make room in your BAG. I'll keep /  your KANGASKHANITE safe until then.

Route117_PokemonDayCare_Text_TogepiEggDe.current: The EGG will be safe here until you /  change your mind.

Route117_PokemonDayCare_Text_TogepiEggNo.current: Your party is full. Make one open slot, /  then return for the EGG.

Route117_PokemonDayCare_Text_OvalCharmGi.current: If you ever want to breed POKéMON, /  this OVAL CHARM helps EGGS turn up.

Route121_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_Catchin.current: First-time visitors get a CATCHING /  CHARM. Carry it and your throws will /  land critical captures more often.

MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_MeetProfCozmo.current: I'm PROF. COZMO. MAGMA asked me to map /  the METEORITE's resonance here. //  I thought it was geological research. /  They took the sample and my readings. //  The pattern matches MT. CHIMNEY's fault /  line and those strange marks in HOENN. //  If they amplify it at the summit, the /  whole network may answer at once.

MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_WhatsTeamMagmaDoi.current: PROF. COZMO: The METEORITE and the /  fault line share one resonance. //  Please stop MAGMA before they force the /  entire network awake. //  ROUTE 112's cable car will take you /  to MT. CHIMNEY's summit.

MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_RivalAfterBattleR.current: MAGMA took the METEORITE toward /  MT. CHIMNEY. We have to follow. //  Take ROUTE 112's cable car /  up to the summit.

MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_WithThisMeteorite.current: The METEORITE is secured. //  Its resonance will force MT. CHIMNEY's /  ancient network awake.

MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_DontExpectMercyFr.current: COURTNEY: You crossed our operation /  twice. Coincidence is no longer likely. //  This formation will remove you from /  MAXIE's equation.

MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_HoldItRightThereM.current: Hold it, TEAM MAGMA! //  That METEORITE reaches currents below /  HOENN. You will not seal them away!

MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_BeSeeingYouTeamAq.current: COURTNEY: AQUA arrived sooner than /  projected. The result is unchanged. //  We have the METEORITE. MAXIE is already /  preparing MT. CHIMNEY's fault network. //  Pursue us if you want to see certainty /  replace your leader's chaos.

MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_ArchieSeenYouBefo.current: ARCHIE: We met at SLATEPORT's MUSEUM. /  {PLAYER}, wasn't it? //  I mistook you for one of MAGMA's crew. /  You proved you choose your own current. //  MAXIE thinks every living system can be /  measured, fixed, and made obedient. //  Now he means to force that certainty /  through MT. CHIMNEY. //  AQUA will stop him. If you value a world /  that can still change, follow us.

MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_BossWeShouldChase.current: BOSS, we should give chase to /  TEAM MAGMA…

MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_ArchieYesNoTellin.current: ARCHIE: We move now. //  If MAGMA drives that METEORITE into the /  fault line, the mountain answers first.

MeteorFalls_1F_1R_Text_ArchieFarewell.current: ARCHIE: {PLAYER}, come to MT. CHIMNEY. /  Take the cable car on ROUTE 112. //  You have already changed this race.

MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_NicolasIntro.current: This is where we DRAGON users do our /  training. //  The CHAMPION even visits. /  Now do you see how special it is here?

MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_NicolasDefeat.current: Urgh! /  I didn't expect you to be so strong!

MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_NicolasPostBattle.current: The rear wall rings near REGIROCK. /  A deeper mark resembles ALAKAZAM. //  Bring those families through the Falls; /  the cave may answer without DEVON.

MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_NicolasRegister.current: I want to know more about your power. /  Let me register you in my POKéNAV.

MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_NicolasRematchInt.current: Since we met, we have trained hard /  with our sights on number one. //  Help us see how much stronger we've /  become!

MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_NicolasRematchDef.current: Urgh! /  I didn't expect you to be so strong!

MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_NicolasPostRematc.current: You've obviously kept up your /  POKéMON training. //  So long as you remain strong, I, too, /  can become stronger!

MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JohnIntro.current: JOHN: We've always battled POKéMON /  together as a twosome. /  We've confidence in ourselves.

MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JohnDefeat.current: JOHN: Oh, my. /  We've lost, dear wife.

MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JohnPostBattle.current: JOHN: We've been married for /  fifty years. //  Come to think of it, I've yet to beat /  my dear wife in a battle.

MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JohnNotEnoughMons.current: JOHN: Well, well, what a young TRAINER! //  Will you battle with us? If so, you'll /  have to return with more POKéMON.

MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JohnRegister.current: JOHN: Young TRAINER, may we trade /  notes on teamwork through MATCH CALL?

MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JohnRematchIntro.current: JOHN: We've always battled POKéMON /  together as a twosome. /  We've confidence in ourselves.

MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JohnRematchDefeat.current: JOHN: Oh, my. /  We've lost, dear wife.

MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JohnPostRematch.current: JOHN: Married for fifty years… //  On reflection, the dear wife and I, /  we battled day in and day out…

MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JohnRematchNotEno.current: JOHN: Well, well, what a young TRAINER! //  Will you battle with us? If so, you'll /  have to return with more POKéMON.

MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JayIntro.current: JAY: We've been married for /  fifty years. //  The bond we share as a couple could /  never be broken.

MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JayDefeat.current: JAY: Oh, dear. /  We've lost, my dear husband.

MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JayPostBattle.current: JAY: Fifty years of marriage… //  If we ever argued, we always settled /  it with a POKéMON battle…

MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JayNotEnoughMons.current: JAY: Well, well, aren't you a young /  TRAINER? //  If you'd care to battle with us, you'll /  have to come back with more POKéMON.

MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JayRematchIntro.current: JAY: We've been married for /  fifty years. //  We've supported each other all that /  time. We've made ourselves strong.

MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JayRematchDefeat.current: JAY: Oh, dear. /  We've lost, my dear husband.

MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JayPostRematch.current: JAY: Fifty years of marriage… /  Many things have happened. //  I hope that we will continue to make /  happy memories together.

MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_JayRematchNotEnou.current: JAY: Well, well, aren't you a young /  TRAINER? //  If you'd care to battle with us, you'll /  have to come back with more POKéMON.

MeteorFalls_1F_2R_Text_MoveSpecialist.current: I once guarded the secret of /  DRAGON ASCENT here. //  The POKéMON CENTER specialist now /  teaches every legal move.

RusturfTunnel_Text_WhyCantTheyKeepDiggin.current: … … //  Why can't they keep digging? /  Is the bedrock too hard? //  My beloved awaits me in VERDANTURF /  TOWN just beyond here… //  If RUSTBORO and VERDANTURF were /  joined by this tunnel, I could visit /  her every day… //  But this… /  What am I to do?

RusturfTunnel_Text_ToGetToVerdanturf.current: To get from RUSTBORO to VERDANTURF, /  you need to go to DEWFORD, then pass /  through SLATEPORT and MAUVILLE…

RusturfTunnel_Text_GruntIntro.current: Grah, keelhaul it all! //  The hostage POKéMON turned out to be a /  useless little bird, and now I'm stuck /  in a tunnel to nowhere! //  Hey! You! You want the package? Come /  and take it from DONDOZO!

RusturfTunnel_Text_GruntDefeat.current: Urrrggh! My career in crime comes to /  a dead end!

RusturfTunnel_Text_GruntTakePackage.current: This is plain not right… //  The BOSS told me this would be a /  slick-and-easy job to pull. //  All I had to do was steal some package /  from DEVON. //  Tch! /  You want it back that badly, take it!

RusturfTunnel_Text_DevonPartsSentToPC.current: Your KEY ITEMS pocket is full, so the /  DEVON PARTS were sent to your PC.

RusturfTunnel_Text_DevonPartsNoRoom.current: Your KEY ITEMS pocket and PC are full. /  Make room, then take the DEVON PARTS.

RusturfTunnel_Text_PeekoGladToSeeYouSafe.current: PEEKO! /  Am I glad to see you're safe!

RusturfTunnel_Text_ThankYouLetsGoHomePee.current: PEEKO owes her life to you! //  They call me MR. BRINEY. /  And, you are? //  … … … … … … … … /  … … … … … … … … //  Ah, so you are {PLAYER}{KUN}! /  I sincerely thank you! //  Now, if there's anything that troubles /  you, don't hesitate to tell me! //  You can usually find me in my cottage /  by the sea near PETALBURG WOODS. //  Come, PEEKO, we should make our way /  home. //  PEEKO: Pihyoh!

RusturfTunnel_Text_MikeIntro.current: What do you call a wild man up in the /  mountains? A mountain man, right? //  So why don't they call a POKéMON in /  the mountains a mountain POKéMON?

RusturfTunnel_Text_MikeDefeat.current: My POKéMON… /  Ran out of power…

RusturfTunnel_Text_MikePostBattle.current: They halted development here to /  protect POKéMON, right? /  There's a feel-good story!

RusturfTunnel_Text_BoyfriendOnOtherSideO.current: On the other side of this rock… /  My boyfriend is there. //  He… He's not just digging the tunnel /  to come see me. //  He works his hands raw and rough /  for the benefit of everyone.

RusturfTunnel_Text_ComeAndGetSome.current: What, are you coming? /  Come and get some, then!

RusturfTunnel_Text_YouShatteredBoulderTa.current: Wow! You shattered that boulder /  blocking the way. //  To show you how much I appreciate it, /  I'd like you to have this HM.

RusturfTunnel_Text_ExplainStrength.current: That HM contains STRENGTH. //  If a muscular POKéMON were to learn /  that, it would be able to move even /  large boulders.

RusturfTunnel_Text_WandaReunion.current: WANDA! /  Now I can see you anytime! //  WANDA: That's…wonderful. //  Please, take some rest at my home.

GraniteCave_1F_Text_GetsDarkAheadHereYou.current: Hey, you. /  It gets awfully dark ahead. /  It'll be tough trying to explore. //  That guy who came by earlier… /  STEVEN, I think it was. //  He knew how to use FLASH, so he ought /  to be all right, but… //  Well, for us HIKERS, helping out those /  that we meet is our motto. //  Here you go, I'll pass this on to you.

GraniteCave_1F_Text_ExplainFlash.current: That HM registers FLASH as a field /  technique for your team. //  It lights up even the inky darkness /  of caves. //  With DEWFORD's GYM BADGE, caves /  light up as you enter them!

GraniteCave_StevensRoom_Text_StoneStorag.current: Your BAG and PC have no room for the /  remaining stone. I'll keep it here. //  Make some room, then speak to me /  again. Your gift will still be here.

GraniteCave_StevensRoom_Text_ImStevenLet.current: I'm STEVEN. Forgive me, I didn't hear /  you come in. Look at these markings. //  They began to shine when the bedrock /  started resonating. But the marks /  themselves are much older than DEVON. //  No mineral vein forms a pattern like /  this… Oh? A LETTER from my father?

GraniteCave_StevensRoom_Text_ThankYouTak.current: You've earned BRAWLY's trust. And you /  came all this way to find me. Thank you. //  Take this MEGA RING. With a matching /  stone, one partner can Mega Evolve /  during a battle. //  Have your partner hold its stone. /  Choose FIGHT, then press START before /  you choose a move. //  The RING and the CHAMPION'S SIGNS /  respond to that same bond.

GraniteCave_StevensRoom_Text_NoStarterSt.current: Your starter's line has no Mega Stone, /  so let your other partners carry one.

GraniteCave_StevensRoom_Text_ArchiveOpen.current: The RING lets your partners use the /  Mega Stones you find across HOENN. //  Look for their glimmer off the path. /  People may have stones to share, too. //  POKéMON CENTER VENDORS still offer /  evolution items free of charge.

GraniteCave_StevensRoom_Text_ReturnWithK.current: The LETTER confirms what I feared: /  these marks are shining across HOENN. //  Challenge BRAWLY at DEWFORD GYM. /  Come back with the KNUCKLE BADGE.

GraniteCave_StevensRoom_Text_FindBrawlyI.current: BRAWLY is visiting SLATEPORT. Look /  outside the OCEANIC MUSEUM for him. //  You've delivered my LETTER, so ask /  MR. BRINEY at the dock to sail there. //  Find BRAWLY, then return to DEWFORD. /  I'll wait here for your KNUCKLE BADGE.

GraniteCave_StevensRoom_Text_CouldBecome.current: There are things a stone can tell me, /  and things only a journey can teach. //  Let's register each other in the /  POKéNAV. If these signs change, /  I'll let you know.

GraniteCave_StevensRoom_Text_SternHandof.current: Now take DEVON's GOODS to CAPT. STERN /  in SLATEPORT CITY. //  Ask MR. BRINEY at DEWFORD's dock /  to sail you there. //  The SHIPYARD staff in SLATEPORT can /  tell you where to find the captain.

GraniteCave_StevensRoom_Text_IveGotToHur.current: I'm heading east. MAGMA and AQUA are /  disturbing more than land and sea. //  A mark in the lower cave resembles /  LUCARIO. Take a member of that family /  to DEVON's researcher on the 2nd floor. //  Each SIGN needs its own translation /  before you return to seek its Pokémon.

GraniteCave_StevensRoom_Text_OhBagIsFull.current: Your BAG is full. Make room and return; /  I will keep the MEGA RING safe.

PetalburgWoods_Text_StayOutOfTallGrass.current: Yo, there! /  Your POKéMON doing okay? //  If your POKéMON are weak and you want /  to avoid battles, you should stay out /  of tall grass.

PetalburgWoods_Text_GoBugPokemonTeam.current: I caught a whole bunch of POKéMON! //  Go, go, go! /  My BUG POKéMON team!

PetalburgWoods_Text_ICouldntWin.current: I have all these POKéMON, /  but I couldn't win…

PetalburgWoods_Text_ImOutOfPokeBalls.current: I caught a bunch of POKéMON. /  Now I'm out of POKé BALLS.

PetalburgWoods_Text_InstantlyPopularWith.current: If you take BUG POKéMON to school, /  you get to be instantly popular!

PetalburgWoods_Text_CantBePopularIfILose.current: I can't be popular if I lose.

PetalburgWoods_Text_PeopleRespectYou.current: If you have a big BUG POKéMON, /  people respect you for it.

PetalburgWoods_Text_IWantRematch1.current: I want to tell you when my BUG /  POKéMON grow up! //  I'm registering you in my POKéNAV!

PetalburgWoods_Text_IWantRematch2.current: I want to tell you when my BUG /  POKéMON grow up! //  I'm registering you in my POKéNAV!

PetalburgWoods_Text_MyPokemonHaveGrown.current: My BUG POKéMON have grown. /  I'll be popular again.

PetalburgWoods_Text_CantBePopularIfLose.current: I can't be popular if I lose.

PetalburgWoods_Text_IveBeenTrainingHard.current: You get to be popular if you have /  strong POKéMON, right? /  So, I've been training hard.

PetalburgWoods_Text_HiddenItemsExplanati.current: BURMY hide among these leaves. Females /  become WORMADAM at Lv. 20; males /  become MOTHIM at the same level. //  After a battle, BURMY makes a cloak /  from its surroundings: leaves in grass, /  sand in caves, or trash in buildings. //  Raise DARTRIX to Lv. 34 or higher here /  to get Hisuian DECIDUEYE. Elsewhere, /  it grows into the usual form.

PetalburgWoods_Text_TryUsingThisItem.current: Oh, neat! /  That's the BADGE from RUSTBORO GYM! //  You must be a TRAINER. /  You should try using this item.

PetalburgWoods_Text_TartAppleExplanation.current: It's a TART APPLE. /  Use it to evolve the right APPLIN. //  Evolution items reward exploring even /  when battle gear is easy to obtain.

PetalburgWoods_Text_NotAOneToBeFound.current: Hmmm… /  Not a one to be found…

PetalburgWoods_Text_HaveYouSeenShroomish.current: Oh, hello! Have you seen a SHROOMISH /  around here? I've always loved them. //  I'm on my way back to DEVON in RUSTBORO. /  I thought I could spare a little time…

PetalburgWoods_Text_IWasGoingToAmbushYou.current: I was going to ambush you, but you /  had to dawdle in PETALBURG WOODS /  forever, didn't you? //  I got sick of waiting, so here I am!

PetalburgWoods_Text_HandOverThosePapers.current: You! DEVON RESEARCHER! //  Hand over those papers!

PetalburgWoods_Text_YouHaveToHelpMe.current: Please, help me! //  These papers belong to DEVON. I can't /  let him take them!

PetalburgWoods_Text_NoOneCrossesTeamAqua.current: Hunh? What do you think you're doing? /  What, you're going to protect him? //  No one who crosses TEAM AQUA /  gets any mercy, not even a kid! //  Come on and battle me!

PetalburgWoods_Text_YouveGotSomeNerve.current: Grrr… You've got some nerve /  meddling with TEAM AQUA! /  Come on and battle me again! //  I wish I could say that, but I'm out of /  POKéMON… //  And, hey, we of TEAM AQUA are also /  after something in RUSTBORO. //  I'll let you go today!

PetalburgWoods_Text_ThatWasAwfullyClose.current: Whew… I thought he'd caught me. /  Thank you for standing up to him. //  I must get these papers back to DEVON. /  But first, take this GREAT BALL. //  It's the least I can do!

PetalburgWoods_Text_TeamAquaAfterSomethi.current: He said TEAM AQUA was after something /  in RUSTBORO, too, didn't he? //  My colleagues could be in trouble.

PetalburgWoods_Text_ICantBeWastingTime.current: I need to warn everyone at DEVON. /  No more looking for SHROOMISH today!

PetalburgWoods_Text_YoureLoadedWithItems.current: You're loaded with items. /  I can't give you this GREAT BALL.

PetalburgWoods_Text_TrainerTipsExperienc.current: TRAINER TIPS //  Use the LEVELER to bring a new partner /  to your current training limit. //  Then prepare its moves, Ability, Nature, /  and held item before the next battle.

PetalburgWoods_Text_TrainerTipsPP.current: TRAINER TIPS //  CUT reveals the eastern paths into the /  old-growth forest. //  Rangers report two CHAMPION'S SIGNS: /  one seeks BRELOOM, one seeks BLISSEY.

MtChimney_Text_ArchieGoStopTeamMagma.current: ARCHIE: {PLAYER}! MAXIE is forcing the /  METEORITE into the volcano's fault line. //  If it breaks, fire will tear through the /  mountain and every connected cavern.

MtChimney_Text_ArchieIHaveMyHandsFull.current: ARCHIE: Grrr… //  I want to stop that MAXIE, /  but I can't! //  Not when I have my hands full battling /  three opponents at once!

MtChimney_Text_MeteoriteWillActivateVolc.current: The METEORITE will force MT. CHIMNEY's /  energy into a stable, permanent field. //  Every cavern on the fault line will /  open, and every ancient SIGN will wake.

MtChimney_Text_MaxieIntro.current: MAXIE: So you are ARCHIE's unexpected /  variable. I prefer solvable systems. //  The sea changes without permission. /  Land lets people build, plan, and grow. //  This machine will stabilize the fault /  network and expand that certainty. //  The marks you call CHAMPION'S SIGNS are /  nodes of the same ancient system. //  You may test my model. You will not stop /  it.

MtChimney_Text_MaxieDefeat.current: You found the flaw before I could /  stabilize the field...

MtChimney_Text_MaxieYouHaventSeenLastOfM.current: MAXIE: The METEORITE was one input, not /  the plan itself. The BLUE ORB remains. //  You stopped this eruption, but the fault /  line is already moving beneath HOENN.

MtChimney_Text_ArchieThankYou.current: ARCHIE: You stopped him. I owe you that. //  But do not confuse AQUA with MAGMA. We /  would free the old current, not cage it. //  Take JAGGED PASS down to LAVARIDGE. /  Your next GYM is there. //  That METEORITE is still in the machine. /  COZMO in FALLARBOR may want it back. //  If you stand in our way again, I will /  expect an even better battle.

MtChimney_Text_TabithaIntro.current: TABITHA: You followed the METEORITE. /  Good. You understand the real objective. //  MAXIE already has it. My formation only /  needs to keep you from his machine.

MtChimney_Text_TabithaDefeat.current: You broke the guard line too quickly…

MtChimney_Text_TabithaPostBattle.current: MAXIE, begin the fault-line sequence! /  The delay model has failed.

MtChimney_Text_DouseThemInFire.current: Hold the high ground! /  Do not let AQUA reach the machine!

MtChimney_Text_AquasNameSimilar.current: MAGMA builds fixed ground. AQUA trusts /  change without limits. //  Do not confuse opposite answers.

MtChimney_Text_LessHabitatForWaterPokemo.current: If they seal the currents, every WATER /  POKéMON below loses its habitat!

MtChimney_Text_MagmaOutnumbersUs.current: MAGMA fixed every approach at once. /  We cannot break their formation!

MtChimney_Text_MagmasNameSimilar.current: AQUA keeps life moving. MAGMA would /  freeze the world into one answer.

MtChimney_Text_LavaCookiesJust200.current: LAVA COOKIES are MT. CHIMNEY's local /  specialty. //  Try one. It's just ¥200.

MtChimney_Text_YouveNotGotTheMoney.current: Oh, dear. You can't buy a thing if /  you've not got the money.

MtChimney_Text_KeepMakingMoreLand.current: We will make the fault line hold!

MtChimney_Text_MeteoritesPackAmazingPowe.current: The METEORITE resonates with the fault!

MtChimney_Text_YouBetterNotMessWithUs.current: Stand back! We are forcing the mountain /  into a stable state for everyone.

MtChimney_Text_TeamAquaAlwaysMessingWith.current: AQUA keeps changing the field before our /  formation can stabilize it.

MtChimney_Text_Grunt2Intro.current: Stable land means homes, roads, and room /  for people to build a future. //  That is why I chose TEAM MAGMA. /  You will not interrupt the work.

MtChimney_Text_Grunt2PostBattle.current: MAXIE promised a safer world. //  If the method frightens everyone it is /  meant to help, what did we misjudge?

MtChimney_Text_ShelbyIntro.current: I've been to the hot springs and /  refreshed my tired bones. /  Right now I'm feeling strong!

MtChimney_Text_ShelbyDefeat.current: Oh, my goodness. /  Now, aren't you something!

MtChimney_Text_ShelbyPostBattle.current: Well, well, I've lost. I can't call /  myself an EXPERT now, can I?

MtChimney_Text_ShelbyRegister.current: Thank you, child. It was fun, as if /  I were battling my own grandchild. //  Please, keep in touch and tell me /  where your journey takes you.

MtChimney_Text_ShelbyRematchIntro.current: If you can mesh your heart with those /  of your POKéMON, why, you should be /  able to achieve great things.

MtChimney_Text_ShelbyRematchDefeat.current: Oh, my goodness. /  Now, aren't you something!

MtChimney_Text_ShelbyPostRematch.current: Perhaps your heart has become one /  with the hearts of your POKéMON.

MtChimney_Text_MelissaIntro.current: I've got the fire in me, baby. /  I can't stand it! I have to battle!

MtChimney_Text_MelissaDefeat.current: Ooh, that was a scorching-hot match!

MtChimney_Text_MelissaPostBattle.current: The heat of MT. CHIMNEY warms /  me up, baby!

MtChimney_Text_SheilaIntro.current: I've finally made it to MT. CHIMNEY. /  I want to make my POKéMON battle!

MtChimney_Text_SheilaDefeat.current: The way you battle… /  It's like a MT. CHIMNEY eruption!

MtChimney_Text_SheilaPostBattle.current: Like I said, I've finally made it to /  MT. CHIMNEY. It would be a shame if /  I only do a little sightseeing… //  I want to get in some battles and buy /  COOKIES as souvenirs.

MtChimney_Text_ShirleyIntro.current: Since I bathed in the hot springs, /  I've been feeling great! /  I'm sure I'm going to win!

MtChimney_Text_ShirleyDefeat.current: Yowch! /  I'm getting a chill out of the water.

MtChimney_Text_ShirleyPostBattle.current: I'll have to take another dip in the /  hot springs. Want to join me? //  Just joking!

MtChimney_Text_Grunt1Intro.current: This ridge could become solid ground, /  not a threat hanging over LAVARIDGE. //  I believe in that future enough to /  defend it.

MtChimney_Text_Grunt1Defeat.current: Belief was not enough to hold the line…

MtChimney_Text_Grunt1PostBattle.current: You came through fire to challenge us. /  Maybe certainty is not the same as truth.

MtChimney_Text_SawyerIntro.current: This is one fine mountain! Plenty of /  hot people around for company!

MtChimney_Text_SawyerDefeat.current: Oh, you're a real firebrand, too!

MtChimney_Text_SawyerPostBattle.current: I think I need a dip in LAVARIDGE /  HOT SPRING with the locals!

MtChimney_Text_SawyerRegister.current: I like little fireballs like you. /  Let me register you in my POKéNAV.

MtChimney_Text_SawyerRematchIntro.current: I'm happily surrounded by hot people /  around these parts. I won't lose!

MtChimney_Text_SawyerRematchDefeat.current: Gosh, you're still the same /  firebrand as before!

MtChimney_Text_SawyerPostRematch.current: Actually, it really is hot here. /  I'm overdressed for these parts.

MtChimney_Text_MeteoriteFittedOnMachine.current: A METEORITE is fitted on a mysterious /  machine… //  The machine seems to be storing /  energy in the METEORITE.

MtChimney_Text_RemoveTheMeteorite.current: A METEORITE is fitted on a mysterious /  machine… //  Do you want to remove the METEORITE?

MtChimney_Text_PlayerRemovedMeteorite.current: {PLAYER} removed the METEORITE from /  the mysterious machine.

MtChimney_Text_PlayerLeftMeteorite.current: {PLAYER} left the METEORITE where /  it was.

MtChimney_Text_MachineMakesNoResponse.current: This mysterious machine… /  It makes no response whatsoever.

JaggedPass_Text_EricIntro.current: MT. CHIMNEY's JAGGED PASS… //  Now this is what I've always wanted /  in a mountain. //  This jagged bumpiness… /  It rocks my soul!

JaggedPass_Text_EricPostBattle.current: Yes, I did lose at POKéMON… //  But, when it comes to the love of /  the mountains, I have you beat!

JaggedPass_Text_EthanIntro.current: JAGGED PASS is hard to walk on. /  It's a good place for training.

JaggedPass_Text_EthanDefeat.current: It was all over while we were still /  trying to find a good footing…

JaggedPass_Text_EthanPostBattle.current: If I had an ACRO BIKE, I'd be able to /  jump ledges.

JaggedPass_Text_EthanRegister.current: When I get more used to this bumpiness, /  I'll send you my best climbing tips! //  Can you register me in your POKéNAV?

JaggedPass_Text_EthanRematchIntro.current: I got used to this bumpiness. /  I sing while I climb now.

JaggedPass_Text_EthanRematchDefeat.current: It's still not easy to battle on this /  bumpy ground…

JaggedPass_Text_EthanPostRematch.current: I should get an ACRO BIKE from RYDEL /  in MAUVILLE CITY…

JaggedPass_Text_DianaIntro.current: This place isn't your casual hike. /  It's not suited for a picnic.

JaggedPass_Text_DianaDefeat.current: Ohhh, no! /  The ground is too bumpy…

JaggedPass_Text_DianaPostBattle.current: Did you know? //  Some people cleverly ride their /  bicycles up this horribly bumpy pass.

JaggedPass_Text_DianaRegister.current: Will you ever be back in this area? /  If you return, share what you've learned.

JaggedPass_Text_DianaRematchIntro.current: Picnics are fun wherever you go. /  Just like POKéMON!

JaggedPass_Text_DianaRematchDefeat.current: I only lost because the ground is /  too bumpy!

JaggedPass_Text_DianaPostRematch.current: I'll forget about losing and just /  enjoy this bumpy hike.

JaggedPass_Text_GruntIntro.current: Wah! What are you doing up here? //  What am I doing up here? Guarding a /  path. Badly, apparently. Fight me!

JaggedPass_Text_GruntDefeat.current: Urrrgh… Should've ducked into the /  HIDEOUT while I could.

JaggedPass_Text_GoWhereverYouWant.current: Okay, oh-kay! /  I admit it--you're strong! //  Don't worry about me. /  Go wherever you want!

JaggedPass_Text_AutumnIntro.current: I climb this hill every day. /  I have confidence in my strength!

JaggedPass_Text_AutumnPostBattle.current: What is that odd rock protrusion /  a little up the hill from here?

JaggedPass_Text_JulioIntro.current: Aiyeeh! It's awfully scary to shoot /  down the mountain in one go!

JaggedPass_Text_JulioDefeat.current: I feel like I'm falling apart…

JaggedPass_Text_JulioPostBattle.current: My bicycle bounced around so much, /  my rear end's sore…

JaggedPass_Text_VialChanseyAshenWoods.current: Blob vanished into ASHEN WOODS. /  The HEAL BALL is still warm.

JaggedPass_Text_BoulderShakingInResponse.current: Oh! This boulder is shaking in response /  to the MAGMA EMBLEM!

MtPyre_1F_Text_TakeThisForYourOwnGood.current: All sorts of beings wander the slopes /  of MT. PYRE… //  There is no telling what may happen. /  Take this. It's for your own good.

MtPyre_1F_Text_ExplainCleanseTag.current: Have a POKéMON hold that /  CLEANSE TAG. //  It will help ward off wild POKéMON.

MtPyre_1F_Text_ComeToPayRespects.current: Did you come to pay your respect /  to the spirits of departed POKéMON? //  You must care for your POKéMON a lot. //  This mountain changes some evolutions. /  Level QUILAVA here at Lv. 36 or higher /  for Hisuian TYPHLOSION. //  Level RUFFLET here at Lv. 54 or higher /  for Hisuian BRAVIARY. Elsewhere, both /  grow into their usual forms.

MtPyre_1F_Text_RestingPlaceOfZigzagoon.current: This is the final resting place of my /  ZIGZAGOON. I cherished it…

MtPyre_2F_Text_MarkIntro.current: Hey! Are you searching for POKéMON? /  You came along after me! You're rude!

MtPyre_2F_Text_MarkDefeat.current: Ayieeeeh! /  I'm sorry, forgive me, please!

MtPyre_2F_Text_MarkPostBattle.current: People don't come here often, so /  I thought there'd be rare POKéMON.

MtPyre_2F_Text_MemoriesOfSkitty.current: Memories of my darling SKITTY… /  My eyes overflow thinking about it.

MtPyre_2F_Text_TumbledFromFloorAbove.current: Ooch, ouch… There are holes in the /  ground here and there. //  I didn't notice and took a tumble from /  the floor above.

MtPyre_2F_Text_DezIntro.current: DEZ: I came here on a dare with my /  boyfriend. //  It's really scary, but I'm with my /  boyfriend. It's okay. //  I know! I'll get my boyfriend to look /  cool by beating you!

MtPyre_2F_Text_DezPostBattle.current: DEZ: We're lovey-dovey, so we don't /  care if we lose!

MtPyre_2F_Text_DezNotEnoughMons.current: DEZ: If you want to challenge us, you /  should bring at least two POKéMON. //  My boyfriend's strong. /  Just one POKéMON won't do at all.

MtPyre_2F_Text_LukeIntro.current: LUKE: We're here on a dare. //  Heheh, if I show her how cool I am, /  she'll fall for me. I know it! //  I know! I'll cream you and show her /  how cool I am!

MtPyre_2F_Text_LukePostBattle.current: LUKE: Well, we lost but that's okay! /  I'm right here by your side. /  We'll make it through this dare!

MtPyre_2F_Text_LukeNotEnoughMons.current: LUKE: If you want to take me on, /  bring some more POKéMON. //  If you don't, I won't be able to show /  off to my girl how cool I am!

MtPyre_2F_Text_ZanderPostBattle.current: I get freaked out every time I see /  anything move… //  I shouldn't have come here to train…

MtPyre_2F_Text_LeahIntro.current: You are an unfamiliar sight… /  Depart before anything befalls you!

MtPyre_2F_Text_LeahPostBattle.current: Our family has been TRAINERS here /  since my great-grandmother's time… //  It is my duty to protect this /  mountain…

MtPyre_3F_Text_WilliamIntro.current: The rich atmosphere of the mountain /  has elevated my psychic power! //  A mere child like you… /  You dream of winning?

MtPyre_3F_Text_WilliamPostBattle.current: My psychic powers have surely /  grown several times, but…

MtPyre_3F_Text_KaylaIntro.current: Ahahahaha! //  This is no place for children, least /  of all you!

MtPyre_3F_Text_KaylaPostBattle.current: This means my training is still not /  enough… //  I've got to keep working toward the /  summit… //  Go, me!

MtPyre_3F_Text_GabrielleDefeat.current: That was amazing! /  You're a very special TRAINER.

MtPyre_3F_Text_GabriellePostBattle.current: POKéMON no longer of this world. /  POKéMON that are with you now. //  And the POKéMON that you will meet /  in the future… //  They are all to be equally cherished. /  Please remember that.

MtPyre_3F_Text_GabrielleRegister.current: I would like to see your POKéMON /  when they grow up some more… //  Please, I need to see your POKéNAV.

MtPyre_3F_Text_GabrielleRematchIntro.current: Oh, it's you… //  Have you come to show me your grown /  POKéMON?

MtPyre_3F_Text_GabrielleRematchDefeat.current: How amazing! /  You are a special person.

MtPyre_3F_Text_GabriellePostRematch.current: POKéMON no longer of this world. /  POKéMON that are with you now. //  And the POKéMON that you will meet /  in the future… //  They are all to be equally cherished. /  I see that you've remembered that.

MtPyre_6F_Text_ValerieIntro.current: When I'm here… /  A curious power flows into me…

MtPyre_6F_Text_ValeriePostBattle.current: Perhaps the power is from the spirits /  of POKéMON in fitful sleep here…

MtPyre_6F_Text_ValerieRegister.current: Fufufu… I lost the match, but… /  I have this little ability… //  Without ever laying my hands on /  your POKéNAV… Hiyah!

MtPyre_6F_Text_ValeriePostRematch.current: The POKéMON at rest here… /  Sometimes, they play…

MtPyre_6F_Text_CedricIntro.current: Have you lost your bearings? /  Have no fear for I am here!

MtPyre_6F_Text_CedricPostBattle.current: I had this feeling that a lost TRAINER /  would be panicked and easy to beat. //  It's dirty and I won't try it again…

MtPyre_6F_Text_PecharuntDormant.current: A violet SIGN shows three masks: a dog, /  a monkey, and a brilliant bird. //  Catch all three challengers before /  returning to this poisoned shrine.

MtPyre_6F_Text_PecharuntNeedsPartner.current: The three masks belong to OKIDOGI, /  MUNKIDORI and FEZANDIPITI. //  Catch all three, then return here. /  They do not need to travel with you.

MtPyre_6F_Text_PecharuntAwakens.current: The three masks flare! A poisoned mist /  spills from the tombstone--PECHARUNT!

MtPyre_6F_Text_PecharuntQuiet.current: The tombstone is still. Three faded /  masks record the trial you completed.

MtPyre_Summit_Text_WillYouHearOutMyTale.current: MT. PYRE is where we calm the spirits /  of POKéMON that have passed on… //  This is a high place where one can /  see all of HOENN… //  The disembodied spirits of POKéMON /  must find solace here… //  Is it coincidence that you are here… //  Will you hear out my tale? A tale long /  told in the HOENN region?

MtPyre_Summit_Text_GroudonKyogreTale.current: Long ago, GROUDON raised the land and /  KYOGRE carved the sea. Their clash grew /  until neither could stop itself. //  Ancient Trainers formed a network of /  SIGNS with trusted POKéMON as its keys. //  The RED and BLUE ORBS joined that net, /  but RAYQUAZA supplied its balance. //  The ORBS calmed the rivals, the SIGNS /  fell dark, and the sky guardian departed. //  The exterior still bears lesser marks: /  one sketches GARDEVOIR, one ABSOL.

MtPyre_Summit_Text_WellThatTooIsFine.current: I see… /  Well, that, too, is fine…

MtPyre_Summit_Text_HearTheNewLegendOfHoe.current: The old legend named three great powers. /  SOOTOPOLIS added a fourth: the Trainer /  who understood why balance mattered. //  Will you hear HOENN's new legend?

MtPyre_Summit_Text_HoennTrioTale.current: Land and sea became absolute, and HOENN /  began to break between them. //  A green POKéMON descended from the sky, /  but it answered a mortal Trainer's call. //  RAYQUAZA restored the board. The Trainer /  restored the reason to keep playing. //  Each awakened SIGN waits to see what /  kind of Champion that Trainer becomes. //  On the sixth floor, a broken-world mark /  now sketches DUSKNOIR.

MtPyre_Summit_Text_MagmaEmblemSentToPC.current: Your KEY ITEMS pocket is full, so the /  MAGMA EMBLEM was sent to your PC.

MtPyre_Summit_Text_MagmaEmblemWaiting.current: The MAGMA EMBLEM is still waiting for /  you. Make room and take it now.

MtPyre_Summit_Text_MagmaEmblemNoRoom.current: Both your KEY ITEMS pocket and PC are /  full. Make room, then speak to me again.

MtPyre_Summit_Text_OrbsHaveBeenTaken.current: With the ORBS apart, land and sea will /  pull against the same ancient network. //  Only the guardian of the sky ever stood /  outside that struggle. //  Take the MAGMA EMBLEM to JAGGED PASS. /  Use ROUTE 112's cable car to MT. CHIMNEY. /  Then go down to the strange boulder. //  Find MAGMA's hideout before they undo /  the seal.

MtPyre_Summit_Text_GroudonKyogreAwakened.current: Oh, my goodness… //  You say that both GROUDON and KYOGRE /  have been awakened? //  It is said that the BLUE ORB and /  the RED ORB quelled the rage of /  the two POKéMON… //  It is also said that the true owner /  of the ORBS still exists. //  However, no one knows who, or what /  exactly, the ORBS belong to. //  It could be a human, or perhaps /  a POKéMON, but no one knows.

MtPyre_Summit_Text_ThoseTwoMenReturnedOr.current: The two men who took the ORBS came /  back to return them on their own. //  Those men… /  Perhaps they are not so evil after all…

MtPyre_Summit_Text_SuperAncientPokemonTa.current: The embodiments of the land, sea, /  and the sky… //  That is said to be the identities of /  the super-ancient POKéMON… //  In the same way that we humans and /  POKéMON have life, our world, too, /  is alive… //  The super-ancient POKéMON have /  taught us that…

MtPyre_Summit_Text_OrbsApart.current: With the ORBS apart, land and sea will /  pull against the same ancient network. //  Only the guardian of the sky ever stood /  outside that struggle.

MtPyre_Summit_Text_Grunt1Intro.current: MAGMA reached the ORBS first, but their /  fixed formation left a path behind them. //  AQUA will take that path and the ORB.

MtPyre_Summit_Text_Grunt1Defeat.current: You changed course inside my attack…

MtPyre_Summit_Text_Grunt1PostBattle.current: One current broke. Others still run /  between you and ARCHIE.

MtPyre_Summit_Text_Grunt2Intro.current: MAGMA guards one lane and calls it order. /  AQUA attacks from every open current. //  Read this one before it carries you away.

MtPyre_Summit_Text_Grunt2Defeat.current: You found still water inside the rush…

MtPyre_Summit_Text_Grunt2PostBattle.current: You keep interfering, but have you /  decided what the ORBS should protect?

MtPyre_Summit_Text_Grunt3Intro.current: We saw you at MT. CHIMNEY. //  You reject MAGMA and still pursue AQUA. /  Then show me the answer you chose.

MtPyre_Summit_Text_Grunt3PostBattle.current: The battle still bought ARCHIE time. /  The RED ORB is already within reach.

MtPyre_Summit_Text_Grunt4Intro.current: You adapt too freely for MAGMA and /  question too much for AQUA. //  A lone Trainer should not be able to /  break two organizations. Prove me wrong.

MtPyre_Summit_Text_Grunt4PostBattle.current: Our crews make ARCHIE's plans possible. /  Your team did the same for yours.

MtPyre_Summit_Text_MattIntro.current: MATT: Rain does more than boost Water. It /  heals, redirects Fire, and changes tempo. //  Break AQUA's formation before the wind!

MtPyre_Summit_Text_MattDefeat.current: You kept one answer outside the current.

MtPyre_Summit_Text_MattAfter.current: ARCHIE is beyond us with the RED ORB. If /  you follow, expect the sea to fight back.

MtPyre_Summit_Text_ArchieWeGotTheOrbLets.current: ARCHIE: MAXIE took the BLUE ORB, but the /  RED ORB belongs to AQUA now. //  The wardens say the ORBS once quieted /  land, sea, and every shining SIGN. //  Then the sea can use that same network /  to wake. AQUA, move out!

MtPyre_Summit_Text_BothOrbsTakenMagmaLef.current: Both ORBS are gone. They were never /  weapons; together they completed a seal. //  The CHAMPION'S SIGNS are that seal's /  outer pattern, spread across HOENN. //  MAGMA dropped this EMBLEM in its haste. /  Take it to their hideout in JAGGED PASS. //  Use ROUTE 112's cable car to MT. CHIMNEY. /  Then descend the pass. Carry the EMBLEM /  near the odd boulder on its east side. //  It may open the way. Stop MAGMA before /  they break what the ORBS protected.

MtPyre_Summit_Text_DarkraiQuiet.current: The nightmare has lifted. The black /  SIGN records the trial you completed.

AquaHideout_1F_Text_OurBossIsSnatchingSo.current: What? What? What do you want with  /  TEAM AQUA? //  Our BOSS isn't here! He's gone off to /  snatch something important! //  … … /  Where did he go? //  Wahaha! Do you really think I'd tell /  you something that crucial?

AquaHideout_1F_Text_WhereMightMagmaHideo.current: What? What? /  Are you a TEAM MAGMA grunt? //  I hear that TEAM MAGMA is trying to /  awaken an awesome POKéMON at their /  HIDEOUT. //  But where might their HIDEOUT be?

AquaHideout_1F_Text_BossWentToJackASubma.current: What? What? What do you want with  /  TEAM AQUA? //  Our BOSS isn't here! /  He's gone off to jack a submarine! //  … … /  Where did he go? //  Wahaha! Do you really think I'd tell /  you something that crucial?

AquaHideout_1F_Text_BossIsOnRoute122.current: What? What? What do you want with  /  TEAM AQUA? //  Our BOSS isn't here! He's on his way to /  MT. PYRE on ROUTE 122! //  … … /  Why did he go? //  Wahaha! Do you really think I'd tell /  you something that crucial?

AquaHideout_1F_Text_TeamMagmaAtMtChimney.current: What? What? /  Are you a TEAM MAGMA grunt? //  I hear that TEAM MAGMA is after /  an awesome POKéMON at MT. CHIMNEY. //  But what is that POKéMON like?

AquaHideout_1F_Text_BossIsInSlateportCit.current: What? What? What do you want with /  TEAM AQUA? //  Our BOSS isn't here! /  He's on his way to SLATEPORT CITY! //  … … /  Why did he go? //  Wahaha! Do you really think I'd tell /  you something that crucial?

AquaHideout_1F_Text_Grunt1Intro.current: Ayiyiyi! Suspicious character! //  Right, right, procedure. TENTACRUEL, /  DHELMISE, hold the gate!

AquaHideout_1F_Text_Grunt1Defeat.current: Grrrr… I lost it! I lost the gate!

AquaHideout_1F_Text_Grunt1PostBattle.current: I did my part. The rest of the crew is /  deeper in, and they're better than me.

AquaHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt2Intro.current: Want the HIDEOUT's secret? Then you go /  through me and my SHARPEDO first!

AquaHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt2Defeat.current: I can't win at all lately…

AquaHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt2PostBattle.current: The secret? There's a submarine at the /  far end. Or… there was. Kekeke.

AquaHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt3Intro.current: Fuel loaded A-OK! Snacks loaded A-OK! //  Only thing left on my checklist is /  KO one meddler. That's you.

AquaHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt3Defeat.current: That's… not how the checklist went.

AquaHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt3PostBattle.current: Humph! My real job was to slow you /  down, and I did. The sub's gone.

AquaHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt5Intro.current: Yawn… Guard duty in a cave with no sea /  view. I'll take you on just to wake up.

AquaHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt5PostBattle.current: Careful running around in here. The /  others aren't as sleepy as me.

AquaHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt7Intro.current: Hey! Honest question. Whose uniform is /  cooler, ours or MAGMA's? //  …Right answer. Now battle me anyway.

AquaHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt7Defeat.current: I lost in a cool way, at least…

AquaHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt7PostBattle.current: Good uniform, you look fine even when /  you lose. That's my whole philosophy.

AquaHideout_B2F_Text_MattIntro.current: MATT: You crossed the entire hideout /  before the tide changed. Impressive. //  ARCHIE needs one final current of time. /  My job is to make every turn cost you.

AquaHideout_B2F_Text_MattDefeat.current: You refused every delay I offered…

AquaHideout_B2F_Text_OurBossGotThroughHi.current: MATT: You won the battle. ARCHIE still /  finished the dive sequence.

AquaHideout_B2F_Text_MattPostBattle.current: MATT: ARCHIE is headed for a cavern /  beneath ROUTE 128. //  Still chasing him? Surf east from /  LILYCOVE to MOSSDEEP and earn its BADGE. //  Then ask STEVEN at his house in the /  northwest of MOSSDEEP about DIVE. //  By the time you can reach the seafloor, /  ARCHIE will have what he came for!

AquaHideout_B2F_Text_Grunt4Intro.current: Waiting is part of an ambush. You finally /  entered the current I was assigned.

AquaHideout_B2F_Text_Grunt4Defeat.current: You turned my ambush back on me…

AquaHideout_B2F_Text_Grunt4PostBattle.current: The delay still served ARCHIE. Whether it /  was enough is happening below us now.

AquaHideout_B2F_Text_Grunt6Intro.current: Warp panels, the HIDEOUT's pride /  and joy! //  Every panel changes your position and /  every battle changes your resources. //  AQUA wins by making the field move.

AquaHideout_B2F_Text_Grunt6Defeat.current: What's wrong with you? /  You're not tired at all!

AquaHideout_B2F_Text_Grunt6PostBattle.current: That reminds me… I can't remember /  where I put the MASTER BALL. //  If I fail to guard it, our BOSS will /  chew me out…

AquaHideout_B2F_Text_Grunt8Intro.current: First thing they taught me here was how /  the warp panels connect. //  Second thing was doubles. I'm better /  at the panels.

AquaHideout_B2F_Text_Grunt8PostBattle.current: I'll learn to battle properly. Someday. /  The panels are just more fun.

Underwater_SeafloorCavern_Text_SubExplor.current: “SUBMARINE EXPLORER 1” is painted /  on the hull. //  This is the submarine TEAM AQUA /  stole in SLATEPORT! //  TEAM AQUA must have gone /  ashore here.

SeafloorCavern_Entrance_Text_HearMagmaNe.current: Hey! /  I remember your face! //  If you're here, it must mean that /  you're about to mess with us again! //  A punk like you, do you really think /  you can take on TEAM AQUA? //  I'd say you're too early by about /  a trillion years! //  You're a perfect fit for the likes of /  TEAM MAGMA! //  Speaking of TEAM MAGMA, I hear they /  were spotted near MOSSDEEP. //  That bunch of goons, they sure don't /  look good near the sea!

A punk like you, do you really think /  you can take on TEAM AQUA? //  I'd say you're too early by about /  a trillion years! //  You're a perfect fit for the likes of /  TEAM MAGMA! //  Speaking of TEAM MAGMA, I hear they /  were spotted near MOSSDEEP. //  That bunch of goons, they sure don't /  look good near the sea!

SeafloorCavern_Room1_Text_Grunt1Intro.current: This cavern changes direction with every /  current. Turn back while you still can.

SeafloorCavern_Room1_Text_Grunt1Defeat.current: You made the shifting floor look fixed…

SeafloorCavern_Room1_Text_Grunt1PostBatt.current: ARCHIE is farther below. Every room from /  here is meant to misdirect pursuit.

SeafloorCavern_Room1_Text_Grunt2Intro.current: The submarine found one narrow route in. /  My formation seals it behind us.

SeafloorCavern_Room1_Text_Grunt2PostBatt.current: The stolen submarine is already deeper. /  You are following its pressure trail.

SeafloorCavern_Room3_Text_ShellyIntro.current: SHELLY: You reached the seafloor without /  our submarine. I expected no less. //  At the INSTITUTE you read the weather. /  Here the cavern itself changes the field. //  Read the current before it closes.

SeafloorCavern_Room3_Text_ShellyDefeat.current: You mapped the current while inside it…

SeafloorCavern_Room3_Text_ShellyPostBatt.current: You would have been formidable in AQUA. //  But you keep choosing balance over our /  freedom. ARCHIE waits beyond this room.

SeafloorCavern_Room3_Text_Grunt5Intro.current: AQUA needs POKéMON to reach a current /  human tools cannot follow. //  Your team carried you just as far. /  Only one formation advances.

SeafloorCavern_Room3_Text_Grunt5PostBatt.current: We followed ARCHIE because his dream /  made motion sound like freedom. //  You came this deep to ask whether a /  world without limits can survive.

SeafloorCavern_Room4_Text_Grunt3Intro.current: Who are you? How did you even get /  down here without the sub?

SeafloorCavern_Room4_Text_Grunt3PostBatt.current: I can't find the way out. I'm not /  scared. Don't get me wrong!

SeafloorCavern_Room4_Text_Grunt4Intro.current: Who are you? Where do you think /  you're going? Not past TOXAPEX.

SeafloorCavern_Room4_Text_Grunt4Defeat.current: I failed to win. Twice today.

SeafloorCavern_Room4_Text_Grunt4PostBatt.current: My partner left the map in the sub. /  How's that for useless?

SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieSoItWasY.current: ARCHIE: Fufufu… /  So it was you, after all.

SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieBeholdKy.current: ARCHIE: KYOGRE, the current before /  maps, borders, or human permission. //  Every awakened SIGN bends toward it. /  Today the sea becomes free again.

SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieYouMustD.current: You chased us through every changing /  route and answered every formation. //  One final current stands between you and /  my dream. Survive it if you can.

SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieDefeat.current: You kept your shape while breaking mine.

SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieWithThis.current: ARCHIE: You won the battle. The RED ORB /  still decides the world. //  KYOGRE, answer the sea!

SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_RedOrbShinesBy.current: The RED ORB suddenly began shining /  by itself!

SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieWhereDid.current: ARCHIE: What?! //  I didn't do anything. /  Why did the RED ORB… //  Where did KYOGRE go?

SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieAMessage.current: ARCHIE: Hm? It's a message from our /  members outside…

SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieWhatRain.current: ARCHIE: Heavy rain? Good. The current is /  moving exactly as planned. //  What? Routes flooded, crews trapped, and /  the pressure still rising? //  No. Freedom was not supposed to erase /  everything it connected.

SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieWhyDidKy.current: ARCHIE: The RED ORB woke KYOGRE, but it /  never promised me control. //  I mistook motion for obedience.

SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_MaxieWhatHaveY.current: MAXIE: ARCHIE, the network is amplifying /  KYOGRE exactly as it amplified GROUDON. //  If this continues, neither land nor the /  people you meant to free will remain.

SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_ArchieDontGetA.current: ARCHIE: Your certainty woke GROUDON! My /  mistake only mirrors yours. //  And the RED ORB should still let me... /  No. We never understood the ORBS.

SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_MaxieWeDontHav.current: MAXIE: Blame is another wasted turn. /  Outside, HOENN is breaking now. //  Look at the world our perfect answers /  created.

SeafloorCavern_Room9_Text_MaxieComeOnPla.current: MAXIE: {PLAYER}, come on, you have /  to get out of here, too!

CaveOfOrigin_1F_Text_CarbinkStuck.current: This CARBINK is guarding an old ladder. //  Its crystals echo with the energy of /  eight BADGES. Come back when they shine.

CaveOfOrigin_B1F_Text_WallaceStory.current: Ah, so you are {PLAYER}{KUN}. STEVEN /  told me how you read the SIGNS. //  My name is WALLACE. I led SOOTOPOLIS's /  GYM until this, and left it to JUAN. //  … … … … … … /  … … … … … … //  GROUDON and KYOGRE are not enemies. The /  network amplified both until neither /  could hear the other. //  The oldest tale says a third power once /  reminded them of the whole: RAYQUAZA. //  It is the one SIGN no one alive has /  read. I do not know where it sleeps…

CaveOfOrigin_B1F_Text_WhereIsRayquaza.current: WALLACE: {PLAYER}{KUN}, you have walked /  more of HOENN than any of us. //  Do you know where RAYQUAZA is now?

CaveOfOrigin_B1F_Text_ButWereInCaveOfOri.current: WALLACE: The CAVE OF ORIGIN? //  But that's right here! /  I need you to do better than that! //  Please, I need you to think about /  where RAYQUAZA might be right now.

CaveOfOrigin_B1F_Text_OldLadyDidntMentio.current: WALLACE: MT. PYRE? //  But when I met the old lady there /  earlier, she made no mention of it. //  I very much doubt that the old lady /  would try to hide something from me… //  {PLAYER}{KUN}, could you think about this /  more carefully for me?

CaveOfOrigin_B1F_Text_CantYouRememberSom.current: WALLACE: Huh? You don't remember? /  Hmm… That's a problem… //  Can't you remember somehow?

CaveOfOrigin_B1F_Text_WellHeadToSkyPilla.current: WALLACE: The SKY PILLAR? //  Of course. Above the sea and the land /  both. That is where the sky would keep /  its oldest SIGN! //  From ROUTE 128, SURF south, then west /  through ROUTES 129 and 130 to ROUTE 131. //  SKY PILLAR is on its north side, east /  of PACIFIDLOG. I will open the way!

VictoryRoad_1F_Text_EdgarIntro.current: I've made it this far a couple times, /  but the last stretch is so long…

VictoryRoad_1F_Text_EdgarPostBattle.current: You've made it this far. Keep the /  momentum going and become the /  CHAMPION! If anyone can, it's you! //  A victory-shaped mark nearby sketches /  LUCARIO. Keep that family close.

VictoryRoad_1F_Text_HopeIntro.current: This seemingly infinite and harsh road /  lives up to its name of VICTORY.

VictoryRoad_1F_Text_HopePostBattle.current: You seem to have the potential for /  becoming the CHAMPION.

VictoryRoad_1F_Text_AlbertIntro.current: I didn't come all this way to lose now. /  That possibility doesn't exist!

VictoryRoad_1F_Text_AlbertPostBattle.current: I lost here… //  That means I lack the qualifications /  to become the CHAMPION…

VictoryRoad_1F_Text_WallyPostEntranceBat.current: WALLY: I couldn't beat you today, but I /  saw the seam in my team. //  Next time it's closed.

VictoryRoad_1F_Text_WallyIntro.current: WALLY: Hi! {PLAYER}! //  I rebuilt again since last time. I /  wanted you to see it first! //  Okay… Here I come!

VictoryRoad_1F_Text_WallyDefeat.current: You still had an answer for my answer…

VictoryRoad_1F_Text_WallyPostBattle.current: WALLY: Not this time either… But the gap /  is closing, {PLAYER}. //  When it closes, I'm taking the LEAGUE.

VictoryRoad_1F_Text_KatelynnIntro.current: I have nothing to say to anyone /  that's come this far. Come on!

VictoryRoad_1F_Text_KatelynnPostBattle.current: Humph, go right on ahead. /  See if I care.

VictoryRoad_1F_Text_QuincyIntro.current: What is the VICTORY ROAD? /  I'll tell you if you win!

VictoryRoad_1F_Text_QuincyPostBattle.current: Getting through here safely--that's /  the final test for any TRAINER aiming /  to become the POKéMON CHAMPION. //  That's why it's called the VICTORY /  ROAD.

VictoryRoad_1F_Text_WallyNotGoingToLoseA.current: WALLY: Hi! {PLAYER}! //  Surprised? I made it here, and it's /  because of you. //  Losing in MAUVILLE showed me my team had /  no answer for speed. Now TOGEKISS pulls /  every attack while the rest set up. //  I'm not losing anymore. Here I come!

VictoryRoad_1F_Text_WallyEntranceDefeat.current: You still had an answer for my answer…

VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_SamuelIntro.current: The thought that I'm getting closer to /  the POKéMON LEAGUE… //  I'm getting stage fright…

VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_SamuelPostBattle.current: The POKéMON LEAGUE became distant /  again… What a letdown…

VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_ShannonIntro.current: To win your way through the POKéMON /  LEAGUE, you need the trust of your /  POKéMON.

VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_ShannonDefeat.current: Your relationship is based on /  solid trust.

VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_ShannonPostBattle.current: By being together all the time, trust /  grows between POKéMON and TRAINERS.

VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_MichelleIntro.current: This isn't the goal. It's only a place /  on the way to the POKéMON LEAGUE.

VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_MichellePostBattle.current: You'll do fine, for sure! /  Your POKéMON are all eager to go!

VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_MitchellIntro.current: My POKéMON are cosmically /  awe inspiring!

VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_MitchellDefeat.current: I've never met anyone like you before.

VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_MitchellPostBattle.current: Even outside of battle, I sense /  incredible power emanating from you /  and your POKéMON.

VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_HalleIntro.current: Okay, no need to get your back up! /  Relax, let's take it easy!

VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_HallePostBattle.current: Sure, this is VICTORY ROAD. //  But it's not all that different from /  the path you've taken so far. //  Try to enjoy things the rest of /  the way!

VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_VitoIntro.current: I trained together with my whole family, /  every one of us! /  I'm not losing to anyone!

VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_VitoDefeat.current: Better than my family?! /  Is that possible?!

VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_VitoPostBattle.current: I was better than everyone in my /  family. I've never lost before… //  I've lost my confidence… /  Maybe I'll go home…

VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_OwenIntro.current: I'd heard that there was a tough /  little kid around. Do they mean you?

VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_OwenPostBattle.current: The rumors I heard, that tough little /  kid is from PETALBURG CITY.

VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_CarolineIntro.current: You must be getting a little tired.

VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_CarolineDefeat.current: No signs of tiring at all!

VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_CarolinePostBattle.current: VICTORY ROAD and the POKéMON LEAGUE /  are long and grueling challenges. /  Beware of fatigue!

VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_JulieIntro.current: You shouldn't get complacent just /  because you have a lot of GYM BADGES. //  There's always going to be someone /  who's better than you!

VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_JuliePostBattle.current: Gaze on your collected BADGES and /  remember the TRAINERS you've faced.

VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_DianneIntro.current: The elite among the elite gather in /  this cave. //  How are you finding it?

VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_DianneDefeat.current: Not rattled in the least bit!

VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_DiannePostBattle.current: You do have guts! I like that! /  Keep it going!

VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_FelixIntro.current: I've come this far, but the tension's /  giving me awful stomach pain…

VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_FelixPostBattle.current: I can't help getting all tense knowing /  that I'm nearing the POKéMON LEAGUE. //  It's all I can do to feign calm.

ShoalCave_Text_RegionalEvolutions.current: Level DEWOTT anywhere in SHOAL CAVE at /  Lv. 36 or higher for Hisuian SAMUROTT. //  Level BERGMITE in the low-tide ice room /  at Lv. 37 or higher for Hisuian AVALUGG. //  Elsewhere they take their usual forms. /  Galarian MR. MIME also lives in that /  ice room. It becomes MR. RIME at Lv. 42.

ShoalCave_LowTideLowerRoom_Text_CanOverc.current: Your focus overcame the cold! //  Take this Deep Sea Scale.

NewMauville_Entrance_Text_UsedBasementKe.current: {PLAYER} used the BASEMENT KEY. //  The door opened!

NewMauville_Inside_Text_ZapdosDormant.current: A CHAMPION'S SIGN marks the generator. //  Its light is dormant. HOENN's story /  has not yet reached this place.

NewMauville_Inside_Text_ZapdosAwakens.current: The CHAMPION'S SIGN erupts with light! /  ZAPDOS answers the challenge!

NewMauville_Inside_Text_SteppedOnSwitchG.current: {PLAYER} stepped on the switch. //  Click… //  … … … … … … … … /  … … … … … … … … //  The generator appears to have /  stopped…

NewMauville_Inside_Text_GeneratorRestart.current: Bzzzt! Something laughed inside the /  generator, and it restarted itself!
The same cry rings through the plant. //  Whatever is inside wants a battle.

NewMauville_Inside_Text_RotomAppears.current: The generator bursts open! /  ROTOM challenges your team!

NewMauville_Inside_Text_RotomRemains.current: ROTOM slips back into the generator. /  It is still waiting for your answer.

NewMauville_Inside_Text_RotomCaught.current: The generator finally falls silent. //  The ROTOM CATALOG nearby can change /  ROTOM between all five appliances. //  Faint conduits sketch REGISTEEL, /  MANECTRIC, and DIALGA. //  Bring them to the dream researcher /  at DEVON CORP. 2F in RUSTBORO. //  Research each Sign before returning /  to find its challenger here.

NewMauville_Inside_Text_GeneratorRadiati.current: The generator is radiating heat that /  can be felt even at a distance. //  It looks like it should be turned off /  as soon as possible.

AbandonedShip_Corridors_1F_Text_IsntItFu.current: Isn't it fun here? /  I get excited just being here!

AbandonedShip_Corridors_1F_Text_CharlieI.current: What's so funny about having my inner /  tube aboard the ship?

AbandonedShip_Corridors_1F_Text_CharlieP.current: It's not easy throwing POKé BALLS /  while hanging on to an inner tube!

AbandonedShip_Rooms_1F_Text_TakingALookA.current: Ships of this sort are rare, so I'm /  taking a look around. //  Hmhm… /  There appear to be other cabins…

AbandonedShip_Rooms_1F_Text_ThaliaIntro.current: What on earth would compel you to /  come here? You must be curious!

AbandonedShip_Rooms_1F_Text_ThaliaDefeat.current: Not just curious, but also strong…

AbandonedShip_Rooms_1F_Text_ThaliaPostBa.current: The man next door… //  He says he's just sightseeing, /  but I don't know about that.

AbandonedShip_Rooms_1F_Text_ThaliaRegist.current: You're such a tough TRAINER! /  Let me register you as a memento!

AbandonedShip_Rooms_1F_Text_ThaliaRematc.current: What on earth would compel you to /  come back? You must really be curious!

AbandonedShip_Rooms_1F_Text_ThaliaPostRe.current: I'm sure that man's up to something! /  He just acts so suspiciously!

AbandonedShip_Rooms_1F_Text_DemetriusPos.current: I'm in trouble with my mom, so I ran. /  Keep it a secret where I am!

AbandonedShip_Corridors_B1F_Text_DuncanI.current: When we go out to sea, we SAILORS /  always bring our POKéMON. /  How about a quick battle?

AbandonedShip_Corridors_B1F_Text_DuncanP.current: The ship's bottom has sunk into the /  depths. //  If a POKéMON knew how to go underwater, /  we might make some progress…

AbandonedShip_Corridors_B1F_Text_DoorIsL.current: The door is locked. //  “STORAGE” is painted on the door.

AbandonedShip_Corridors_B1F_Text_Inserte.current: {PLAYER} inserted and turned the /  STORAGE KEY. //  The inserted KEY stuck fast, /  but the door opened.

AbandonedShip_Rooms_B1F_Text_GettingQuea.current: Urrrrppp… //  I'm getting queasy just being aboard /  this ship… //  It's not even moving, but…

AbandonedShip_Rooms2_B1F_Text_PerfectPla.current: This is a perfect place to go exploring! /  It's exciting here! //  I bet there're amazing treasures on /  board.

AbandonedShip_Room_B1F_Text_PutKeystoneI.current: Something compels you to place the /  ODD KEYSTONE in this trash can. //  Place the ODD KEYSTONE?

AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_DanIntro.current: DAN: While searching for treasures, /  we discovered a TRAINER!

AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_DanDefeat.current: DAN: We couldn't win even though /  we worked together…

AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_DanPostBatt.current: DAN: We can't find any treasures… /  I wonder if someone got them already?

AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_DanNotEnoug.current: DAN: You don't even have two POKéMON. /  You can't expect to beat us like that.

AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_KiraRegiste.current: KIRA: Oh, you make me so angry! /  I'm going to register you for that!

AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_DanRematchI.current: DAN: We've been searching for /  treasures all this time. //  Our POKéMON have grown stronger, too. /  Let us show you, okay?

AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_DanPostRema.current: DAN: We can't find any treasures, /  we lose at POKéMON… //  I want to go home… But if I say that, /  she gets all angry with me…

AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_DanRematchN.current: DAN: You don't even have two POKéMON. /  You can't expect to beat us like that.

AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_KiraIntro.current: KIRA: Oh? /  We were searching for treasures. /  But we discovered a TRAINER instead!

AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_KiraPostBat.current: KIRA: Where could the treasures be? //  I've already decided what I'm buying /  when we find the treasures!

AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_KiraNotEnou.current: KIRA: Oh, you don't have two POKéMON? /  We'll have to battle some other time!

AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_KiraRematch.current: KIRA: Oh? We meet again! //  Just like us, you still haven't given up /  searching for treasures, have you? //  Want to make it so the loser has /  to give up searching?

AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_KiraPostRem.current: KIRA: We're not leaving until we raise /  our POKéMON some more and we find /  the treasures here!

AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_KiraRematch.current: KIRA: Oh, you don't have two POKéMON? /  We'll have to battle some other time!

AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_GarrisonInt.current: Strength and compassion… /  Those are a TRAINER's treasures!

AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_GarrisonDef.current: Ah, there is something about you /  that sparkles.

AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_GarrisonPos.current: In a cabin somewhere on board, /  I saw something sparkle.

AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_JaniIntro.current: I'm not good at swimming, /  but I am good at battles!

AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_JaniDefeat.current: Oops. /  That didn't go very well.
