AbandonedShip_Rooms2_1F_Text_JaniPostBat.current: Walking around barefoot in this ship /  is kind of gross.

AbandonedShip_CaptainsOffice_Text_NoSucc.current: I'm investigating this ship on behalf /  of CAPT. STERN. //  He also asked me to find a SCANNER, /  but I haven't had any success…

AbandonedShip_CaptainsOffice_Text_OhCanY.current: Oh! That's a SCANNER! //  Listen, can I get you to deliver that /  to CAPT. STERN? //  I want to investigate this ship a /  little more.

AbandonedShip_CaptainsOffice_Text_ThisIs.current: This ship is called S.S. CACTUS. /  It seems to be from an earlier era.

AbandonedShip_HiddenFloorCorridors_Text_.current: The door is locked. //  “RM. 1” is painted on the door.
{PLAYER} inserted and turned the /  KEY. //  The inserted KEY stuck fast, /  but the door opened.
The door is locked. //  “RM. 2” is painted on the door.
The door is locked. //  “RM. 4” is painted on the door.
The door is locked. //  “RM. 6” is painted on the door.

AbandonedShip_HiddenFloorRooms_Text_Brig.current: It's bright and shiny! /  But it's just trash…

SealedChamber_InnerRoom_Text_RegigigasSt.current: It's a statue of a Pokémon. /  It exudes tremendous power… //  There's something engraved on it…

SealedChamber_InnerRoom_Text_RegigigasEC.current: The three REGIS answer together! /  The colossal statue begins to move!

SkyPillar_Outside_Text_OpenedDoorToSkyPi.current: WALLACE: Oh, my, I'm terribly sorry! //  In my haste, I didn't notice that /  I'd left you behind! //  I've opened the locked door of /  the SKY PILLAR. //  {PLAYER}{KUN}, let's be on our way!

SkyPillar_Outside_Text_EarthquakeNotMome.current: WALLACE: It's an earthquake! //  There's not a moment to waste! /  We've got to hurry!

SkyPillar_Outside_Text_SituationGettingW.current: WALLACE: Hmm… /  The situation is getting worse…

SkyPillar_Outside_Text_GotToGoBackForSoo.current: WALLACE: This isn't good… //  The distortion reaches even here. The /  network is pulling on the pillar itself. //  {PLAYER}{KUN}. RAYQUAZA should be farther /  up. The SIGN will only answer one /  Trainer, and it will not be me. //  I must go back for SOOTOPOLIS. /  Everything is in your hands now.

ShoalCave_LowTideIceRoom_Text_ArticunoDo.current: A CHAMPION'S SIGN marks the ice altar. //  Its light is dormant. HOENN's story /  has not yet reached this place.

ShoalCave_LowTideIceRoom_Text_ArticunoAw.current: The CHAMPION'S SIGN erupts with light! /  ARTICUNO answers the challenge!

SkyPillar_Top_Text_RayquazaFlewOff.current: The oldest SIGN answered. RAYQUAZA flew /  toward SOOTOPOLIS…

MagmaHideout_1F_Text_Grunt1Intro.current: Every guard has one fixed position. /  Mine is this corner and this approach. //  MAXIE says order fails when one person /  abandons their place. I will hold mine.

MagmaHideout_1F_Text_Grunt1Defeat.current: I held the position, but not the battle…

MagmaHideout_1F_Text_Grunt1PostBattle.current: A fixed post is useless if the opponent /  can change every approach.

MagmaHideout_1F_Text_Grunt2Intro.current: Our leader told us to dig into /  MT. CHIMNEY, so we dug and dug. //  We found a chamber tied to the same /  network as the CHAMPION'S SIGNS. //  Beat my formation and see it yourself.

MagmaHideout_1F_Text_Grunt2PostBattle.current: The chamber is deeper in. What MAXIE /  woke there may already be moving.

MagmaHideout_2F_1R_Text_Grunt4Intro.current: An intruder! SCRAFTY, it's a real fight /  for once, not another drill!

MagmaHideout_2F_1R_Text_Grunt4Defeat.current: Graaah! Even the drills didn't go /  like that!

MagmaHideout_2F_1R_Text_Grunt4PostBattle.current: I've already lost. Do I have to keep /  running laps around this rock?

MagmaHideout_2F_1R_Text_Grunt5Intro.current: Oh, oh! Nobody told me anyone would /  actually get this far!

MagmaHideout_2F_1R_Text_Grunt5PostBattle.current: I'm not much of a battler. I'm in it /  for the volcano. It's really pretty.

MagmaHideout_2F_1R_Text_Grunt14Intro.current: Hey! No hood, no business here. //  I joined MAGMA because my town floods /  every spring. Solid ground, that's all /  I ever asked for. Now beat it!

MagmaHideout_2F_1R_Text_Grunt14Defeat.current: Aiyiyi… My hood and my pride, both.

MagmaHideout_2F_1R_Text_Grunt14PostBattl.current: Go on, then. Just… if you see MAXIE, /  ask him if the ground is worth this.

MagmaHideout_2F_1R_Text_Grunt3Intro.current: Hold it! You think I'll just let you /  stroll past a CLAYDOL and a GARBODOR?

MagmaHideout_2F_1R_Text_Grunt3PostBattle.current: Honestly, I only signed up for the /  dental plan. Don't tell the ADMINS.

MagmaHideout_2F_2R_Text_Grunt8Intro.current: Wait. One of ours dropped his MAGMA /  EMBLEM outside. Was it you who found it? //  Doesn't matter. You're still not /  getting past FLYGON.

MagmaHideout_2F_2R_Text_Grunt8PostBattle.current: Between you and me? I've got a feeling /  this plan ends badly for everyone.

MagmaHideout_2F_2R_Text_Grunt7Intro.current: You feel those tremors? People say it's /  the volcano. Some of us know better. //  Whoops! Never mind. Fight me!

MagmaHideout_2F_2R_Text_Grunt7Defeat.current: You hit like a volcano yourself…

MagmaHideout_2F_2R_Text_Grunt7PostBattle.current: You won this one. Doesn't matter. /  MAGMA's almost there. I hope.

MagmaHideout_2F_2R_Text_Grunt6Intro.current: I used to hate this heat. Then MAGMORTAR /  taught me to wear it like armor.

MagmaHideout_2F_2R_Text_Grunt6PostBattle.current: Maybe TEAM MAGMA suits me after all. /  I just need a stronger furnace.

MagmaHideout_2F_2R_Text_Grunt15Intro.current: Nothing personal. I'm following orders, /  and my orders are: nobody passes.

MagmaHideout_2F_2R_Text_Grunt15PostBattl.current: We dug up something huge down here, and /  MAXIE has the BLUE ORB now. //  I don't know what happens next. I don't /  think he does either.

MagmaHideout_3F_1R_Text_Grunt9Intro.current: Guard posting next to the lava. My left /  ear's been cooking for an hour. //  At least fighting you means I can move.

MagmaHideout_3F_1R_Text_Grunt9PostBattle.current: Do you think it's weird that we wear /  hoods inside a volcano? Be honest.

MagmaHideout_3F_1R_Text_Grunt16Intro.current: MAXIE offers a world people can predict, /  build on, and pass to their children. //  AQUA rejects it. You question it. /  I will defend it.

MagmaHideout_3F_1R_Text_Grunt16PostBattl.current: I still believe MAGMA's question matters. /  I am less certain our answer is complete.

MagmaHideout_3F_2R_Text_Grunt10Intro.current: I understand everything our leader /  says. But you know what? //  Doing stuff like digging up a super- /  ancient POKéMON and ripping off /  someone's METEORITE… //  I think we're going a little too far. /  What do you think?

MagmaHideout_3F_2R_Text_Grunt10Defeat.current: Yeah, I think we are doing something /  wrong somehow.

MagmaHideout_3F_2R_Text_Grunt10PostBattl.current: You know, losing to you cleared my mind. //  The next time I see our leader, /  I'm going to ask him about what we do.

MagmaHideout_4F_Text_Grunt11Intro.current: MAXIE promised solid ground under every /  home in HOENN. I believe him. //  MANDIBUZZ taunts, MAMOSWINE crushes. /  You will not reach the chamber.

MagmaHideout_4F_Text_Grunt11Defeat.current: You moved before my TAUNT mattered…

MagmaHideout_4F_Text_Grunt11PostBattle.current: None of us have seen GROUDON. MAXIE /  keeps it behind the last door. //  I wonder if certainty needs a door.

MagmaHideout_4F_Text_Grunt12Intro.current: Sun, sand, and GARCHOMP's stone. MAXIE /  built this formation for one outcome. //  Soon! Very soon our ground will hold!

MagmaHideout_4F_Text_Grunt12Defeat.current: The formation had one answer, and you /  found the other…

MagmaHideout_4F_Text_Grunt12PostBattle.current: MAXIE, sir! An intruder is headed for /  the chamber!

MagmaHideout_4F_Text_Grunt13Intro.current: AMOONGUSS pulls your attacks. RHYPERIOR /  turns the ones that land into power. //  You're not getting by me easily!

MagmaHideout_4F_Text_Grunt13Defeat.current: You hit the slot I left open…

MagmaHideout_4F_Text_Grunt13PostBattle.current: Go on, then. Tell MAXIE the ground /  moved under us too.

MagmaHideout_4F_Text_TabithaIntro.current: TABITHA: Every chamber behind you was /  built to make one approach predictable. //  MAXIE is already with GROUDON. I only /  need to make your last answer too slow.

MagmaHideout_4F_Text_TabithaDefeat.current: Your last answer was faster than my /  model allowed…

MagmaHideout_4F_Text_TabithaPostBattle.current: Every minute you spent on me was one /  more MAXIE had with GROUDON. //  Go and see what certainty awakened.

MagmaHideout_4F_Text_AdminsStillStanding.current: COURTNEY and TABITHA still hold this /  chamber. Face both before MAXIE.

MagmaHideout_4F_Text_MaxieAwakenGroudon.current: MAXIE: GROUDON, ancient architect of /  continents... accept the BLUE ORB. //  The SIGN network is awake. Bind its /  energy to land that will never yield. //  Show HOENN the certainty of your power!

MagmaHideout_4F_Text_MaxieGroudonWhatsWr.current: MAXIE: GROUDON! The model was exact. /  Why did the ORB make you reject me? //  Where are you going?

MagmaHideout_4F_Text_MaxieOhItWasYou.current: MAXIE: You again. GROUDON fled before /  you touched the machine. //  Then prove the error is mine, not yours.

MagmaHideout_4F_Text_MaxieDefeat.current: What makes you so adept at handling /  POKéMON?

MagmaHideout_4F_Text_MaxieImGoingAfterGr.current: MAXIE: Your team adapted; my plan did /  not. I understand the lesson. //  But GROUDON is loose, and ARCHIE still /  holds the matching disaster. //  He needs STERN's submarine to reach /  the seafloor. STERN is in SLATEPORT. //  Go to the harbor in northeast /  SLATEPORT and warn CAPT. STERN. //  I will follow GROUDON. This is no /  longer an experiment we control.

MagmaHideout_4F_Text_CourtneyIntro.current: COURTNEY: Prediction: you will target the /  sun before noticing the split pressure. //  Let us measure how quickly you correct.

MagmaHideout_4F_Text_CourtneyAfter.current: MAXIE values certainty. You keep proving /  that adaptation is also measurable.

MirageTower_4F_Text_TakeRootFossil.current: You found the ROOT FOSSIL. //  If this FOSSIL is taken, the ground /  around it will likely crumble away… //  Take the ROOT FOSSIL anyway?

MirageTower_4F_Text_TakeClawFossil.current: You found the CLAW FOSSIL. //  If this FOSSIL is taken, the ground /  around it will likely crumble away… //  Take the CLAW FOSSIL anyway?

MeteorFalls_StevensCave_Text_ShouldKnowH.current: STEVEN: Oh, wow, {PLAYER}{KUN}. /  I'm amazed you knew where to find me. //  Do you, uh…maybe think of me as /  just a rock maniac? //  No, that can't be right. //  We battled alongside each other at /  the MOSSDEEP SPACE CENTER. //  You should have a very good idea /  about how good I am. //  Okay, {PLAYER}{KUN}, if you're going to mount /  a serious challenge, expect the worst!

MeteorFalls_StevensCave_Text_StevenDefea.current: You… /  I had no idea you'd become so strong…

MeteorFalls_StevensCave_Text_MyPredictio.current: STEVEN: Come to think of it, ever since /  our paths first crossed in GRANITE /  CAVE in DEWFORD, I had this feeling. //  I thought that you would eventually /  become the CHAMPION. //  My predictions usually come true. //  And where will you go from here? //  … … … … … … /  … … … … … … //  Fufufu, even I couldn't tell you that.

InsideOfTruck_Text_BoxPrintedWithMonLogo.current: The box is printed with a POKéMON logo. //  It's a POKéMON brand moving and /  delivery service.

SSTidalCorridor_Text_CanRestInCabin2.current: It'll be some time before we make land, /  I reckon. //  You can rest up in your cabin if you'd /  like. Your cabin's No. 2. //  The bed in there is soft and plushy. /  I can attest to how comfy it is!

SSTidalCorridor_Text_VisitOtherCabins.current: Go visit other cabins. /  TRAINERS bored of the boat trip will /  be itching to battle.

SSTidalCorridor_Text_BrineyWelcomeAboard.current: MR. BRINEY: Welcome aboard, {PLAYER}{KUN}! //  They made me honorary captain of /  the S.S. TIDAL! //  You can call me CAPTAIN BRINEY now! //  You know, I retired once before, /  but when I saw this majestic ship… //  Let me just say, it stirred my sleeping /  soul as a sailor!

SSTidalCorridor_Text_HorizonSpreadsBeyon.current: The horizon spreads beyond /  the porthole.

SSTidalCorridor_Text_ScottBattleFrontier.current: SCOTT: Well, hi, hi! /  {PLAYER}{KUN}, {PLAYER}{KUN}! //  Something's come up, so I have to /  disembark, but am I glad to see you! //  Congratulations, LEAGUE CHAMPION! //  There's a place I'd like to invite /  someone like you. //  It's the… /  BATTLE FRONTIER! //  What's the place like? /  You'll understand when you see it! //  I've spoken with the ship's CAPTAIN /  about this. //  The next time you take a ferry, /  you should be able to sail to /  the BATTLE FRONTIER. //  Okay, {PLAYER}{KUN}, I'll be waiting for you /  at the BATTLE FRONTIER!

SSTidal_Text_FastCurrentsHopeYouEnjoyVoy.current: This ferry is built to plow through /  fast-running currents. //  We hope you enjoy your voyage with us. /  Feel free to explore the ship.

SSTidal_Text_HopeYouEnjoyVoyage.current: We hope you enjoy your voyage on /  our ferry.

SSTidal_Text_MadeLandInSlateport.current: We have made land in SLATEPORT CITY. /  Thank you for sailing with us.

SSTidalLowerDeck_Text_PhillipIntro.current: Arrrgh! I'm fed up and dog-tired of /  cleaning this huge place! //  Let's have a quick battle!

SSTidalLowerDeck_Text_PhillipPostBattle.current: We're the CLEANUP BROTHERS! //  The old one dumps the detergent, /  and the young one does the scrubbing!

SSTidalLowerDeck_Text_LeonardIntro.current: This is the bottom of the ship's hull. /  There's plenty of room. /  It'll be alright for a POKéMON battle.

SSTidalLowerDeck_Text_LeonardPostBattle.current: We're the CLEANUP BROTHERS! //  The old one dumps the detergent, /  and the young one does the scrubbing!

SSTidalRooms_Text_ColtonIntro.current: I often sail to LILYCOVE CITY. //  I enjoy attending CONTESTS, /  you see.

SSTidalRooms_Text_ColtonPostBattle.current: I get so excited imagining what kinds /  of POKéMON I'll get to see in the next /  CONTEST. The anticipation of it thrills!

SSTidalRooms_Text_MicahPostBattle.current: Friends need not be human. /  For me, POKéMON are treasured friends!

SSTidalRooms_Text_ThomasIntro.current: Child… /  Did you knock on the door?

SSTidalRooms_Text_ThomasDefeat.current: A loss is to be accepted without haste /  or panic.

SSTidalRooms_Text_ThomasPostBattle.current: To be never ruffled in any situation is /  the GENTLEMAN's code of conduct.

SSTidalRooms_Text_JedIntro.current: JED: I feel a little shy about this, but… /  We'll show you our lovey-dovey power!

SSTidalRooms_Text_JedPostBattle.current: JED: It's the first time that our lovey- /  dovey power couldn't prevail! /  You must be an awesome TRAINER!

SSTidalRooms_Text_JedNotEnoughMons.current: JED: You only have one POKéMON? /  Isn't that just too lonesome?

SSTidalRooms_Text_LeaIntro.current: LEA: I feel a little silly, but… /  We'll show you our lovey-dovey power!

SSTidalRooms_Text_LeaPostBattle.current: LEA: I can't believe it! /  Our lovey-dovey power failed… /  You must be an awesome TRAINER!

SSTidalRooms_Text_LeaNotEnoughMons.current: LEA: I wanted to battle… /  But you don't even have two POKéMON…

SSTidalRooms_Text_GarretIntro.current: Ah, you've come just in time. //  I'm bored, you see. /  You may entertain me.

SSTidalRooms_Text_GarretPostBattle.current: Perhaps I shall get Father to acquire /  a yacht for me. /  A yacht for me and POKéMON!

SSTidalRooms_Text_NaomiIntro.current: Oh, you're such an adorable TRAINER. /  Would you like to have tea? /  Or would you rather battle?

SSTidalRooms_Text_NaomiDefeat.current: I see. /  You're the active sort.

SSTidalRooms_Text_NaomiPostBattle.current: A world cruise on a luxury liner has its /  charms, I must say… //  But, I will admit there is an appealing /  side to touring HOENN by ferry.

SSTidalRooms_Text_NotSuspiciousTakeThis.current: Uh… Hi! I'm not acting suspicious! //  I didn't SNATCH this REAPER CLOTH /  from anyone. It's clean! Take it!

SSTidalRooms_Text_ExplainReaperCloth.current: A REAPER CLOTH evolves DUSCLOPS. /  Use it from the Bag when ready.

SSTidalRooms_Text_TakeRestOnBed.current: There's a bed… /  Let's take a rest.

BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_BestOutO.current: I'm the best out of all my friends. /  But here… /  I've been useless!

BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_MayISeeY.current: Hello, are you here for the ferry? /  May I confirm your ferry pass?

BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_MustHave.current: Your ferry pass is not registered. //  I'm terribly sorry. //  You need a registered pass to board /  the ferry.

BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_WhereWou.current: The attendant confirmed your ferry /  pass. //  Perfect! That's all you need! //  And where would you like to go?

BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_SailWith.current: Please sail with us another time!

BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_PleaseBo.current: Please board the ferry and wait for /  departure.

BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_ThenWher.current: Then, where would you like to go?

BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_WontLetG.current: Ah, so this here is the BATTLE DOME? /  I won't let GENTLEMEN beat me! //  But where is the entrance?

BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_OnlyToug.current: It's not as if just anyone can come /  here, you know? //  Only those TRAINERS who've been /  recognized as tough are brought here. //  That's why many TRAINERS don't even /  know about the BATTLE FRONTIER.

BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_FinallyA.current: I've finally arrived at the BATTLE /  FRONTIER! //  I'm sure to grab attention with /  my looks and ability!

BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_SquareFi.current: Munch, munch… //  It looks like this square's filled with /  tough people. //  Munch, munch…

BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_YoureOff.current: Oh? You're off to challenge /  the BATTLE DOME? //  I'll wish you the best of luck. /  Let us both win our way up and meet /  in challenges.

BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_SureWeCa.current: Hey, bro… //  Are you sure we can make challenges /  even if we don't have any POKéMON?

BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_BigGuySa.current: Uh… /  I'm sure it'll be okay. //  I think… //  But remember that big scary guy? /  He said, “I'll lend you POKéMON!”

BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_NothingH.current: There used to be nothing here not all /  that long ago. //  But, now look at this place! Amazing! /  I'll bring my mother out to see this.

BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_ScaredOf.current: I'm scared of going into the BATTLE /  PIKE because of SEVIPER… //  B-but I came all the way here, so I will /  try to conquer everything! /  …Shudder…

BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_LetsPlay.current: Let's play rock, paper, scissors! /  One, two, three! //  … … … … … …

BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_WonIllTa.current: Yay! I won! /  I will take the BATTLE PIKE challenge!

BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_LostIllP.current: Oh, no… /  I lost. //  I guess I'm not very lucky today. /  I'll put off my BATTLE PIKE challenge /  until tomorrow.

BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_WhosRais.current: That's the BATTLE FACTORY. /  You can rent strong POKéMON there. //  But it makes me wonder. /  Who's raising those rental POKéMON?

BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_KeepBatt.current: Today, I'm going to keep battling, no /  matter what, until I get a Symbol.

BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_ChooseFi.current: I believe I'm the only person here who, /  for some unknown reason, would choose /  fishing over battling. //  Huh? You can't catch anything here? /  That's disappointing…

BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_GotSeasi.current: I wanted to take a challenge as soon /  as I arrived here. //  But on the way, I got seasick… /  Urrrrp…

BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_MetOlder.current: Crunch, munch… //  A while back, I met this older girl /  at the BATTLE PIKE. //  She had these eyes that were scary /  in a real ornery way. //  Crunch, munch… //  She got all furious: “Will you quit /  eating!” Then she whaled on me. //  It was a hair-raising kind of /  scary experience, sure enough. //  Crunch, munch…

BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_LastTime.current: Huh? Will you listen to yourself? /  That's nothing! //  Why, the last time I cheered for him, /  our eyes met and sparks flew!

BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_DomeAceL.current: Whaaaaaat?! /  Pfft! //  That only happened because /  I happened to be sitting next to you! //  The DOME ACE only looked our way /  because my cheering was so loud!

BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_DomeAceI.current: Oh, shush! /  Keep that racket down! //  You fair-weather fans should stick /  to cheering for some GYM LEADER! //  The DOME ACE is mine! /  The only idol for me!

BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_FansOver.current: Those people squabbling over there… //  It's hard to believe, but they once /  were TRAINERS, and good ones, too. //  They used to be incredibly tough, /  and they were famous, too. //  But they were obliterated by this /  certain TRAINER at a tournament. //  They were so thoroughly whipped, /  they became smitten by the TRAINER. //  Now they're just fans of the TRAINER. /  They go cheer for their idol at the /  BATTLE DOME every day now.

BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_MonWithL.current: I heard a rumor that someone saw /  a POKéMON with an unusually long tail /  somewhere in the BATTLE FRONTIER. //  It must be adorable. I'm sure of it… //  Oh, challenges can wait. I feel driven /  to find the delightful creature!

BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_BattleDo.current: This is the BATTLE DOME! /  Your path to the invincible superstar!

BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_BattlePi.current: This is the BATTLE PIKE! /  Choose one of three paths!

BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_BattleFa.current: This is the BATTLE FACTORY! /  Seek out the toughest POKéMON!

BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_Cir.current: This is the FRONTIER's premier challenge: /  the CHAMPIONS CIRCUIT. //  Every match is a full-team Double Battle /  assembled from competitive roles. //  Your team becomes Lv. 100. Opponents /  gain one total level after each win. //  They can climb as high as Lv. 255. /  Every desk enters this Circuit.
Welcome back to the CHAMPIONS CIRCUIT. /  Are your six Pokémon ready?
Your team battles at Lv. 100. Held items /  and HP return after every match. //  Your difficulty sets the starting /  opponent levels. Begin a new run?
Circuit milestone reached! //  {STR_VAR_1} joined your party.
Circuit milestone reached! //  {STR_VAR_1} was sent to the PC.
A Circuit reward is waiting, but both /  your party and PC are full. //  Make room, then speak to this desk again.
This desk hosts a challenge beyond /  the Pokémon League. //  Return after becoming Champion.
The Circuit requires six healthy /  Pokémon and no Eggs.
Prepare any six you like. The Circuit /  will be waiting.
Your reward remains recorded. //  Review this Pokémon's legendary lead /  for any remaining conditions. //  Your wins will not be lost.

BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_Win.current: The number of matches you win in a row /  is recorded. //  I'd better not get beaten in /  an embarrassing way!

BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_Can.current: Once you've entered the BATTLE TOWER, /  you can't leave until you either lose /  or you beat seven TRAINERS in a row. //  You'd best be certain that you're up /  to the challenge.

BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_Rul.current: The BATTLE TOWER rules are listed.

BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_Rea.current: Which heading do you want to read?

BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_Exp.current: The BATTLE TOWER is a facility where /  four types of battles are waged-- /  SINGLE BATTLE, DOUBLE BATTLE, MULTI /  BATTLE, and LINK MULTI BATTLE. //  For each of these types, there are /  separate BATTLE ROOMS. //  Please speak with a guide offering /  the type of battle you wish to enter.

Depending on the BATTLE ROOM you are /  entering, you will be required to take /  a certain number of POKéMON. //  The SINGLE BATTLE mode requires /  three POKéMON. //  The DOUBLE BATTLE mode requires four, /  and the MULTI modes both require two.

The BATTLE SALON is where you must /  find a partner to form a tag team for /  the MULTI BATTLE ROOM challenge. //  Choose the best partner for you by /  examining other TRAINERS' /  POKéMON and their moves. //  You may choose a new tag partner /  after winning seven straight matches.

The LINK MULTI BATTLE Mode is for two /  friends to mount a challenge together. //  You and your friend must be linked with /  Wireless Adapters or a GBA Game Link /  cable. //  You must choose two POKéMON at /  the registration counter. //  These POKéMON must be different /  from those of your friend. //  You may not interrupt this challenge /  in the middle, unlike other modes.

BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_Did.current: Excuse me! //  You didn't save before you quit your /  challenge last time. //  Because of that, your challenge so far /  has been disqualified. Sorry!

BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_Con.current: Congratulations! /  You've beaten all seven TRAINERS! //

BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_Rec.current: Your record will be saved. /  Please wait.

BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_Pro.current: Before entering a BATTLE ROOM, your /  progress will be saved. Please wait.

BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_Abo.current: You're finally about to face the /  50th TRAINER. //  From here on, every time you beat seven /  TRAINERS in a row, your POKéMON will /  receive a commemorative RIBBON. //  Good luck!

BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_Her.current: Here are some RIBBONS for beating /  seven tough TRAINERS in a row. //  {PLAYER} received some RIBBONS!

BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_Put.current: {PLAYER} put the RIBBONS on /  the challenger POKéMON.

BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_Loo.current: We look forward to seeing you on /  another challenge!

BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_Sho.current: I will now show you to the /  {STR_VAR_1} BATTLE ROOM.

BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_Rec.current: Shall I record your last BATTLE TOWER /  match on your FRONTIER PASS?

BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_Con.current: Congratulations! /  You have defeated the SALON MAIDEN /  and swept seven TRAINERS!

BattleFrontier_BattleTowerLobby_Text_Awa.current: In recognition of your infinite talent, /  we award you these Battle Point(s).

BattleFrontier_BattleTowerBattleRoom_Tex.current: The CHAMPIONS CIRCUIT is ready. /  Each victory brings a new opponent.
We will restore your POKéMON to /  full health.
You will be facing opponent no. 2. /  Are you ready?
You will be facing opponent no. 3. /  Are you ready?
You will be facing opponent no. 4. /  Are you ready?
You will be facing opponent no. 5. /  Are you ready?
You will be facing opponent no. 6. /  Are you ready?
You will be facing opponent no. 7. /  Are you ready?
Record your battle on your /  FRONTIER PASS?
Would you like to save and /  quit the game?
Saving your battle data. /  Please wait.
Would you like to cancel your BATTLE /  ROOM challenge?
Excuse me, but… //  Our leader, the SALON MAIDEN, is on /  her way here in hopes of battling you. //  She should be arriving very shortly.
You will be facing the SALON MAIDEN. /  Are you prepared?

Greetings… /  My name is ANABEL. //  I am the SALON MAIDEN, and I am in /  charge of running the BATTLE TOWER… //  I have heard several rumors /  about you… //  In all honesty, what I have heard does /  not seem attractive in any way… //  The reason I've come to see you… /  Well, there is but one reason…
Let me see your talent in /  its entirety…
ANABEL: Fufufu, nicely done… //  Your FRONTIER PASS, please… /  Your talent shall be recognized.
The Ability Symbol was embossed on /  the FRONTIER PASS!

… … … … … … //  You have confidence in your POKéMON /  battling talent, don't you? //  I urge you to keep battling and /  keep on winning. //  I will be waiting for you. /  Until the next time we meet…

ANABEL: You really did come back to /  see me… //  … … … … … … //  You've won straight matches to see me… /  I won't have to hold back against you… //  It's been too long now… //  Too long since I've been able to battle /  without thinking about anything…
Let's begin, shall we?
ANABEL: Fufu, congratulations… /  Your FRONTIER PASS, please…
The Ability Symbol took on /  a golden shine!
That was fun… //  I have never had a POKéMON battle /  so enjoyable before… //  I wish I could battle with you again…
You earned {STR_VAR_3} Battle Points! //  Spend them at the Exchange Service /  Corner whenever you like.

BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_BattleTo.current: Wow! /  It's huge! //  The BATTLE TOWER feels special. /  It's different from the others.

BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_ConquerL.current: My grand ambition is to conquer both /  the BATTLE FRONTIER and the POKéMON /  LEAGUE. //  And if my dream comes true… //  I… I'm going to ask MIMI next door /  if she will be friends with me!

BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_PyramidT.current: The BATTLE PYRAMID's too harsh! /  I just can't make it to the top! //  Since I'm out of options, maybe I can /  climb the outside…

BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_ThriveIn.current: I thrive in darkness… /  Yes… What is worthy of me? /  None other than the BATTLE PYRAMID… //  What say you to wandering in darkness /  and in utter and total desperation?

BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_PutToget.current: I didn't sleep for a week, but then /  I put together the ultimate team! //  I can't see myself losing, no joke. /  We're storming the BATTLE ARENA!

BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_BelieveI.current: ZIGG! /  I believe in you, little buddy! //  I'll make my little ZIGG any favorite /  tasty treats you like if you win!

BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_OnceBeat.current: I may not look that impressive now, /  but I once beat a GYM LEADER. //  Who knows, maybe I should give it /  another shot at glory.

BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_DidScott.current: Did SCOTT bring you here, too? /  What is it with that guy? //  It sounds like he really does know /  how to spot talented TRAINERS, but… //  I've never seen him battling in person /  ever.

BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_PeopleCa.current: People call me a busybody, /  but I can't help it. //  Your hat's on crooked! /  Oh, no, trash on the ground! /  Oops, it's almost dinnertime! //  I don't know if I can stand to just /  watch at the BATTLE PALACE…

BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_FastOnBi.current: I'm fast on my BIKE, and that goes for /  the way I battle, too. //  I win matches in the blink of /  an eye!

BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_BetterTh.current: I'm better than my daddy /  at POKéMON.

BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_GoRackUp.current: Go on, my baby sweetie! /  Go rack up some wins for Daddy! //  You're just like your mother, /  so you'll be dominating!

BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_HeardPre.current: It wasn't easy getting here, /  but I'd heard about this knockout /  pretty girl at the BATTLE ARENA. //  Instead of her, do you know what /  I found? //  A whole teeming mob of sweaty, /  stinky, and primitive martial artists!

BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_Sometime.current: I sometimes see this really important- /  looking old man going in there. //  He has these really awesome POKéMON. /  He seems really nice, though.

BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_LegendOf.current: Do you know it? /  The legend of the BATTLE PYRAMID? //  When there comes a confident TRAINER /  reaching for the golden pinnacle, /  there shall appear a man among men. //  Don't know that legend? /  Well, of course not! /  I just made it up! //  What's it supposed to mean? /  That, my friend, I can't say!

BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_GotWiped.current: Man! Oh man! /  I've never lost once before! //  But I got wiped out with no saving /  grace at all! //  And then I'm told I don't have any /  talent?! Man!

BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_ToughTra.current: This guy ran into a horribly tough /  TRAINER while he was on the BATTLE /  TOWER challenge. //  Now look at him… //  You need to be cautious if you ever /  decide to go to the BATTLE TOWER.

BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_EnoughBa.current: Yes! /  I've finally got enough Battle Points! //  I guess I'll trade for another giant /  plush DOLL!

BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_LikeToHa.current: Oh, yeah, okay! /  So this is the RANKING HALL! //  I'd like to go down in history as /  a super champ and have my name /  recorded here for posterity.

BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_CanDoAny.current: With you by my side, I can do anything.

BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_PowerOfO.current: Ooh, darling, you are so wonderful! //  Ooh, I just can't wait anymore! //  Let's go to a MULTI BATTLE ROOM /  right this instant! //  If we get together in the BATTLE SALON, /  the power of our love will overcome /  everyone we meet. //  Why, before us, darling, everything /  will topple like dominoes!

BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_OddTreeH.current: Excuse me, young one. /  Have you good eyesight? //  There is an odd tree past here, and to /  my tired eyes it seems to wiggle.

BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_OnceAnOd.current: Excuse me, young one. /  Have you a good memory? //  I have this feeling there once was /  an odd tree past here.

BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_Frontier.current: The BATTLE FRONTIER isn't exclusively /  for tough TRAINERS. //  Many people with special abilities /  have been invited, it seems. //  That man SCOTT… //  He may have built this place to serve /  a bigger objective…

BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_StickyMo.current: I… /  I saw it! //  There was a sticky sort of a POKéMON /  with a long tail up ahead! //  It was hiding under a boulder, and /  it kept staring at me!

BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_BattleTo.current: This is the BATTLE TOWER! /  Keep the win streak as the toughest /  TRAINER!

BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_BattlePa.current: This is the BATTLE PALACE! /  Keep your eyes on POKéMON battles!

BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_BattleAr.current: This is the BATTLE ARENA! /  Let the toughest teams gather!

BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_BattlePy.current: This is the BATTLE PYRAMID! /  Advance through the Battle Quest!

BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_Exchange.current: BATTLE POINT EXCHANGE SERVICE CORNER /  Exchange your Battle Points!

BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_RankingH.current: BATTLE FRONTIER RANKING HALL /  Set your sights on new records!

BattleFrontier_BattleTowerMultiPartnerRo.current: {PLAYER}, you have not found a partner /  for your tag team. //  Would you like to quit looking and /  return to the reception counter?
Then, please find a partner from /  the TRAINERS gathered here.
Please find a partner from out of /  the TRAINERS gathered here.
Thank you for choosing a partner. //  I will now show you to your /  MULTI BATTLE ROOM.

BattleFrontier_BattleTowerMultiBattleRoo.current: The 2nd set of opponents is next. /  Are you ready?
The 3rd set of opponents is next. /  Are you ready?
The 4th set of opponents is next. /  Are you ready?
The 5th set of opponents is next. /  Are you ready?
The 6th set of opponents is next. /  Are you ready?
The 7th set of opponents is next. /  Are you ready?

BattleFrontier_BattleDomeLobby_Text_Need.current: I would've won if I'd kept this POKéMON /  held in reserve. //  You need to check your opponent's /  POKéMON carefully before choosing /  your battling POKéMON.

BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_La.current: For a hardy fellow like me, /  hardy POKéMON are the best. //  Offense is the best defense! /  A relentless attack is the ultimate! //  But that's not what I wanted to chat /  about. //  Every so often a really cute lady /  swings by here. //  She says that she can tell what /  POKéMON are thinking. //  I don't know about that part, /  but she is really cute. //  Huh? /  Why are you looking at me like that?

BattleFrontier_BattlePalaceLobby_Text_Ex.current: Here, POKéMON are required to think /  and battle by themselves. //  Unlike in the wild, POKéMON that live /  with people behave differently /  depending on their nature.

Depending on its nature, a POKéMON /  may prefer to attack no matter what. //  Another POKéMON may prefer to protect /  itself from any harm. //  Yet another may enjoy vexing or /  confounding its foes. //  Due to its nature, a POKéMON /  will have favorite moves that it is good /  at using. //  It may also dislike certain moves that /  it has trouble using.

There are offensive moves that inflict /  direct damage on the foe. //  There are defensive moves that are /  used to prepare for enemy attacks or /  used to heal HP and so on. //  There are also other somewhat-odd /  moves that may enfeeble the foes with /  stat problems including poison and  /  paralysis. //  POKéMON will consider using moves in /  these three categories.

When not under command by its TRAINER, /  a POKéMON may be unable to effectively /  use certain moves. //  A POKéMON is not good at using any /  move that it dislikes. //  If a POKéMON only knows moves that /  do not match its nature, it will often /  be unable to live up to its potential.
Depending on its nature, a POKéMON may /  start using moves that don't match its /  nature when it is in trouble. //  If a POKéMON begins behaving oddly /  in a pinch, watch it carefully.
