BattleFrontier_Lounge3_Text_YouDontHaveE.current: Oh, no, no, no! /  You don't have enough Battle Points! //  I wish you wouldn't monkey around and /  waste everyone's time!

BattleFrontier_Lounge3_Text_ThanksOffYou.current: Heheh! Thanks much! /  So, off you go!

BattleFrontier_Lounge3_Text_NiceTryCantR.current: Oh, it's you… /  Nice try… //  I hate to break it to you, but I can't /  return your Battle Points… //  I guess we'll have to let it motivate /  us to try harder next time!

BattleFrontier_Lounge3_Text_HelloChampHe.current: Oh, yes! /  Hello there, champ! //  I knew you could! /  I knew you would! /  We're both big winners! //  I'll return your Battle Points and, /  of course, a little extra from me!

BattleFrontier_Lounge3_Text_ThinkOfMeFor.current: If you're up for another challenge, /  please do think of me!

BattleFrontier_Lounge3_Text_NotIntereste.current: Not interested?! You shouldn't be /  so afraid to take a chance!

BattleFrontier_Lounge3_Text_TrainerGoodB.current: That TRAINER… //  He's good, but he gets rattled too /  easily to survive the BATTLE DOME…

BattleFrontier_Lounge3_Text_BackedWrongT.current: I backed the wrong TRAINER again! //  Maybe I should be battling normally /  like everyone else…

BattleFrontier_Lounge3_Text_KnowWinnerWh.current: Giggle! /  I know a winner when I see one!

BattleFrontier_Lounge3_Text_ShouldBeTaki.current: Those TRAINERS… /  What are they doing? /  They should be taking challenges.

BattleFrontier_Lounge4_Text_WonderIfInte.current: I wonder if they'll be airing interviews /  with tough TRAINERS today?

BattleFrontier_Lounge4_Text_IfIOpenedRes.current: If I opened a restaurant here, /  it'd make money for sure.

BattleFrontier_Lounge4_Text_NeedBreather.current: Whew… //  I need to take a breather after /  some intense battles… //  But even now, I never take a break /  from plotting strategy and combos.

BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_WelcomeT.current: SCOTT: Well, hello and welcome! /  Heheh… Sorry about the cramped space. //  Anyway, {PLAYER}{KUN}, let me formally /  welcome you to the BATTLE FRONTIER. //  This is my dream come true. /  It took me years and years, but I've /  finally given shape to my dream.

BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_HowMuchE.current: On reflection, it was a terribly long /  journey… //  I left home alone on a quest to find /  strong TRAINERS. //  No one can imagine how much effort /  or time it took to make this real.

BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_HaveThis.current: But that's all in the past. /  No point dwelling on that! //  All I want for you is to enjoy battling /  to your heart's content here. //  {PLAYER}{KUN}, I want you to have this /  as a memento for all the time our /  paths crossed on our journeys.

BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_ExplainB.current: SCOTT: You can check your Battle /  Points on your FRONTIER PASS. //  The more success you have here at /  the BATTLE FRONTIER, the more Battle /  Points you will collect. //  Use your Battle Points the way you /  see fit, like trading them for items.

BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_Expectin.current: I'm expecting great things from you!

BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_WhyIGoSe.current: SCOTT: Every TRAINER is an individual. /  They all lead lives of their own. //  But when they're in a battle, /  it doesn't matter who they are. //  They're all the same! //  I love the purity of battle, /  where everyone is equal. //  That's why I go everywhere seeking /  TRAINERS who are serious about /  battling, and invite them here.

BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_HaveYouM.current: SCOTT: Have you met any of /  the FRONTIER BRAINS? //  Better yet, have you obtained any /  symbols from them? //  I handpicked the FRONTIER BRAINS /  as the toughest TRAINERS anywhere. //  But I'm sure that seeing how tough /  you are will startle even them!

BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_MayFindW.current: SCOTT: You don't just train for battle, /  right? //  I think I remember you working on /  a POKéDEX as well. //  Well, guess what? //  You may run into wild POKéMON in /  the BATTLE FRONTIER somewhere… /  Fufufu!

BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_YouveCol.current: SCOTT: Are you enjoying things in /  the BATTLE FRONTIER? //  …Wait a second… /  Oh! //  Your FRONTIER PASS! /  You've collected the full set /  of silver symbols! //  That's more than impressive! /  You are tough, just as I suspected! //  Normally, I wouldn't do something /  like this, but this is a special time! //  I want you to have this. /  I'm sure you can put it to proper use.

SCOTT: I hope you're enjoying /  everything in the BATTLE FRONTIER. //  …Wait a second… /  Oh, my disbelieving eyes! //  Your FRONTIER PASS! /  You've gathered up the full set /  of gold symbols! //  That's more than stupendous! /  You're incredible, just as I suspected! //  … … … … … … //  {PLAYER}, you've got to accept this! //  I think you will be able to /  appreciate the value of my gift!

BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_SoGladIB.current: I must say I have the gift of knowing /  a good TRAINER when I see one. //  I'm so glad I had the foresight to /  bring you here!

BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_BerryPoc.current: Your BERRY POCKET seems to /  be stuffed.

BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_Beat50Tr.current: SCOTT: Oh, I heard about you! /  How you ruled the BATTLE TOWER! /  You beat over 50 TRAINERS in a row? //  That's fantastic! /  I want you to have this!

BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_Beat100T.current: SCOTT: Oh, my! I heard about you! /  How you overwhelmed the BATTLE TOWER! /  You beat over 100 TRAINERS in a row? //  That's ridiculously spectacular! /  You've got to have this!

BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_Expectin.current: I'll be expecting to hear even greater /  things about you now!

BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_ComeBack.current: Oops, well, if you have too much /  stuff, come back for this later.

BattleFrontier_Lounge5_Text_NatureGirlGr.current: Ehehe! /  I can tell what POKéMON are thinking! //  Please! /  Can I see your POKéMON?

BattleFrontier_Lounge5_Text_NatureGirlEg.current: That's silly! An EGG is asleep! /  I can't talk to it!

BattleFrontier_Lounge5_Text_LadyClaimsSh.current: How charming! /  That little lady claims she can /  understand POKéMON!

BattleFrontier_Lounge5_Text_GirlSayingSo.current: I have this feeling that the little girl /  is saying something profound.

BattleFrontier_Lounge5_Text_GirlPlaysAtR.current: I know something! //  That little girl plays at the red house /  a lot!

BattleFrontier_Lounge6_Text_WouldYouLike.current: My POKéMON is a {STR_VAR_2}. /  Do you know it? /  It was built to become anything. //  It deserves a Champion's team, and /  I could trade it with pride. //  Would you like to trade me a {STR_VAR_1} /  for my {STR_VAR_2}?

BattleFrontier_Lounge6_Text_PromiseIllBe.current: Oh, it's adorable! /  Thank you! /  I promise I'll be good to it! //  {STR_VAR_2} comes with a complete /  battle set. Give it a memory disc /  and it will become SILVALLY.

BattleFrontier_Lounge6_Text_DontTradeFor.current: Oh, I'm sorry! /  I don't intend to trade for anything /  but a {STR_VAR_1}.

BattleFrontier_Lounge6_Text_WellThatsFin.current: Oh, you won't? /  Well, that's fine, too. /  Please come visit us again.

BattleFrontier_Lounge6_Text_SkittySoMuch.current: Giggle! /  A SKITTY is so much cuter than I had /  imagined. I'm delighted!

BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_ThinkLadiesD.current: Those ladies, the way they bad-mouth /  each other, you probably think that /  they don't get along. //  But if that were true, they wouldn't /  stay out here together, would they?

BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_LeftTutorInt.current: Buhahaha! //  You couldn't tell it from looking now, /  but I used to be one tough TRAINER. //  I had a reputation as the toughest /  BEAUTY around, I tell you! //  … … … … … … //  What is it now? /  You don't believe me. //  I'm not like that blowhard woman over /  there. I'm actually talented! //  Let me prove it to you. /  I can teach your POKéMON special and /  yet cute moves. //  But my lessons don't come free. /  How about paying for the moves I teach /  with a wee bit of Battle Points?

BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_LeftTutorWel.current: Buhahaha! //  Are you back to learn special and /  yet cute POKéMON moves?

BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_TeachWhichMo.current: Fine, fine, look here! /  Which move should I teach?

BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_MoveWillBeXB.current: The move {STR_VAR_1}, is it? /  That will be {STR_VAR_2} Battle Points, okay?

BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_TeachMoveToW.current: Fine, fine, now pick the POKéMON /  I should teach the move to.

BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_HaventGotEno.current: What the… /  You haven't got enough Battle Points!

BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_IllTakeBattl.current: Do you see how skilled I am now? /  I'll take your Battle Points, thanks!

BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_YouDontWantT.current: What's that? /  You don't want to… //  If you want to see how skilled I am, /  you come see me anytime!

BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_RightTutorIn.current: Ihihihi! //  I know it's hard to see now, but I used /  to be one fantastic TRAINER. //  I had a reputation as the most /  invincible SWIMMER around, I tell you! //  … … … … … … //  What's wrong? /  You don't believe me. //  I'm not like that buffoonish woman over /  there. I'm actually experienced! //  I can prove it to you. /  I can teach your POKéMON hard and /  yet pretty moves. //  But my lessons don't come free. /  How about paying for the moves I teach /  with a wee bit of Battle Points?

BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_RightTutorWe.current: Ihihihi! //  Have you come to learn hard and /  yet pretty POKéMON moves?

BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_LadiesWereSt.current: When I was just a wee YOUNGSTER, /  those ladies were strong and beautiful. //  They were idols among us TRAINERS. //  Even now, age hasn't dulled their /  abilities. //  In fact, their POKéMON moves have /  grown even more polished. //  But… For some reason, I can't help /  but feel this… //  Time is so cruel…

BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_Welcom.current: The front lines of POKéMON battling! /  Welcome to the BATTLE FRONTIER!

BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_EnjoyB.current: We hope you enjoy all that the BATTLE /  FRONTIER has to offer!

BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_YourGu.current: I'm your guide to the various facilities /  here in the BATTLE FRONTIER.

BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_LearnA.current: Which would you like to learn about?

BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_Battle.current: It is the gigantic tower considered /  to be the BATTLE FRONTIER's symbol. //  There are four kinds of BATTLE ROOMS /  in the tower for SINGLE, DOUBLE, MULTI, /  and LINK MULTI BATTLES. //  The far desk hosts the /  CHAMPIONS CIRCUIT, the FRONTIER's /  premier full-team test.

The BATTLE DOME is the large building /  shaped like a huge egg. //  Events named Battle Tourneys are held /  in this facility. //  The Battle Tourneys are offered in /  two courses--for SINGLE and DOUBLE /  BATTLES.
The BATTLE PALACE is the red building /  on the right of the BATTLE FRONTIER. //  There are two kinds of BATTLE HALLS /  for SINGLE and DOUBLE BATTLES.
The BATTLE ARENA is the dojo-like /  building at the center-right of /  the BATTLE FRONTIER. //  An event called the Set KO Tourney /  takes place at the BATTLE ARENA.

The BATTLE FACTORY is the large /  building that is the closest to us. //  An event called the Battle Swap /  is conducted there. //  The Battle Swap event is offered in /  two courses for SINGLE and DOUBLE /  BATTLES.
The BATTLE PIKE is the building shaped /  like a POKéMON at the center-left of /  the BATTLE FRONTIER. //  An event called the Battle Choice /  is conducted there.
The BATTLE PYRAMID is the enormous /  pyramid. //  An event called the Battle Quest /  is conducted there.

BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_Rankin.current: The RANKING HALL is located near /  the BATTLE TOWER. //  There, you may see the most fantastic /  records left by the TRAINERS that /  took on the many challenges of /  the BATTLE FRONTIER.

BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_Exchan.current: The EXCHANGE SERVICE CORNER is near /  the BATTLE TOWER. //  The Battle Points you have earned in /  the BATTLE FRONTIER may be exchanged /  for fabulous prizes there.

BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_YourGu.current: I'm your guide to the basic rules that /  are common to all the challenges /  offered by the facilities in the BATTLE /  FRONTIER.

BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_LearnA.current: What would you like to learn about?

BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_LevelM.current: All the challenges at the BATTLE /  FRONTIER's facilities come in /  two courses--Level 50 and Open Level.

BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_Level5.current: The Level 50 course is open to POKéMON /  up to and including Level 50. //  Please keep in mind, however, that /  no TRAINER you face will have any /  POKéMON below Level 50. //  This course is the entry level for /  battles at the BATTLE FRONTIER. //  To begin, we hope you will challenge /  this course.

BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_OpenLe.current: The Open Level course places no limit /  on the levels of POKéMON entering /  challenges. //  The levels of your opponents will /  be adjusted to match the levels of /  your POKéMON. //  However, no TRAINER you face will /  have any POKéMON below Level 60.

BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_MonEnt.current: Virtually any kind of POKéMON may take /  on the challenges at all facilities. //  EGGS and certain kinds of POKéMON, /  however, are not permitted. //  The numbers of POKéMON required for /  challenges will depend on the facility. //  At all facilities, however, two or more /  of the same kind of POKéMON are not /  permitted.

BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_HoldIt.current: When entering a challenge at a BATTLE /  FRONTIER facility, POKéMON may not /  be holding the same kind of item. //  Please make sure that all POKéMON /  entering a challenge are holding /  different items.

BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_YourGu.current: I'm your guide to the FRONTIER PASS.

BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_LearnA.current: Which would you like to learn about?

BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_Symbol.current: There are seven facilities at /  the BATTLE FRONTIER. //  TRAINERS who gain recognition for /  their abilities may be rewarded with /  symbols from each of the facilities. //  To earn a symbol, TRAINERS may need /  to defeat other TRAINERS in a row, /  and may need to win events repeatedly. //  It's certainly not easy to win symbols. /  I wish you the best of luck!

BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_Record.current: Battle recordings are not offered /  at this BATTLE FRONTIER. //  Your FRONTIER PASS instead tracks /  symbols, BATTLE POINTS, and your /  challenge records.

BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_Battle.current: Battle Points are rewards given to /  TRAINERS who battled outstandingly /  at the BATTLE FRONTIER. //  You may trade in your Battle Points /  for prizes at the EXCHANGE SERVICE /  CORNER.

BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_FirstT.current: Is it your first time here? /  Please step this way!

BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_IssueF.current: For a first-time visitor, we issue /  the FRONTIER PASS. //  It's for use at all the facilities /  in the BATTLE FRONTIER. //  Here you are!

BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_Placed.current: {PLAYER} placed the TRAINER CARD /  in the FRONTIER PASS.

BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_IfItIs.current: ???: Well, if it isn't {PLAYER}{KUN}! /  You came out here!

BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_OhMrSc.current: GUIDE: Oh! MR. SCOTT, sir! /  Good day to you, sir!

BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_ScottG.current: SCOTT: It's great to see you here, /  it really is! //  Start with the CHAMPIONS CIRCUIT at /  the far desk inside the BATTLE TOWER. //  It assembles a new full-team Double /  Battle every round. The other facilities /  preserve HOENN's classic challenges. Naturally, I hope you'll also experience /  the pure essence of battling. //  I also have my quarters here, so feel /  free to visit if you have time.

BattleFrontier_Lounge8_Text_ToldMeIHaveT.current: At the BATTLE TOWER, an older girl /  told me that I have a lot of talent /  for battling! //  I like POKéMON CONTESTS more! //  But I'm no good at CONTESTS! //  I guess having talent and liking /  something aren't the same.

BattleFrontier_Lounge8_Text_WhatATrainer.current: What a TRAINER needs… //  Knowledge… /  Strategy… /  Luck… /  Guts… /  Spirit… /  Bravery… /  And ability… //  Well, I'm all set in every way! /  I'll be unstoppable at every building! //  Huh? POKéMON? /  What's that?

BattleFrontier_Lounge8_Text_KnowAboutFro.current: Do you know about the FRONTIER /  BRAINS? //  That's what SCOTT calls the seven /  special TRAINERS that run the seven /  facilities in the BATTLE FRONTIER.

BattleFrontier_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Nev.current: There was someone here using a  /  POKéMON I've never seen before. //  I never learned about it at /  TRAINER'S SCHOOL at least. //  I wonder where you can catch POKéMON /  like that.

BattleFrontier_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Nex.current: Okay! Next stop, the BATTLE ARENA! /  I'd better get the right POKéMON from /  the PC Storage System.

BattleFrontier_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Goi.current: Giggle… I'm going to go through every /  challenge with just this baby!

BattleFrontier_Mart_Text_CaptureBallsMak.current: Dear, what do you think of this? /  Wouldn't these BALLS make a nice gift? //  Our grandson is always searching for /  one more teammate.

BattleFrontier_Mart_Text_FacilitiesDontA.current: A lot of the BATTLE FRONTIER's /  facilities don't allow the use of items /  during battles. //  That rule makes things tougher than /  they already are!

TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_HopeYouGiveItY.current: I hope you give it your best.

TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_FriendsTryingT.current: Do you see the Time Board over there? //  My friends and I are trying to see who /  can reach the top in the least time.

TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_DoYouKnowWhenT.current: Do you know when they're opening /  this place up? //  I'm waiting here to be the first /  challenger ever!

TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_WhatSortOfTrai.current: Who knows what sort of TRAINERS /  and POKéMON combos are ahead? //  All I know is that I'll knock aside /  anyone that stands in my way!

TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_CantWaitToTest.current: I heard tough TRAINERS come to this /  TRAINER HILL from all over. //  I can't wait to test the waters! //  I'll knock aside anyone that stands /  in my way!

TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_StillGettingRe.current: This is the TRAINER HILL where /  you may enjoy tag battles with many /  TRAINERS. //  Unfortunately, we're still getting /  things ready. Please come back later!

TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_WelcomeToTrain.current: Welcome! //  This is the TRAINER HILL where /  you may enjoy tag battles with many /  TRAINERS!

TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_SaveGameBefore.current: Is this your first visit here? //  Before you enter, please save /  your game.

TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_TrainersUpToFl.current: Let's see… /  The TRAINERS here now are… //  Up to floor no. {STR_VAR_1}.

TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_TrainersInEver.current: Let's see… /  The TRAINERS here now are… //  There appear to be TRAINERS gathered /  in every room.

TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_LikeToChalleng.current: Would you like to challenge the /  waiting TRAINERS?

TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_TimeProgessGet.current: I will time your progress. /  Best of luck! //  On your marks… //  Get set… //  Go!

TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_ExplainTrainer.current: Here at the TRAINER HILL, we conduct /  an event called the Time Attack. //  It is a race that measures how long /  you take to reach our owner on /  the rooftop from this counter. //  The fastest times are posted on /  the Time Board--try competing with /  your friends. //  In TRAINER battles along the way, /  neither Exp. Points nor money will /  be awarded.

TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_TooBadTremendo.current: That was too bad. //  I think you put in a tremendous /  effort in your battling. //  Please come back and try again!

TrainerHill_Entrance_Text_MovedReception.current: When the TRAINERS switch places, /  the movement can be hectic. //  To avoid the stampede, we moved /  the reception counter here. //  I'm sorry for the inconvenience.

Route109_SeashoreHouse_Text_SeashoreHous.current: I'm the owner of the SEASHORE HOUSE. /  But you can call me MR. SEA! //  What I love above all is to see hot /  POKéMON battles. //  Let me see that your heart burns hot! //  If you can defeat all the TRAINERS /  here, I'll reward your efforts.

Route109_SeashoreHouse_Text_ShowMeSomeHo.current: Show me some hot matches! //  I run this SEASHORE HOUSE just for /  that reason alone!

Route109_SeashoreHouse_Text_TakeTheseSod.current: You're scorching hot! /  Those battles blazed! /  I'm more than just satisfied! //  As thanks for showing me your hot /  streak, I want you to take these. //  It's half a dozen bottles of SODA POP!

Route109_SeashoreHouse_Text_BagFull.current: Oh, but hey, your BAG's jammed full. /  I'll hang on to these for you.

Route109_SeashoreHouse_Text_WantToBuySod.current: Want to buy some SODA POP? /  POKéMON love it! //  Just ¥300 a bottle! /  Buy some!

Route109_SeashoreHouse_Text_DwayneIntro.current: If you're looking for a battle in the /  SEASHORE HOUSE, you'll find no /  hotter TRAINER than me, matey!

Route109_SeashoreHouse_Text_DwayneDefeat.current: That was a hot battle! /  I can accept that loss, matey!

Route109_SeashoreHouse_Text_DwaynePostBa.current: Whenever I'm in SLATEPORT, I enjoy /  hot battles and ice-cold SODA POP!

Route109_SeashoreHouse_Text_SimonIntro.current: I'm going to show you how great /  my POKéMON are, but don't cry!

Route109_SeashoreHouse_Text_SimonPostBat.current: If one of my POKéMON knew the move /  for carrying me across water on its /  back, I could get rid of this inner tube.

Route109_SeashoreHouse_Text_JohannaIntro.current: Boring battles aren't worth the effort. //  Fiery hot battles are what toughen up /  TRAINERS and POKéMON!

Route109_SeashoreHouse_Text_JohannaPostB.current: Whew, I'm all thirsty. /  Maybe I'll have a SODA POP.

Route110_TrickHouseEntrance_Text_Conceal.current: Hah? Grrr… //  How did you know I concealed myself /  beneath this desk? You're sharp!
Hah? Grrr… //  How did you know I concealed myself /  behind this tree? You're sharp!
Hah? Grrr… //  How did you know I concealed myself /  in this dresser? You're sharp!

Route110_TrickHouseEntrance_Text_Coneale.current: Hah? Grrr… //  How did you know I concealed myself /  beyond this window? You're sharp!

Route110_TrickHouseEntrance_Text_Conceal.current: Hah? Grrr… //  How did you know I concealed myself /  in this planter? You're sharp!
Hah? Grrr… //  How did you know I concealed myself /  in this cupboard? You're sharp!
Hah? Grrr… //  How did you know I concealed myself /  behind this window? You're sharp!
Hah? Grrr… //  How did you know I concealed myself /  beneath this cushion? You're sharp!

Route110_TrickHouseEntrance_Text_NextTim.current: For the next time, I'll use this trick, /  and that scheme, and those ruses… //  Mufufufu… If I may say so, it's /  brilliantly difficult, even for me!

Route110_TrickHouseEntrance_Text_InMidst.current: Hah? What?! /  Oh, it's you! //  I'm in the midst of devising new tricky /  challenges! //  It's not too much to ask for a bit more /  time for me to think, is it now? /  You wouldn't begrudge me that? /  Come back in a little while!

Route110_TrickHouseEntrance_Text_YoureHe.current: Ah, it's you! You're here to accept the /  reward from before, isn't that right? /  Yes, right I am! //  Here! /  I'll give it to you now!

Route110_TrickHouseEntrance_Text_DidYouN.current: Hah? /  Did you not come to claim your reward?

Route110_TrickHouseEntrance_Text_Mechado.current: MECHADOLL 5 I AM! /  IF REWARD IS NOT TAKEN BY YOU, /  THEN TRICK MASTER YOU CANNOT FOLLOW. //  RED TENT OR BLUE TENT, /  WHICH DO YOU PREFER?

Route110_TrickHouseEntrance_Text_PCFullA.current: YOUR PC STATUS: FULL AGAIN. /  MEAN, YOU ARE.

Route110_TrickHouseEntrance_Text_GoInHol.current: There is a big hole behind the scroll! //  Want to go in?

Route110_TrickHouseEntrance_Text_Leaving.current: There is a note affixed to the scroll… //  “I am leaving on a journey. /  Don't look for me. TRICK MASTER”

Route110_TrickHouseEntrance_Text_TheyCal.current: Behold! //  For I am the greatest living mystery /  of a man in all of HOENN! /  They call me… //  The TRICK MASTER! /  Wahahaha! Glad to meet you!

Route110_TrickHouseEntrance_Text_ComeToC.current: You, you've come to challenge /  my TRICK HOUSE, haven't you? //  That's why you're here, isn't it? /  Yes, it is! //  Consider your challenge accepted! //  Enter through the scroll there, /  and let your challenge commence! //  I shall be waiting in the back!

Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_YouveMadeItT.current: Aak! /  You've made it to me? /  Hmmm… You're sharp!

Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_AllNightToPl.current: It took me all night to plant all those /  trees… //  You're almost my equal in greatness by /  one, two, three, four, five, six places!

Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_AllNightToMa.current: It took me all night to make the maze… //  You're almost my equal in greatness by /  one, two, three, four, five places!

Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_AllNightToPr.current: It took me all night to prepare /  the wall panels… //  You're almost my equal in greatness by /  one, two, three, four places!

Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_AllNightToSh.current: It took me all night to shove in those /  boulders… //  You're almost my equal in greatness by /  one, two, three places!

Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_AllNightToMa.current: It took me all night to make MECHADOLLS /  and another to think up the quiz… //  You're almost my equal in greatness by /  one, two places!

Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_AllNightToIn.current: It took me all night to install /  the doors… //  You're almost my equal in greatness!

Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_AllNightSett.current: It took me all night setting up arrows… //  You're my equal in greatness!

Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_AllNightPoli.current: It took me all night polishing floors… //  You're above me in greatness! /  Possibly…

Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_FountainOfId.current: Wh-what should I do? /  My fountain of ideas for tricks has /  run dry… //  Perhaps it is time I toured the country /  on a quest to devise new tricks…

Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_DefeatedMePr.current: I hate to admit defeat, but you have /  bested me! //  Still, you must have been reeled in by /  my charisma for you to visit me again /  and again. Yes, you must have! //  But that has nothing to do with my /  losing! //  In recognition of the friendship /  between you, the driven, and the genius /  that is myself, I demand that you take /  this keepsake! //  Actually there are two-- /  a RED TENT and a BLUE TENT. /  Which do you prefer?

Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_NoRoomInPC.current: What? No room in your PC? /  What am I to make of that? //  I wish I could say that, but I am much /  too kind and caring, so come back later!

Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_LeavingOnJou.current: … … … … … … //  I am leaving on a journey of discovery. /  A quest in search of new tricks. //  I wish that you will one day visit and /  entertain me again. //  And now, farewell!

Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_YouHaveEarne.current: Fine! /  You have earned this reward!

Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_NoRoomForThi.current: What? Have you no room for this? /  What manner of items do you carry? //  But fine, since you've reached me, /  your reward will be with me till later.

Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_MakeNewTrick.current: Scrub that smug smirk from your face! /  It's much too early to think you've won! //  I'll make new tricks to stump you, I will. /  You may mock me only when you're done. //  Come back for the next exciting /  installment!

Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_FinalPrizeMe.current: And one more thing! A true master of /  tricks deserves a master of the mind.

Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_YoureIgnorin.current: Now, now! You're ignoring me now? /  Now that, I consider heartbreaking!

Route110_TrickHousePuzzle1_Text_SallyInt.current: I'll hack and slash my way to victory /  with the CUT we just learned!

Route110_TrickHousePuzzle1_Text_SallyPos.current: I never get tired of hacking /  and slashing!

Route110_TrickHousePuzzle1_Text_EddieInt.current: I wandered into this weird house /  by accident…

Route110_TrickHousePuzzle1_Text_EddiePos.current: I lost my way, I lost a battle, and I'm /  now even more lost… I can't get out…

Route110_TrickHousePuzzle1_Text_RobinInt.current: Just who is the TRICK MASTER?

Route110_TrickHousePuzzle1_Text_RobinDef.current: I lost while I was lost in thought!

Route110_TrickHousePuzzle1_Text_RobinPos.current: You're strong! /  Just who are you?

Route110_TrickHousePuzzle2_Text_TedDefea.current: After that battle, I'm even more /  confused!

Route110_TrickHousePuzzle2_Text_TedPostB.current: Can I get you to push all the buttons /  for me?

Route110_TrickHousePuzzle2_Text_PaulIntr.current: Oh! You're on your second TRICK HOUSE /  challenge!

Route110_TrickHousePuzzle2_Text_PaulPost.current: The TRICK MASTER rigged all the tricks /  in this house all by himself.

Route110_TrickHousePuzzle2_Text_GeorgiaI.current: I want to make my own GYM one day. /  So, I'm studying how to set traps.

Route110_TrickHousePuzzle2_Text_GeorgiaP.current: You're strong, aren't you? /  Maybe even enough to be a GYM LEADER!

Route110_TrickHousePuzzle3_Text_JustinIn.current: I keep coming back to this same place!

Route110_TrickHousePuzzle3_Text_JustinDe.current: I'm already having trouble, and then /  you have to beat me? It's not fair!

Route110_TrickHousePuzzle3_Text_JustinPo.current: It's full of doors here! /  It's too small and dark in here! Help!

Route110_TrickHousePuzzle3_Text_MarthaIn.current: I don't know what's going on here. /  I'm starting to feel sad…

Route110_TrickHousePuzzle3_Text_MarthaPo.current: I know I'm weak! /  And, I have no sense of direction!

Route110_TrickHousePuzzle3_Text_AlanIntr.current: I don't get it. What would anyone want /  with a house this bizarre?

Route110_TrickHousePuzzle3_Text_AlanDefe.current: I don't get it. /  How did I lose?

Route110_TrickHousePuzzle3_Text_AlanPost.current: I don't get it. /  How many traps are in this house? //  You may be the one to solve that.

Route110_TrickHousePuzzle4_Text_CoraIntr.current: It's too much bother to think this out. /  I only wanted to battle!

Route110_TrickHousePuzzle4_Text_CoraDefe.current: Even though I lost, I still like battling /  the best!

Route110_TrickHousePuzzle4_Text_CoraPost.current: Wouldn't you agree? You would go /  anywhere if TRAINERS were there.

Route110_TrickHousePuzzle4_Text_PaulaInt.current: The TRICK HOUSE is getting trickier, /  isn't it?

Route110_TrickHousePuzzle4_Text_PaulaPos.current: Has anyone made it to the end?

Route110_TrickHousePuzzle4_Text_YujiIntr.current: Heh! Boulders like this, I can brush /  aside with one finger!

Route110_TrickHousePuzzle4_Text_YujiDefe.current: I can push boulders, but I can't solve /  the puzzle…

Route110_TrickHousePuzzle4_Text_YujiPost.current: It's not good enough to be brawny… /  You have to use your head. Be brainy!

Route110_TrickHousePuzzle5_Text_Mechadol.current: CLICKETY-CLACK… /  MECHADOLL 1 AM I! //  IF YOU ANSWER QUIZZES CORRECTLY, /  THEN YOU WILL GO TO MECHADOLL 5. /  THEN YOU CAN OBTAIN THE SECRET CODE.
MECHADOLL 1 QUIZ. //  One of these POKéMON is not found /  on ROUTE 110. Which one is it?
MECHADOLL 1 QUIZ. //  One of these POKéMON is not of the /  WATER type. Which one is it?
MECHADOLL 1 QUIZ. //  One of these POKéMON does not use /  LEECH LIFE. Which one is it?

Route110_TrickHousePuzzle5_Text_CorrectG.current: CONGRATULATIONS. CORRECT YOU ARE. /  GO THROUGH. PLEASE.

Route110_TrickHousePuzzle5_Text_WaitForN.current: YOUR NEXT CHALLENGE WE WAIT FOR.

Route110_TrickHousePuzzle5_Text_Mechadol.current: CLICKETY-CLACK… /  MECHADOLL 2 AM I! //  MECHADOLL 1'S QUIZ DIFFICULTY LEVEL /  IS SET TOO LOW.
MECHADOLL 2 QUIZ. //  Which of these POKéMON did WALLY /  borrow from your father?
MECHADOLL 2 QUIZ. //  Which of these POKéMON was chasing /  PROF. BIRCH?
MECHADOLL 2 QUIZ. //  Which of these POKéMON did TEAM AQUA /  use in PETALBURG FOREST?
CLICKETY-CLACK… /  MECHADOLL 3 AM I! //  MATTERS OF MONEY ARE MY SOLE FOCUS.
MECHADOLL 3 QUIZ. //  Which costs more? /  Three HARBOR MAILS or one BURN HEAL?
MECHADOLL 3 QUIZ. //  Sell one GREAT BALL and buy /  one POTION. How much money remains?
MECHADOLL 3 QUIZ. //  Do one REPEL and SODA POP cost /  more than one SUPER POTION?
CLICKETY-CLACK… /  MECHADOLL 4 THAT IS ME! //  MY QUIZ IS AN OBJECT OF BEAUTY.
MECHADOLL 4 QUIZ. //  In SEASHORE HOUSE, were there more men /  or women?
MECHADOLL 4 QUIZ. //  In LAVARIDGE TOWN, were there more /  elderly men or elderly women?
MECHADOLL 4 QUIZ. //  In the TRAINER'S SCHOOL, how many /  girl students were there?
CLICKETY-CLACK… /  MECHADOLL 5 AM I! //  THE MASTER'S BEST AND PROUDEST /  ACHIEVEMENT AM I.
MECHADOLL 5 QUIZ. //  In SLATEPORT's POKéMON FAN CLUB, /  how many POKéMON were there?
MECHADOLL 5 QUIZ. //  In FORTREE CITY, how many /  tree houses were there?
MECHADOLL 5 QUIZ. //  On the CYCLING ROAD, how many /  TRIATHLETES were there?

Route110_TrickHousePuzzle6_Text_SophiaIn.current: When I heard there was a strange /  house, I had to check it out.

Route110_TrickHousePuzzle6_Text_SophiaPo.current: I'm sure having a good time checking /  this place out. //  It's a challenge I've found worth /  repeating!

Route110_TrickHousePuzzle6_Text_BennyInt.current: Maybe I could get my BIRD POKéMON /  to fly over the wall…

Route110_TrickHousePuzzle6_Text_BennyPos.current: Ehehehe… I guess I lost because /  I was trying to cheat.

Route110_TrickHousePuzzle6_Text_Sebastia.current: I'm getting dizzy from these rotating /  doors…
Everything's spinning around and /  around. I can't take this anymore…
You don't seem to be affected at all. /  Or do you have your poker face on?

Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_JoshuaIn.current: The TRICK MASTER always vanishes /  like smoke. How does he do it?

Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_JoshuaDe.current: Aiyeeeh! You're much too strong! /  How do you do it?

Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_JoshuaPo.current: I wish I could appear and disappear as /  if I were smoke, too.

Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_AlexisIn.current: Whoever wins will get through here /  first. That's the feeling I get.

Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_AlexisPo.current: You're solving all the puzzles in the /  TRICK HOUSE. That's the feeling I get.

Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_Patricia.current: Going around the same spot… /  It begets ill fortune…
I've circled the same spot over ten /  times now… It's ill fortune…

Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_AlvaroIn.current: I ever so closely watched you coming!

Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_AlvaroDe.current: This outcome I didn't see coming…

Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_AlvaroPo.current: Well, anyway, we both picked a weird /  place to get acquainted. //  As one weirdo to another, /  let's do our best!

Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_MarielaI.current: Nufufufu, here at last! /  Let's get right with it!

Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_MarielaP.current: Humph! I'm not upset! /  Not me!

Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_EverettP.current: I was hoping to switch places with you /  when I beat you, but…

Route110_TrickHousePuzzle8_Text_VincentI.current: Not many TRAINERS have made it /  this far.

Route110_TrickHousePuzzle8_Text_VincentD.current: That must mean you're tough, too…

Route110_TrickHousePuzzle8_Text_VincentP.current: You've beaten the POKéMON LEAGUE /  CHAMPION? That's too much!

Route110_TrickHousePuzzle8_Text_LeroyInt.current: You've been slugging through the TRICK /  HOUSE challenge, too.

Route110_TrickHousePuzzle8_Text_LeroyDef.current: I see… /  You possess an extraordinary style.

Route110_TrickHousePuzzle8_Text_LeroyPos.current: Seeing someone like you should please /  the TRICK MASTER.

Route110_TrickHousePuzzle8_Text_KeiraInt.current: Consider yourself lucky to be /  battling me!

Route110_TrickHousePuzzle8_Text_KeiraDef.current: This isn't right! /  I can't lose!

Route110_TrickHousePuzzle8_Text_KeiraPos.current: It's a miracle that you beat me. /  You can brag about it.

Route110_SeasideCyclingRoadSouthEntrance.current: On CYCLING ROAD, you can go all out /  and cycle as fast as you'd like. //  It feels great to go that fast, but try /  not to crash into anyone!
Sorry, you can't walk on CYCLING /  ROAD. It's too dangerous. //  Please come back with a BIKE.

Route110_SeasideCyclingRoadNorthEntrance.current: On CYCLING ROAD, you can go all out /  and cycle as fast as you'd like. //  It feels great to go that fast, but try /  not to crash into anyone!
Sorry, you can't walk on CYCLING /  ROAD. It's too dangerous. //  Please come back with a BIKE.

Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_GoCollectAsh.current: This area is covered in volcanic ash, /  huff-puff! //  I'm specially gifted, huff-puff. //  I make glass out of volcanic ash /  and make items, huff-puff. //  Go collect ashes with this, huff-puff.

Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_ExplainSootS.current: Just take that SOOT SACK and walk /  through piles of ash, huff-puff. //  And it will fill up with the volcanic ash, /  huff-puff. //  Once you think you've collected a good /  amount, come see me, huff-puff.

Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_LetsSeeColle.current: Have you collected ashes, huff-puff? /  Let me see, huff-puff.

Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_NotEnoughAsh.current: Hmmm… /  There's not enough ash here, huff-puff. /  I can't make glass with this, huff-puff. //  Let's see… {STR_VAR_1} is the number of steps /  you'll need to walk for me to make you /  a BLUE FLUTE, huff-puff.

Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_WhichGlassIt.current: Oh! /  You've got a lot of ashes, huff-puff! //  I'll make you a glass item, huff-puff! /  Which one would you like, huff-puff?

Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_IsThatTheIte.current: A {STR_VAR_1}, huff-puff? /  Is that the one for you, huff-puff?

Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_WhichWouldYo.current: Which one would you like, huff-puff?

Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_IllMakeItemF.current: A {STR_VAR_1} it is, then, huff-puff! //  Okay! I'll make it for you, huff-puff. /  Just wait a little while, huff-puff.

Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_NotEnoughAsh.current: A {STR_VAR_1}, huff-puff? //  There's not enough ash here to make /  that, though, huff-puff. //  Let's see… {STR_VAR_2} is the number of steps /  you'll need to walk through volcanic ash /  for me to make that item, huff-puff. //  Which item would you rather have me /  make instead, huff-puff?

Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_AllThatAshBu.current: You've collected all that ash, but you /  don't want anything, huff-puff?

Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_IveFinishedG.current: Ah, I've finished your {STR_VAR_1}. /  Take it, huff-puff.

Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_NoRoomInBag.current: Oh? /  You've no room in your BAG, huff-puff. //  I'll hold on to it, so come back later, /  huff-puff.

Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_NoRoomInPC.current: Oh? /  You've no room in your PC, huff-puff? //  I'll hold on to it, so come back later, /  huff-puff.

Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_HaventGotYou.current: Hah? You haven't got your SOOT SACK /  with you, huff-puff. //  You have to keep it with you to collect /  volcanic ash, huff-puff.

Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_FunToBlowGla.current: It's fun to blow a glass flute while /  my boss is talking. //  Huff-huff! Puff-puff!

Route123_BerryMastersHouse_Text_GardenWe.current: A good garden always has something /  to share. What brings you here?

Route123_BerryMastersHouse_Text_StonePri.current: Each stone costs {STR_VAR_2} garden berries. /  You have {STR_VAR_1}. One of each stone!

Route123_BerryMastersHouse_Text_StoneRec.current: You traded the berries and received /  a {STR_VAR_1}!

Route123_BerryMastersHouse_Text_StoneAlr.current: That one's already yours! I only /  found one of each in these fields.

Route123_BerryMastersHouse_Text_MoreBerr.current: Keep gathering as you travel. Plant /  a few, and your harvest will grow!

Route123_BerryMastersHouse_Text_GardenBe.current: Razz, Bluk, Nanab, Wepear and Pinap /  are perfect for my garden. //  Pomeg, Kelpsy, Qualot, Hondew, Grepa /  and Tamato count, too. Any mixture! //  I found these stones while digging. /  Let's put them to better use.

Route119_WeatherInstitute_1F_Text_Grunt1.current: The INSTITUTE mapped every pressure /  shift before the storm arrived. //  ARCHIE needs those maps. You are not /  interrupting this current again.
You read the pressure change first…
The maps show weather and the SIGNS /  moving together. //  SHELLY took the researchers upstairs. /  She wants their readings for ARCHIE.

Route119_WeatherInstitute_1F_Text_Grunt4.current: You crossed the flooded grass alone? /  Then this indoor front will not stop you. //  I will change the forecast myself.
The bed restores exhausted teams. /  Use it. SHELLY is upstairs with the /  researchers. That is your next front.

Route119_WeatherInstitute_1F_Text_WhatWe.current: You saved our staff and our records. //  AQUA was tracing the same anomaly that /  links our weather stations to the SIGNS.

Route119_WeatherInstitute_1F_Text_ProfSt.current: The PROFESSOR loves rain. /  That's a fact. //  But if it keeps raining, people will be in /  trouble. That's another fact. //  And thus, the PROFESSOR is studying /  if the rain can be put to good use.

Route119_WeatherInstitute_1F_Text_Notici.current: On the 2nd floor of the INSTITUTE, /  we study the weather patterns over /  the HOENN region. //  We've been noticing temporary and /  isolated cases of droughts and /  heavy rain lately…

Route119_WeatherInstitute_1F_Text_Everyo.current: Those AQUA people took the researchers /  upstairs while I was asleep! //  Can you go up and help them?

Route119_WeatherInstitute_1F_Text_WowYou.current: Wow, you're really strong! //  I wish I could be a POKéMON TRAINER /  like you!

Route119_WeatherInstitute_1F_Text_TakeRe.current: There's a bed… /  Let's take a rest.

Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_Grunt2.current: CASTFORM reads a battlefield before the /  first drop falls. AQUA needs that gift. //  You will not reach the research wing.
You changed the forecast around me…
CASTFORM does not command the weather. /  It survives by changing with it.

Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_Grunt3.current: Rare data, rare POKéMON, hidden currents. /  AQUA follows what the world conceals.
ARCHIE wants a world no border can hold. /  You keep asking what that freedom costs.

Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_Shelly.current: SHELLY: We came for weather records, /  but they chart the SIGNS as well. //  AQUA wins by changing the board before /  the opponent knows what it became. //  Let's see how quickly you read a storm.
You found the calm inside my storm…
You adapted inside the storm. No wonder /  ARCHIE remembers you. //  The records point to MT. PYRE. We move.

Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_TeamMa.current: TEAM MAGMA just passed below us. They /  were searching for an ancient BLUE ORB. //  They are headed for MT. PYRE!

Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_WeHave.current: What?! MAGMA already moved toward the /  BLUE ORB? //  The records confirm MT. PYRE is the next /  node. AQUA, change course now!

Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_Thanks.current: You saved our staff and our data. Take /  this CASTFORM as a research partner. //  It reads weather directly, and old desert /  records say the land itself knows it.

Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_Pokemo.current: CASTFORM changes with the weather. /  Let it show you what a storm can do. //  Before each SIGN's challenge, visit /  DEVON's researchers in RUSTBORO.

Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_Reveal.current: This REVEAL GLASS changes the forms of /  TORNADUS, THUNDURUS, and LANDORUS. //  The northern bridge is clear now. /  Follow ROUTE 119 to FORTREE's GYM.
The REVEAL GLASS is ready for you, but /  your KEY ITEMS pocket is full. //  Make room, then speak with me again.

Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_Changi.current: Our instruments still trace that old /  network beneath HOENN. //  Report to DEVON's lab in RUSTBORO /  before each SIGN you want to challenge. //  The road north leads to FORTREE. /  You're welcome to rest here on the way.

Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_Groudo.current: I track weather patterns over /  the HOENN region. //  Presently, a drought has been recorded /  in {STR_VAR_1}. //  Could that mean, somewhere near /  {STR_VAR_1}…

Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_Kyogre.current: I track weather patterns over /  the HOENN region. //  Presently, heavy rainfall has been /  recorded over {STR_VAR_1}. //  Could that mean, somewhere near /  {STR_VAR_1}…

Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_NoAbno.current: Abnormal weather conditions are /  no longer being reported. //  The occasional rainfall is a blessing, /  really.

Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_Grunt5.current: You came for the weather POKéMON, too? //  Then you know a changing form can answer /  more fields than a rigid one. Show me.
Your answer changed one turn sooner…
CASTFORM was never the whole objective. /  The records point from storms to SIGNS, /  and from here to MT. PYRE.

Route119_House_Text_RumorAboutCaveOfOrig.current: I heard about a cave called the CAVE /  OF ORIGIN. //  People rumor that the spirits of /  POKéMON are revived there. Could /  something like that really happen?

Route124_DivingTreasureHuntersHouse_Text.current: I'm the DIVING TREASURE HUNTER! //  I'm the awesome dude who makes /  deep-sea dives to gather treasures /  resting at the bottom.
Tell me, have you seen any SHARDS of /  tools made in ancient times?
You haven't got any treasures /  for me… //  If you see any SHARDS, like the RED /  SHARD, you've got to trade it with me!
Oh, hey! That… /  That's a SHARD! I'm looking for those! //  Oh, man, you've got to trade that /  with me! I'll give you something good!
What do you want to trade?
You'll trade your {STR_VAR_1} for /  my {STR_VAR_2}, then?
It's a done deal! /  Use that wisely!
Do you want to trade something else?
Whoops, your BAG's full. /  Get rid of some items, friend!
No? That's a downer. /  Well, if you change your mind, come back.

AlteringCave_B1F_Text_MewtwoDormant.current: A CHAMPION'S SIGN is carved here. //  Its light is dormant. Hoenn's story /  has not yet reached this place.

AlteringCave_B1F_Text_MewtwoAwakens.current: The CHAMPION'S SIGN erupts with light! /  MEWTWO answers the challenge!

AlteringCave_B1F_Text_LeafIntro.current: I followed the distortions here from /  Kanto. They react to strong teams. //  Show me whether Hoenn chose well.

AlteringCave_B1F_Text_LeafDefeat.current: It did. That was a Champion's answer.

AlteringCave_B1F_Text_LeafAfter.current: Take this MEWTWONITE X. What waits /  below deserves its full power.

AlteringCave_B1F_Text_LeafBagFull.current: Make room for the MEWTWONITE X. /  Your reward will wait here.

AshenWoods_Text_RomanIntro.current: One drop of water can wake a mountain. /  Interrupt the engine if you can!

AshenWoods_Text_RomanDefeat.current: You stopped the engine before it ran.

AshenWoods_Text_RomanAfter.current: The best doubles plans are visible. /  The hard part is answering in time.

AshenWoods_Text_AlannahIntro.current: The ash feeds roots tougher than stone. /  Can your team outlast mine?

AshenWoods_Text_AlannahDefeat.current: Your answer grew through the ash.

AshenWoods_Text_AlannahAfter.current: The forest rewards adaptation, not one /  perfect type chart.

AshenWoods_Text_MartinIntro.current: A firebird circles whenever the sun /  breaks through. Face the whole blaze!

AshenWoods_Text_MartinAfter.current: MOLTRES waits beyond EMBER PATH. /  Strength alone will not reach it.

AshenWoods_Text_ElmerIntro.current: Every insect here wins differently. /  Show me four different answers!

AshenWoods_Text_ElmerDefeat.current: You changed pace with every swarm.

AshenWoods_Text_ElmerAfter.current: A Champion needs a toolbox, not a /  single unbeatable hammer.

AshenWoods_Text_Caretaker.current: GROUDON's heat burned this place. /  Rain returned it to life. //  The old wardens say RAYQUAZA is not /  a conqueror, but Hoenn's balance.

AshenWoods_Text_VialBlobNowhereToRun.current: Blob watches the HEAL BALL. /  This is your chance to bring it home.

AshenWoods_Text_VialNoHealBall.current: You need one of the nurse's HEAL BALLS. /  Return to her on ROUTE 111 for another.

AshenWoods_Text_VialCatchBlob.current: {PLAYER} threw the HEAL BALL at Blob!

AshenWoods_Text_VialBlobCaught.current: Click! Blob was caught! //  The nurse is waiting on ROUTE 111.

AshenWoods_Text_VialBlobKeepsRunning.current: Blob disappeared deeper into the ash. /  The chase is not over yet.

AshenWoods_Text_VialBlobCornered.current: Blob reached the far edge of the woods. /  There is nowhere else to run.

DewfordMeadow_Text_ManorSign.current: DEWFORD MANOR: Once a sea captain's /  escape, now home only to POKéMON.

ScorchedSlab_HeatransRoom_Text_PlaceMagm.current: The MAGMA STONE is reacting /  to something… //  Will you set it down here?

VerdanturfMeadow_Text_Warden.current: DEERLING graze among these flowers. /  They evolve into SAWSBUCK at Lv. 34. //  A SUN STONE used on PETILIL in this /  meadow yields Hisuian LILLIGANT. /  Use it elsewhere for the usual form.
